article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola patients flee hospitals in the Democratic Republic of the Congo amid a hunger crisis.
article.articleSummary: Nearly 900 people in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo are infected with Ebola, with over 25% fatalities. Since late May, more than 150 Ebola patients have fled treatment and isolation centres in search of food, including an incident in the Mongbvalu district where 11 patients left a hospital due to shortages. Health workers are tracing about 6,400 individuals who may have been exposed. The hunger crisis is hindering outbreak control as communities face a trade-off between quarantine and sustenance. The World Food Programme estimates at least $175 million is needed to sustain humanitarian operations in Congo through November. International actors, including the G7, are coordinating the response to the Ebola outbreak in Africa as the situation evolves.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ患者が飢饉危機のため病院から逃げている
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイク（900人感染、25%以上の致死率）、患者の治療中断による制御困難化、国際的対応の必要性が認識されており、IHR基準およびWPRO基準の複数に該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、イベントはコンゴ民主共和国東部で実際に発生していることが明確。飢饉による治療中断がアウトブレイク制御を著しく困難にしており、約6,400人の曝露者追跡が進行中。G7を含む国際的な対応調整が行われている。WFPの資金需要（1.75億ドル以上）が指摘されており、国際支援の緊急性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Пацієнти з Еболою тікають із лікарень у Конго через голодну кризу
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Patients with Ebola flee from hospitals in Congo due to a hunger crisis.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo has grown to nearly 900 people affected, with more than 25% mortality. Since the end of May, over 150 Ebola patients have fled treatment and isolation centers seeking food, including an incident near Mongbalu where 11 patients escaped. Health authorities are tracing about 6,400 potential contacts. Hunger is severely hindering containment, forcing families to choose between quarantine and survival. The World Food Programme warns that hunger directly undermines outbreak response. To sustain humanitarian operations in the DRC through November, at least $175 million is needed.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ患者が飢饉危機により病院から逃亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上に該当し、エボラ出血熱の大規模流行で公衆衛生への深刻な影響が明らかである。患者の逃亡により隔離が失われ、国際的拡大リスクが高い。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行（約900人罹患、25%以上の死亡率）にて、患者150人以上が飢饉を理由に治療・隔離施設から逃亡。6,400人の接触者追跡が継続中。飢饉による隔離破綻が封じ込めを著しく困難にしており、国際的支援（1.75億ドル以上）が急務。DRCは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。

article.articleHeadline: OMS menține alerta: Ebola a ucis peste 200 de persoane în Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO maintains the alert: Ebola has killed over 200 people in Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in North-East Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri province) has surpassed 200 deaths with 875 laboratory-confirmed infections and 202 fatalities as of mid-June 2026; the cluster was officially declared May 15. The Bundibugyo virus strain has no vaccine or specific treatment. In Uganda, 19 cases and 2 deaths have been confirmed; Africa CDC reported Uganda’s situation under control as of June 11. WHO maintains an international health alert, with very high public health risk in the DRC, high regional risk, and low global risk. Transmission occurs via close contact and bodily fluids, with hemorrhagic fever symptoms. The region’s accessibility is hindered by poor road infrastructure and armed-group insecurity, complicating response efforts. NGOs warn of severe gaps in health-system organization. The epicenter is Ituri, raising cross-border spillover concerns into Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: WHO がアラートを維持：コンゴでエボラが 200 人以上を殺害
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つすべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。DRC における Bundibugyo ウイルス株アウトブレイク（200 人以上死亡、875 確定例）であり、ウガンダへの越境拡大が確認されている。WHO が国際的保健警告を発令中。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーにはウガンダでの 19 確定例および 2 死亡が記載されているが、サマリーの主題はコンゴ DRC（Ituri 州）のアウトブレイク中心であり、ウガンダは二次的言及である。DRC が対象国リストに含まれているため verified_locations に含める。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。vaccine なし、治療法なし、アクセシビリティの問題、武装勢力による不安定性が対応を複雑化させており、manageability は Yes。

article.articleHeadline: سيستخدم مركز السيطرة على الأمراض 107 مليون دولار من التمويل الطارئ لاستجابة إيبولا في جمهورية الكونغو الديمقراطية وأوغندا - ميزو نيوز
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The CDC will use $107 million in emergency funding for the Ebola response in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda - Mezu News
article.articleSummary: CDC allocates $107 million in emergency funding for Ebola response in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda, addressing Bundibugyo virus disease (BVD), a rare Ebola virus illness. The western DRC/eastern Uganda border outbreak is the third-largest on record. As of June 15, 2026, 837 confirmed cases in the DRC and 19 in Uganda have been reported, with 198 total deaths across both countries; about 31 health zones in the DRC are affected, and Kampala, Uganda has 31 cases. The case fatality rate for this outbreak is estimated at 30–50%. Transmission occurs via direct contact with blood, body fluids, and contaminated surfaces; the global risk remains low. The US CDC deploys 23 field staff and 125 other personnel in the two countries. Total Ebola response funding rises to about $910 million, with donor contributions under 10%. CDC aims to control the outbreak in both nations and maintain internal readiness for spillover.

triage.headline_ja: CDCが民主コンゴ共和国とウガンダでのエボラ対応に1億700万ドルの緊急資金を使用
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo virus disease）の確認された多国間アウトブレイク（837件確認例、198死亡）であり、IHR基準の4項目すべてに該当する重大事象。緊急対応資金の投入と国際的対応の実施により、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限の可能性が明確。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC（民主コンゴ共和国）とウガンダが主な発生地とされているが、対象国リストではDRCのみが該当するため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを記載した。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。Bluedot APIの「発生地域」ではUgandaと米国も含まれているが、記事の主題は両国でのアウトブレイク対応であり、米国は支援国として位置付けられている。

article.articleHeadline: 美FDA專家力挺莫德納流感疫苗　剛果伊波拉疫情告急 - 民視新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: U.S. FDA experts back Moderna's influenza vaccine; Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is dire
article.articleSummary: Influenza vaccination breakthrough in the United States as FDA advisory committee unanimously (9-0) endorses Moderna's mRNA influenza vaccine for adults aged 50 and older, signaling the first seasonal mRNA flu vaccine. Simultaneously, Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo remains dire as WHO's PHEIC enters its second month; health systems are collapsing with shortages of healthcare workers, ambulances, and even construction materials for isolation wards. Africa CDC notes that only a fraction of pledged funds—less than 10% of the $910 million—has arrived; CDC has activated $107 million in emergency funds to support outbreak response. Also, the United States moves to address flu season by approving Roche's single-dose antiviral Xofluza for influenza. Overall, US regulatory decisions spur vaccination advances while Ebola response faces critical funding and logistics gaps in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: 米FDA専門家がモデルナのインフルエンザワクチンを支持；コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行は危機的
triage.triage_reason: エボラ流行は IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WHO PHEIC発動中で深刻な公衆衛生上の影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスクがある。DRCの保健システム崩壊と資金不足により管理困難性も高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではエボラ流行がDRC東部を中心に深刻化し、WHO PHEIC第2ヶ月に突入、保健システム崩壊と資金不足が明記されている。インフルエンザワクチン承認はUS国内の規制動向であり、DRCのエボラ流行が主要な懸念事項。発生地域にUSが含まれているが、該当するインフルエンザイベントはワクチン承認という公衆衛生上の好機であり、感染症の新規発生ではないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: Viêm gan B kèm nhiễm xoắn khuẩn gây vàng da
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hepatitis B with spirochete infection causing jaundice
article.articleSummary: 42-year-old man in Ho Chi Minh City with chronic hepatitis B and cirrhosis, irregular antiviral therapy, was laboratory-confirmed to have Leptospira infection causing jaundice. At Tam Anh General Hospital, he presented with ten days of fever. Liver enzymes were 5–10× ULN; total bilirubin 106.9 μmol/L and direct 60.9 μmol/L, with evident jaundice. Leptospira bacteria inhabit water, moist soil, and environments contaminated by animal urine, especially rats. Coexisting chronic liver disease can worsen hepatic injury and may precipitate renal dysfunction, hemorrhage, sepsis, and multi-organ damage if untreated. After antibiotic therapy and liver-supportive care, fever subsided, jaundice diminished, and discharge occurred after two weeks. Leptospirosis is not rare in Vietnam but often overlooked due to flu-like early symptoms. Prevention focuses on environmental hygiene, rodent control, protective clothing when cleaning damp areas, and proper wound care.

triage.headline_ja: レプトスピラ菌感染を伴うB型肝炎が黄疸を引き起こす
triage.triage_reason: ホーチミン市における単一の重症例（42歳男性の慢性B型肝炎患者のレプトスピラ症重複感染）の報告。WPROスクリーニング基準「重症度」に該当するが、現時点で国際的拡大リスク、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、社会政治的関心の明確な兆候がない。続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 単一症例報告であり、患者は抗生物質療法と肝臓支持療法により回復している。ベトナムではレプトスピラ症は珍しくないとされているが、インフルエンザ様症状の早期段階では見落とされやすい。動物からの環境汚染および水系感染リスクが存在するため、引き続き監視が適切。

article.articleHeadline: Africa CDC Warns Ebola Outbreak In Congo And Uganda Kills Over 200 As Cases Rise Fast - The Logical Indian
article.articleSummary: As of 19 June 2026, Africa CDC warns of a fast-spreading Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (eastern regions) and neighboring Uganda, with over 894 confirmed cases and more than 200 deaths in the first month across 32 health zones, and cross-border transmission into Uganda. The rare Bundibugyo strain appears to drive transmission, with case counts rising 38% in one week. Contact tracing is severely constrained, with fewer than 15% of an estimated 35,000 exposed individuals traced, hampered by conflict, displacement, difficult terrain, and insecurity. The outbreak unfolds in conflict-affected, remote areas, stressing fragile health systems and raising regional spillover risk via informal trade routes and population movement. Uganda has intensified cross-border surveillance along affected frontiers, but surveillance and response remain strained.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカCDCがコンゴおよびウガンダのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク警告 - 200人以上の死亡、症例数急増
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。致死率の高いBundibugyo株による急速な国際拡大（894確定患者、200人以上の死亡）、脆弱な疫学調査体制、国境を越えた感染拡大のリスクが高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは「コンゴ東部地域とウガンダへの国境を越えた感染拡大」と記載されているが、記事のGeoNamesリストにUganda（ID1850144）は含まれていない。対象国リストにもウガンダは含まれていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとしている。DRC内での確定患者894名、死亡200名以上という深刻な状況が報告されており、紛争地域での感染者追跡困難（追跡率15%未満）、脆弱な保健体制が懸念される。Bundibugyo株の週38%の増加率は急速な拡大を示唆している。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : 782 cas confirmés et 181 décès, l'Ituri demeure l'épicentre de la 17e épidémie (bilan du 13 juin)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: 782 confirmed cases and 181 deaths, Ituri remains the epicenter of the 17th Ebola outbreak (as of June 13).
article.articleSummary: Ebola in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo reports 782 confirmed cases and 181 deaths (case fatality 23.1%) as of June 13, with Ituri remaining the epicenter. This is the 17th Ebola outbreak in DRC and the first linked to Bundibugyo; there is no vaccine or specific treatment for this strain, unlike the Zaïre-targeting Ervebo. The outbreak spans three provinces: Ituri (20 health zones), North Kivu (10), and South Kivu (Miti-Murhesa; 1), affecting 31 health zones. By June 13, 56 patients had recovered and 359 were in isolation or hospital; contact follow-up stood at 56.5%. Transmission is rising, with cases increasing more than eightfold from 63 on May 22 to 515 by June 6; WHO notes intensified transmission and a higher regional risk. Response relies on standard public health measures. Security challenges and community mistrust hamper sample transport and contact tracing; a helpline (151) exists; PHEIC declared May 17.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ：確認症例782件、死亡181件、イトゥリが第17次流行の中心地のままである（6月13日現在の集計）
triage.triage_reason: Bundibugyo系エボラウイルスの新規発生で、IHR基準4項目全てに該当し、WHOがPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）を5月17日に既に宣言している極めて高リスクのシグナル。
triage.notes: 本イベントはWHOがPHEIC宣言（5月17日）済みの既知シグナルであるが、継続的な進行状況の監視が必須。Bundibugyo系統の出現は新規リスク要因。セキュリティ上の課題と地域社会の不信が対応を阻害。症例数が指数関数的に増加（5月22日の63件から6月6日の515件）している点に注意。現在のところワクチンが存在しない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola patients flee treatment centres in Congo for food as hunger crisis deepens
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo has infected almost 900 people and killed more than a quarter, as of 19 June 2026. Hunger and food insecurity in eastern Congo drive isolation challenges, with more than 150 escapes from Ebola treatment and isolation facilities since late May; about 6,400 people may have been exposed. Ituri Province accounts for more than 90% of confirmed cases, with the epicenter around Mongbwalu; incidents include 11 suspected patients fleeing a hospital in Bambu, 40 km from the outbreak center. The World Food Programme distributes hot meals at treatment centres and to contacts and affected families, delivering 590 meals in one day. WFP seeks $175 million for Congo operations, including $32 million for Ebola activities; funding shortfalls hamper response amid a broader hunger crisis affecting nearly 10 million people.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ患者が食糧不足のため治療センターから脱出、コンゴで飢饉危機が深刻化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてに該当し、WPRO基準でも5項目すべてに該当する。エボラウイルス病の大規模発生であり、患者の脱出による感染拡大リスク、国際的な支援需要が明確。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）でのエボラ発生を主題とし、イタリアは発生地域フィールドに含まれるが本体事象に関係なく除外。2026年6月19日時点で約900人の感染者と250人以上の死亡が報告されており、患者の脱出（150件以上）による接触者の曝露リスクが約6,400人に及ぶ。飢餓危機による治療施設の機能不全がリスク増加要因。WFP による支援が活動中だが資金不足が指摘されている。フルRRA推奨。

article.articleHeadline: NAJMANJE 90 MRTVIH I 12.000 ZARAŽENIH! Kolera hara Nigerijom, broj žrtava raste!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: At least 90 dead and 12,000 infected! Cholera ravages Nigeria, death toll rising!
article.articleSummary: Nigeria’s Borno state reports a cholera outbreak with at least 90 deaths and more than 12,000 cases since it began in early May. Humanitarian agencies, led by UN OCHA, are expanding treatment, case-surveillance, and access to safe water to curb transmission, with an additional $4 million from OCHA-managed funds allocated to emergency response; more funding is needed for prevention and care. Borno, in northeastern Nigeria, has long faced conflict and humanitarian crises that hinder control of infectious diseases. In the Democratic Republic of Congo, Ebola numbers rose to 635 confirmed cases and 127 deaths as of June 10, with 22 recoveries; new cases have not ignited widespread spread across health zones. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain was reported May 15 in a setting already affected by conflict across Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu, making this one of the largest Ebola outbreaks in the world.

triage.headline_ja: 少なくとも90人が死亡、12,000人が感染！コレラがナイジェリアを襲い、死亡者数が増加している！
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準を4つ中3つ満たす（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。複数の高致死性疾患（コレラとエボラ）の同時流行で、重症度、異常性、管理困難性が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの主題はコレラの流行。DRCはエボラ情報を含むが、コレラの主要発生地はナイジェリア（対象国外）。検証対象国はDRCのみ。ナイジェリアはWPRO基準の地域対象外だが、IHRとWHO通知要件は満たすため、DRCのエボラ確認に基づきPICKUP。複数疾患同時流行、高い致死率、紛争地帯での管理困難性が重要リスク要因。

article.articleHeadline: Riset BRIN: Limpa Bisa Jadi Tempat Persembunyian Parasit Malaria
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: BRIN Research: Limpa Could Be a Hiding Place for Malaria Parasites.
article.articleSummary: Malaria can hide in the spleen, not just in the blood, complicating elimination in Indonesia. BRIN researchers, including Ari Winasti Satyagraha of Eijkman BRIN, reported findings from Steven Kho (Menzies School of Health Research, Darwin, Australia) that the spleen may serve as a reservoir for Plasmodium vivax and Plasmodium falciparum, allowing parasites to persist outside peripheral blood and evade standard tests, potentially enabling asymptomatic carriers to retransmit to mosquitoes. The discovery emerged from a 12 June 2025 webinar on the spleen’s role in malaria pathogenesis. Concurrently, red blood cell disorders—G6PD deficiency, thalassemia, Hemoglobin E (HbE), and Southeast Asian Ovalocytosis (SAO)—arise under malaria pressure and can confer protection by inhibiting parasite growth, accelerating clearance of infected cells, or boosting immune responses. Implications for Indonesia’s elimination efforts are significant, highlighting the need for spleen-focused surveillance and integration of host genetics into control strategies.

triage.headline_ja: BRIN研究：脾臓がマラリア寄生虫の隠れ場所となる可能性
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアのマラリア制御に関する研究報告であり、異常性と長期曝露のリスクは認識されるが、現在のところ新規流行や急性危機の兆候がなく、情報が基礎研究レベルである。続報による状況確認が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはインドネシアにおけるマラリア研究成果の報告であり、脾臓への寄生虫の隠匿が除去戦略に影響する可能性を指摘している。オーストラリア（Menzies研究所との共同研究）は研究機関の所在地であり、実際の流行地は記事主題外。スクリーニング基準3つ該当するが、急性の流行信号ではなく、基礎研究レベルの発見であるため、引き続き現地の流行動向を監視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Study Explains How Anti-CRISPR Protein Promotes The Spread Of Hospital-Acquired Infections
article.articleSummary: Klebsiella pneumoniae, a common cause of hospital-acquired infections such as pneumonia and meningitis in immunocompromised patients, spreads antibiotic resistance via plasmids that carry resistance genes. Researchers from Skoltech in Russia, with U.S. and Chinese colleagues, report in PNAS that although K. pneumoniae harbors a CRISPR-Cas immune system targeting the resistance-carrying plasmid, the plasmid uses anti-CRISPR proteins to suppress immunity, enabling persistence and spread. The team identifies AcrIE9 and AcrIE10 as two anti-CRISPR proteins that typically operate in tandem, and also discovers a previously uncharacterized anti-CRISPR protein that may target bacterial DNA rather than CRISPR proteins. Experiments with E. coli showed the same plasmid can invade diverse species, suggesting anti-immunity genes facilitate conjugative plasmids and outbreaks of drug-resistant infections. The study recommends monitoring anti-immunity genes alongside resistance genes, with future work aiming to reactivate bacterial immunity to remove resistance plasmids.

triage.headline_ja: 抗CRISPR蛋白がどのように院内感染の拡大を促進するかを説明する研究
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は基礎研究論文の発表であり、実際の感染症アウトブレイクの発生を報告するものではない。疾患名フィールドの「E. coli」は研究の実験対象であり、臨床イベントではない。
triage.notes: 本記事はロシア・米国・中国の研究者による基礎研究の発表であり、特定の国での実在するアウトブレイクイベントではない。Bluedot APIが発生地域として複数国を検出しているが、これは論文著者の所属機関の所在地であり、感染症イベントの発生地ではない。シグナル対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebolas upuru skaits Kongo DR pārsniedz 200
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola death toll in DR Congo surpasses 200.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri in the east, with cases also in North Kivu and South Kivu) reports 875 confirmed infections and 202 deaths, according to Africa CDC on 2026-06-19. Over the past week, confirmed cases rose 38%, though the true burden is believed higher since the outbreak was confirmed only on May 15 after symptoms began weeks earlier. Seventy-four recovered. Ituri houses the vast majority of cases (over 90%). Cross-border transmission is evident, with 19 infections and two deaths reported in neighboring Uganda. The report notes no additional laboratory details beyond Africa CDC figures; no specifics on symptoms or infection sources are provided. The situation indicates an ongoing, regional Ebola outbreak necessitating continued surveillance, containment, and cross-border cooperation.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ死亡者数が200人を超える
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当する。エボラウイルス病は公衆衛生上の深刻な影響を与え、875例の確定症例と202人の死亡を報告、国際的な拡大（ウガンダへの越境感染）と渡航・貿易制限のリスクがある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは DRC（Ituri、South Kivu、North Kivu州）でのエボラ発生を主題としている。Uganda への越境感染も報告されているが、Uganda は対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。症例数の急速な増加（1週間で38%上昇）、高い致命率、および越境感染の存在により、フルRRA（Rapid Risk Assessment）への進行が強く推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC: une épidémie sans vaccin, des groupes armés et une défiance populaire
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: an outbreak without a vaccine, armed groups and public mistrust
article.articleSummary: Seventeenth Ebola outbreak declared in the Democratic Republic of Congo on May 15 after Kinshasa’s lab confirmed Bundibugyo ebolavirus. The epicenter is Ituri province, notably Bunia, with 246 suspected cases and 80 deaths reported early on. A Congolese national died in Kampala, Uganda, marking an imported case; Uganda later reported 19 confirmed cases and 2 deaths and closed its border with DRC. The WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern; Africa CDC warned ten African countries are at risk. Bundibugyo has no vaccine or specific treatment; existing vaccines protect only Zaire ebolavirus, so control relies on isolation and contact tracing. Bunia airport has been suspended to facilitate humanitarian access. Africa CDC hopes a Bundibugyo vaccine by year-end; trials are underway. Testing capacity is weak; within two weeks there were about 1,140 suspected cases and 246 deaths. Local mistrust and violence hinder the response; Tedros visited Kinshasa and Bunia urging containment. International travel restrictions and visa policies vary.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：ワクチンなしの流行、武装勢力、そして国民の不信
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準5項目すべてに該当。WHOが国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）を宣言、複数国への波及確認、高い死亡率、ワクチン欠如による管理困難性が認められ、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの越境感染例（1死亡、確定症例19例）およびアフリカCDCによる10カ国への波及リスク警告が記事に明記されているが、ウガンダは対象国外のため verified_locations に含めない。Bundibugyo ebolavirus はワクチン及び特異的治療法がなく、感染制御が困難。WHOがPHEIC宣言、国際的な旅行制限が実施されている。

article.articleHeadline: Количество умерших от лихорадки Эбола в ДР Конго увеличилось до 232
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of deaths from Ebola virus disease in the DR Congo has risen to 232.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has reached 232 deaths and 896 confirmed cases, as of June 18 in the government daily bulletin. Transmission remains ongoing among residents in districts affected by the outbreak, with health authorities warning of the risk of further spread to other regions within the DRC. Reuters reports the health authorities’ concerns. Japanese researchers have stated that Ebola virus carriers from Africa could reach major European and Asian transit hubs within a month. Financial Times described the Congo outbreak as a dress rehearsal for a new global pandemic, citing shrinking health funding and waning public trust in science. An Evening Moscow article discusses what the virus is, its danger, its potential reach toward Russia, and available treatments. The report emphasizes international concern and potential implications for travel and public health measures.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ熱による死亡者数が232人に増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病は深刻な公衆衛生影響を持ち、232人の死亡と896人の確定症例は異常・予想外の規模、国際的拡大リスクと渡航制限のリスクが指摘されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはコンゴ民主共和国での発生流行が主題。日本の研究者によるヨーロッパ・アジアの主要経由地への到達可能性の指摘、Financial Timesによる「新たなグローバルパンデミックの予行演習」との指摘により、国際的関心が高い。発生地域にロシア連邦が含まれているが、サマリーではロシアでの実際の発症報告なく、潜在的なリスク議論にとどまるため verified_locations に含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Brote de ébola en Congo y Uganda supera las 200 muertes en un mes y África CDC advierte que aún está lejos de ser controlado
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in Congo and Uganda has surpassed 200 deaths in a month, and Africa CDC warns that it is still far from being under control.
article.articleSummary: Ebola Bundibugyo outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo and neighboring Uganda has surpassed 200 deaths in its first month, with 894 confirmed cases and up to 35,000 contacts under follow-up. Ituri Province accounts for more than 90% of cases, with additional spread in North and South Kivu amid movement and access challenges. Uganda reports 19 cases and 2 deaths, signaling cross-border transmission. The Bundibugyo variant lacks approved vaccines or specific therapies. Cases rose 38% in a week as surveillance expands to 32 health zones. About 74 recoveries have been reported. A major barrier is contact tracing: for 800+ cases, 17,000-35,000 contacts would require monitoring, but only around 4,000 are under surveillance. Ongoing conflict, displacement (nearly 1 million in Ituri), and mining-driven mobility impede response. Africa CDC needs 540 workers but has 84; funding (over $900 million pledged) remains largely undisbursed, with ~90 million released.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴとウガンダのエボラ出血熱の流行が1ヶ月で200人以上の死亡を超え、アフリカCDCは依然として制御下にあることはほど遠いと警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当。Bundibugyo型エボラ出血熱で1ヶ月で200人以上の死亡、894例の確認症例、国境を越えた二次感染（ウガンダへの伝播）、ワクチン未認可、接触者追跡の著しい不足（4,000/17,000-35,000）により公衆衛生影響が極めて深刻かつ異常。国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではエボラ出血熱の流行の主な発生地はコンゴ民主共和国のイトゥリ州、南キブ州で、ウガンダへの国境を越えた伝播（19例、2死亡）が報告されている。対象国リストではコンゴ民主共和国（ID:203312）のみ該当。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。Bundibugyo型は致死率が高く、ワクチン未認可、治療法なし、接触者追跡体制が極めて不十分（23-89%の追跡率）で管理不可能な状況。紛争、国内避難民（イトゥリで約100万人）、採掘関連の移動による複雑な状況。アフリカCDCの職員不足（84/540人）と資金配分の遅延が重大な懸念。

article.articleHeadline: Ужасът Ебола: Вирусът се крие в тялото години след оздравяване и може да удари отново
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola Horror: The virus hides in the body for years after recovery and can strike again.
article.articleSummary: Persistent Ebola virus infection: A Nature Microbiology study shows Ebola can linger in the brain long after clinical recovery. Using lab-grown mini-brains, scientists found Ebola can infect brain immune cells—astrocytes and microglia—and immune molecules produced in these models fail to clear the virus, implying current treatments may not fully eradicate persistence. Survivors may develop meningitis, brain inflammation, or ocular disease months after infection, and researchers identified a mutated, longer-lasting but defective viral genome in late-stage persistent infections, raising questions about its impact on human disease. The team aims to determine whether such persistence occurs in people. The finding occurs during an ongoing Ebola outbreak in Africa as of 2026-06-19, with about 200 deaths and hundreds of cases in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with rising cross-border cases detected in Uganda. Ebola spreads via contact with blood or bodily fluids; bats are thought to be the natural reservoir.

triage.headline_ja: エボラの恐怖：ウイルスは回復後も数年間体内に潜み、再び襲いかかる可能性がある
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当する。進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク（DRC＆ウガンダ、約200死亡）と、ウイルス持続感染に関する新知見が組み合わさっており、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限の可能性がある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーにウガンダの記述（「rising cross-border cases detected in Uganda」）がある一見重要な内容だが、対象国リストにウガンダが含まれないため verified_locations に含めない。DRCは対象国であり記事の主要な焦点であるため含める。進行中のアウトブレイク（約200死亡、数百症例）と持続感染に関する新知見の組み合わせにより、緊急なシグナル特性を有する。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Claims More Than 200 Lives in DR Congo
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Ebola outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo virus, the 17th Ebola outbreak, concentrated in Ituri province in eastern DRC, accounting for >90% of 875 confirmed cases and 202 deaths (case fatality 23%) within its first month since declaring outbreak on May 15. By June 19, 2026, 67 recoveries and 379 patients in isolation or hospitalized have been reported. The northeastern provinces Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu face conflict-driven insecurity; contact tracing hampered by remoteness and security challenges, delaying control. A Red Cross official warned the peak may still be ahead and containment could take up to a year. The outbreak has spilled across the border to Uganda, with 19 confirmed cases and two deaths. The Bundibugyo virus has no approved vaccines or treatments, compounding response difficulties.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱がコンゴ民主共和国で200人以上の命を奪う
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。公衆衛生への深刻な影響（死亡202人、CFR23%）、異常な大規模アウトブレイク、複数国への国際的拡大（ウガンダへ波及）、渡航・貿易制限リスク。WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目すべてに該当。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの波及も記事に明記されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations に含めない。DRCにおいて、Bundibugyo型エボラウイルスによる第17次アウトブレイク。発症後1ヶ月で875例確定、死亡202例（CFR23%）。治療法やワクチンがない。紛争地帯での流行により制御困難な状況。Red Cross当局はピークがまだ先の可能性を指摘。

article.articleHeadline: Casos de Ébola aumentam quase 40% numa semana, número de mortos ultrapassa os 200
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola cases rise nearly 40% in a week; the death toll surpasses 200.
article.articleSummary: On 19 June 2026, the Ebola outbreak in eastern Congo and Uganda has reached 894 confirmed cases and over 200 deaths in its first month, three times larger than Uganda’s 2000 outbreak (281). Confirmed on 15 May, the cluster spans 32 health zones, with Ituri province accounting for more than 90% of cases; North Kivu and South Kivu report cases, and Uganda has 19 cases and two deaths. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus; there are no approved vaccines or treatments for Bundibugyo, while Zaire ebolavirus—more common in Congo—has a vaccine. About 74 people have recovered; experimental monoclonal antibodies are being developed for Bundibugyo. Contact tracing is hampered by insecurity and displacement in Ituri (nearly one million) and miners’ movements. Africa CDC estimates 17,000–35,000 contacts for roughly 800 confirmed cases, but only about 4,000 have been traced; funding shortfalls persist: over $900 million promised, only about $90 million available; 540 responders needed, 84 deployed.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ症例が1週間で約40％増加、死亡者数が200人を超える
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラウイルス感染症（Bundibugyo種）による大規模多国家アウトブレイク（894確定症例、200人以上の死亡）、初月で過去アウトブレイクの3倍規模、国際的拡大（ウガンダへの波及）、接触者追跡困難、資金不足等から制御困難な状況。
triage.notes: 発生地域にUganda（Republic of Uganda）が列挙されているが、記事サマリーではウガンダは19症例2死亡の波及地域として言及されており、主要な発生地はコンゴ東部（Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu）。対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみのため verified_locations に DRC のみを記載。本アウトブレイクはワクチン・治療法がない Bundibugyo ebolavirus による初の大規模流行で、資金枯渇、セキュリティ問題による接触者追跡の困難さ等から制御不能のリスクが高い。速やかなフルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Следы древнейшей в истории эпидемии чумы обнаружили в Сибири
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Traces of the oldest plague epidemic in history discovered in Siberia.
article.articleSummary: Yersinia pestis-related plague traces identified in Siberia near Lake Baikal reveal the oldest known epidemic, about 5,500 years ago among hunter-gatherers. An international team analyzed 46 skeletal remains and found plague bacteria in 39% of individuals, indicating substantial exposure within small family groups. Primary origins appear to be bites from wild marmots around Baikal, with subsequent human-to-human transmission contributing to mortality, especially among children aged 8–11. The findings, published in Nature, challenge the view that European origins or Neolithic agricultural transitions were prerequisites for plague pandemics, showing outbreaks far earlier and farther from Europe. Some Baikal-region samples predate European counterparts, suggesting northern Eurasian roots for early plague. The study underscores that ancient outbreaks could be deadly in relatively mobile, small communities, prompting revisions to models of plague emergence and spread.

triage.headline_ja: シベリアで発見された歴史上最古のペスト流行の痕跡
triage.triage_reason: 本件は5,500年前の古代における考古学的発見に関する学術記事であり、現在進行中の感染症イベントではない。現在の公衆衛生リスクは存在しない。
triage.notes: 本記事は5,500年前のシベリア（バイカル湖近郊）における古代ペスト流行の考古学的・遺伝学的証拠についての歴史的研究報告である。Nature誌に掲載された学術論文の報道であり、現在進行中の感染症イベントとして評価すべきものではない。Bluedot APIが発生地域としてThailandやRussian Federationを抽出しているが、サマリーは歴史上の古代イベントを扱っており、現在の感染症リスクには該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Chennai Corporation to conduct mass polio immunisation drive for 5.56 lakh children on June 28
article.articleSummary: Chennai Corporation will conduct a mass polio immunisation drive on 28 June for 5.56 lakh children, marking the 29th consecutive year of the nationwide campaign. A preparatory orientation chaired by Joint Commissioner (Health) VP Jayaseelan at Ripon Building reviewed readiness with senior officials. To achieve 100% coverage, the Greater Chennai Corporation will set up 1,641 immunisation booths citywide, operating 7 am–5 pm. Booths will be located at Urban Community Health Centres, government hospitals, schools, nutrition centres, private hospitals, railway stations, and bus terminals. In addition, 52 mobile booths will target high-traffic hubs, including Marina Beach and the Koyambedu Chennai Mofussol Bus Terminus (CMBT).

triage.headline_ja: チェンナイ市が6月28日に556万人の子どもを対象とした大規模ポリオ予防接種キャンペーンを実施
triage.triage_reason: ポリオ予防接種キャンペーンは定期的な公衆衛生活動であり、新たな感染症イベント・アウトブレイク報告ではない。IHR基準・WPRスクリーニング基準のいずれにも該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事はポリオ予防接種キャンペーンの実施案内であり、ポリオ患者の発生やアウトブレイク報告ではない。29年連続の定期キャンペーンであることが明記されており、異常事象ではない。シグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: 174 Kasus Suspek Flu Singapura Ditemukan di Bandung Barat
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 174 Suspected Singapore Flu Cases Found in West Bandung Regency
article.articleSummary: 174 suspected Singapore flu cases (Hand, Foot, and Mouth Disease, HFMD) detected in West Bandung Regency, West Java, Indonesia, as of June 19, 2026. All cases reported by health facilities across Bandung Barat remain suspects; no confirmed positives due to limited diagnostic capacity. Symptoms include red lesions on hands and feet and mouth ulcers. Officials caution HFMD is virus-driven and typically resolves with adequate immunity, but dehydration is a key risk when mouth sores impede eating and drinking. Transmission is via feces, bodily fluids, fomites, and food (4F); thus emphasis on hygiene and maintaining strong immunity to prevent spread. No follow-up testing underway due to equipment shortages. Highlights the need for surveillance and preventive measures in Bandung Barat.

triage.headline_ja: バンドゥン・バラッ県で174件のシンガポール風邪（手足口病）疑い患者を検出
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア・西ジャワ州で174件のEV71疑い患者が報告されており、WPRO基準で異常性・流行性が認められる。しかし確定例がなく診断能力の限界があるため、情報確度と重症度の評価が困難。続報と確定例の報告を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事は西ジャワ州バンドゥン・バラッ県での174件のEV71（手足口病）疑い患者を報告している。確定例がなく、診断機器の不足により確認検査が実施されていない点が重要。WPRO基準では4項目該当するが、IHR基準は1項目のみ（異常性）で、確定例・重症度・死亡の報告がないため判定は控え目。ただしEV71は小児を中心とした流行性が高く、衛生環境が課題とされているため、続報と確定診断の結果を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Kerala Ebola Case: केरळात इबोलाचा नवा रुग्ण? सुदानवरून आलेली महिला आजारी; हाय अलर्ट
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kerala Ebola Case: A New Ebola Patient in Kerala? Woman from Sudan Is Ill; High Alert.
article.articleSummary: Suspected Ebola case in Kerala, India: A 52-year-old South Sudan-returnee and Pala resident is in isolation at Kottayam Medical College, presenting with fever, headache, muscle pains and sore throat. Blood samples have been sent to a local laboratory for Ebola confirmation; results are not yet available. Precautionary contact tracing has been initiated as the health department maintains high alert after Ebola outbreaks in Africa. The patient had sought care at a private hospital on fever onset; authorities are monitoring her condition and advising public calm. Kerala Health Minister K. Murali Dharan said there is no cause for immediate panic, but vigilance is being maintained, including monitoring travelers from Africa and reinforcing surveillance at healthcare facilities. Ebola transmits via bodily fluids and presents with fever, weakness, vomiting, diarrhea, and bleeding, per officials.

triage.headline_ja: ケーララでエボラ疑い例：スーダンからの帰国女性が発症、高度警戒態勢
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）し、WPRO基準でも複数項目該当。エボラ疑い例は重篤な感染症であり、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが返した発生地域にChad、Sudan、Keralaなど複数国が含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題は『インド・ケーララ州で検出された疑い例』であり、患者が南スーダンからの帰国者であることと、アフリカでのアウトブレイク背景は状況説明に過ぎない。したがってverified_locationsはIndiaのみ。確定例ではなく疑い例だが、エボラウイルス病は致死率が極めて高く（種によって40～90%）、疑い段階でも迅速な確認検査と接触者追跡が必要。検査結果が未確定であることと、当局が適切に隔離・接触者追跡を実施中である点は良好だが、検査結果の報告待ちのため進展を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Members of 3 families fall ill after eating malai peda: FDA suspends licence of this popular dairy
article.articleSummary: Three families in India fell ill after consuming malai peda from Guru Nanak Dairy, leading to the suspension of the retailer’s licence and a stop-work order on the manufacturing unit as investigations proceed. Victims include a 14-year-old boy, a 44-year-old woman, and a 48-year-old man, among others, who reportedly became ill after meals at home where the peda was the only outside food; several were admitted to the ICU. Police alerted the Food and Drug Administration, and authorities await laboratory findings before further action. Preliminary assessments point to food poisoning, with the department planning action if the product is deemed unsafe. Potential causes cited include improper storage of milk-based ingredients during hot weather, contamination or adulteration of khoya (as warned by FSSAI), and cross-contamination during preparation, which can allow bacteria such as Salmonella or E. coli to trigger nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, and stomach cramps. If lab results confirm danger, a case will be registered under applicable laws.

triage.headline_ja: 3つの家族がマライペダ摂取後に発病：FDAが人気乳製品企業のライセンスを停止
triage.triage_reason: 食品由来の感染症アウトブレイク（チフス菌、パラチフス菌、大腸菌の可能性）で複数家族が罹患し、ICU入院者を含む。公衆衛生当局が対応を開始し、食品販売許可が停止された。IHR基準2つ以上該当かつWPRO基準複数該当でシグナルとして識別。
triage.notes: チフス菌およびパラチフス菌は報告疾患であり、食品汚染由来の多家族規模の罹患は公衆衛生上の懸念。ICU入院者の存在と複数病原体の関与（Salmonella、E. coli）が確認されている。当局の積極的対応（ライセンス停止、製造停止命令、検査実施中）が継続中。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Cases in Congo Climb to 896 as Outbreak Continues to Spread
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak (Bundibugyo strain) has reached 896 confirmed cases and 232 deaths as of 2026-06-19. Twenty-one new confirmed cases and six deaths were reported on Wednesday, from Ituri and North Kivu, with the outbreak spanning 33 health zones in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu. Isolation or hospital treatment involves 383 patients; 78 have recovered, including 11 declared recovered on Wednesday after follow-up testing. There are 151 suspected cases (35 deaths) still under investigation. A total of 6,367 contacts are being monitored; 4,525 were reached recently, for a 71.1% follow-up rate. This is the DRC’s 17th Ebola outbreak, first reported in May 2026, and has crossed into Uganda (Kampala). Vaccines/treatments developed for Zaire strain may not be fully effective against Bundibugyo. Ongoing conflict hampers response; ~1.9 million in aid need in the affected provinces. International teams operate in Bunia, Mongbwalu, and Goma.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのエボラ症例が896件に急増、感染拡大が続く
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の確認症例896件、死亡232件という大規模な公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と、DRC・ウガンダへの国際的拡大が確認されており、IHR基準3項目以上該当。WPROスクリーニング基準も全項目該当。
triage.notes: DRC での 17 番目のエボラアウトブレイク（Bundibugyo株）。2026年5月に最初に報告。ウガンダのカンパラへの越境確認。紛争の影響により対応が阻害されている。国際支援チームが展開中。ワクチン/治療薬の有効性が不完全である可能性あり。

article.articleHeadline: No vaccine, conflict, mistrust: Ebola's return to DR Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo's Ituri province, centered in Bunia and Mongbwalu; the 17th outbreak was declared on May 15 after weeks of undetected spread. By that date, 246 suspected cases and 80 deaths had been recorded; initial tests failed to detect the Bundibugyo strain, delaying identification. The country now reports 19 confirmed cases and 2 deaths, with Uganda closing its border with the DRC after a Congolese traveller death linked to the outbreak, highlighting cross-border risk to as many as 10 countries per Africa CDC. The Bundibugyo strain has no approved vaccine or specific treatment; existing vaccines target the Zaire strain, though a Bundibugyo-targeted vaccine could be available by year-end pending trials. The outbreak unfolds in Ituri amid militia violence, displacement camps, weak health systems, and logistical challenges, with early symptoms resembling malaria and later hemorrhagic signs.

triage.headline_ja: ワクチンなし、紛争、不信：エボラのコンゴ民主共和国への回帰
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の新規アウトブレイクで重篤性が高く、国家的対応が必要。Bundibugyo株で既存ワクチンが無効であり、国境を超えた感染拡大リスクがある。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株は既存ワクチン・特異的治療法なし。Ituri州での紛争・避難キャンプ・脆弱な医療体制により対応困難。ウガンダが国境を閉鎖、10カ国への波及リスクあり。5月15日に第17次アウトブレイクとして宣言、検出遅延により初期段階で拡大。

article.articleHeadline: गाजियाबाद में पोलियो अभियान: भीषण गर्मी में वैक्सीन की 'कोल्ड चेन' पर विशेष फोकस, सीसीटीवी से होगी निगरानी - ghaziabad polio vaccine cold chain cctv monitoring ensured
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ghaziabad polio campaign: Special focus on the vaccine cold chain in the scorching heat, monitored by CCTV
article.articleSummary: Ghaziabad, Uttar Pradesh, launches a polio vaccination campaign after a sewage sample tested positive for Vaccine-Derived Poliovirus Type-1, signaling circulating risk. In extreme heat, authorities stress strict cold chain maintenance, with CCTV and the electronic Vaccine Store monitoring vaccine dispatch to sub-centers. About 9.32 lakh doses have been allocated; vaccines will be supplied by vans to centers in Loni, Dasna, Bhojpur, Vijaynagar, Modinagar, Muradnagar, and Dundahera. The Chief Medical Officer warned of strict action against officials, clinicians, and health workers for any lapse. For the first time, a dedicated surveillance team will monitor the entire campaign. More than 6,000 vaccination teams are being mobilized, with specialized training. Sensitive areas will receive intensified door-to-door vaccination efforts, targeting over 1,000 identified households under nodal officer supervision.

triage.headline_ja: ガジアバード：ポリオ予防接種キャンペーン - 酷熱の中でワクチンの『コールドチェーン』に特別な焦点、CCTVで監視
triage.triage_reason: Vaccine-Derived Poliovirus Type-1が下水サンプルから検出されたことによる予防接種キャンペーン実施。インドにおけるポリオは公衆衛生上極めて深刻であり、IHR基準（異常性、国際的拡大リスク）を満たしており、ワクチン由来株の検出は重要なシグナル。
triage.notes: ワクチン由来ポリオウイルス（VDPV）の下水検出は循環リスクを示唆するため、公衆衛生学的に重要。インドは既にポリオの蔓延地域としての歴史があり、VDPV検出は国際的警戒を要する。記事は予防接種キャンペーンの実施状況（冷蔵チェーン厳格化、6,000以上の予防接種チーム動員など）を記述しており、積極的な対応が取られている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : 896 cas confirmés et 232 décès un mois après la déclaration de l'épidémie
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: 896 confirmed cases and 232 deaths one month after the outbreak was declared.
article.articleSummary: One month after the Ebola outbreak was declared in the Democratic Republic of Congo, Ituri province (Bunia) reports a persistent outbreak: 896 confirmed cases and 232 deaths since onset, yielding a case-fatality rate of about 26%. Health Minister Samuel Roger Kamba stressed that these figures derive from laboratory-confirmed tests and a validation process involving national health authorities, WHO, Africa CDC, and partners. The 896 total includes cases diagnosed after declaration and some deaths investigated retroactively through surveillance analyses. Ituri remains the epicenter. The government will intensify the response with enhanced epidemiological surveillance, contact tracing, and expanded treatment capacity in affected zones. Communities are urged to promptly report symptomatic individuals to improve survival and limit transmission.

triage.headline_ja: RDC（コンゴ民主共和国）のエボラ出血熱：宣言後1ヶ月で確認症例896例、死亡232例
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（重篤な公衆衛生影響、高い死亡率、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限の可能性）。活動中の大規模流行であり、フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: Ituri州Buniaを中心とした現在進行中のエボラ流行。確認症例896例、死亡232例（CFR約26%）と実質的な死亡率。宣言後1ヶ月時点での報告であり、政府、WHO、Africa CDCが関与した検証プロセス済み。国際支援・サーベイランス強化が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Dịch Ebola: Tình hình tiếp tục diễn biến phức tạp, số ca mắc tăng nhanh
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak: The situation continues to develop in a complex manner, with cases rising rapidly.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda is described by Africa CDC as the most severe in the early phase of a spillover. As of 2026-06-19, DRC reports 896 confirmed cases and 232 deaths; Uganda reports 19 cases and 2 deaths. The outbreak covers 33 health zones across Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu in eastern DRC and has crossed into Uganda. It is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a rare strain with no licensed vaccine or approved specific therapy. About 74–78 patients have recovered; experimental treatments are under study. Contact tracing is hindered by insecurity, rugged terrain, staff shortages, and limited funding. With nearly 900 cases, 17,000–35,000 contacts may require follow-up, but only 4,000–6,300 are identified and monitored. Ituri accounts for >90% of cases amid protracted conflict and displacement (~1 million). UN CERF provides $4 million to Uganda for health, logistics, surveillance, and 29 districts; DRC receives more medical supplies and Kinshasa airport screening, plus enhanced cross-border coordination.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：状況は複雑に推移し続け、症例数が急速に増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当、WPRO基準5項目全て該当。DRC・ウガンダでの多数死亡例、国際的拡大、医療システム逼迫、国際支援必要性が明確。
triage.notes: ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations からは除外。記事サマリーはDRCとウガンダの両国での発生を述べるが、ウガンダ（GeoNames ID不明）は対象国リストに含まれていない。DRCは対象国リストに含まれるため含める。Bundibugyo ebolavirus による稀なアウトブレイク、ワクチン未承認、接触者追跡の困難性、大規模な流行可能性があり、極めて高いリスク。

article.articleHeadline: UNICEF-Sprecher: "Heute ist es Ebola. Was könnte es morgen sein?"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: UNICEF spokesperson: "Today it's Ebola. What could it be tomorrow?"
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of Congo, Ebola is now the third-largest outbreak globally and the 17th in the country, affecting a crisis-affected region where nearly one million people are displaced in Ituri. The Bundibugyo variant, previously rare, delayed detection because standard tests were often negative. The first official warning came on May 15, and by 2026-06-19 the outbreak had over 100 confirmed deaths with daily new cases across multiple health zones. Access is hindered by ongoing conflict; Goma’s airport, in North Kivu, has been closed for a year, complicating logistics. UNICEF, led by John James, is supplying protective gear, chlorine, medical materials, tents, soap, and handwashing facilities; educating communities on symptoms and care; engaging religious leaders, journalists, and local radio; training 1,500 community health workers with more planned; and deploying Web Watchers to counter misinformation. It highlights child and human rights and the need for safe access to care.

triage.headline_ja: ユニセフ報道官：「今日はエボラ。明日は何だろうか？」
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の大規模アウトブレイク（世界第3位、100人以上の確認死亡）がDRCで発生。IHR基準4項目全て該当し、WPRO基準も全て該当。国際的関心も高い。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo型エボラウイルスによる世界第3位の大規模アウトブレイク。北キブ州Goma空港閉鎖により物流阻害。紛争による医療アクセス制限が懸念。ユニセフによる大規模な対応実施中。即座のフルRRA実施が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 에볼라바이러스병 특별 주의 당부
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Special precautions urged for Ebola virus disease.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-19, Ebola virus disease (EVD) is circulating in parts of Africa, with Bundibugyo ebolavirus identified; the WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on 2026-05-17. In Korea, Uljin County Public Health Center has heightened surveillance to prevent overseas importation. Three Koreans returning from Uganda with symptoms were classified as suspected cases and admitted to designated hospital beds; all Ebola tests were negative. EVD transmits via blood and bodily fluids; incubation can be up to 21 days, with fever, severe headache, abdominal pain, and vomiting. Preventive measures include avoiding wildlife contact (fruit bats, monkeys, gorillas); washing hands for at least 30 seconds; avoiding contact with sick people and attendance at healthcare facilities or funerals (wear PPE if unavoidable); and not touching the face with contaminated hands. Travel to DR Congo, Uganda, South Sudan, Rwanda, and Ethiopia should be avoided; if travel is unavoidable, follow precautions and seek care/report within 21 days after return by calling 1339 or the local health center.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス病の特別注意喚起
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。WHOが2026-05-17にPHEICを宣言したアフリカのエボラウイルス病流行に対し、韓国で境界措置と検査体制が実施されている。対象国DRCおよびウガンダでの発生が確認されており、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが提供する発生地域には複数国（スーダン、エチオピア、ルワンダ、ウガンダなど）が含まれるが、対象国リストに該当するのはDRCのみ。記事サマリーでウガンダが言及されているが、ウガンダ（1269750の国リスト外）は対象国に含まれないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。WHOがPHEICを宣言しており、国際的な懸念レベルは高い。韓国での疑い患者検査結果はすべて陰性だが、継続的な監視体制が構築されている。

article.articleHeadline: No vaccine, conflict, mistrust: Ebola's return to DR Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola is spreading again in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, centered in Ituri province with 19 confirmed cases and two deaths; border with Uganda closed after a traveler’s death linked to the outbreak. The Bundibugyo strain has no approved vaccine or specific treatment, while existing vaccines for the Zaire strain do not protect Bundibugyo. WHO has declared a global health emergency; Africa CDC warns up to 10 countries could be at risk. The outbreak was declared May 15, after Mongbwalu in Ituri reported an illness. By May 15, 246 suspected cases and 80 deaths had been recorded in Ituri. Initial misdiagnoses and lab tests limited to Zaire strain delayed confirmation. Containment relies on basic measures (isolation, contact tracing) in a conflict-torn region with security challenges, displacement camps, and limited healthcare; a Bundibugyo-targeting vaccine could be available by year-end per Africa CDC, with spread across three provinces and into neighboring Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: ワクチンなし、紛争、不信：エボラがコンゴ民主共和国に戻ってきた
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WHO緊急宣言、複数国への越境リスク、深刻な死亡率が認められる。WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。フルRRA実施対象。
triage.notes: DRCのIturi州で確認されたエボラ（Bundibugyo株）の新規アウトブレイク。19確認症例、80疑似症例、80死亡記録。ウガンダへの越境事例あり（旅行者の死亡確認）。ワクチンなし、基層部での対応という極めて深刻な状況。WHO緊急宣言済み。Africa CDCは最大10ヶ国がリスクと警告。紛争地域での対策困難性も懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en Ituri : déjà 78 personnes guéries, Roger Kamba appelle à une prise en charge précoce
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Ituri: 78 people have already recovered; Roger Kamba calls for early treatment.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease is circulating in Ituri province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, with hundreds of cases and deaths reported; 78 patients have recovered since the outbreak began, announced by Health Minister Samuel Roger Kamba in Bunia. He noted that recovery requires initial positive tests followed by two negative tests and that early treatment improves survival, prompting hope that more patients may soon leave treatment centers. Survivors have publicly testified to rapid care after symptom onset, aiming to counter rumors and mistrust. The Ituri outbreak remains the most affected area, and authorities hope increasing recoveries will boost community trust and encourage early screening and presentation at treatment facilities.

triage.headline_ja: イトゥリ州のエボラ出血熱：既に78人が回復、ロジェ・カンバ保健大臣が早期治療を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の確認事例で、IHR基準4項目すべてに該当する（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、予想外の流行、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPRO基準も5項目すべて該当し、シグナルとして優先度が高い。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病の流行で、イトゥリ州ブニアを中心に発生。記事は数百例の患者と死亡例を報告し、78人の回復例を強調している。保健大臣が早期治療の重要性を強調していることから、当局の対応関心が高い。DRCが対象国リストに含まれるため、フルRRA進行推奨。

article.articleHeadline: कांगो में स्वास्थ्य मंत्रालय ने कहा, इबोला के मामले बढ़कर 896 हुए - Punjab Kesari
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Congo, the Health Ministry said Ebola cases have risen to 896.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo has risen to 896 confirmed cases with 232 deaths as of June 19, 2026. In eastern provinces Ituri and North Kivu, 21 new confirmed cases were reported, including 6 deaths. The outbreak now spans 33 health zones across Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu. Authorities report 383 patients in isolation or hospitalized, with 78 recoveries (including 11 after negative control tests). On Wednesday, 151 suspected cases were recorded, with 35 deaths among the suspected. A total of 6,367 contacts are being monitored, 4,525 reached during the reporting period (71.1% follow-up). The weekly rise in confirmed cases signals ongoing community transmission and a risk of geographic spread if public health measures are not promptly implemented. This is the 17th Ebola outbreak in DR Congo, declared May 15.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴの保健省がエボラ患者数が896人に増加したと発表
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラウイルス感染症の急速な拡大で、深刻な公衆衛生への影響、複数州への地理的拡大、国際的な感染リスク、渡航・貿易制限の可能性が認められる。
triage.notes: コンゴ民主共和国内での17番目のエボラ流行。記事は5月15日に宣言された現在の流行について報告している。複数の州（Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu）にわたる33の保健ゾーンに拡大。社会的・政治的関心が高く、コンタクト追跡によって継続的な地域感染が示されている。フルRRA実施が急務。

article.articleHeadline: Ghana Health Service to reach 8 million people with drugs on NTDs
article.articleSummary: Ghana Health Service launches nationwide Mass Drug Administration (MDA) June 20–July 3, 2026, to reach nearly eight million people with preventive treatment against three NTDs: onchocerciasis (river blindness), lymphatic filariasis (elephantiasis) and schistosomiasis (bilharzia). The program covers 86 districts endemic for onchocerciasis across 15 regions; about 266,000 people in two LF-endemic districts; deworming for schistosomiasis in 13 districts across eight regions. Eligible participants: all except children under five, pregnant women, and those with prior severe reactions. WHO-recommended, safe and essential in protecting communities. Ghana aims to eliminate NTDs as public health threat by 2030. Transmission of lymphatic filariasis interrupted in 114 of 117 endemic districts; onchocerciasis-endemic districts reduced; schistosomiasis nearing elimination in several areas. Achievements include Guinea worm elimination in 2015, trachoma elimination in 2018, sleeping sickness elimination in 2023. Donor support declining; call for increased domestic financing and a National NTD Fund.

triage.headline_ja: ガーナ保健サービス、NTDs対策薬で800万人への支援提供予定
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は予防的な薬物投与キャンペーン（公衆衛生対応）の報告であり、新規発生イベントではない。IHR基準は非該当で、スクリーニング基準も満たさず、社会政治的関心も低い。
triage.notes: 記事はガーナ保健サービスによる計画的な公衆衛生キャンペーン（MDA）の発表であり、感染症の新規発生や危機的な事態ではない。実績報告と今後の実施計画を含む進捗状況の報告に分類される。対象国はGhana（2300660）。

article.articleHeadline: GHS to reach 8 million people with drugs on Neglected Tropical Diseases - Adomonline.com
article.articleSummary: Ghana Health Service launches a nationwide Mass Drug Administration from 20 June to 3 July 2026 to shield nearly eight million people with preventive treatment against three neglected tropical diseases: onchocerciasis (river blindness), lymphatic filariasis (elephantiasis) and schistosomiasis (bilharzia). The campaign covers 86 onchocerciasis-endemic districts in 15 regions, plus about 266,000 people in two districts endemic for lymphatic filariasis, and schistosomiasis deworming in 13 districts across eight regions. Eligible individuals, except children under five, pregnant women, and those with prior severe reactions, are urged to participate. Medicines are WHO-recommended, safe, and essential for eliminating these diseases. Ghana notes progress toward 2030 targets: lymphatic filariasis transmission interrupted in 114 of 117 endemic districts; onchocerciasis and schistosomiasis nearing elimination in several areas. Historical gains include eradication of guinea worm (2015), trachoma (2018) and sleeping sickness (2023). Donor funding gaps prompt calls for a National NTD Fund to sustain elimination efforts.

triage.headline_ja: ガーナ保健サービス、顧みられない熱帯病に対する医薬品で800万人に到達予定
triage.triage_reason: 本イベントは予防的な薬物投与キャンペーン（公衆衛生上の実績）であり、新規の感染症アウトブレイク、異常事象、または国際的な医療危機を示すものではない。顧みられない熱帯病の管理・排除に向けた計画的な公衆衛生介入であり、シグナルトリアージの基準を満たさない。
triage.notes: 本記事は計画的な予防キャンペーン（Mass Drug Administration）の実施予定を報じるもので、新規アウトブレイク、異常な感染症事象、または医療危機を示していない。むしろガーナの顧みられない熱帯病対策の進捗を示すポジティブなニュースである。ギニアワーム（2015年）、トラコーマ（2018年）、睡眠病（2023年）の根絶という過去の成功例も記載されている。

article.articleHeadline: Россия передала Африке более семи тысяч тестов для диагностики Эболы
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Russia has supplied Africa with more than seven thousand Ebola diagnostic tests.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-06-19, Russian health authorities reported that Rospotrebnadzor developed and organized production of PCR diagnostic test systems for Ebola caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus. In response to the threat of a new Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda, the agency has delivered more than 7,000 test systems to African countries to support molecular diagnosis. The rapid four-day effort highlights international diagnostic capacity for the Bundibugyo variant and aims to bolster outbreak response by enabling faster detection in affected nations. The announcement concentrates on PCR-based diagnostic tools and their distribution across Africa, with no reported case counts or clinical details. These measures focus on improving laboratory confirmation rather than treatment or vaccine deployment, addressing the risk posed by the ongoing outbreak in the region.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア、アフリカにエボラ診断用検査キット7,000以上を供給
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス感染症の流行リスクが懸念される地域（DRC、ウガンダ）への国際的支援の提供報告であり、異常性・国際的関心は存在するが、実際の患者発生報告がなく、具体的な流行規模が不明なため、追加情報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCとウガンダにおけるエボラ流行リスクへの対応として診断検査キット供給を報告しているが、具体的な症例数、死亡者数、流行の確認状況の記載がない。ウガンダはBluedotの発生地域に含まれるが、対象国リストに該当しないため verified_locations に含めない。ロシアは診断支援を提供する国として記載されており、発生地ではないため除外。DRCは対象国（ID 203312）に該当するため含める。

article.articleHeadline: Роспотребнадзор: более 7000 тест-систем для диагностики Эболы передано Африке
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rospotrebnadzor: More than 7,000 Ebola diagnostic test systems handed over to Africa.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-19, more than 7,000 Ebola diagnostic test systems have been handed over to Africa, according to Rospotrebnadzor. In response to the threat of a new Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, Russia was among the first to develop and scale production of PCR tests for this variant within four days. The shipments have reached African countries, with Uganda and the Democratic Republic of the Congo specifically cited. Requests for the Russian-made Bundibugyo detection systems have also come from North Korea and Turkmenistan, while Tajikistan has submitted a request. The article notes prior assurances from Gamaleya Institute virologist Anatoly Altstein that Ebola is unlikely to trigger a global pandemic.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア保健監督庁：エボラ診断検査システム7000以上がアフリカに引き渡された
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス（ブンディブギョ種）のアウトブレイク対応として、複数国への検査試薬配布というシグナル。DRCとウガンダで実際の流行が進行中の可能性があり、IHR基準（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、国際的拡大リスク）を満たす。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCとウガンダでのBundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak対応と明記されているが、対象国リスト内ではDRCのみが該当。ウガンダは対象国外のため除外。北朝鮮、トルクメニスタン、タジキスタンからの検査試薬リクエストは「脅威への予防的対応」であり、それら国での実際のアウトブレイク発生は記事で述べられていない。

article.articleHeadline: Роспотребнадзор передал странам Африки 7 тысяч тест-систем для диагностики Эболы
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rospotrebnadzor handed seven thousand test systems for Ebola diagnosis to African countries.
article.articleSummary: Rospotrebnadzor handed over more than 7,000 PCR test systems for detecting Bundibugyo ebolavirus to Uganda, the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), and the Republic of Congo. Tests were also delivered to North Korea (DPRK) and Turkmenistan, with Tajikistan submitting a request. In response to the threat of a new Ebola outbreak caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus in the DRC and Uganda, Russia’s consumer health watchdog developed and organized production of PCR tests within four days. Deployments to the DRC, Republic of Congo, and Uganda included field validation in real outbreak settings, with direct comparative testing against assays from other countries. The announcement highlights international collaboration to boost diagnostic capacity for Ebola in affected regions and beyond.

triage.headline_ja: ロスポトレブナドゾル、アフリカ諸国にエボラ診断用の7千個のテストシステムを供与
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo型）に関する国際的な診断能力強化の取り組みであり、DRCとウガンダでの新規発生の脅威に対応する異常かつ重要な公衆衛生イベント。IHR基準（異常性、国際拡大リスク）とWPRO基準（流行しやすさ、長期曝露）に複数該当。
triage.notes: 発生地域リストにはDRCの他、北朝鮮・トルクメニスタン・タジキスタン・ロシア・ウガンダが含まれているが、サマリーの内容を検証すると、実際のエボラウイルス発生地はDRCとウガンダであり、他国への搬出は診断用テストキットの供給であることが明確である。対象国リストに基づき、DRCのみをverified_locationsに含める。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。本イベントはエボラウイルスの新規脅威に対する国際的な診断能力強化であり、ピックアップ値する。

article.articleHeadline: Actualité | Ebola : Bunia ne sera pas confinée, rassure le ministre Roger Kamba | mediacongo.net
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: News | Ebola: Bunia will not be quarantined, reassures Minister Roger Kamba | mediacongo.net
article.articleSummary: Bunia city in Ituri province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, will not be quarantined despite an Ebola virus disease outbreak in Ituri, Health Minister Roger Kamba said on June 18, 2026. He stated confinement is not an appropriate response at this stage and could complicate response operations. The plan emphasizes strengthening checkpoints, rapid identification of contacts, and their regular follow-up to limit transmission. Health authorities continue surveillance and care as part of the Ebola response in Ituri. No case counts are provided in the briefing, but officials highlight case finding, contact tracing, and supportive care to curb transmission, signaling a shift toward targeted public health measures rather than broad confinement in Bunia.

triage.headline_ja: ニュース | エボラ：ブニア市は隔離されない、ロジェ・カンバ保健大臣が保証 | mediacongo.net
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国のイトゥリ州でのエボラウイルス疾患発生報告。IHR基準で公衆衛生への深刻な影響および異常性が該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数項目が該当。国際的拡大の可能性と政府対応の明確化が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはエボラの発生がコンゴ民主共和国のイトゥリ州ブニア市で確認されていることを明確に述べており、DRCは対象国リストに含まれる。発生地域フィールドのすべての地点（Ituri州、Bunia市、DRC）は同一事件を示している。具体的な症例数は記事に記載されていないが、公式な保健大臣のコメント（2026年6月18日付）により政府レベルの対応が確認されている。隔離措置の回避方針とチェックポイント強化、接触者追跡などの対応方針が述べられており、管理可能性について当局の見通しを反映している。

article.articleHeadline: Demam Mereda Bukan Berarti Sembuh, Waspadai Fase Kritis DBD
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fever Subsides Does Not Mean You Are Cured; Beware the Critical Phase of Dengue Fever.
article.articleSummary: As of 19 June 2026, dengue fever (DF) can progress through three stages—fever, critical, and recovery—posing serious death risk if not managed. In the fever phase (1–3 days), patients experience sudden high fever (38–40°C) with headache, muscle and joint pain, nausea, and fatigue. The critical phase follows defervescence to about 37°C or near normal, when the risk of complications rises. Plasma leakage from blood vessels can reduce intravascular volume, leading to shock; without prompt treatment, organ failure and death may occur. If shock is avoided, patients may enter the recovery phase, during which appetite improves and platelet counts gradually return to normal. The warning comes from Jakarta-based health authorities, who stressed close monitoring during defervescence. The remarks were delivered during ASEAN Dengue Day in Indonesia to emphasize timely medical care and observation.

triage.headline_ja: 熱が下がった＝治ったわけではない。デング熱の重篤期に注意
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア（ジャカルタ）からのデング熱に関する公衆衛生啓発記事。臨床段階の説明と警告は提供されているが、具体的な新規発症数、死亡者数、流行規模に関する情報が不足している。
triage.notes: 記事はジャカルタの保健当局がASEAN デング熱の日に発表した臨床教育メッセージである。重症度と死亡リスクについて言及されているが、現在の流行状況、患者数、死亡者数に関する具体的なエピデミオロジカルデータが欠落している。続報で流行規模が確認される場合はPICKUPに昇格する可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: Güney Kore'de yumurta krizi: Kuş gribi ve üretim düşüşü sonrası ABD ve Tayland'dan 21 milyon ithalat!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Egg crisis in South Korea: After avian influenza and a decline in production, 21 million eggs imported from the United States and Thailand!
article.articleSummary: South Korea faces an egg shortage driven by avian influenza outbreaks that depressed poultry production and lifted prices. To alleviate the shortfall, the government will import more than 21 million eggs from the United States and Thailand by the end of July 2026. Seoul will also release about 4.5 million eggs weekly into local markets to ease price pressures, targeting supply restoration after winter outbreaks. Mid-June retail price for a 30-egg carton reached 7,506 won (~$4.90), up 7.1% year-on-year. Daily egg production declined to 47.05 million eggs, down 3.3% from the previous year, with welfare and biosafety policies reducing hen densities adding pressure. Officials expect the squeeze to be temporary, with production rebounding in July as pullets begin laying.

triage.headline_ja: 韓国での卵危機：鳥インフルエンザと生産減少後、米国とタイランドから2,100万個の卵を輸入
triage.triage_reason: 鳥インフルエンザによる動物での発生であり、ヒト感染の確認報告はない。記事は主に経済的影響（卵不足・輸入）に焦点があり、感染症の流行拡大リスクは限定的だが、動物での異常な発生（季節外れの冬季でない時期の集団発生）と複数国への関連を考慮し経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事は韓国での動物（家禽）での鳥インフルエンザ発生に関するもの。ヒト感染事例は記載されていない。タイランドは卵輸入元として言及されており verified_locations に含める。United States は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。Seoul/Republic of Koreaは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。IHR基準は2つ該当するが、主に家畜への影響であり、ヒト感染リスク評価に必要な情報が不足している。

article.articleHeadline: Tanzania declares Ebola free status as Government tightens border surveillance
article.articleSummary: Tanzania declares Ebola-free status as of June 18, 2026, while tightening border surveillance. The government says there are no Ebola cases in Tanzania, despite ongoing outbreaks in neighboring Uganda and the Democratic Republic of Congo. Health Minister Mohamed Mchengerwa stressed readiness to prevent, detect early, and contain any threat. Since the threat declaration, authorities investigated 64 alerts from 21 regions; 11 suspected cases met criteria and had samples collected, all testing negative for Ebola. Measures include intensified screening and surveillance at border posts, airports and seaports, plus guidelines issued to healthcare professionals and the public. Officials will maintain monitoring and provide timely updates. Citizens are urged to follow health guidance and rely on official Government sources to avoid unverified reports. The government aims to safeguard the health of Tanzanians and healthcare workers against Ebola.

triage.headline_ja: タンザニア、エボラ出血熱の撲滅状態を宣言 政府は国境監視を強化
triage.triage_reason: タンザニアはエボラ感染者ゼロを宣言したが、隣国ウガンダとDRCで流行が継続中であり、国境での警戒態勢強化と継続的な監視が必要。現在のところシグナル化には至らないが、地域的な緊張状況を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: タンザニアはエボラ感染者ゼロを宣言し、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響がないため、対象国リストではDRCのみを verified_locations に含めた。隣国の継続的な流行リスクにより、タンザニアの継続的な監視は必要であるが、現在のシグナルポイントとしての基準は満たさない。

article.articleHeadline: Συναγερμός για τους 202 θανάτους από τον ιό Έμπολα στο Κονγκό
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Alarm over 202 deaths from the Ebola virus in Congo.
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak: Africa CDC reports 202 deaths among 875 confirmed cases (case fatality rate 23%) about one month after the outbreak began. The Bundibugyo strain drives the current surge, with no vaccines or therapies available for this strain. Health officials warn that contact tracing is hampered as security issues and limited access prevent response teams from reaching some areas, hindering containment. This marks the 17th Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo’s history. The situation underscores ongoing challenges in surveillance, case investigation, and rapid isolation amid insecurity, with continued transmission until access improves.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのエボラウイルスによる202人の死亡に対する警報
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の大規模発生、国際的拡大リスク高、渡航制限リスク）。Bundibugyo株でのワクチン・治療法がなく、セキュリティと接近制限による対応困難が確認されており、継続的な感染リスクが存在。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株はエボラウイルスの稀な亜種であり、既存ワクチン・治療法がないことが重大な懸念。セキュリティ上の制限と接近困難により、接触者追跡が不十分で、ウイルス封じ込めが困難な状況が続いている。DRCの17番目のエボラ発生であり、致死率23%は既知の株よりやや低いが、高い致死性を示す。

article.articleHeadline: Dịch Ebola: Tình hình tiếp tục diễn biến phức tạp
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak: The situation continues to develop in a complicated manner.
article.articleSummary: Coordinated by Africa CDC, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda is the most severe at this early stage, with a near 40% weekly rise in cases. As of now, DRC reports 896 confirmed cases and 232 deaths; Uganda 19 cases and 2 deaths. The outbreak spans 33 health zones in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu in eastern DRC and has crossed into Uganda. The strain is Bundibugyo, a rare Ebola lineage with no licensed vaccine or approved specific therapy. About 74-78 patients have recovered; experimental treatments under study. Contact tracing is severely impeded by security issues, difficult terrain, and resource limitations. Projected contacts to follow range 17,000–35,000, yet only roughly 4,000–6,300 have been identified and monitored to date.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：状況は引き続き複雑に展開している
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。Bundibugyo株による大規模流行で、ワクチンなし、急速な症例増加（週40%）、接触者追跡の大規模な課題あり。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRC（South KivuおよびIturi州）とUgandaでのエボラ流行を述べているが、対象国リストではDRCのみ該当。Bundibugyo株は稀な系統で、利用可能なワクチンやApproved specific therapyがなく、急速な増加（週40%）、セキュリティ問題による接触者追跡の大規模な阻害、17,000～35,000の接触者が予測されながら僅か4,000～6,300のみ特定・監視されている状況が重大なリスク要因。

article.articleHeadline: कांगो और युगांडा में इबोला मामलों में एक सप्ताह में 40 फीसदी की बढ़ोतरी, मृतक संख्या 200 पार
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola cases in Congo and Uganda rise 40% in a week, death toll surpasses 200.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu) and neighboring Uganda shows a 40% weekly rise with deaths exceeding 200. Africa CDC reports 894 confirmed cases, 74 recoveries, and ongoing spread affecting cross-border transmission to Uganda (19 cases, 2 deaths). The outbreak is caused by the rare Bundibugyo virus, for which no approved vaccine or treatment exists; early days of detection were missed. Overall, Ituri accounts for over 90% of cases; contact tracing is hampered by terrain and security, with 800+ confirmed cases needing 17,000–35,000 contacts, but only about 4,000 have been traced. About 35,000 potential contacts are identified, while displacement in Ituri (~1 million people) complicates surveillance. International aid pledged exceeds $900 million, but only about $90 million has been released; 540 staff are needed, with 84 deployed. Experimental monoclonal antibodies are under development.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴとウガンダのエボラ感染者が1週間で40%増加、死亡者数が200人を超える
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当し、WPRO基準も5つすべて該当。稀なブンディブギョウイルス株による国際的なエボラ流行で、死亡者が200人を超え、ウガンダへの国境越え感染も確認されている。
triage.notes: ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsからは除外。DRCのIturi、North Kivu、South Kivu州での発生が主題。稀なBundibugyo株による流行、ワクチン未承認、接触者追跡の困難性、約100万人の避難民により管理が複雑化。国際支援が誓約されているが実装率が低い。

article.articleHeadline: Fiocruz identifica alta de casos graves de síndrome respiratória
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fiocruz identifies an increase in severe cases of respiratory syndrome.
article.articleSummary: On 19 June 2026, Fiocruz’s InfoGripe reports a renewed rise in Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SRAG) across Brazil, driven by influenza A and B and affecting youths, adults and the elderly, with respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) continuing to fuel pediatric hospitalizations. RSV remains high in small children, though signs of deceleration are emerging for under‑4s. Nationally, SRAG severity is easing among 5–14‑year‑olds while influenza drives hospitalizations and deaths in older and young adults. In the last four weeks, RSV accounted for 51.4% of lab‑confirmed SRAG cases; influenza A 19.1%; rhinovirus 23.9%; influenza B 7.1%; SARS‑CoV‑2 2.2%. Since the start of 2026, Brazil has reported 89,725 SRAG cases. Vaccination remains key: influenza vaccines for at‑risk groups; RSV vaccination for pregnant women from 28 weeks gestation; boosters for seniors/immunocompromised; masks and isolation when symptomatic. Fourteen states and eleven capitals are at alert/high risk.

triage.headline_ja: Fiocruz が呼吸器症候群の重症例の増加を確認
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル全域で重症急性呼吸器症候群（SRAG）の新たな増加が報告され、インフルエンザA・B およびRSVが主要な原因。89,725例の確定症例報告、14州と11の州都が警戒/高リスク状態であり、IHR基準3つ以上に該当。
triage.notes: 複数の呼吸器系ウイルス（RSV 51.4%、インフルエンザA 19.1%、ライノウイルス 23.9%、インフルエンザB 7.1%）が同時流行中。2026年初頭からの累積症例数89,725例は相当規模の流行を示唆。公式機関（Fiocruz）による公式報告であり、信頼性が高い。ただしWHO国際通知基準の「国際的拡大のリスク」および「渡航・貿易制限のリスク」に関する情報は現サマリーには含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: 腸病毒疫情緩升增1重症！未滿5歲女童染D68型　8重症警訊須留意 | LIFE生活網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Enterovirus outbreak shows a gradual uptick, with one more severe case! A girl under five contracted EV-D68; Eight warning signs of severe illness to watch for.
article.articleSummary: Taiwan reports a new enterovirus D68 severe case in the north: a girl under 5 with fever, runny nose, and cough progressed to somnolence, breathing difficulty, and limb weakness. Lab-confirmed EV-D68, with bronchopneumonia on admission and brain/spinal involvement (encephalitis, myelitis, acute flaccid paralysis) leading to ICU care for over two weeks. EV-D68 presents mainly with fever, runny nose, and cough rather than typical hand, foot, and mouth disease, and there is no vaccine or specific antiviral; prevention centers on hand hygiene, cough etiquette, avoiding crowds, and staying home when ill. Five severe enterovirus infections have been recorded this year (including 1 death): 3 EV-D68, 1 Coxsackie A4, 1 Coxsackie A16. Week 23 surveillance shows 5,824 ED visits (2.4% up); Coxsackie A6 most common, followed by A4, D68, A10. Eight warning signs for under-5s include somnolence, altered consciousness, poor vitality, limb weakness/paralysis, muscle twitching, persistent vomiting, and rapid breathing or tachycardia; seek urgent hospital care (1922/0800-001922). Regional outbreaks are rising in Vietnam, Mainland China, Thailand, Korea, Japan, and Hong Kong.

triage.headline_ja: 腸病毒疫情緩升增1重症！未滿5歲女童染D68型　8重症警訊須留意
triage.triage_reason: 台湾でエンテロウイルスD68による重症例（急性弛緩性麻痺、脊髄炎、脳炎を伴う）が報告され、地域内（ベトナム、中国、タイ、韓国、日本、香港）での流行拡大が指摘されている。IHR基準2項目以上該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数項目が適合する。
triage.notes: 台湾での報告であるが、台湾は対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。ただし、サマリーで明示的に地域流行拡大（ベトナム、中国、タイ、韓国、日本、香港での発生増加）が言及されており、対象国のうち China、Vietnam、Thailand について実際の発生が確認される。EV-D68による急性弛緩性麻痺は重大な神経障害であり、5歳未満児への臨床的影響が明確。ワクチンなし、特異的治療法なしの点も管理可能性の課題を示唆する。

article.articleHeadline: Meghaladta a kétszázat az afrikai ebolajárvány halálos áldozatainak száma
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The death toll from the African Ebola outbreak has surpassed two hundred.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease, Bundibugyo variant, is circulating in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri region) with spillover into Uganda. As of 19 June 2026, laboratory-confirmed infections reach 894, including 875 in the DRC, and deaths total 204 (200 in the DRC, 2 in Uganda); 74 patients have recovered. Eastern provinces show a 38% rise in confirmed infections since Sunday, indicating poor control. Active contact tracing remains limited: 4,112 contacts are being actively followed, with an estimated 17–35 thousand total contacts. The outbreak was declared on 15 May for the Bundibugyo variant; there is no vaccine or specific treatment. The Ituri epicenter is hard to access due to poor roads and insecurity from armed groups. Donors pledged about $910 million for response, but less than $90 million has been disbursed; authorities will press donors to fulfill commitments.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカのエボラ出血熱流行の死亡者数が200人を超えた
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準5つすべてに該当する。進行中の大規模エボラウイルス病流行であり、複数国への拡大、高い死亡率、不十分な対応体制、国際的な資金・支援ニーズが明確である。
triage.notes: 発生地域にウガンダ（226074）も含まれているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には DRC のみを記載。記事サマリーではウガンダでも死亡例（2例）が報告されており、国境を越えた感染拡大の実態が確認されている。Bundibugyo variant の流行、ワクチンおよび特異的治療の欠如、貧弱なアクセスと不十分な接触者追跡、資金不足による対応力の制限が深刻。

article.articleHeadline: Έμπολα στη ΛΔ Κονγκό: Επιδημία χωρίς εμβόλιο και βαθιά δυσπιστία
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: an outbreak without a vaccine and deep distrust.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo centers on Ituri province near the Uganda and South Sudan borders, declared May 15 as the 17th Ebola outbreak. The Bundibugyo strain is not covered by existing vaccines, which target only the Zaire strain, so containment relies on patient isolation and contact tracing. Early reports listed 246 suspected cases and 80 deaths; Uganda later reported its first Ebola death in Kampala, with 19 confirmed Ugandan cases (2 deaths) and borders closed. WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern; Africa CDC warns 10 countries are at risk. Vaccines for Bundibugyo are anticipated by year-end as trials progress. Testing capacity is limited; initial tests were negative due to reagent shortages amid access challenges in conflict-affected areas. By mid-June, counts included 1,140 suspected and 246 deaths two weeks after declaration, with a latest tally of 875 cases and 202 deaths. Bunia flights were suspended; MSF cautions official figures may undercount. US tightened visas for travelers from high-risk areas.

triage.headline_ja: DRC（コンゴ民主共和国）のエボラ：ワクチンなしの流行と深い不信
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、複数国への国際拡大（ウガンダ確認、10カ国がリスク）、WHO PHEICが宣言され、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響がある。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株は既存ワクチンでカバーされておらず、紛争地域での検査能力制限が懸念。ウガンダでも死者確認されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。WHO PHEIC宣言済み。

article.articleHeadline: कांगो में स्वास्थ्य मंत्रालय ने कहा, इबोला के मामले बढ़कर 896 हुए | Congo Ebola cases rise to 896: health authorities
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Congo, the Ministry of Health said, Ebola cases have risen to 896.
article.articleSummary: As of 19 June 2026, Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) reports 896 laboratory-confirmed Ebola virus disease (Bandibugyo strain) cases and 232 deaths. Eastern provinces Ituri and North Kivu accounted for 21 new confirmed cases with 6 deaths, with the outbreak spanning 33 health zones across Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu. There are 383 patients in isolation or hospitalized, and 78 recovered, including 11 who tested negative on control testing. On the same day, 151 suspected cases were recorded with 35 deaths. A total of 6,367 contacts are under monitoring, with 4,525 reached during the reporting period (71.1% follow-up). Weekly increases in confirmed cases indicate ongoing community transmission and the potential for geographic spread without rapid public health measures. The DR Congo outbreak is the 17th Ebola event in the country, declared on 15 May. Typical Ebola symptoms include fever, fatigue, malaise, myalgia, headache, sore throat, vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal pain, rash, and organ impairment.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴにおける保健省によると、エボラ症例が896例に増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。DRCでのエボラ流行は深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスクを伴う。確定症例896例、死亡232例、週間増加継続中。
triage.notes: DRCにおけるBandibugyo型エボラウイルスの17番目の発生。Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu州で継続的なコミュニティ伝播を示す。週間症例増加傾向、6,367名の接触者監視中（71.1%フォローアップ率）。迅速な公衆衛生措置がない場合、地理的拡大の可能性あり。

article.articleHeadline: 腸病毒疫情緩升增1重症！未滿5歲女童染D68型　8重症警訊須留意 - 健康新聞 - PChome Online 新聞
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Enterovirus outbreak eases, with one more severe case! A girl under 5 contracted EV-D68; eight warning signs of severe illness to watch for - Health News - PChome Online News
article.articleSummary: Taiwan confirms one more severe enterovirus infection due to EV-D68 in a girl under five, now in intensive care after evolving from fever, runny nose and cough to somnolence, respiratory distress and limb weakness. Lab confirmation of EV-D68; chest X-ray showed bronchopneumonia, and she has been hospitalized for over two weeks with persistent limb weakness. EV-D68 typically presents like a cold but can cause pneumonia, encephalitis and acute flaccid paralysis; no vaccine or specific therapy exists. Prevention focuses on hand hygiene, cough etiquette, avoiding crowded places, and staying home when ill. Eight warning signs for severe illness in children under five include lethargy, altered consciousness, poor activity, limb weakness or paralysis, muscle jerks, persistent vomiting, rapid breathing, and fast heart rate—seek urgent care at a major hospital. This year Taiwan has five severe enterovirus cases, including one death; three are EV-D68, with one each of Coxsackie A4 and A16. Week 23 ED visits: 5,824; surrounding regions report rising enterovirus activity (Vietnam, China, Thailand, Korea, Japan, Hong Kong).

triage.headline_ja: 腸病毒疫情緩升増1重症！未滿5歲女童染D68型　8重症警訊須留意
triage.triage_reason: エンテロウイルス（EV-D68）による重症感染症が複数国で報告されており、小児の急性弛緩麻痺など重症化リスクが明確。IHR基準で「異常・予想外」「国際的拡大リスク」に該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも「重症度」「流行しやすさ」「管理可能性」が該当。
triage.notes: 台湾は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。記事では台湾での重症化を主題としつつ、周辺地域（ベトナム、中国、タイ、韓国、日本、香港）でのエンテロウイルス活動増加が報告されている。対象国の中で Vietnam, China, Thailand が確認された。EV-D68は急性弛緩麻痺を引き起こす可能性があり、ワクチンや特異的治療法がないことが懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Tidak Benar, Gambar Korban Hantavirus di Jakarta
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Not True: Image of a Hantavirus Victim in Jakarta.
article.articleSummary: Misinformation circulated on Facebook in May 2026 claiming four hantavirus cases in Jakarta and showing a woman in medical distress. Tirto’s fact-check found no credible confirmation; reverse-image search linked the photo to Wish Ko Lang!, a Philippine program, and a 2025 behind-the-scenes video for a Rabies series, not hantavirus. Officially, the Jakarta Health Office reported four hantavirus cases in 2026, with three recovered and one still suspected awaiting laboratory confirmation.
