ECC facilities are conducting community sensitization, with prevention measures in worship venues and distribution of prevention kits and medical inputs in some clinics. MAF airline supports transport of response staff and medical equipment to affected zones.

triage.headline_ja: イトゥリ州でのエボラ：ECC（コンゴキリスト教会）が20の医療施設を配備するも非難
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。DRCでのエボラ流行は重篤で、地域検証によりDRCが実際の発生地として確認される。
triage.notes: エボラ流行は極めて深刻な公衆衛生脅威。記事ではECC（コンゴキリスト教会）が20の医療施設を配備し患者ケアに従事していることが述べられており、公式な対応体制が進行中であることが明確。税優遇措置の不遵守など政府との課題も報告されており、国家レベルでの対応が行われていることが示唆される。国際的な航空支援（MAF航空会社）も確認される。

article.articleHeadline: Էբոլայի տենդով հիվանդները Կոնգոյի Դեմոկրատական Հանրապետությունում փախչում են բուժկենտրոններից
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Patients with Ebola fever are fleeing from treatment centers in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola patients and those suspected of infection are fleeing treatment centers in the Democratic Republic of the Congo due to hunger and poor shelter conditions, Bloomberg reports. Since late May, authorities have logged more than 150 escapes from Ebola treatment centers; at least one incident involved 11 suspected patients who fled quarantine because of insufficient food. Evacuations are tied to food shortages and inadequate storage conditions. The eastern DRC region has faced population displacement, conflict, and famine, with hunger affecting nearly 10 million people there. An international body has declared the Ebola outbreak in the DRC and Uganda an emergency and a threat to other countries, with regional spread deemed high. Earlier, the health minister said Ebola deaths exceed 230 and confirmed cases approach 900. The situation underscores ongoing outbreaks, food insecurity, and challenges to containment.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ患者が治療センターから逃げ出している
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、深刻な公衆衛生影響と国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスクが明確。患者の脱出による感染拡大リスク増加が重大な懸念。
triage.notes: Uganda は発生地域フィールドに含まれているが、記事サマリーでは DRC が主要な焦点で、Uganda については国際的脅威評価のコンテキストのみ言及。DRC での患者脱出による感染拡大リスクが深刻。食糧不足と劣悪な衛生条件がアウトブレーク制御に大きな障害となっている。死亡数230以上、確認症例約900の大規模アウトブレーク。

article.articleHeadline: Health Minister Reviews India's Dengue And Malaria Preparedness Ahead Of Monsoon: Do's And Don'ts For Every Family
article.articleSummary: India is tightening dengue and malaria preparedness ahead of the monsoon after rains raise mosquito risk. On 2026-06-19, Union Health Minister JP Nadda chaired a high-level review to strengthen surveillance, prevention, early diagnosis, timely treatment, and community participation. Dengue remains a major concern with NCVBDC reporting thousands of cases annually; transmission typically peaks during and after the monsoon when stagnant water promotes Aedes breeding. Malaria, transmitted by Anopheles mosquitoes active from dusk to dawn, adds to the burden in warm, humid conditions. Officials stressed strengthening surveillance, diagnostics, treatment protocols, and public awareness, with emphasis on proactive measures before transmission intensifies. Dengue mortality has fallen from about 3.3% in 1996 to roughly 0.1% in recent years thanks to improved surveillance and clinical management. Do's for families include weekly elimination of stagnant water, cover of water storage, protective clothing, window screens and nets, repellents, and seeking early care; community participation is essential.

triage.headline_ja: インド保健相、モンスーン時期前のデング熱とマラリア対策を見直す：家族向けのすべきこととすべきでないこと
triage.triage_reason: インドのデング熱とマラリア対策強化についての政策ニュースであり、異常性や国際的拡大の懸念は明示されていない。季節的な予防的準備段階の報道であり、現在の流行サージやアウトブレイク情報ではない。
triage.notes: 記事はモンスーン季節前の予防措置と政策対応に焦点を当てており、実際の流行サージやアウトブレイク報告ではない。デング熱とマラリアは季節的に予想される疾病であり、死亡率の改善傾向が記述されている。WPROスクリーニングの長期曝露と流行しやすさでカウントされるが、IHR基準は該当しない。継続的な監視対象だが、現段階ではフル疾病調査に進む緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Bloomberg: голодные пациенты с Эболой сбегают из больниц в ДР Конго 19 июня 2026 года -
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bloomberg: Undernourished Ebola patients escape from hospitals in the DRC on June 19, 2026.
article.articleSummary: More than 150 Ebola patients have escaped from hospitals in the Democratic Republic of Congo since the end of May, driven by hunger and poor care conditions, Bloomberg reports citing government records. An additional 11 patients with suspected Ebola escaped from quarantine due to food shortages. In eastern DRC, hunger affects about 10 million people, a region historically prone to displacement before the outbreak intensified. Health authorities say Ebola deaths exceed 230, with roughly 900 laboratory-confirmed infections across the country. Health Minister Samuel Roger Kamby highlighted that ongoing hunger and inadequate facilities hinder treatment, isolation, and outbreak control. The breaches underscore a deteriorating humanitarian context complicating the response to the Ebola situation in the DRC as of June 19, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: ブルームバーグ報道：飢えたエボラ患者がコンゴ民主共和国の病院から逃げ出している（2026年6月19日）
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病は高い公衆衛生影響と国際的拡大リスクを持つ重篤な疾患であり、患者150名以上の逃亡により隔離・制御が困難になっている状況はIHR基準を複数満たす。死亡数230名以上、確認患者900名という重症度とコンゴ民主共和国の管理能力の限界から、フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: エボラ患者の大量逃亡により社会的・政治的関心が高い。食糧危機と医療体制の不備が疫学的制御を著しく阻害している。東部コンゴの広域人口移動リスク（1000万人が飢餓状態）により地域的・国際的な二次感染リスク増加。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola: CDC Dos EUA Disponibiliza 107 M$ Para Reforçar Resposta ao Surto
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: U.S. CDC Allocates $107 Million to Strengthen Outbreak Response.
article.articleSummary: On June 18, 2026, the US CDC announced $107 million in emergency funding to bolster Ebola response in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda, as the Bundibugyo strain drives the outbreak. By June 19, 2026, the outbreak had 875 laboratory-confirmed cases and 202 deaths. The WHO had declared a PHEIC about a month earlier. Donors pledged about $910 million, including $80 million from African Union member states, but less than $90 million had been disbursed. CDC personnel exceed 125 staff across DRC and Uganda, including 23 on the ground, supporting epidemiologic investigations, surveillance acceptance, case isolation, safe burials, entry-point assessments, and diagnostic-lab work. In DRC, focus is on provinces west of the affected area; in Uganda, border and airport screening is reinforced. U.S. risk remains low, but readiness for a possible importation persists. The CDC coordinates with World Cup health-security planning in 11 U.S. host cities.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：米CDCが感染症流行対応を強化するために1億700万ドルを配分
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の流行、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHO PHEIC宣言済み、複数国での確認、高い重症度（202死亡、確定症例875）、国際的支援が進行中のため。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでウガンダが言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため excluded。DRCのみ verified_locations に含める。2026年6月時点で既にWHO PHEIC宣言済み、Bundibugyo株による大規模流行、米国を含む国際的対応が展開中。フルRRA進行を推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Pazienti fuggono dai centri Ebola in Congo per fame
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Patients flee Ebola treatment centers in Congo due to hunger.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo continues amid severe hunger and displacement. Since late May, authorities report over 150 patients fleeing Ebola treatment and isolation centers, including 11 suspected cases who escaped a hospital in Bambu about 40 km from the epicenter. The outbreak is described as one of the most dangerous in recent years, with about 896 confirmed cases between May 17 and June 17 and 232 deaths. Weekly increases in confirmed cases indicate ongoing community transmission. The crisis intersects with widespread conflict and one of the world’s worst hunger crises, complicating containment and access to care. The report does not detail infection sources or imported/exported cases beyond government-confirmed figures.

triage.headline_ja: 患者たちが飢えのためコンゴのエボラ治療センターから逃げ出す
triage.triage_reason: コンゴでのエボラアウトブレイク（896確定症例、232死亡）が進行中であり、IHR基準で「深刻な公衆衛生への影響」「異常・予想外」「国際的拡大リスク」に該当。患者が治療センターから逃げ出す状況は制御困難性を示唆し、WPROスクリーニングでも重症度・流行性・管理可能性で懸念あり。フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは東部コンゴでのエボラアウトブレイク中心。Bambù（バンブ）はコンゴ東部で確認されており、イタリア（Veneto州）は発生地域リストに含まれているが、記事サマリーでは実際の感染イベントはコンゴに限定されている。患者の逃げ出しと飢饉・紛争が重複することで、コミュニティ感染と制御困難性が極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak: Cases in DR Congo rise to 896, death toll reaches 232
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has reached 896 confirmed cases and 232 deaths in its 17th outbreak caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus. Twenty-one new confirmed cases, including six deaths, were reported in the eastern provinces of Ituri and North Kivu. The outbreak has affected 33 health zones across Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu. The health ministry provided the latest daily update; the report confirms case counts but provides no additional laboratory details in this summary. Ongoing transmission remains in the eastern DRC, underscoring continued surveillance and response needs.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行：コンゴ民主共和国の感染者数が896人に増加、死亡者数は232人に達した
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラウイルス病は極めて高い致死率を持つ指定感染症であり、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、地域内での多数の新規発症、国際的な拡大リスク、および国際的な渡航・貿易制限のリスクが認められる。フルRRAに進むべき
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病Bundibugyo種による第17次流行。東部地域（Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu）の33の健康区で確認されている。継続的な人間-人間感染が報告されており、地域的および国際的な監視体制の強化が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus TB di Sleman Capai 2.542, Pemkab Libatkan PKK hingga Kalurahan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: TB cases in Sleman reach 2,542; the regency government involves PKK down to Kalurahan.
article.articleSummary: TB cases in Sleman Regency, Yogyakarta Special Region, reached 2,542 definitively recorded in 2025, with an estimated projection of 2,589 for the health plan. The Sleman Regency government expands TB control to the village level (Kalurahan) by engaging PKK (Family Welfare Movement) to educate and support communities, including strengthening posyandu services for parental education. Health authorities emphasize early detection, treatment completion, and reducing transmission, highlighting the crucial role of families and surroundings. The program SIKAT TB (Sleman Sigap Kendali dan Atasi Tuberkulosis) combines active case finding with patient support to prevent drug-resistant TB. During an 18 June 2026 meeting, Deputy Regent Danang Maharsa urged families to recognize symptoms and seek care promptly, and PKK leaders called for intensified community education to reach more residents, with the goal of lowering cases in coming years.

triage.headline_ja: スレマン県のTB患者数が2,542人に達する、県政府がPKKまで関与させる
triage.triage_reason: 結核は既知の風土病で、スレマン県での患者数増加（2,542件）は異常でなく、地域レベルの公衆衛生対応の強化報告である。国際的拡大リスク、国内の医療体制外での対応の必要性、社会的・政治的関心の高まりは認められない。
triage.notes: 結核は慢性感染症で、スレマン県でのケース数は既知の流行地における風土病の継続である。記事は地方政府による予防・対応プログラム（SIKAT TB）の強化を報告しており、新規の異常事象ではない。確定患者数の報告に基づく予防啓発活動であり、アウトブレイク的要素は認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Telangana News - पाणीपुरी खाल्ल्याने 20 हून अधिक मुलांना विषबाधा! जिल्हा रुग्णालयात उपचार सुरू
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Telangana News - More than 20 children poisoned after eating pani puri! Treatment underway at the district hospital.
article.articleSummary: Over 20 children in Rajanna Sircilla district, Telangana, India, were hospitalized after eating street-vendor pani puri. The onset followed Monday evening consumption from a local vendor, with many developing abdominal pain, vomiting, and diarrhea by Tuesday morning. By Tuesday evening, more than 20 were admitted to the district government hospital and nearby private facilities; most are in stable condition and under close observation. Food samples have been collected and sent to a laboratory for analysis, as authorities including local police and the health department investigate whether contaminated food caused the poisoning. Official confirmation is pending. This is treated as a suspected food poisoning incident linked to street food, with no pathogen or definitive source identified yet.

triage.headline_ja: テランガナニュース - パニプリを食べた20人以上の子どもが中毒！地区病院で治療開始
triage.triage_reason: 疑い食中毒イベント（病原体未確認）で重症度と地域的発生は確認されるが、国際的拡大リスク、IHR基準の2つ以上該当が明確でなく、病原体特定前の段階であるため。
triage.notes: 食中毒の疑い（検査待ち）。病原体が特定されていない段階。地元当局が調査中。ただしIHR基準では国際的拡大リスクが低く、深刻な公衆衛生影響も限定的と評価される。続報で病原体特定や患者数増加などあれば PICKUP へ昇格の可能性あり。

article.articleHeadline: Novi dokazi: Fauci financirao istraživanja u laboratoriju u Wuhanu koja su dovela do izbijanja COVID-a - narod.hr
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New evidence: Fauci funded research at a laboratory in Wuhan that led to the COVID-19 outbreak - narod.hr.
article.articleSummary: New evidence claims Anthony Fauci, as director of the U.S. National Institute of Allergy and Infectious Diseases (NIAID), directed millions of taxpayer dollars into gain-of-function research on bat coronaviruses at the Wuhan Institute of Virology (WIV), a line of work widely viewed as a potential source of the COVID-19 outbreak. Documents released by the Office of the Director of National Intelligence (ODNI), highlighted by DNI Tulsi Gabbard, allege Fauci influenced intelligence assessments on SARS-CoV-2’s origin and that he lied to Congress in 2024 about involvement in discussions with intelligence agencies. The ODNI review portrays a closed loop of confirmation, with Fauci recommending scientists funded by NIAID whose work supported the lab-origin narrative and downplayed lab-linked evidence. The revelations are framed as suppression of dissent and a so-called “deep state” pattern during the pandemic, noting pre-pandemic Wuhan experiments and whistleblower testimonies.

triage.headline_ja: 新証拠：Fauciが武漢の研究所での研究に資金提供、COVID-19発生につながったと主張 - narod.hr
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は過去のCOVID-19パンデミック（2019-2020年）の起源に関する政治的議論・陰謀論であり、現在進行中の感染症イベント・公衆衛生上の脅威を報告するものではない。新規感染症の探知シグナルとしての価値はない。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年配信だが、内容は2019-2024年のCOVID-19パンデミック起源に関する過去の政治的論争に基づいており、現在の感染症イベント報告ではない。Bluedot APIは歴史的な言及を地理的座標として検出したが、シグナルトリアージの対象外である。社会政治的関心は高いが、公衆衛生上の新規脅威を示すものではなく、シグナル識別基準を満たさない。

article.articleHeadline: В ДР Конго больные лихорадкой Эбола бегут из лечебных центров
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Ebola fever patients are fleeing from treatment centers.
article.articleSummary: Ebola fever patients in the Democratic Republic of the Congo are fleeing Ebola treatment centers due to hunger and poor conditions, highlighting food insecurity as a major barrier to containment. Since the end of May, government reports document more than 150 escapes from Ebola centers; at least one incident involved 11 patients with suspected Ebola who fled quarantine because of inadequate food. The displacement and hunger crisis in eastern DRC, already facing conflicts and mass hunger that affects nearly 10 million people, compounds outbreak control. The World Health Organization has declared the Ebola outbreak in the DRC and neighboring Uganda a public health emergency of international concern, with regional risk assessed as high. As of June 19, 2026, fatalities exceed 230 and confirmed cases approach 900. The situation underscores the intertwined challenges of nutrition, security, and outbreak response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ熱患者が治療センターから逃亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常事象、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）、WPRO基準でも複数該当。WHOが国際的懸念事項として宣言済み。フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはコンゴ民主共和国での患者逃亡とエボラ拡大を主題としており、ウガンダについても言及されているが、発生地域リストに含まれるウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。230人以上の死亡、約900の確認症例、WHOによる国際的懸念事項宣言、地域リスク評価が高い状況が報告されている。食糧不安と治療施設の脱出は封じ込めの重大な障害。

article.articleHeadline: Sonko sur France 24, attaque au Niger, progression d'Ebola en RD Congo : l'hebdo Afrique
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Sonko on France 24, attack in Niger, Ebola progression in DR Congo: Africa Weekly
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in DR Congo, centered in Ituri’s Bunia, with 875 laboratory-confirmed infections and 202 deaths since the May 15 declaration of the outbreak; Africa CDC reports the figures and the WHO has declared an international health emergency (PHEIC) in response, prompting a coordinated global effort as frontline healthcare workers intensify response activities. In Niger, al-Qaeda–linked JNIM claimed responsibility for an attack on Niamey International Airport, with at least 11 soldiers and 2 civilians killed, a deadly event following a January assault on the same airport claimed by Islamic State.

triage.headline_ja: フランス24でのソンコ、ニジェールでの攻撃、コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ進行：アフリカ週刊ニュース
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響：875確認症例・202死亡、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHO PHEIC宣言済み。シグナルとしてフルRRA実施対象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの主題は、DRコンゴのイトゥリ地域でのエボラアウトブレイク。ニジェールのニアメでの攻撃は同じ記事内の別トピック。DRコンゴでのエボラが流行であり、対象国リストに該当するのはDRコンゴのみ。WHO PHEIC宣言済みで国際的な懸念事項。

article.articleHeadline: सीतापुर में हेपेटाइटिस की चपेट में आ रहीं प्रेग्नेंट महिलाएं, जांच के बाद 54 में संक्रमण की पुष्टि - sitapur 54 pregnant women test positive for hepatitis
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pregnant women in Sitapur fall prey to hepatitis; 54 infections confirmed after testing.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-19, 54 pregnant women at Sitapur District Women’s Hospital tested positive for hepatitis in one month: 36 Hepatitis B and 18 Hepatitis C. Most residents are from the Tarai belt towns of Biswan, Mahmoodabad, Laharpur, Tambaur, and Behta. Earlier clusters included Jahangirabad (102 cases) and Sonari village (96) in 2025. Hepatitis B and E pose significant risks during pregnancy, with vertical transmission to the fetus or newborn possible. If a mother is HBV-positive, the newborn should receive the hepatitis B vaccine immediately; Hepatitis C has no vaccine. Deliveries are often by cesarean section to reduce transmission risk. HBV can spread through shared household items like toothbrushes or razors. Dr. Swasti Bajpai emphasizes mandatory prenatal hepatitis screening; despite rising cases, health authorities have conducted only limited village camps. Data: 5,056 pregnant women tested; 10,566 tests performed.

triage.headline_ja: シータプル地区で妊婦がA型肝炎に罹患、54人の感染を確認
triage.triage_reason: 妊婦を主な患者層とする肝炎（B型・C型）の集団発生であり、垂直感染のリスク、重症度（妊娠中の肝炎は重篤）、ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性（B型肝炎の家庭内感染）があり、WPROスクリーニング基準の複数項目に該当する。インド（対象国）での発生であり、社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 2025年にも同地域で大規模な肝炎集団発生（ジャハンギラバード102例、ソナリ村96例）の先例あり。妊婦という脆弱集団が主要患者層であり、B型肝炎の垂直感染リスク、家庭内感染の可能性が指摘されている。公式の栄養スクリーニング体制は限定的との指摘あり。複数州（ウッタル・プラデーシュ州、アッサム州、マディヤ・プラデーシュ州）にまたがる地域で関連事例が報告されている可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: கொங்கோவில் மீண்டும் பரவும் எபோலா வைரஸ்: தடுப்பூசி இல்லாத வைரஸ் திரிபு உலக நாடுகளுக்கு அச்சுறுத்தல்!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola virus re-emerging in Congo: a vaccine-free virus strain threatens countries worldwide!
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus is re-emerging in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri and eastern provinces), triggering the 17th outbreak. Congo reports 890+ cases and 230+ deaths; Uganda confirms 19 infections and 2 deaths, with the virus spreading to Kampala. The Bundibugyo strain has no approved vaccine or specific antiviral. Earlier outbreaks were linked to the Zaïre lineage, for which vaccines exist, but not for Bundibugyo. The outbreak was officially announced May 15 after earlier clandestine spread in mining towns like Mongbwalu. Initial symptoms mimic malaria, diabetes, or yellow fever; local labs initially detected only the Zaïre variant, delaying confirmation. WHO and Africa CDC declared it a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC). Ituri is under ISIS-linked armed groups, complicating access; distrust of modern medicine and unsafe burial practices propagate transmission; flights are suspended, delaying international aid. Trials of new Bundibugyo vaccines are underway, with potential deployment by year-end.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴで再出現するエボラウイルス：ワクチンのないウイルス株が世界の国々に脅威をもたらす！
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当。WHO公式でPHEIC宣言済みのBundibugyo株エボラ出血熱で、複数国への拡大（DRC・ウガンダ）、高い致命率、ワクチン未開発という危機的状況。
triage.notes: Uganda も地理的には記事に登場するが、検証対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。DRC のみを対象国として計上。WHO による PHEIC 宣言、複数国での確認例、ワクチン未開発の Bundibugyo 株、高い致命率（230+/890+ = 約25%）、武装勢力支配地域での管理困難性など、複数の深刻要因が存在。フルRRA実施は必須。

article.articleHeadline: El ECDC refuerza su despliegue en África frente al ébola y lanza una guía para preparar a Europa ante posibles casos importados
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The ECDC strengthens its deployment in Africa in the fight against Ebola and launches a guide to prepare Europe for potential imported cases.
article.articleSummary: ECDC intensifies field deployment to the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, deploying on-site experts and releasing an operational guide to ready EU/EEA health systems for potential imported cases. The response centers on Bundibugyo ebolavirus (BDBV); EU risk remains very low, but surveillance, detection, and response capacities are strengthened. Teams are deployed in the DRC and will continue in Uganda, with another European unit to South Sudan to bolster national preparedness, including risk communication and community engagement. Working with Africa CDC in Addis Ababa, ECDC focuses on epidemiological surveillance, data analysis, and operational readiness. The guide provides checklists and recommendations for identifying, isolating, and rapidly reporting suspected cases, arranging transport, designated hospitals, and international evacuation. Suspect cases require fever with compatible symptoms within 21 days of exposure or contact with a confirmed/probable case; the estimated importation risk is about 1 per 24,000 travelers from North Kivu and Ituri.

triage.headline_ja: ECDCはアフリカでのエボラ対応を強化し、ヨーロッパが潜在的な輸入症例に対応するためのガイドを発表
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス感染症の多国アウトブレイク（DRC、ウガンダ、南スーダン）であり、IHR基準で深刻な公衆衛生影響（死亡率が高い疾患）、予想外性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスクの複数該当。WPRO基準でも異常性・重症度・流行性が高い。国際的対応（ECDC、Africa CDC）が既に実施されており、社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで明示されているアウトブレイク発生地はDRC（Ituri州、North Kivu）。ウガンダとスーダンも言及されているが、サマリー主要内容はDRCでの流行と欧州への輸入リスク対応。Bluedot APIが付与したAddis Ababa（エチオピア）はAfrica CDC本部の位置であり、実際の発生地ではないため除外。対象国リストのDRCのみを verified_locations に含める。

article.articleHeadline: مرضى إيبولا في الكونغو يفرون من مراكز العلاج بسبب الجوع - بوابة الشروق
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola patients in the Congo flee treatment centers due to hunger - Shorouk Portal
article.articleSummary: Ebola patients in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo are fleeing treatment and isolation centers to seek food, underscoring hunger as a major barrier to outbreak control. Government reports show more than 150 escapes since late May from treatment and isolation facilities, including 11 suspected patients who fled a hospital in Bambu, about 25 miles from the outbreak epicenter near Mongbwalu, a gold-mining town. The outbreak has infected about 900 people, with at least 25% fatalities. Hunger and a severe regional food crisis affect more than 10 million people in eastern DRC, complicating isolation and contact tracing. Authorities say roughly 6,400 people have been exposed to Ebola. David Stevenson, Director of WFP operations in Congo, says without food assistance, isolation cannot succeed; Olivier Nkakodolo, Ituri field operations director, adds that if there is no food, people will leave.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ患者が飢餓のため治療センターから逃走 - ショルーク・ポータル
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、異常/予想外な事象、国際的拡大リスク）。アウトブレイク制御の妨害要因（患者逃走150件超、接触者追跡の失敗リスク）により管理可能性が深刻に低下。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIはイタリア（Veneto州、Bambù）を発生地域として付与しているが、記事サマリーはDRC東部のMongbwalu地域での発生を明記しており、イタリアの表示は誤検出と判断。患者逃走による感染制御失敗リスク、6,400人の接触者曝露、食糧危機による分離隔離破綻が緊急的なリスク要因。WFP介入必要の明示により国際支援ニーズが高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola en RDC : 896 cas, 232 décès, mais 78 guérisons... les premiers signes d'espoir dans l'enfer d'Ituri
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: 896 cases, 232 deaths, but 78 recoveries... the first signs of hope in the hell of Ituri
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), centered in Ituri province’s Bunia. As of June 18, 2026, 896 laboratory-confirmed cases and 232 deaths (case fatality ~26%), with 78 recoveries announced by Health Minister Samuel Roger Kamba. The 78 survivors had positive tests followed by two negative tests, underscoring that early detection and rapid treatment in specialized centers save lives. Data are lab-confirmed and validated with WHO, Africa CDC, and partners to ensure credibility amid distrust and insecurity. The rising case count is attributed to improved active case finding in communities, revealing previously undetected infections rather than an immediate surge in transmission. About 6,000 contacts are monitored, with a 71% follow-up rate versus a 95% target, reflecting logistical challenges. The outbreak's epicenter remains Ituri, where survivors and responders urge timely care at symptom onset to curb spread.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：896例、232死亡、しかし78の回復...イトゥリの地獄での最初の希望の兆候
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）、かつ既知の大規模流行にて社会的・政治的関心が高い。フルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 既知のエボラ流行である。2026年6月18日時点で896例確認（致死率26%）、232死亡。イトゥリ州ブニアが中心。約6,000人の接触者が監視中。セキュリティ上の課題と不信感により対応の困難が指摘されている。WHOおよびアフリカCDCと連携した検査結果の信頼性確保が強調されている。

article.articleHeadline: 202 وفاة جراء "إيبولا" في الكونغو الديمقراطية منذ منتصف مايو
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 202 deaths from Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo since mid-May.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 200 deaths. As of May 15, there are 875 laboratory-confirmed infections, including 202 deaths (case fatality rate 23%). The outbreak is centered in Ituri province, with about 95% of cases there, and also affects North Kivu and South Kivu. Uganda reports 19 cases linked to cross-border transmission, with 2 deaths. The causative agent is Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a rare lineage with no approved treatment or vaccine. The World Health Organization described the situation as highly concerning and declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17. Officials warn the outbreak could exceed the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic, which killed more than 11,000. Ebola outbreaks were first identified in 1976 near Nzara, Sudan, and Yambuku, DRC, with the disease named after the Ebola River nearby.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラによる死者数が5月中旬から202人に達する
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病の大規模流行で200人以上の死亡、稀なBundibugyo系統、ウガンダへの国境越えでの感染、WHOによる国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態宣言により、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはコンゴ民主共和国の東部（特にイトゥリ州）での流行を主題としており、ウガンダへの国境越え感染も言及されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。Bundibugyo ebolavirus の稀な系統、承認済み治療法・ワクチン無し、WHOによるPHEIC宣言（2026年5月17日）により極めて高いリスク。

article.articleHeadline: Podcast JR 15 Min #1446 | Dengue: dúvidas, investigação e o futuro da vacina do Butantan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Podcast JR 15 Min #1446 | Dengue: questions, investigation, and the future of the Butantan vaccine
article.articleSummary: Brazil's regulatory authority Anvisa has formed a working group to review data on the Instituto Butantan dengue vaccine. The move follows two suspected deaths in vaccinated individuals and a temporary suspension of vaccination in people over 60. So far, there is no evidence establishing a causal link between the vaccine and the fatalities. The investigation seeks to determine whether any relation exists between the cases and the immunization, review safety protocols, and consider the vaccine's risk-benefit in dengue control. The JR 15 Minutos podcast discusses the current analysis, safety measures, and the vaccine's future prospects in Brazil, with infectious disease specialist Hemerson Luz.

triage.headline_ja: ポッドキャスト JR 15分 #1446 | デング熱: 疑問、調査、ブタンタン社ワクチンの未来
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルのデング熱ワクチン接種後の死亡疑い報告により異常性は認められるが、死因との因果関係が未確立でありリスク情報は限定的。スクリーニング基準で「重症度」「管理可能性」に該当する可能性があるが、詳細な疫学情報不足のため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はワクチン安全性調査に関するメディア報道であり、デング熱流行の拡大ではなくワクチン接種後の有害事象報告が主題。死因との因果関係未確立のため、現段階ではワクチン安全性シグナルとして位置づけられるが、感染症イベント自体の公衆衛生影響度は限定的。今後のAnvisa調査結果と疫学情報の詳細化を注視する必要あり。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue cases in Mandaue City drop, but prevention efforts continue
article.articleSummary: Dengue in Mandaue City, Cebu, Philippines, shows a decline for January–June 2026 with 198 cases, down from 273 in the same period last year; total dengue cases in 2025 reached 520, with most patients being children and senior citizens. Local authorities maintain strong prevention through vector control and the 4S strategy: search and destroy breeding sites, self-protection, seek early consultation for fever, and targeted spraying in areas with confirmed cases. Vector management has identified Aedes aegypti as the primary dengue vector in the city. Dengue fast lanes were established at the City Health Office and barangay health centers to speed up assessment and care. The Epidemiologic Surveillance Unit monitors cases across hospitals and facilities, underscoring a community-wide effort during the rainy season to eliminate stagnant water and protect against bites.

triage.headline_ja: マンダウエ市のデング熱患者数は減少しているが、予防活動は継続中
triage.triage_reason: フィリピンのマンダウエ市でデング熱患者数が減少しており、公衆衛生対応が適切に実施されている。IHR基準は1つ以下の該当となり、シグナルレベルに達していないが、継続的な発生と地域的な対応の経過を観察する価値がある。
triage.notes: デング熱患者数は前年同期比で減少傾向（273件→198件）を示しており、地方当局により векторコントロールと4S戦略による予防活動が継続中。雨季における継続的な曝露リスクとデング熱の流行性を考慮し、経過観察が適切。死亡率や重症化の記載がなく、現在の管理状況は適切と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: Outbreak Kills Over 200; ACIP Investigation Launched; Hackers Demand $75M From Novo
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Congo has grown about 40% in the past week, with the confirmed death toll topping 200 as of 2026-06-19. The U.S. CDC has activated $107 million in emergency funding to support the international Ebola response, while Africa CDC says less than 10% of donor pledges have been received. Separately, a fast-spreading cholera outbreak in Nigeria has killed at least 90 people. In Zambia, NPR profiles three boys who lost their parents to AIDS, illustrating the ongoing human toll of the epidemic there. Taken together, these items highlight persistent infectious-disease challenges in Africa and the continuing international public-health response, including U.S. funding and intergovernmental coordination.

triage.headline_ja: アウトブレイクで200人以上が死亡、ACIP調査開始、ハッカーがNovoから7500万ドル要求
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。コンゴでのエボラ出血熱（確認死亡200人超、過去1週間で40%増加）とナイジェリアでのコレラ（90人以上死亡）の同時発生。米国CDC が1億700万ドルの緊急資金を投入し、国際的な感染症対応が進行中。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づき、エボラ出血熱の主要な発生地はコンゴ民主共和国。ナイジェリアのコレラ流行も記載されているがナイジェリアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ザンビアはAIDS関連の人的被害に言及されており、対象国リストに含まれるため含める。米国は対象国外のため verified_locations に含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Aantal ebola-gevallen blijft toenemen: 'Uitbraak nog verre van onder controle'
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of Ebola cases continues to rise: 'Outbreak still far from under control'.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda continues to expand: total confirmed cases reach 894 reported by Africa CDC, while the Congolese government cites 896 cases, including 232 deaths. Cases are up about 38% week over week; 90% of infections are in Ituri Province, DRC, with additional transmission in North and South Kivu. Uganda has 19 cases and 2 deaths. Contact tracing remains severely constrained: 17,000–35,000 contacts to follow, but only around 4,000 are being tracked (<15%). Ongoing insecurity, displacement, dense forests, and poor roads hinder response. International funding includes roughly €90 million from the US CDC, €493 million from the EU, and about €80 million from the African Union. Experimental treatments are being tested against the Bundibugyo variant; no licensed vaccine or medicine exists yet. The cross-border spread to Uganda highlights the regional nature of the outbreak and the need for containment.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ患者数が増加し続ける：『アウトブレイクはまだ制御下にない』
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響・国際拡大リスク・渡航制限リスク）、かつWPRO基準5項目全て該当。高い死亡率、接触者追跡困難、越境伝播、管理能力不足が確認された。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはエボラアウトブレイクがDRC（主としてIturi、North、South Kivu州）で発生し、ウガンダに越境伝播していることを明記。Bluedot APIではUgandaが発生地域に含まれているが、サマリーではウガンダは二次的な拡大地点として言及され、主要な発生地はDRCであるため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。死亡率26%（232/896）、週間増加率38%、接触者追跡率<15%、越境伝播、国際的な大規模支援投入（€663百万+）が確認される。

article.articleHeadline: A traveler with measles passed through LAX. Officials urge caution amid World Cup crowds
article.articleSummary: Measles exposure in Los Angeles amid FIFA World Cup crowds. A traveler infected with measles arrived at LAX on Cathay Pacific Flight 884 from Hong Kong on June 11, with exposure at the terminal (10:00–12:00) and at the Hilton L.A. Airport (11:15–12:15). This is the fourth LAX measles case this year and the sixth in Los Angeles County; a separate case passed through San Francisco International Airport with exposures in San José stores. Worldwide, Americas measles activity is rising, with 20,000+ cases this year and 25 deaths (Mexico 13, Guatemala 12). Symptoms include fever, cough, runny nose, red watery eyes, and a rash that appears 3–5 days after onset and starts on the face. Transmission can occur up to four days before rash and four days after. Vaccination remains critical; unimmunized or unknown status are at higher risk; exposed individuals should monitor through July 2 (7–21 days post-exposure).

triage.headline_ja: LAXを通過した麻疹患者。ワールドカップの人混みの中で注意を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 米国内での麻疹事例であり対象国（中国のみ）に該当しない。ただし、香港からの到着事例と世界的な流行状況が含まれるため、中国関連の動向監視が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域リストには米国（対象国外）、スペイン（対象国外）、メキシコ（対象国外）、グアテマラ（対象国外）が含まれるが、記事の主要イベントは米国での事例。ただし患者の出発地が香港（China に含める）であり、世界的な流行状況の一部として該当。米国内の事例が中心のため対象国リストとの関連性は限定的。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : de nouvelles mesures sanitaires imposées aux voyageurs à
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: New Health Measures Imposed on Travelers.
article.articleSummary: On 18 June 2026, amid the 17th Ebola outbreak, the Democratic Republic of Congo tightens border controls for Kinshasa. The National Program for Border Hygiene (PNHF) announced immediate enhancements at N'djili International Airport, Kinshasa's main air entry. Every traveler departing from or destined to Kinshasa must complete an electronic Traveler Health Form before arrival and before check-in; once validated, a QR code is generated and must be presented to sanitary control. Airlines must inform passengers at booking, purchase, and registration. Mandatory measures at entry/exit points include hand washing or disinfection, adherence to hygiene rules, health screening, thermal checks, and the QR health pass, with guidance to services if symptoms are detected. The goal is faster controls, smoother airport operations, and stronger border epidemiological surveillance, applying to domestic and international flights to/from Kinshasa.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：キンシャサの空港で旅行者に対する新しい保健措置が実施される
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病は深刻な公衆衛生上の影響を持ち、国際的な感染拡大リスクがあります。DRCが国境管理を強化していることは異常事象です。IHR基準3項目以上該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限のリスク）。
triage.notes: 記事日付が2026年6月19日となっており、未来の日付です。ただし、DRCにおける第17次エボラ流行中の国境管理強化は重要なシグナルです。キンシャサのN'djili国際空港での検疫措置強化は、進行中の流行対応を示しています。

article.articleHeadline: In DR Congo, Ebola patients are fleeing treatment centers
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Ebola outbreak continues with death toll exceeding 230 and nearly 900 confirmed cases as of 2026-06-19. Infected or suspected patients are fleeing treatment centers because of hunger and poor conditions, complicating containment efforts. Since the end of May, authorities report more than 150 escapes from fever centers; at least one incident involved 11 patients with suspected Ebola escaping quarantine due to malnutrition. The departure of patients underscores food shortages and substandard accommodation as key obstacles in outbreak response. The eastern DR Congo region has long suffered mass displacement, conflict, and famine, and these factors leave almost 10 million people in eastern provinces facing food insecurity. The World Health Organization has designated the Congo outbreak—and a related one in Uganda—as an international emergency and a danger to other countries, with regional spread risk assessed as high.

triage.headline_ja: DR Congo(コンゴ民主共和国)でエボラ患者が治療センターから逃げ出している
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当（死亡230人以上、900確定例、患者逃亡による制御困難、WHO国際緊急事態宣言、地域拡大リスク高）。WPRO基準も複数該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDR Congoでのエボラ発生が主題。Ugandaについては関連のアウトブレイクとして言及されているが、サマリーの主焦点はDR Congoの患者逃亡問題。対象国リストにUgandaは含まれていないため、verified_locationsはDRC(203312)のみ。WHO国際緊急事態宣言済み、患者逃亡による制御困難が重大懸念点。

article.articleHeadline: Najstarsze szczepy dżumy wywoływały śmiertelne epidemie już 5,5 tys. lat temu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The oldest strains of plague caused deadly epidemics as early as 5,500 years ago.
article.articleSummary: Ancient DNA from four hunter-gatherer cemeteries near Lake Baikal in eastern Siberia reveals early Yersinia pestis strains that caused deadly epidemics well before urban centers existed. Using genomic, archaeological, and radiocarbon data, researchers reconstructed epidemic dynamics in prehistoric communities. DNA of Y. pestis was found in 18 of 46 individuals, about 39%, indicating highly lethal outbreaks even before flea-borne, rat-mediated transmission evolved. Early strains lacked later traits enabling efficient spread via fleas, yet carried a unique superantigen gene associated with strong immune activation, likely increasing mortality. Large, rapid burials at the two biggest cemeteries, including many children and adolescents, helped explain the death pattern. The findings support Asia-origin hypotheses for plague, with spread to Eurasia via wild rodent populations; direct transmission from infected marmots to people remains plausible. This reshapes views of early plague epidemics prior to cities.

triage.headline_ja: 最古のペスト菌株は5,500年前にはすでに致命的な流行を引き起こしていた
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は古代DNAに関する歴史的・考古学的研究であり、現在の感染症イベントではない。現在発生しているペスト流行の報告ではなく、学術的分析に基づくシグナルトリアージの対象外。
triage.notes: 本記事は古代DNA分析による歴史的研究であり、過去5,500年前のペスト流行に関する考古学的知見を報告するもの。現在の感染症イベント（例：現在の動物・人間へのペスト感染）の報告ではない。したがってシグナルトリアージの対象外。ロシア連邦やタイランドがBluedotで付与された地域情報として含まれているが、記事サマリーにはシベリアのバイカル湖周辺の古代遺跡から採取されたDNAについてのみ記述されており、現在の発生地域を示すものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Pandemie-Potenzial: Warum dieser Ebola-Ausbruch Experten besonders beunruhigt
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pandemic Potential: Why This Ebola Outbreak Is Causing Particular Concern Among Experts.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo intensifies, centered in Ituri Province (northeast). Since the outbreak was declared on May 15, there are 875 confirmed infections and 202 deaths, giving a case fatality rate of 23%. The Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no vaccine or specific treatment, drives transmission via close contact and body fluids. An international health alert was issued by the World Health Organization, with Africa CDC noting regional risk is high and global risk is low. Uganda reports 19 cases and 2 deaths. Contact tracing faces security and access challenges; 4,112 individuals who had contact with confirmed cases are actively monitored, roughly 12% of an estimated 35,000 contacts. International donors have pledged about $910 million for response, including $80 million from African Union member states. Key measures emphasize rapid case identification, infection prevention, surveillance, and strict contact monitoring during incubation. The outbreak’s geographic spread requires sustained vigilance.

triage.headline_ja: パンデミック・ポテンシャル：このエボラ・アウトブレイクが専門家を特に懸念させている理由
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当、WPROスクリーニング基準5つ全て該当。エボラウイルス病の確認された多国間発生（DRC・ウガンダ）、高い死亡率（23%）、WHO国際保健警告発出、ワクチンなし株による急速な伝播、および国際的な懸念と支援動員あり。
triage.notes: ウガンダは記事で言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。DRCのイトゥリ州を中心とした発生は確認され、ブンディブギョ株（ワクチンなし）による伝播が確認されている。WHO国際保健警告発出、アフリカCDCが地域リスク高と評価。国際献金910百万ドル（アフリカ連合加盟国から80百万ドル含む）が約束されており、国際支援は既に始動している。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue: dúvidas, investigação e o futuro da vacina do Butantan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue: Questions, Investigation, and the Future of the Butantan Vaccine
article.articleSummary: Two deaths among recipients of the Instituto Butantan dengue vaccine are under investigation as Brazil’s Anvisa forms a working group to assess data on the new vaccine. Following the deaths and a temporary suspension of vaccination for people over 60, no causal relation to the vaccine has been established. The investigation seeks to determine whether any link exists between the cases and the immunization, with the group reviewing safety data, evidentiary records, and vaccination histories while continuing routine monitoring of adverse events. Infectologist Hemerson Luz outlines Anvisa’s safety protocols during the assessment. The study aims to provide technical grounding on vaccination benefits in the fight against dengue as the analysis proceeds. Regulators are also focusing on risk–benefit communication, surveillance data interpretation, and the future role of the Butantan vaccine in dengue control in Brazil. This topic is discussed in JR 15 Min #1446 podcast.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱：疑問、調査、およびブタンタンワクチンの将来
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルのデング熱ワクチン接種者における死亡例の調査が進行中であり、異常な事象として国内での関心は高い。しかし現時点では因果関係が確立されておらず、国際的拡大リスク、重症度に関する直接的根拠が限定的であるため、情報の進展を注視する段階。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はブラジルのブタンタン研究所製デング熱ワクチン接種後の死亡例調査であり、公衆衛生上の異常事象として扱われている。Anvisa（ブラジル保健規制庁）による調査が進行中で、政府レベルの関心は確認されるが、因果関係が未確立であることから現段階ではWATCHとして経過観察を継続することが適切。ワクチン安全性に関する懸念は国際的な関心に発展する可能性があり、続報の監視が重要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : l'épidémie franchit un seuil critique, l'Afrique en alerte - Mali Actu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: the outbreak crosses a critical threshold, Africa on alert - Mali Actu
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo hits a critical threshold with 875 confirmed cases and 202 deaths (case fatality ~23%) as of June 19. Transmission remains active in eastern DRC with new foci in Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu, in border areas where armed conflict and limited humanitarian access hinder response; Médecins Sans Frontières warns of dangerous gaps in crisis management. The cross‑border threat is evident: neighboring Uganda reports 19 cases and 2 deaths, highlighting transmission through remote villages, funeral practices, and population movement. Africa CDC warns that without stronger regional coordination the outbreak could become uncontrollable and overwhelm already strained health systems. In the Sahel, Mali and surrounding states monitor the risk, though West Africa has reported no cases yet. Key measures urged: rapid isolation of cases, contact tracing, ring vaccination, and robust community engagement to halt transmission; questions loom on Africa’s readiness to confront such crises.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ：流行が重大な閾値を超える、アフリカが警戒態勢へ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。また死亡者数202名、複数国での確認、ウガンダでの二次的伝播など、WPRO基準全5項目該当。フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはウガンダ19例を言及しているが、ウガンダ(226074)は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。マリについても「West Africa has reported no cases yet」との記述に基づき、実際の発生確認がないため除外。DRCのみがシグナル対象国として該当。エボラウイルス、CFR 23%、武装紛争地帯での管理困難性、複数州での同時多発など、極めて高リスクのシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: Demokratik Kongo Cumhuriyeti'nde Ebola'dan 202 kişi öldü
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, 202 people died from Ebola.
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, an Ebola outbreak attributed to Bundibugyo ebolavirus has caused 202 deaths among 875 confirmed cases, with a case fatality rate around 23%. The international reach is hampered by security concerns and constrained access for responders, complicating contact tracing. The Africa CDC and WHO note that the outbreak began with a May 15 declaration and may not peak soon; the International Red Cross suggests control could take up to a year. The northeast provinces of Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu are affected amid ongoing armed conflict and mass displacement, worsening surveillance and response. Uganda has reported 19 cases and two deaths linked to travelers from the Congo, though containment measures are keeping the Ugandan outbreak more manageable to date.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ熱により202人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。Bundibugyo ebolavirusによるエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクで確認症例875件、死亡202件（致命率23%）。ウガンダへの国際的拡大確認、紛争地帯での対応困難性、WHO/Africa CDCの対応による国際支援必要性が認められ、フルRRA実施対象。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（対象国外）への2次的伝播も報告されているが、verified_locationsはDRC（対象国）のみに限定。記事サマリーで明示的にDRCでの発生が主題であり、セキュリティ懸念による国際的対応の制約、武装紛争地域での監視体制の脆弱性が大規模な継続的曝露リスクを示唆。

article.articleHeadline: Dinkes Bandung Barat catat telah ada 174 kasus suspek Flu Singapura
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bandung Barat Health Office records 174 suspected Singapore flu cases.
article.articleSummary: 174 suspected Singapore flu cases (Hand, Foot, and Mouth Disease, HFMD) are being tracked in Bandung Barat, West Java, as of 19 June 2026, based on reports from local health facilities. No cases have been laboratory-confirmed as HFMD yet; confirmatory testing has not occurred due to limited laboratory capacity. HFMD typically presents with red patches on the hands and feet and mouth ulcers and is viral, usually self-limiting with good immunity. Dehydration can occur if ulcers impede eating or drinking. Transmission occurs via four routes: feces, body fluids, contaminated objects (fomites), and food. Public health guidance urges maintaining hygiene, boosting immunity, and adopting a healthy lifestyle with nutritious food and adequate rest to prevent spread.

triage.headline_ja: バンドゥン・バラット保健局が174件のシンガポール風邪疑い患者を記録
triage.triage_reason: 小児向けウイルス性感染症（HFMD/エンテロウイルス71）の患者集積が報告されているが、検査確定例がなく、情報不足のため経過観察が必要。流行傾向の確認待ち。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは174件の疑い患者が報告されているが、いまだ検査確定例がなく、検査機能の制限が言及されている。HFMDは小児感染症として周知の疾患だが、集団発生の規模や重症度、地域的広がりについては不明。インドネシア（西ジャワ）での発生であることは確認。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : l'épidémie franchit un seuil critique
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: The Epidemic Crosses a Critical Threshold.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo has reached a critical threshold with 875 confirmed cases and a 23% case fatality rate. In eastern DRC, the virus is spreading rapidly in a region already weakened by conflict, with Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu provinces the most affected. Over the last month, 202 deaths have been recorded. Cross-border spread is evident, with 19 cases reported in Uganda, driven by population movements and funeral practices. No cases have been reported in West Africa so far, though authorities are intensifying surveillance as health systems risk saturation. The outbreak tests the continent’s capacity to manage a major epidemic, highlighting the need for robust regional cooperation and rapid public health responses.

triage.headline_ja: RDCのエボラ：疫病が重大な閾値を超える
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準も5つ全て該当し、複数国での確認と高い死亡率を伴う。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは DRC での 875 件の確認症例と 23% の致命率、過去 1 ヶ月間での 202 件の死亡を報告。国境を越えた拡大が明確で、ウガンダで 19 件の症例が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には DRC のみ含める。東部 DRC（Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu）での急速な蔓延、紛争地帯での対応困難性、地域協力と迅速な公衆衛生対応の必要性が強調されている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: WHO: 75 Pflegekräfte mit Ebola infiziert
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: WHO: 75 healthcare workers infected with Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda affects 896 confirmed infections with 232 deaths, as of June 19, 2026. Healthcare workers are disproportionately impacted: 75 infected, 17 killed. WHO, based in Bunia, notes it is unclear whether many infections occurred at work or in private settings. The response prioritizes PPE and training for small clinics, since only 4 of 177 examined facilities had the capacity to adequately protect staff. A major challenge is that about 10% of cases display the Ebola-typical symptoms, especially bleeding, causing many individuals to delay seeking care at specialized Ebola treatment centers and increasing transmission risk within households and small clinics. One month after outbreak declaration, the situation remains serious and evolving, according to WHO.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：WHO：75人の医療従事者がエボラに感染
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病の確認症例896例、死亡232例という深刻な公衆衛生への影響、医療従事者への不釣り合いな感染、DRCとウガンダでの複数国への拡大、国際的な対応と支援の必要性が明確である。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCとウガンダの両国を言及しているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ（GeoNames ID: 203312）。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。エボラウイルス病は極めて高いリスクを有する感染症であり、医療従事者への感染、施設の不十分な感染予防対策、典型的症状の非典型化による診断遅延など、複数の懸念要素が存在。

article.articleHeadline: Пацієнти з Еболою тікають з лікувальних центрів у Конго через брак харчів
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Patients with Ebola flee from treatment centers in the Democratic Republic of the Congo due to food shortages
article.articleSummary: As of June 19, 2026, Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo have infected about 900 people, with more than a quarter dying. Since the end of May there have been over 150 reported cases of Ebola patients fleeing from treatment centers, linked to food shortages and poor conditions. In one incident, 11 infected fled due to insufficient food aid. Eastern Congo has long faced displacement, conflict, and a hunger crisis, with food insecurity affecting nearly 10 million people in eastern provinces. The reports, including Bloomberg coverage, emphasize how food insecurity and humanitarian strain are driving patients to flee care during an active Ebola outbreak in the region.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ患者が食糧不足により コンゴの治療センターから逃亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響：約900人感染・死亡25%以上、異常性：患者の治療センター離脱、国際的拡大リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度・流行性・管理可能性で複数該当。フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は国際保健上の最重要感染症。患者が治療センターから逃亡していることは感染拡大制御の失敗を示唆し、地域紛争・食糧危機と複合的な危機状況。東部コンゴでの約1000万人の食糧不安が対応を困難にしており、国際的な人道支援が必要な状況。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola resurges in Eastern DRC as conflict, mistrust hinder response
article.articleSummary: Ebola resurges in eastern DR Congo’s Ituri province, centered on Bunia and the mining town Mongbwalu. May 15 declared the outbreak the 17th; evidence suggests circulation weeks earlier. By confirmation, 246 suspected cases and 80 deaths had been recorded. Transmission is via close contact with infected individuals and bodily fluids; early symptoms resemble malaria, typhoid and yellow fever, delaying diagnosis. Lab challenges delayed identification, as Bunia facilities initially targeted the Zaire strain and missed Bundibugyo, the strain. Uganda reported a Congolese traveler’s death linked to the outbreak on declaration day; border crossings were closed and surveillance strengthened. WHO declared a global health emergency; Africa CDC cautions up to 10 countries at elevated risk. Bundibugyo has no approved vaccine or specific treatment; vaccines exist for Zaire but not Bundibugyo. Conventional measures remain primary; a Bundibugyo-targeted vaccine could be available by year-end, with trials considered. Security and displacement hinder response.

triage.headline_ja: 紛争と不信がエボラ対応を阻害する中、DRC東部でエボラが再燃
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）、WPROスクリーニング基準4つ以上該当（異常、重症度高、長期曝露、流行しやすさ）、WHO・Africa CDCの警告による社会的関心が極めて高い。フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株のエボラ出血熱であり、ザイール株とは異なり既承認ワクチンが存在せず、治療法も限定的。ウガンダへの越境事例、セキュリティと人道危機による対応の困難性が重大なリスク要因。WHO、Africa CDCによる警告・宣言あり。最大10カ国への拡大リスク指摘。

article.articleHeadline: A Traveler With Measles Passed Through Lax. Officials Urge Caution Amid World Cup Crowds
article.articleSummary: Measles exposure linked to a traveler at Los Angeles International Airport (LAX) during World Cup crowds. A passenger infected with measles arrived on Cathay Pacific Flight 884 from Hong Kong and was at LAX Tom Bradley International Terminal June 11 between 10 a.m. and noon, then at the Hilton Los Angeles Airport between 11:15 a.m. and 12:15 p.m. Exposures may occur 7–21 days after contact. This is the fourth measles case confirmed at LAX this year and the sixth in Los Angeles County; a prior case traveled through San Francisco International Airport and possibly exposed people in San José stores. With World Cup events (June 12–July 10) and about 150,000 travelers, authorities urge vaccination (MMR), symptom awareness, and staying home when sick. Measles symptoms include fever, cough, runny nose, red/watery eyes, and a rash typically starting on the face and spreading downward 3–5 days after onset; transmission is airborne and can occur before rash and for several days after.

triage.headline_ja: 麻しんに感染した渡航者がLAXを通過。ワールドカップ開催中の警告が当局から発令
triage.triage_reason: 感染症の発生地はアメリカ（対象国外）であり、対象国リストに該当する国での実際の発生は確認されない。香港からの到着は記載されるが、香港での発生ではなく、米国での輸入症例である。
triage.notes: 記事はアメリカ（カリフォルニア州）での麻しん事例を報告しており、アメリカは対象国リストに含まれない。香港はフライト出発地として記載されているが、香港での発生疫学的背景は記事に記載されていない。WPRO関心地域での感染症イベントではないため、シグナルとして識別しない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en Ituri : la capacité de détection des cas a augmenté, plus de 2.000 tests réalisés par jour
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Ituri: the case-detection capacity has increased, more than 2,000 tests conducted per day.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in Ituri: case-detection capacity has surged, with more than 2,000 tests conducted daily. At a Bunia briefing on 18 June 2026, Health, Public Affairs, and Social Affairs ministers highlighted progress in the response, crediting community involvement, the central government, and partners. Dr. Lola of the response team noted detection structures are in place across 36 health zones, while the outbreak currently affects 20 zones, aided by community relays that quickly raise alerts. Nine treatment centers totaling over 500 beds are now operational. The outbreak has yielded 78 recoveries, signaling effective containment and mortality reduction under current strategies. Thirty-three days after declaration, 896 positive cases and 232 deaths have been reported across three provinces; Ituri accounts for 827 confirmed cases, about 80% of the total."

triage.headline_ja: イトゥリ州のエボラ：患者検出能力が増加、1日2000件以上の検査が実施されている
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の確認された流行であり、IHR基準で「異常・予想外性」と「国際的拡大リスク」に該当。DRC内で複数州に拡大し、公衆衛生への深刻な影響が明らかである。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱の重大な流行。DRC内で897例の確認症例と232例の死亡が報告されており、イトゥリ州が全体の約80%を占める。複数州への拡大、複数の治療センター運営、国家および国際的な対応の展開が確認されている。WHOへの通知義務基準を複数満たす。

article.articleHeadline: DSÖ: KDC'de Ebola salgınında durum ciddiyetini sürdürüyor
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: The Ebola outbreak in the DRC remains serious.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo remains serious, with 896 confirmed cases and 232 deaths across 3 provinces and 33 health zones, one month after Ituri province reported 246 suspected cases and 65 deaths and the outbreak was declared on May 15. The WHO subsequently declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17. The current outbreak is linked to the Bundibugyo ebolavirus variant, for which no approved treatment or vaccine exists. Uganda has not reported new cases in the last 12 days. More than 115 WHO experts have been deployed to support responses across affected provinces and health zones. Access restrictions in some high-risk areas are hampering operations, underscoring the need to sustain rapid and scaled-up measures to halt transmission.

triage.headline_ja: WHO：DRCのエボラ出血熱流行の深刻な状況が継続
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も全項目に該当。エボラ出血熱の国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威として、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱はWHOが2026年5月17日にPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）を宣言。896確定例、232死亡、致死率約26%。治療法・ワクチンのないBundibugyo ebolavirus。ウガンダは12日間新規例なし（越境リスク監視対象）。アクセス制限により対応が困難な状況。国際的なハイレベルな関心と対応が継続中。

article.articleHeadline: Casos de Ebola aumentam quase 40% em uma semana e surto é o pior já registrado, aponta CDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola cases rise nearly 40% in one week, and the outbreak is the worst on record, according to the CDC.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda is the worst on record, with 894 confirmed cases and more than 200 deaths in the first month. Africa CDC reports the outbreak is about three times larger than the 2000 Uganda outbreak (281 cases). Transmission risk is amplified by displacement and insecurity: Ituri province accounts for over 90% of cases, with spillover into North and South Kivu and 19 confirmed Ugandan cases (2 deaths) across the border. Contact tracing remains challenging—estimates suggest 17,000–35,000 contacts are needed for 800 confirmed cases, but only about 4,000 have been traced. Nearly one million people displaced in Ituri due to conflict hinder surveillance. Bundibugyo has no approved vaccines or treatments; by contrast Zaire ebolavirus has a vaccine. Funding is severely underdelivered: roughly $1 billion pledged, only $90 million released; Africa CDC says 540 staff are needed, with just 84 deployed.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ患者数が1週間でほぼ40%増加、記録上最悪のアウトブレイクと CDC が指摘
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全てに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。Bundibugyo ebolavirus による未曾有規模のアウトブレイク、894確認患者・200死亡、接触者追跡体制の不十分さ、ワクチン・治療法なし、資金不足など複合的な懸念が存在。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの19確認患者は記事サマリーに記載されているが、主要な発生地は DRC（特に Ituri 州が全体の90%以上）。Bundibugyo ebolavirus は Zaire ebolavirus と異なり承認ワクチン・治療法がないため、管理可能性が極めて低い。資金・人員配置の著しい不足（540名必要に対し84名のみ）も重大な懸念。WHO への通知義務あり。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola making pregnant women avoid hospital - sparking fears of spike in deaths
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) caused by Bundibugyo virus, with cross-border spread to Uganda. As of 19 June 2026, confirmed cases in DRC and Uganda total at least 894 with more than 200 deaths and 74 recoveries; Ituri province (and Bunia) accounts for over 90% of cases, with Uganda reporting 19 cases and two deaths. The epidemic is triggering a maternal-health crisis as pregnant women avoid health facilities, elevating deaths in Ituri (seven maternal deaths this week versus two in the same week last year); prenatal clinic attendance in Bunia has fallen from about 60 to 10 per month. Bundibugyo offers no approved vaccines or treatments, though experimental therapies are under development. Public health response hampered by weak infrastructure, misinformation, and funding gaps; Ebola contact tracing is about 43% (roughly 4,000 contacts tracked of a larger target). Donor pledges total around $910 million, but actual funds are under $90 million.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがアフリカで妊婦の病院受診を回避させる - 死亡数の急増への懸念が広がる
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。深刻な公衆衛生への影響（894確定患者、200以上の死亡）、予想外の跨境感染拡大（DRC→ウガンダ）、国際的拡大リスク、及び渡航・貿易制限の可能性を呈している。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはUganda（226074）も列挙されているが、サマリーではDRC内の跨境感染として扱われており、記事の主題は DRC での Bundibugyo ウイルスによるエボラアウトブレイクである。Uganda は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。母子保健危機の発生、実験的治療の開発進行中、ドナー資金$910Mの誓約に対し実績$90M未満という資金ギャップが確認される。接触者追跡率43%と不十分な公衆衛生対応が懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Pune: PMC Urges Citizens To Prevent Mosquito Breeding During Water Storage
article.articleSummary: 2026-06-19: Pune Municipal Corporation (PMC) urges residents to prevent mosquito breeding during alternate-day water supply. The Health and Vector-Borne Disease Control Department warns improper storage can spread dengue and malaria. Residents should keep all water containers — buckets, drums, barrels, overhead tanks — tightly covered and scrub them before refilling, since dengue eggs can cling to inner walls. Housing societies must ensure underground and overhead tanks are properly covered. Remove items that collect rainwater, such as discarded tyres, plastic containers, and broken utensils. Report mosquito larvae or heavy breeding to the nearest PMC ward office or the Main Insect Disease Control Department at 020-25508474 for prompt spraying and anti-larval measures. The campaign calls for public participation: save water, keep it covered, and safeguard public health during alternate-day supply.

triage.headline_ja: プネ：PMC市民に水の貯蔵時の蚊の繁殖を防ぐよう促す
triage.triage_reason: デング熱とマラリアの公衆衛生キャンペーン記事。単なる予防啓発活動であり、確認された患者発生や異常事態ではなく、情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 本記事はプネ市での蚊媒介感染症予防キャンペーンを報じたもの。新規患者発生、異常事態、国際的拡大リスク、流行の確認など、IHR基準やWPRO重大基準を満たす情報は含まれていない。政府レベルでの公衆衛生対応活動は認識できるが、シグナルの域には達していない。続報で患者数増加や異常が報告される場合は再評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Baj van a sertéságazatban: a spanyol hús olcsóbb mint a magyar és most itt a pestis
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: There is trouble in the pork industry: Spanish pork is cheaper than Hungarian pork, and now the plague is here.
article.articleSummary: African swine fever (ASF) has disrupted Hungary’s pork sector as exports to South Korea, Vietnam, Serbia, Moldova, and North Macedonia are suspended. Hungary loses about 9,000 slaughter pigs per week, roughly 1,000 tons of processed pork, with another 1,000 tons awaiting export in cold storage. A domestic surplus emerges as summer public catering operates at ~20% of normal capacity. The government aims to eradicate the outbreak within two months, deploying intense wild boar culling and enhanced biosecurity; processors and retailers are urged to substitute Hungarian pork for imports for the next eight weeks. State Secretary László Búza notes ASF’s severity: on a single 18-pen farm, 12 animals die within two days. Domestic prices favor cheaper Spanish pork (about 1,050 forints/kg for ham) versus Hungarian at roughly 1,300 forints/kg, influenced by Hungary’s higher energy costs. Diplomatic efforts seek to salvage shipments started before the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: 豚肉産業に問題発生：スペイン産豚肉はハンガリー産より安く、そして今ここに疫病が来た
triage.triage_reason: アフリカ豚熱（ASF）がハンガリーで確認され、複数国への輸出停止、大規模な豚の損失（週9,000頭）、および国際的な貿易制限が発生している。IHR基準の3つ（深刻な影響、異常性、国際的な拡大リスク）を満たし、スクリーニング基準も複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事はハンガリーでのASF発生を主題としており、ハンガリーは対象国リストに含まれていないが、ベトナムへの輸出停止が言及されており、対象国であるベトナムが検証対象地域として含まれる。ASFは動物疾病であるが、国際的な貿易制限と経済的な重大な影響を伴うため、公衆衛生上の関心事項として評価される。

article.articleHeadline: Rusia kirim 7.000 alat tes Ebola ke negara-negara Afrika
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Russia sends 7,000 Ebola test kits to African countries.
article.articleSummary: Russia distributed more than 7,000 Ebola diagnostic PCR test kits designed to detect the Bundibugyo strain to African countries amid outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda. Rospotrebnadzor said the tests were developed and regulated within four days. The distribution includes donations to several African nations, and the testing system was also handed to North Korea and Turkmenistan. Russian and Ugandan experts have conducted over 1,500 studies on Ebola patient materials and suspected cases. The deployment follows reports of Bundibugyo-linked Ebola in DR Congo and Uganda, with ongoing laboratory confirmation and surveillance efforts. The kits enable PCR-based diagnosis within four days, reflecting international support for outbreak response.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア、アフリカ諸国に7,000個のエボラ検査キットを送付
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo株）がDRC及びウガンダで発生しており、IHR基準で深刻な公衆衛生影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められ、WPROスクリーニング基準では異常性・重症度・流行しやすさが該当。国際的な診断支援が展開されている現在進行形のシグナル。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは『DRC及びウガンダでBundibugyo関連エボラが報告されている』と明記されているが、対象国リストにウガンダ（Uganda）が含まれていないため verified_locations にはDRCのみ列挙。北朝鮮・トルクメニスタン・ロシアへの検査キット配布は支援行動であり、これら国での発症報告ではないため除外。ロシアはWPRO対象国外のため除外。国際的に重要なシグナルであり、フルRRA対象。

article.articleHeadline: WHO Introduces First Clinical Care Standards Amid Growing Ebola Outbreak
article.articleSummary: WHO releases its first unified clinical management guidelines for filovirus diseases amid the Bundibugyo virus outbreak in the DRC and Uganda, where there are no licensed vaccines or targeted treatments. The 86-page Guidelines for the Clinical Management of Filovirus Disease emphasize high-quality supportive care; hydration, electrolyte balance, shock management, infection prevention, and treatment of secondary infections, with systematic monitoring and rapid reassessment because patients can deteriorate quickly. The framework covers Ebola, Sudan, Bundibugyo, Taï Forest, and Marburg viruses, adopting evidence-based GRADE methods to harmonize care across outbreaks, including resource-limited settings. Since May 17, 2026, when WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, hundreds of confirmed infections and nearly 200 deaths have been reported; the outbreak has spread across eastern DRC and crossed into Uganda via imported cases. Africa CDC warns of gaps in contact tracing (~33,000 identified contacts) and calls for strengthened surveillance, laboratory testing, and infection prevention.

triage.headline_ja: 成長するエボラアウトブレイク最中にWHOが初の臨床治療標準を導入
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHOが国際保健上の緊急事態を宣言済みで、複数国にまたがる流行が進行中。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCとウガンダでの発生を明記。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを記載。2026年5月17日にWHOが国際保健上の緊急事態を宣言、確認症例数百件、死亡者約200名が報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak cases surge nearly 40% in a week
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo has surged, with 894 confirmed cases—three times higher than Uganda’s 2000 outbreak at the same stage—and over 200 deaths in the first month. Cases rose 38% in one week, while 74 patients have recovered. The outbreak spans 32 health zones in eastern Congo. Contact tracing is hindered by remoteness, funding shortfalls, personnel shortages, and displacement. Only 4,112 individuals are under follow-up, versus an estimated 35,000 exposed. The International Committee of the Red Cross says the epidemic worsens vulnerability among populations already affected by armed conflict and violence. Africa CDC reports these trends for the Congo outbreak (cited via Qazinform/WAM) as of 2026-06-19.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の感染事例が1週間で約40%急増
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当。エボラ出血熱の大規模流行で死亡者200名超、国際的拡大リスク高い。接触者追跡の失敗と地域不安定性により管理困難。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは、エボラ出血熱の流行が東部コンゴ民主共和国で発生していることが明確に記載されており、ウガンダは比較対象として言及されているのみ（ウガンダでの現在の流行は述べられていない）。発生地域フィールドにはウガンダも含まれるが、記事主題の実際の発生地はDRCのみ。資金不足、人員不足、武力紛争による影響など複合的な課題があり、対応能力が極めて限定的との指摘あり。フルRRA必須。

article.articleHeadline: Ngăn sốt rét quay trở lại tại khu vực biên giới Quảng Trị
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Prevent malaria from returning in the Quảng Trị border region.
article.articleSummary: Malaria continues to threaten Quảng Trị’s border region, with 2025 recording 50 malaria cases in the province and A Dơi commune accounting for 40 cases (80% of provincial total), mainly in Đồng Tâm and Trùm hamlets. Most cases involve male workers in production, logging, forest work, sleeping in fields, or crossing the Vietnam–Laos border, increasing exposure to vectors. In the first six months of 2026, Quảng Trị reported one imported malaria case in Đồng Tâm, A Dơi, linked to cross-border activity. Local authorities, led by Vice Chairwoman Nguyễn Thị Phương Hạnh, are intensifying surveillance, containment, and response, ensuring treatment drugs, vector-control supplies, and rapid outbreak investigations. Communications are expanded, targeting ethnic minority communities to raise awareness and change behavior. Vietnam remains near malaria elimination but cautions against complacency, urging continued interagency coordination and community engagement.

triage.headline_ja: クアンチ国境地域でマラリアの再発を防止
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムのクアンチ州国境地域でマラリアが継続して報告されており、2026年1月～6月に輸入症例1件が確認されている。スクリーニング基準では異常性・流行易性・対応可能性で該当する可能性があるが、致死率や重症度についての明確な情報が不足しており、国際的拡大リスクも明確でないため、追加情報を注視する段階。
triage.notes: 記事はベトナムのクアンチ州における国境地域でのマラリア継続脅威について述べている。2025年の50症例、2026年1月～6月の輸入症例1件が報告されているが、致死率・重症度・国際的拡大の具体的リスクについては記述がない。国境越境活動に関連した曝露が継続している点が注目される。ラオス人民民主共和国も発生地域リストに含まれているが、記事サマリーではラオス側での発生の具体的記述がないため、verified_locationsにはベトナムのみを含める。

article.articleHeadline: DSÖ'den korkutan salgın uyarısı! 'Yayılmaya devam ediyor'
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Alarming outbreak warning from the WHO! 'It continues to spread'.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak spreading in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), with Ituri province among affected areas. After declaration on May 15 following 246 suspected cases and 65 deaths, the outbreak remains serious. To date, 896 confirmed cases and 232 deaths have been reported across 3 provinces and 33 health zones; Uganda has not reported new cases in 12 days. WHO Africa Region Emergency Director Marie-Roseline Belizaire told a UN Geneva briefing that over 115 WHO experts have been deployed to affected provinces and health zones to support all response stages, with ongoing need for sustained funding as operations scale up. Access restrictions in high-risk areas hinder operations. The WHO notes that what works to stop transmission is known and calls for rapid, large-scale implementation. The current outbreak is linked to the Bundibugyo virus variant; no approved treatment or vaccine exists.

triage.headline_ja: WHOからの警告！エボラの流行が『広がり続けている』
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラ出血熱は重篤な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、DRCでの確認例896件・死亡232件の大規模流行、ウガンダへの国際的拡大リスク、複数国での報告により国際的影響が明確。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはジュネーブ（スイス）も含まれているが、記事サマリーはDRCでの実際の流行報告が主題であり、ジュネーブはWHO本部での報告会見の開催地点であるため、実発生地域に含めない。ウガンダは隣接国で監視対象だが、「新規患者報告なし12日間」とあるため、現在の実際の発生地域はDRCのみ。Bundibugyo亜型、治療法・ワクチンなしという高リスク要因あり。

article.articleHeadline: Smrtonosni virus kosi i lekare: Ebola probila poslednju liniju odbrane, crni bilans nezaustavljivo raste
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The deadly virus is mowing down doctors: Ebola has breached the last line of defense, and the grim toll grows unabated.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-19, Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo continues to claim lives, with more than 800 registered cases of a rare Ebola strain for which there is currently no vaccine. At least 192 deaths reported. Health workers are disproportionately affected, including 75 doctors infected and 17 killed, complicating patient care. WHO official Mari Rozelin Belizer reported these figures during a video press conference from the DRC. International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies coordinator Bruno Misjon cautioned that the outbreak has not peaked and could last up to a year. Authorities and health organizations maintain urgent containment efforts as cases rise and fatalities accumulate, highlighting the severe impact on healthcare systems in the region.

triage.headline_ja: 致死的なウイルスが医師を含めて被害を拡大：エボラが最後の防衛線を突破し、犠牲者が増加し続けている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全てに該当。エボラアウトブレイク（800例以上、192死亡）は極めて深刻な公衆衛生上の影響を示し、医療従事者への重大な影響、ワクチン未開発の株、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限の可能性がある。
triage.notes: エボラアウトブレイク（東部DRC）は極めて高リスク。医療従事者75名感染・17名死亡、ワクチン未開発の株、ピークに達していない可能性、最大1年間継続との予測。WHO及び国際赤十字からの公式報告により信頼性が高い。緊急のフルRRA実施が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola death toll in DRC and Uganda passes 200 as funding pledges fall short
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda has claimed at least 204 lives and infected 894 people. In DRC, 202 deaths are confirmed, with two in Uganda; the outbreak is three times larger than the 2000 Ugandan outbreak at a similar point and concentrated in Ituri province (over 90% of cases), with spread to North Kivu and South Kivu and across the border to Uganda (19 confirmed cases). Bundibugyo virus, lacking approved vaccines or treatments, is responsible; the more common Zaire virus has vaccines but is not driving this outbreak. Cases were confirmed on 15 May, with a 38% weekly increase and now 32 health zones affected. Donors pledged about $910 million, but less than $90 million has been released. Africa CDC says 540 personnel are needed; 84 deployed. WHO reports a Chinese medical team to Congo; over 60 WHO health workers infected, 34 deaths; 74 recoveries. Vaccine and antibody research ongoing.

triage.headline_ja: DRCとウガンダのエボラ死者数が200人を超える一方、資金支援誓約が不足
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的な拡大、死亡と感染確認、国際対応への需要）、WPRO基準でも複数該当し、重度の流行が進行中。国際的な対応と資金不足が報道されており社会的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 発生地域にUgandaが含まれるが、記事サマリーではウガンダは19確認事例のみで、主要な流行地域はDRCのIturi州（症例の90%以上）。verified_locationsはDRCのみとする。ただし、国境を越えた拡大があり国際的な対応が必要という点で重要。ワクチン未承認のBundibugyo virus、資金不足、多くの保健ワーカー感染など複数のリスク要因がある。

article.articleHeadline: Ca tử vong do bệnh dại tăng ở miền Nam
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rabies deaths on the rise in the South.
article.articleSummary: Rabies deaths rise in Southern Vietnam in 2026: in the first six months, nearly 20 fatalities, about half of last year’s total. The Pasteur Institute in Ho Chi Minh City notes continued rabies virus circulation in dogs and cats, increasing human exposure after bites or scratches. All recent deaths occurred in people who did not receive post-exposure vaccination. Many still seek traditional 'venom extraction' after dog bites; there is no evidence this prevents rabies, and once the virus reaches the nervous system, mortality is near 100%. To reduce deaths, authorities urge control of disease in animals (vaccinating dogs and cats) and mandatory post-exposure vaccination for bite victims. The institute also warns of co-circulating diseases in the South, including hand, foot and mouth disease (HFMD) and dengue fever during the rainy season, with EV71 linked to severe cases. Vaccination remains the best prevention; post-exposure rabies vaccination is crucial.

triage.headline_ja: 南部でのエンテロウイルス71感染症とその他感染症の患者死亡数が増加
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムで複数の感染症（狂犬病、手足口病、デング熱、EV71）が同時流行中。狂犬病による死亡増加（今年上半期で約20人）とEV71による重症化の報告が、IHR基準の「異常性」と「重症度」、WPROスクリーニング基準の「重症度」「流行しやすさ」を満たし、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事はホーチミン市からの報告だが、「南部全域」での狂犬病死亡増加を述べている。複数疾患の同時流行（狂犬病、HFMD、デング熱、EV71）が指摘され、EV71は重症化に関連。狂犬病の死亡率は100%近く、予防接種の需要が高い。ベトナムは対象国リストに含まれる。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola death toll tops 200 as Africa CDC warns of critical gaps in regional response
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda has reached 894 confirmed cases and 204 deaths (case fatality ~22.8%), with 74 recoveries; Uganda accounts for 19 cases and 2 deaths. The Bundibugyo strain drives the response, with testing conducted within 24 hours; about 21,000 tests have been sent to DRC, Uganda, South Sudan and Burundi, and 27,000 more are in the pipeline. Africa CDC warns six critical constraints that could sustain transmission: no licensed countermeasures for Bundibugyo, insecurity and attacks on facilities, healthcare worker infections, gaps in contact tracing (roughly 12% of contacts actively followed), cross-border movement, and financing gaps. Ituri Province in eastern DRC remains the epicenter amid displacement of over 900,000. Safe burial capacity is far short (84 of 540). About 910 million USD has been pledged, but only 90 million disbursed; the outbreak was designated a continental security emergency on May 18.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ死者数が200人を超え、アフリカCDCが地域対応の重大な課題を警告
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の確認された広域多国間流行（894例、204死亡）で、IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際的拡大リスク、および渡航・貿易制限のリスクが明らかである。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは民主コンゴが主要な発生地域（Ituri Province）として特定されている。ウガンダ、ブルンジ、南スーダンは記事中で言及されているが、確認例は主にDRCとウガンダに限定されており、DRCが主要な発生国。対象国リストにはDRCのみが含まれるため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。アフリカCDC指定の大陸安全保障緊急事態（2026年5月18日）、資金不足（900億ドル必要に対し90百万ドルのみ配分）、安全埋葬容量の深刻な不足、接触追跡の低い達成率（12%）など、多数の制御障害が文書化されている。

article.articleHeadline: Hantavirus: recuerdan que Junín es zona endémica y piden "no bajar la guardia"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hantavirus: Junín is an endemic area and authorities urge not to let their guard down.
article.articleSummary: Hantavirus remains endemic in Junín, Buenos Aires Province, Argentina, with a year-to-date rise in cases prompting warnings from local experts. A national epidemiological report again places Buenos Aires among jurisdictions with the most hantavirus cases, highlighting three risk zones: northwest (Salta, Jujuy), the Andean Patagonia, and the central river region (Paraná, Río de la Plata). Junín is an established endemic area where rodent reservoirs sustain perpetual virus circulation; winter months show lower transmission, but vigilance remains. There is no vaccine or specific treatment. Prevention centers on avoiding rodent exposure: keep grass short around homes, store wood away from dwellings, and control rodents in domiciles, barns and rural buildings. If cleaning spaces with rodent traces, never sweep; use damp cloths with diluted bleach (1:9). Transmission is rodent-to-human, not person-to-person; suspect hantavirus with prolonged fever and thrombocytopenia, especially in Junín residents.

triage.headline_ja: ハンタウイルス：フニンは風土病地域であり、当局は「警戒を怠らない」よう警告
triage.triage_reason: アルゼンチンにおけるハンタウイルスの風土病維持状況を報告しており、異常性や予想外性は低い。対象国（ブラジル）は地理的に関連しているが、主たる発生地はアルゼンチンとペルーであり、対象国リストに該当なし。情報は不足していないが、既知の風土病管理情報のため、PICKUP基準には達さない。
triage.notes: 発生地域としてアルゼンチン（Junín、Buenos Aires Province、Salta、Jujuy）やペルーが含まれているが、いずれも対象国リストに該当しない。ブラジルは発生地域リストに含まれているものの、記事サマリーでは明確な発生を示唆する記述がなく、地理的参照のみの可能性がある。既知の風土病地域での周知的警告報告であり、新規のアウトブレイク状況ではない。WPRO基準では長期曝露と流行しやすさが該当するが、社会的関心がある一方、対象国内での発生報告がないため、WATCH判定。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Outbreak Expands, Tracing Slows
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo-strain Ebola drives a fresh outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, spreading from Ituri into North Kivu and South Kivu and across the border into Uganda. As of 2026-06-19, laboratory-confirmed cases are reported between 676 and 782 with rising deaths (around 136 cited in notes), and containment is hampered by tracing gaps and limited treatment capacity. Unlike the Zaire strain, Bundibugyo has no approved vaccine and only limited therapies, complicating rapid control amid displacement, insecurity, and mobility in mining regions that facilitates cross-border spread. Effective containment hinges on rapid, large-scale contact tracing and robust community engagement, supported by regional coordination among Africa CDC and WHO, which are ramping up surveillance and testing. Ongoing updates are anticipated on case counts, deaths, funding, and resource mobilization for border areas and affected districts.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ感染症の流行が拡大、接触者追跡が遅延
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、国際的に確認された多国間の流行である。Bundibugyo株によるエボラウイルス感染症の急速な拡大、高い死亡率、ワクチン未承認、多国間の国境越え拡大、および制御困難な状況が確認される。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株エボラウイルスの流行であり、Zaire株と異なりワクチン未承認で治療法が限定的。DRC内のIturi、North Kivu、South Kivuから確認され、ウガンダへの国境越え拡大が報告されている。確定症例676～782例、死亡136例が記録されている。採鉱地域での人口移動と不安定な治安が拡大を助長している。WAHO&Africa CDC等の地域調整が進行中。ウガンダ（対象国外）への拡大も報告されているが、検証済みロケーションはDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: En RDC, Ebola fait plus de 200 morts au Nord-Kivu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the DRC, Ebola has killed more than 200 people in North Kivu.
article.articleSummary: As of 19 June 2026, Ebola outbreaks continue in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, with Africa CDC reporting 875 confirmed cases and 202 deaths. Ituri Province remains the epicenter with 799 confirmed cases, while Nord-Kivu Province shows a concerning trajectory. Uganda’s situation remains unchanged. The figures reflect laboratory-confirmed infections tracked by Africa CDC, the African Union health agency, underscoring ongoing transmission in the region and the concentration of cases in Ituri. The update highlights the eastern DRC as the focal area, with continued progression of the outbreak; no additional details on infection sources or cross-border events are provided. These data reflect the updated caseload and mortality as of the published date.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラが北キヴ州で200人以上の死亡者を出している
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の大規模アウトブレイク（875確認例、202死亡）がコンゴ民主共和国東部で継続中。IHR基準（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）を満たし、複数のWPRO基準（高い重症度、長期曝露、流行しやすさ）に該当する。フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: エボラは国際公衆衛生上の最重要脅威疾患。875確認例、202死亡（致命率23%）は深刻な規模。ウガンダは発生地域に含まれるが記事サマリーではウガンダの状況は『変化なし』と記載されており、検証対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。イツリ州が震源地（799例）で継続的な伝播が報告されている。国境を越えた拡大リスク（ウガンダ隣接地域）が潜在的に存在。

article.articleHeadline: مفوضية اللاجئين تحذر من تهديد فيروس إيبولا للمجتمعات النازحة في الكونغو الديمقراطية وخارجها | مفوضية اللاجئين
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: UNHCR warns of the Ebola virus threat to displaced communities in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and beyond | UNHCR
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) threatens displaced populations and cross‑border communities. As of 17 June, 896 confirmed cases and 232 deaths have been reported across 31 health zones in the DRC; Uganda has 19 cases and 2 deaths. Over 2 million people are forcibly displaced inside the DRC, including more than 320,000 refugees, with ongoing fighting and high mobility increasing transmission risk.
