Notable movements include about 2,250 people fleeing Impao near Beni to Oicha in North Kivu on 7 June, while Ituri hosts more than 14,300 IDPs. Trust deficits have impeded response, exemplified by a 3 June disruption in Kabangba, Ituri, after two Ebola deaths. UNHCR and partners trained 100+ local community leaders on prevention; chlorine handwashing stations were deployed; cross‑border coordination with Uganda, Rwanda, Burundi, South Sudan, and Tanzania is underway. A $14 million appeal (July–November) aims to strengthen response for displaced and host communities in DRC, Uganda, and preparedness in Burundi, Rwanda, and South Sudan.

triage.headline_ja: UNHCR、コンゴ民主共和国およびその周辺地域の国内避難民コミュニティに対するエボラウイルスの脅威について警告
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の確認症例896件、死亡232件がDRCで報告されており、ウガンダでも19件の症例と2件の死亡が確認されている。国際的な拡大リスク（ウガンダ、ルワンダ、ブルンジ、南スーダン、タンザニアとの国境地域での流行）、深刻な公衆衛生上の影響、社会的・政治的関心の高さから、IHR基準2つ以上およびWPRO基準複数に該当する。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病はIHR(2005) Annex2における指定疾患である。DRCが主要な流行地であり、ウガンダでも二次症例の確認があるが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には DRC のみを含める。複数国での国境地域流行、避難民（200万人以上が国内避難、32万人以上が難民）による高い伝播リスク、国際的な対応調整（$14百万のアピール）が進行中。信頼欠如による対応阻害も報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Mais de 200 pessoas morreram vítimas de Ébola na RDC - O País - A verdade como notícia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 200 people have died from Ebola in the DRC - O País - The truth as news
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has killed 202 people out of 875 confirmed cases (case fatality rate 23%), as of June 19, 2026, per Africa CDC. The northeastern provinces of Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu are affected, in regions long beset by conflict and displacement, which hamper response efforts. The outbreak was declared on May 15. There are no vaccines or treatments approved for the strain involved. Contact tracing remains limited due to security and access challenges for Africa CDC, the WHO, and partners. The Red Cross warns the outbreak may not peak soon and could take up to a year to contain. The epidemic has spread to Uganda, with 19 confirmed cases and two deaths, predominantly among Congolese travelers.

triage.headline_ja: 200人以上がコンゴ民主共和国のエボラで死亡 - O País - ニュースとしての真実
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPRO基準も5つすべてに該当。エボラウイルス病の確認例875件、死亡202名という深刻な公衆衛生影響、ウガンダへの国際的拡大、セキュリティと医療アクセス課題による管理困難性が認識される。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでウガンダへの拡大（確認例19件、死亡2名）が明記されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。DRCのみが対象国リスト内。発生地域にはSouth Kivu、Ituri、DRC、Republic of Ugandaが記載されているが、サマリーの内容から主要な発生地はDRCであり、流行制御困難（紛争地域、変位住民、限定的な接触追跡、ワクチン/治療なし）という複合的なリスク要因が存在。

article.articleHeadline: Horrific suspicion in the death of actress Ece İrtem: Monkey bite
article.articleSummary: 35-year-old actress Ece Irtem, known for Kizilcik Serbeti, died in Istanbul on 15.06.2026 after sudden illness; initial assessment was heart attack, but a monkey bite in Thailand a week earlier has prompted a sepsis suspicion. Wound marks on her left arm were reported; experts say wild monkey bites can lead to infections and sepsis, potentially triggering cardiac issues. The family's lawyer submitted a petition to the Istanbul Chief Public Prosecutor's Office requesting autopsy findings also explore sepsis as a cause. An autopsy at the Forensic Medicine Institute is planned to clarify whether death resulted from heart attack or infection contracted in Thailand. Investigation continues; no laboratory confirmation reported publicly yet; authorities will determine if the bite is linked to death and whether this constitutes an infection contracted abroad.

triage.headline_ja: 女優エジェ・イルテムの死亡に関する悍ましい懸念：サルによる咬傷
triage.triage_reason: 個別の死亡事例であり、感染症の集団発生や公衆衛生危機の証拠がない。検査室確認がなく、現在のところ感染症イベントとしての流行・拡大のシグナルなし。
triage.notes: 記事は著名な女優の個別死亡事例を報道しており、タイで受けた猿咬傷との関連を調査中の段階である。感染症の集団発生、流行、または公衆衛生危機のシグナルではない。検査室診断の確認がなく、現在は推測段階。個別死亡例の解剖結果待ちであり、感染症イベント監視の対象外と判定。

article.articleHeadline: Exclusif : à Bunia en RD Congo, les soignants en première ligne face à Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Exclusive: In Bunia, DR Congo, healthcare workers on the front line against Ebola.
article.articleSummary: As of June 19, 2026, Bunia in eastern Ituri province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, remains the epicenter of the Ebola outbreak’s 17th resurgence. No vaccine is yet available for the new strain. In a clinic overwhelmed by suspected cases, frontline healthcare workers lack sufficient protective equipment and the facility is not equipped to manage the outbreak, with staff fearing for their lives after a colleague died. Treating patients on the first line, personnel screen suspected cases before transfer to Ebola treatment centers. Gracia, who lost her nurse aunt, denounces severe PPE shortages, noting she worked without gloves. Despite deliveries of masks and gloves, needs persist and authorities have not disclosed the exact number of health worker deaths. The country has faced several Ebola outbreaks before, and hopes to curb this flare-up remain high.

triage.headline_ja: エクスクルーシブ: コンゴ民主共和国ブニアで医療従事者がエボラに対抗している最前線
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当。エボラウイルス疾患は重大な公衆衛生影響を持ち、新種株での流行は予想外、国際的拡大リスクが高く、渡航・貿易制限を招く可能性が高い。コンゴ民主共和国での確認されたエボラ発生であり、フルRRA進行が必須。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス疾患の確認された発生。医療従事者の感染による死亡、防護具不足、新種株の存在が報告されている。国際的な支援体制が必要とされている状況。2026年6月19日時点での報告。

article.articleHeadline: WHO Reports Rising Ebola Infections Among Medics in DR Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has led to 75 healthcare workers infected and 17 deaths as of 19 June 2026, per the World Health Organization. The outbreak was officially declared on 15 May, but the virus was likely circulating earlier, exposing many medical staff before recognition. Frontline workers are impeded by shortages of basic protective equipment (gloves, masks, infection-control supplies), intensifying transmission risk in a health system already characterized by low staffing. Healthcare worker infections are a critical indicator of outbreak severity and can cripple response capacity and raise nosocomial spread. International support is being mobilized, with medical teams from China and Uganda deployed. Containment hinges on improved infection control, expanded staffing, and reliable PPE access, with monitoring focused on whether new HCW cases continue to rise, signaling gaps in outbreak control. The DR Congo context highlights systemic vulnerabilities in outbreak response.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがコンゴ民主共和国の医療従事者におけるエボラ感染の増加を報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも全5項目に該当。エボラ出血熱は国際的に最も高リスクな病原体であり、医療従事者への感染拡大は対応能力の喪失と院内感染拡大のリスクを示唆している。
triage.notes: 発生地域にUgandaとChinaが含まれているがサマリーに基づけばDRCが主発生地。UgandaとChinaは医療支援派遣国として言及されているのみで、実際の発生地ではない。エボラ出血熱の医療従事者感染はWHO定義の公衆衛生上の緊急事態に該当し、フルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: IOM Surpasses 1M Health Screenings, Boosts Ebola Efforts
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) with cross-border transmission into Uganda. As of 18 June 2026, WHO reports 856 infections and 198 deaths. IOM has conducted over 1,000,000 health screenings at borders and along major travel corridors, expanding surveillance to 110 Points of Entry and 43 additional screening points with surge staff in high-risk border areas. Ituri Province alone has about 16,000 cross-border movements daily, underscoring mobility’s role in both spread and containment. Mobility data guide enhanced surveillance, contact tracing, risk communication, and referral of suspected cases. Preparedness is being strengthened in at-risk countries including Burundi, Ethiopia, Kenya, Rwanda, South Sudan, Tanzania and Zambia. The outbreak response is supported by the US government and the European Union, with IOM appealing for additional support to sustain border health interventions and prevent further spread.

triage.headline_ja: IOMが100万件以上の健康スクリーニングを実施、エボラ対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の国際的な公衆衛生上の重大な脅威であり、DRC-ウガンダ間での越境伝播、国際的な支援体制が確立されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCとウガンダでの発生が明記されており、DRCは対象国リストに含まれる。ウガンダは対象国ではないため除外。準備態勢強化国として言及されるBurundi、Ethiopia、Kenya、Rwanda、South Sudan、Tanzaniaのうち、対象国リストに含まれるのはZambiaのみ（他国は対象国外）。米国と欧州連合の国際支援、IOMによる大規模スクリーニング体制により、管理可能性に課題ありと評価。

article.articleHeadline: Ебола се шири међу лекарима у Конгу, 17 преминулих
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola is spreading among doctors in Congo, 17 dead.
article.articleSummary: Ebola is spreading among doctors in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), with 17 doctor deaths among 75 infected since the outbreak began. The eastern DRC outbreak has not yet peaked and could last up to a year, according to an IFRC/ICRC operations coordinator quoted by the article. More than 800 cases have been reported for a rare Ebola strain for which there is no vaccine, with 192 deaths to date. The article notes heavy toll on healthcare workers and ongoing transmission in eastern Congo, but provides no details on laboratory confirmation, infection sources, or imported/exported cases. The data underscore the severe impact on medical staff amid the continuing outbreak in eastern DRC, and authorities are monitoring the situation closely and coordinating with aid groups.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ（民主共和国）でエボラ出血熱が医師の間で拡大、17人の死亡者
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱は高い公衆衛生的影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスクを有し、IHR基準を4つすべて満たす。医療従事者への感染拡大、高致死率（192/800以上）、ワクチンなしの菌株という重大な懸念がある。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は国際保健規則上の最優先監視対象疾患。記事は医療従事者への深刻な影響（17人の医師死亡/75人感染）、ワクチン未開発の稀有株、最大1年続く可能性、複数の国際機関（IFRC/ICRC）が関与していることを報告しており、フルRRA実施の優先度は極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Bloomberg: У Конго пацієнти з Еболою тікають із лікарень через брак їжі
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bloomberg: Ebola patients flee from hospitals in Congo due to food shortages.
article.articleSummary: Ebola patients flee treatment and isolation centers in the Democratic Republic of Congo due to food shortages. Since late May, authorities report more than 150 escapes. In one incident, 11 patients with suspected Ebola fled a hospital in Bambu, about 40 km from the epicenter near the gold-mining town of Mongbwalu. The virus has been detected in nearly 900 people, with more than a quarter dying. Ituri province accounts for over 90% of confirmed cases. In eastern Congo, food insecurity affects almost 10 million, making isolation and contact tracing harder; about 6,400 individuals are under observation. The World Food Programme has started providing hot meals at treatment centers and delivering food to patients, contacts, and affected families; 590 hot meals were distributed in a single day this week. WFP Congo seeks $175 million by November, including $32 million for Ebola; budgets have fallen by about a third in 2–3 years.

triage.headline_ja: Bloomberg: コンゴのエボラ患者が食糧不足を理由に病院から逃げている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で2つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク）し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数該当（重症度、長期曝露、流行しやすさ）。感染制御の崩壊を示唆する重大なシグナル。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが誤ってイタリア（Veneto）を発生地域として含めているが、記事サマリーはコンゴでのエボラ患者の病院からの逃亡が主題であり、イタリアは除外した。150人以上の患者逃亡、900人以上の感染者、死亡率25%超、食糧不足による感染制御の崩壊は極めて深刻。WFPの支援要請額が大きく、国際支援が急務。

article.articleHeadline: La ONU nombra un coordinador para la respuesta frente al brote de ébola en República Democrática del Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The UN appoints a coordinator for the response to the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: UN appoints Julien Harneis as coordinator for the Ebola response in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo. The outbreak has reached about 900 cases and over 230 deaths in DRC; Uganda reports 19 cases and two deaths. Based in Bunia, Harneis will work with the Inter-Agency Standing Committee to coordinate with the WHO, national authorities, and partners, strengthening response and speeding aid delivery. OCHA confirms 16.5 tonnes of medical supplies and new health-surveillance facilities at Kinshasa airport to bolster surveillance. UN humanitarian chief Tom Fletcher has earmarked four million dollars for Uganda’s Ebola Emergency Response Fund, as part of a 60-million-dollar package announced in late May to support work in 29 districts. The outbreak was declared May 15, and WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern two days later. DRC had declared the last Ebola outbreak ended in Kasai in December 2025.

triage.headline_ja: 国連、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行への対応コーディネーターを任命
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常・予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも全5項目該当。WHO Public Health Emergency of International Concern宣言済み。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病（Ebola）の確定的な流行。DRC東部での約900症例および230以上の死亡。ウガンダへの越境確認（19症例、2死亡）。WHO PHEIC宣言済み（2026年5月17日）。国連コーディネーターの任命、多機関調整、460万ドルの即応資金投入が報告されている。高度に管理可能性が低い状況と見られる。

article.articleHeadline: Ученый заявил об эффективности российских тестов для выявления возбудителя Эболы // Новости НТВ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Scientist says Russian tests are effective for detecting the Ebola pathogen // NTV News
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus is the focus of a Russian diagnostic push. Rospotrebnadzor shipped over 7,000 test systems to Africa after developing the detection method in four days. As of 2026-06-19, the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) reports nearly 900 cases, with Uganda also a current epicenter. Russian experts from the Epidemiological Special Forces have been in Africa since May, diagnosing Bundibugyo and training local staff to use the Russian PCR-based tests, which run on the same platform as influenza and COVID-19 assays. Evgeny Morozkin, head of the diagnostics group, says the system shows 100% sensitivity and specificity in tested samples. Morozkin recently returned from Uganda and is in quarantine. Russia has begun producing diagnostic tools for potential outbreaks in Rwanda, South Sudan, Central African Republic, Kenya, and beyond.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア人科学者、エボラ検出用ロシア製検査の有効性を発表 // NTVニュース
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo ebolavirus）の多数の症例報告（DRCで約900例）と複数国への地理的拡大により、IHR基準3つ以上該当。また重症度が高く、国際的な関心と支援が生じている。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでのエボラ流行（約900例）とウガンダでの集積を主題としており、ロシアが診断支援を展開している。Rwanda、南スーダン、中央アフリカ共和国、ケニアは「潜在的な発生に対する準備」としてのみ言及されており、現在の確認例とは記述が異なるため verified_locations にはDRCのみ含める。対象国リストに該当する国がウガンダにない点に注意。

article.articleHeadline: Congo reporta 896 casos confirmados de ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 896 confirmed Ebola cases.
article.articleSummary: Lab-confirmed Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) caused by the Bundibugyo strain, with 896 laboratory-confirmed cases and 232 deaths across Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu. In the latest update, 21 new infections were recorded yesterday, six fatal. The outbreak spans 33 health zones in three eastern provinces. Currently 383 patients are isolated or hospitalized; 78 have recovered, with 11 new discharges after negative control tests. There are 151 suspected cases, including 35 deaths. A total of 6,367 contacts are under follow-up, with 4,525 located (71.1%). Health authorities warn weekly cases are rising, indicating active community transmission and a risk of rapid geographic spread without reinforced public health measures. Declared May 15; this is the 17th outbreak in the DRC's history.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国がエボラ確認症例896件を報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も全項目で肯定的。エボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイクで、死亡者232名、複数州での拡大、さらなる地理的拡散リスクが明確。
triage.notes: DRCの第17回エボラアウトブレイク。Bundibugyo株による896確認症例、232死亡。複数州（イトゥリ、北キブ、南キブ）にわたる33保健地域での拡大。毎週新規症例が増加中で、コミュニティ伝播が活発。国際的な支援と監視が必要な危機的状況。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak in Congo infects 75 health workers, kills 17: WHO emergency director
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has infected 75 healthcare workers since the start of the current outbreak, with 17 deaths, per WHO emergency director Marie Roseline Belizaire. Health workers remain highly vulnerable due to close contact with patients and bodily fluids. As of 2026-06-19, total confirmed Ebola cases in the DRC reached 896, with 232 deaths. WHO and Congolese health officials continue contact tracing, bolster treatment facilities, and protect frontline staff; authorities emphasize rapid detection, vaccination, and community awareness to bring the outbreak under control. Ebola is a deadly virus transmitted by animals and humans, first identified in 1976 in Sudan and the DRC; the current outbreak has been described as more lethal and widespread than earlier ones.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行、75人の医療従事者が感染、17人死亡：WHO緊急事態局長
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準4つ以上該当。対象国DRCで実証済みの大規模流行イベント。
triage.notes: スーダンは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。DRCでの確認症例896件、死亡232件の大規模流行。医療従事者への感染拡大が顕著。WHO等国際機関による積極的対応が報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: La República Democrática del Congo eleva a 896 los casos confirmados de ébola y reporta 232 fallecidos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo raises the number of confirmed Ebola cases to 896 and reports 232 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of Congo reports 896 confirmed Ebola cases and 232 deaths (case fatality 26%) as of 19 June 2026, from the outbreak declared May 15 in the eastern DRC. Health Minister Samuel-Roger Kamba said 21 new infections and six deaths in the last 24 hours, with 11 recoveries. The outbreak now spans 33 health zones in Ituri (epicenter), North Kivu and South Kivu. Treatment centers host 383 patients in isolation; 78 have been discharged since the start. Contact tracing stands at 71%, with a goal of 95%. The outbreak has spread to Uganda, reporting 19 cases (14 imported from DRC) and two deaths. The virus is Bundibugyo Ebola, with a reported fatality rate between 30% and 50%, and no licensed vaccine or specific treatment. WHO classified the outbreak as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ確認症例を896例に増加させ、232人の死亡を報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WHO PHEIC (Public Health Emergency of International Concern) に分類されたエボラアウトブレイク。既に国際的拡大（ウガンダへの波及19例）が確認されている。
triage.notes: エボラアウトブレイク（Bundibugyo系統）は2026年5月15日に宣言され、WHO によってPHEIC に指定（5月17日）。東部DRCのイトゥリ、北キブ、南キブの33保健地域に拡大。ウガンダへの波及も確認（輸入症例14例を含む19例）。症例致命率26%（一般的な致命率30-50%）。ワクチンおよび特異的治療法なし。連絡先追跡は71%（目標95%）。

article.articleHeadline: République démocratique du Congo | L'OMS constate une accélération de la transmission de l'Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo | WHO notes an acceleration in Ebola transmission.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) shows accelerated transmission across 33 health zones in three provinces, centered in Ituri province in the northeast, amid challenging road access and insecurity. The 17th outbreak, declared May 15, is caused by the Bundibugyo strain with no vaccine or specific treatment. WHO reports 896 cases and 232 deaths (case fatality 26%). Uganda has 19 confirmed cases and 2 deaths; no newer cases in 12 days. The WHO response includes deployment of over 115 experts and more than 110 tonnes of emergency supplies; health capacity comprises 516 beds and testing capacity over 2,000 tests per day. Ongoing challenges include limited access, need for greater operational/financial support, and 75% contact tracing (goal 95%), with deaths and cases in displaced populations signaling continuing transmission chains. A Chinese medical team arrived in Kinshasa; IOM notes >1 million border controls across DRC and neighboring countries.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国 | WHOがエボラ出血熱の伝播加速を確認
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限のリスク）。WPRO基準5項目全て該当。エボラ出血熱は最高レベルの優先度を要する感染症であり、フルRRAが必須。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱の発生として第17波の宣言。ウガンダでの国際的な二次感染も確認（19例、2死亡）。イツリ州の3州33保健地帯での加速的伝播。死亡率26%（896例中232死亡）。アクセス困難性、不安全情報、資金不足など多くの課題が報告されている。WHOは115人以上の専門家と110トン以上の緊急物資を配備。対象国リストではDRCのみが検証地域となる。

article.articleHeadline: Kymmenet terveydenhuollon työntekijät sairastuneet ebolaan Kongossa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dozens of healthcare workers infected with Ebola in Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of June 19, 2026, 75 healthcare workers have contracted Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with 17 deaths, according to the World Health Organization. The outbreak is believed to have spread for months before authorities declared it on May 15 this year. Limited personal protective equipment and shortages of gloves and masks have hindered frontline staff from adequately shielding themselves. The Democratic Republic of the Congo also faces a severe healthcare workforce shortage, with only about 11 healthcare workers per 10,000 people. By comparison, Finland has roughly 190 nurses per 10,000 residents and about 35 physicians per 10,000. The report underscores ongoing transmission among health workers and critical gaps in infection prevention resources.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱：コンゴで数十人の医療従事者が感染
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響・医療従事者での集団感染・国際的拡大リスク・渡航制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準も全て該当。エボラウイルスの確認感染事例であり、公式にはシグナルとして識別すべき。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは明確にコンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ発生を主題としている。フィンランドは比較対象として言及されているのみであり、実際の発生地ではないため verified_locations から除外した。WHOによる公式確認、医療従事者への集団感染（75人、死亡17人）、感染防止資材の不足という実質的なリスク要因が複数存在。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية: 896 إصابة إيبولا و233 وفاة في جمهورية الكونغو الديمقراطية - أردو بوینت
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: 896 Ebola cases and 233 deaths in the Democratic Republic of the Congo - Urdu Point
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization reports that as of June 19, 2026, in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, there are 896 laboratory-confirmed Ebola virus disease cases and 232 deaths, roughly one month after the outbreak was declared. The response has mobilized more than 115 experts and delivered 110 tonnes of emergency supplies to support containment, with 78 patients having recovered. Despite these efforts, WHO notes persistent challenges in reaching high-risk areas and in tracing contacts, which impede timely isolation and transmission interruption. The agency also calls for additional funding to sustain and expand the response, underscoring the ongoing need for surveillance, rapid case investigation, and coordinated public health measures to control the outbreak. The update focuses on operational progress and gaps rather than new clinical guidance.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関：コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱896例、死者233人
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の大規模爆発で深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常事象、国際感染リスク、渡航制限リスクが明確。WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当し、高い社会的・政治的関心がある。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は最高レベルの感染症脅威であり、896症例・233死亡（致死率約26%）の報告は深刻。WHOが追加資金要請し、連絡先追跡や高リスク地域への到達に課題があると指摘。一ヶ月の短期間での急速な症例増加と、国際的な支援体制の必要性から、直ちにフルRRA対象とすべき。

article.articleHeadline: Accra Workshop Ties African Science Skills to Ebola Response
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak (Bundibugyo strain) in Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu has caused nearly 200 deaths by mid-June, with spread into Uganda and no licensed vaccine. The WHO classified the event a public health emergency of international concern. In Accra, a three-day TWAS skills workshop (June 16–18, Tang Palace Hotel) brought 26 early-career African scientists from 13 countries, linking capacity building to outbreak response. The event is part of the TWAS Seed Grant for New African Principal Investigators (SG-NAPI), launched in 2021 and funded by Germany, which has issued 124 grants across five calls, awarding up to 67,700 USD for researchers returning to Africa after PhD studies. Accra is the third stop after Dakar (2024) and Nairobi (2025). Keynote by Prof. Nii Narku Quaynor promoted collaboration; Abdool Karim tied the workshop to lasting impact amid the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: アクラワークショップ：アフリカの科学技術をエボラ対応に結びつける
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の進行中の発生（DRC、ウガンダで確認、国際的懸念事象）が報道されているが、本記事の主題はアクラで開催される科学技術ワークショップであり、直接的な流行拡大やリスク増加の新情報ではない。情報が不足しており、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: DRCのエボラ発生自体はIHR基準2つ以上・WPRO基準複数該当し深刻だが、本記事はアクラ開催の容量構築ワークショップが主体。記事サマリーではDRC、ウガンダの発生状況が背景として述べられており、Ghana（アクラ）はイベント開催地である。エボラ発生の最新的な流行拡大や死亡者増加の新情報は含まれず、学術イベントの報道である。DRCとGhanaを verified_locations に含める。

article.articleHeadline: More than 70 Congo medics infected with Ebola since outbreak started, WHO says
article.articleSummary: 75 medics in the Democratic Republic of Congo have been infected with Ebola and 17 have died since the outbreak began. The outbreak was declared on May 15, but Ebola is thought to have circulated months earlier, exposing frontline health workers before officials recognized it. PPE shortages, including gloves and masks, hinder protection. DRC’s healthcare worker density is among the lowest globally (about 11 per 10,000 people), amplifying the system’s burden. China and Uganda are sending medical teams to assist. The WHO is providing psychological support to medics distressed by colleagues’ illnesses. WHO emergency director Marie Roseline Belizaire highlighted the high price the healthcare system is paying and the strain on services in eastern DRC.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴで75人以上の医療従事者がエボラに感染、WHOが報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目すべて該当。エボラウイルス病は国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、医療従事者への感染拡大、複数国への国際支援要請、国際的な懸念が高い。
triage.notes: DRCは対象国リストに含まれていないが、エボラ発生の主要現場であり国際的に報告されている。Chinaは医療チーム派遣国として含める。Ugandaは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。医療従事者への高い感染率（17人死亡）、PPE不足、保健システム容量の脆弱性が重大な管理課題。

article.articleHeadline: Роспотребнадзор передал тест-системы для борьбы со вспышкой Эболы в Африке
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rospotrebnadzor handed over diagnostic testing systems to combat the Ebola outbreak in Africa.
article.articleSummary: Rospotrebnadzor handed over more than 7,000 PCR diagnostic test systems to Africa to combat the Ebola outbreak caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, delivering kits to the DRC, Republic of the Congo, and Uganda. Four days after the threat, Russian specialists developed and organized production of the tests, which were evaluated at outbreak sites and against foreign assays, earning praise for ease of use and accuracy. In Uganda, the mission trains staff and supports cross-border anti-epidemic measures; over 1,500 tests on patient materials and environmental samples have been performed. A KamAZ mobile lab was moved to the DRC–South Sudan border to test samples from 60 people arriving from DRC and monitor surroundings. In the DRC, 25 locals were trained and a mobile lab established at the border. Since Uganda declared the outbreak in January 2025, cases have emerged in DRC border areas; current counts are about 894 cases and 204 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: ロスポトレブナゾール、アフリカのエボラ出血熱流行対策のための診断検査システムを供与
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の国際的流行（DRC、ウガンダ、南スーダン国境など複数国）で、死亡例を含む深刻な影響があり、IHR基準3項目以上該当。WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度・流行しやすさ・長期曝露が明確に該当する。
triage.notes: 記事はロシアのRospotrebnadzorによるDRC、ウガンダへの検査システム供給を報告。実際の流行発生国はDRCとウガンダ。Bluedot APIは南スーダンとロシア連邦を付与しているが、サマリーの主要な流行地はDRCとウガンダで、ウガンダは2025年1月に流行を宣言し894症例204死亡を報告。対象国リストに含まれるのはDRC(203312)とウガンダ(記事ではUganda = Uganda)。ウガンダはGeoNames ID 226074だが、対象国リストでは確認できない(リスト内のIDは検索対象)。ただし記事が'Uganda'を明記しているため確認が必要。対象国リストを再確認：Uganda該当IDなし。したがってverified_locationsはDRCのみとする。

article.articleHeadline: SZO: Više od 70 lekara u Kongu zaraženo ebolom od početka epidemije, 17 preminulo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: More than 70 doctors in the Democratic Republic of the Congo infected with Ebola since the start of the outbreak, 17 have died.
article.articleSummary: As of June 19, 2026, the World Health Organization says that in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Ebola outbreaks in the eastern region have infected 75 doctors and killed 17 since the start of the outbreak. WHO official Mari Rozelin Belizer spoke via video-link from the DRC at a press briefing. The outbreak has caused 192 deaths overall, with more than 800 cases reported for a rare Ebola virus strain for which there is no vaccine. Bruno Misjon, operations coordinator for the International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies, said the epidemic in eastern Congo has not peaked and could last up to a year. The numbers underline the ongoing transmission and elevated risk to healthcare workers amid the ongoing outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: WHO：コンゴ民主共和国で75人以上の医師がエボラに感染、流行開始以来17人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も全て該当。エボラの新規流行報告であり、医療従事者への感染、高い死亡率、ワクチン未開発株、国際支援体制の関与など、緊急対応が必要な深刻なシグナル。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱の流行は国際保健上の最優先課題。記事ではDRC東部での流行が明記されており、医療従事者への高い感染リスク、ワクチン未開発株、流行ピークに達していないとの専門家指摘、および国際赤十字による支援活動の関与が確認される。死亡率および感染者数の急速な増加が懸念される。フルRRA実施推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola causa 202 fallecidos en República Democrática del Congo | TN8.ni
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola kills 202 people in the Democratic Republic of the Congo | TN8.ni
article.articleSummary: As of 19 June 2026, the Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo has caused 202 deaths and 67 recoveries, with a case fatality rate of 23%. The Ituri province remains the main transmission focus, accounting for 91% of cases and 78% of deaths, while the virus has spread to North Kivu near the Uganda border, complicating access for responders. Uganda has reported 19 cases, including 14 imported from the DRC, with two deaths. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo strain, whose mortality can reach 30–50%, and there is currently no approved vaccine or targeted treatment. The emergency was declared on May 15. The African Union mobilized about $910 million to support the response in DRC and Uganda, with $80 million from member states; needs could rise from $518 million to $1.5 billion for surveillance, contact tracing, labs, care, and coordination.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがコンゴ民主共和国で202人の死者を出す
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。ブンディブギョ株による活動的な流行で、DRCおよびウガンダでの複数国での発生確認。
triage.notes: ウガンダは発生地域に含まれているが、記事サマリーではDRCからの輸入症例として言及されており、ウガンダは対象国リスト外のため除外。記事の主な焦点はDRC内の流行。ブンディブギョ株による高致死率（23%、最大30-50%）、アフリカ連合が約9.1億ドルの資金動員、緊急事態宣言（5月15日）等から、極めて優先度の高いシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: Roorkee scientists identify antiviral compounds in Ayurvedic cow urine distillate against Chikungunya virus
article.articleSummary: As of 19 June 2026, Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) research from IIT Roorkee identifies bioactive compounds in cow urine distillate (CUD) with potent antiviral activity. In Roorkee, Uttarakhand, India, researchers led by Prof. Shailly Tomar report CUD reduces CHIKV levels by >90% at safe concentrations; an optimized formulation combining CUD, thymoquinone (from Nigella sativa), and piperine (from black pepper) yields a 99.85% reduction in viral load under laboratory conditions. Benzoic acid, hippuric acid, and oleic acid are highlighted as key constituents interfering with viral replication proteins. The study, published in ACS Agricultural Science & Technology, involved cross-institution collaboration and was supported by the Ministry of AYUSH. CHIKV is mosquito-borne (Aedes); symptoms include fever and debilitating joint pain, with limited existing antivirals.

triage.headline_ja: ルールキー科学者がチキungunya ウイルスに対するアーユルヴェーダ牛尿蒸留液の抗ウイルス化合物を特定
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は既存の流行中のチクングニア発生ではなく、IIT Roorkeeにおける実験室ベースの抗ウイルス研究報告である。新規感染症発生、異常な症例集積、または公衆衛生危機の兆候を示していない。
triage.notes: 本記事はチクングニア新規患者発生報告ではなく、Roorkeeの研究機関による抗ウイルス薬候補物質の実験室研究である。実地での流行状況、症例数、重症度に関する情報はない。公衆衛生上の即時対応を要する事象ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Ece İrtem'in şüpheli ölümünde sır perdesi: Maymun ısırığı iddiası
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The veil of mystery surrounding Ece İrtem's suspicious death: Monkey bite allegation.
article.articleSummary: Death of actress Ece İrtem in Istanbul on June 15 is under official investigation, after initial assessments suggested a possible heart attack; an autopsy by the Forensic Medicine Institute is pending. Istanbul Anadolu Chief Public Prosecutor's Office has broadened the inquiry to include her medical history, medications, and recent activities. Some media reports claim antidepressant use and possible alcohol consumption before death, though these are unconfirmed. Lawyer Uğur Gökkoyun said statements about the mother were disputed and that she is under medical observation. A new filing to prosecutors alleges three wounds on İrtem's left arm and that a monkey bite during a Thailand trip could be the source, prompting expert consultations on infections and sepsis, which could be life-threatening and will be evaluated in the autopsy. Last footage shows her with her mother and friends prior to death; investigators are weighing heart failure, drug/alcohol interactions, or monkey-related infection as explanations.

triage.headline_ja: 女優エジェ・イルテムの不審死の謎：猿咬傷疑惑
triage.triage_reason: 記事は単一の個人死亡事例についての司法捜査であり、公衆衛生的な感染症アウトブレイク、異常な疾患パターン、または集団発症の証拠がない。猿咬傷由来の感染症は仮説段階であり、未確認である。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIはタイを発生地域として記載しているが、記事サマリーはイスタンブールでの個人死亡事例が主題であり、タイでの実際の感染症発生は記載されていない。タイ旅行中の猿咬傷は死因の一仮説に過ぎず、確認されていない。対象国リスト内に実際の感染症イベント発生地は特定できず。個人の司法捜査案件であり、感染症シグナルとしてはピックアップ対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Mais de 70 profissionais de saúde do Congo foram infectados pelo ebola desde início do surto, diz OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 70 healthcare workers in Congo have been infected with Ebola since the outbreak began, says WHO.
article.articleSummary: As of June 19, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has infected 75 healthcare workers, with 17 deaths among them, according to a senior World Health Organization official. The outbreak, declared on May 15 by Congolese authorities, is thought to have circulated for months before recognition, exposing many workers before they knew of its presence. Health authorities report that stocks of basic protective equipment—gloves and masks—are running out, intensifying concerns about frontline protection amid the outbreak. PPE shortages have been reported, raising concerns about protection of frontline workers. The report underscores the vulnerability of healthcare staff in the outbreak response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴの70人以上の医療従事者がエボラに感染、WHOが報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病の確認された流行で、公衆衛生への重大な影響、異常な死傷者数、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限の可能性が明確。
triage.notes: 2026年6月19日時点でコンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ流行が公式に宣言されている。医療従事者75人の感染（死亡17人）、PPE不足による脆弱性が確認されており、即座のフルRRA実施が必要。

article.articleHeadline: قبل 5500 عام... الطاعون كان هنا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 5,500 years ago... the plague was here.
article.articleSummary: About 5,500 years ago in the Lake Baikal region of Siberia, researchers identify the oldest known plague outbreak caused by Yersinia pestis. Ancient DNA from four burial sites (of 46) reveals the earliest plague lineages. The victims were hunter-gatherers dependent on forest resources; children and adolescents were disproportionately affected, suggesting age-linked susceptibility or exposure. Marmots are implicated as the original reservoir, with the disease arising in northeast Asia before spreading across Eurasia. The study challenges the view that farming and dense settlements sparked early pandemics and implies repeated spillovers from animal hosts to humans. A contemporaneous outbreak between 5,300 and 5,000 years ago occurred in Latvia, about 3,000 miles away. Led by Eske Willerslev and published in Nature, the work underscores plague as a long-standing zoonosis with deep roots in human history.

triage.headline_ja: 5,500年前...ペストはここにあった
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は古代DNA分析による考古学的発見であり、現在の感染症アウトブレイク情報ではない。現在の公衆衛生上の脅威を示す情報がないため、シグナルトリアージの対象外。
triage.notes: 本記事は5,500年前の古代ペスト流行に関する考古学・遺伝学的研究成果であり、現在の感染症事例ではない。Bluedot APIが検出した疾患名『Plague』と地域情報は、記事のテーマとなっている古代の地理的位置（シベリア、ラトビア）に基づいているが、現在の感染症動向監視対象外。タイが発生地域に含まれているが、記事サマリーはタイでの現在のペスト発生には言及していない。

article.articleHeadline: WHO reports 75 health-care workers infected with Ebola
article.articleSummary: As of 19 June 2026, the World Health Organization reports 896 confirmed Ebola cases and 232 deaths in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, amid a continuing outbreak. Health-care workers account for 75 infections, with 17 fatalities; it remains unclear whether these infections occurred at work or in private settings. WHO representative Marie-Roseline Belizaire in Bunia emphasizes PPE supply and staff training, noting only four of 177 surveyed clinics initially had full capacity to protect staff. A major challenge is that only about 10% of those infected show the classic Ebola symptoms, particularly bleeding, leading many patients to stay home, assume malaria, and delay treatment at Ebola centers. This delays care and increases transmission risk within families and small clinics. The situation remains serious and continually evolving one month after the outbreak was declared.

triage.headline_ja: WHOが75人の医療従事者がエボラウイルスに感染したと報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラウイルスの確認症例896例・死亡232例は深刻な公衆衛生影響を示し、医療従事者への感染という異常な状況、DRC・ウガンダ両国への拡大、国際的な懸念から渡航制限のリスクがある。
triage.notes: 発生地域フィールドにウガンダが含まれているが、記事サマリーではDRC内のブニア（Bunia）が主要な発生地点として述べられており、ウガンダは併記されているものの詳細な感染事例の記述がないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。エボラウイルスは高致死率で国際的に重大な懸念事項。医療従事者への感染率の高さと診断の困難さ（症状発現率10%）が管理可能性を低下させている。

article.articleHeadline: В ДР Конго от Эболы умерли 17 медработников - ВОЗ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the DRC, 17 healthcare workers died from Ebola - WHO.
article.articleSummary: Ebola Virus Disease outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) continues into its second month, with 17 healthcare workers dead and 75 infected. Laboratory-confirmed fatalities total 232 among 896 cases. The outbreak began May 15, 2026; a Ugandan imported case was confirmed that day. The World Health Organization declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17. Healthcare facilities report shortages of protective gear, contributing to transmission risks. Authorities warn the disease could spread to new areas as limited contact tracing covers roughly 12% of contacts, leaving the true scale uncertain. The situation remains active, with ongoing transmission in the DRC and cross-border implications for Uganda, underscoring the need for enhanced outbreak control and protection of health workers.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラにより医療従事者17人が死亡 - WHO
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度・流行可能性・管理可能性で該当。WHOがPHEIC宣言済みの活動的なエボラ流行事案として、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの患者輸入確認されているが、サマリーの主題はDRC流行。WHOによるPHEIC宣言（2026年5月17日）済み。医療従事者への感染と防護具不足が報告されている活動的流行。接触者追跡の不十分性（約12%）により真の規模が不明な懸念あり。

article.articleHeadline: UNHCR warns Ebola outbreak threatens displaced communities in DRC and beyond
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus disease is spreading in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). As of 17 June, 896 confirmed cases and 232 deaths have been reported across 31 health zones; Uganda has 19 cases and two deaths. More than 2 million forcibly displaced people, including over 320,000 refugees, live in at-risk areas in the DRC, where ongoing conflict intersects with the outbreak and population movements heighten transmission risks. On 7 June, about 2,250 people fleeing from Mbau near Beni arrived in Oicha, North Kivu, an Ebola-affected zone hosting more than 14,300 displaced people. Internal distrust led to temporary access blockages at Kpangba in Ituri on 3 June. UNHCR trains community leaders, supports chlorinated handwashing stations, and coordinates with governments to align health and protection responses. Regional risk extends to Uganda, Rwanda, Burundi, Tanzania and South Sudan; a $14 million appeal (July–November) aims to bolster preparedness and response.

triage.headline_ja: UNHCRがエボラ出血熱の流行が難民・避難民コミュニティを脅かしていることを警告（DRC及び周辺地域）
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。ブンディブギョエボラウイルスがDRCで活動中紛争地域で拡大し、896確定患者232死亡、ウガンダへの越境（19例2死亡）、200万人以上の避難民が危険地域に存在し、地域内流行リスク極めて高い。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョエボラウイルス（BDBV）による活動中の流行。DRC内31保健ゾーンでの患者発生に加え、ウガンダへの確定的な越境感染を確認。紛争地域での実施困難性、大規模避難民集団の存在により管理可能性が低い。地域検証：発生地域リストにはRwanda、Burundi、Tanzania、South Sudanも記載されているが、サマリーではこれらは「地域リスク」として言及されるのみで、確認された患者発生はDRCとウガンダのみである。対象国リストにはDRCのみ該当するため、verified_locationsはDRCに限定。

article.articleHeadline: Prefeitura de Santo Antônio de Lisboa intensifica ações de combate à dengue na localidade Sítio Salvador
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: City Hall of Santo Antônio de Lisboa intensifies dengue control measures in the Sítio Salvador locality.
article.articleSummary: Three-day, intensified dengue control campaign in Sítio Salvador, Santo Antônio de Lisboa, amid rising dengue cases in the municipality. The initiative, supported by FUNASA, included dedetização (insecticide spraying), home visits, distribution of educational leaflets, identification and elimination of mosquito breeding sites, and enhanced vector-control measures. Executed in collaboration with Community Health Agents (ACS) and Endemic Control Agents (ACE), the effort targets Aedes aegypti. Municipal Health Secretariat stresses shared responsibility between authorities and residents; residents are urged to remove containers that accumulate water, keep water storage tanks tightly closed, and regularly clean yards and lots. The administration reaffirms commitment to health promotion and disease prevention and ongoing dengue response in Santo Antônio de Lisboa.

triage.headline_ja: リスボア・サント・アントニオ市が、シチオ・サルバドル地域でデング熱対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の予防啓発キャンペーンが取り上げられているが、記事は対策実施と啓発を記述しており、新たな流行発生や重大な集団発生の報告ではない。IHR基準およびWPRO基準には該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジルのシチオ・サルバドル地域でのデング熱対策キャンペーンについて述べている。これは自治体レベルの予防啓発活動であり、新規患者の大規模発生や異常な疫学的状況を示唆していない。ルーチン的な公衆衛生活動として位置付けられるため、シグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: सामने आ गई कोरोना की असली कहानी? US साइंटिस्ट ने की फंडिंग, चीन में बना वायरस!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Has the real story of the coronavirus come to light? A US scientist funded it; the virus was created in China!
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 origin debate persists after newly released ODNI documents, highlighted by Tulsi Gabbard, which raise questions about early assessments and the U.S. role. The report accuses Dr. Anthony Fauci of involvement in discussions on the virus’s origin and of withholding certain information, though Fauci has denied concealing facts or influencing intelligence. ODNI materials reveal long-standing internal disagreements among U.S. agencies over natural-origin versus lab-leak theories; some analyses suggested the lab-leak possibility but no decisive conclusion was reached. The Wuhan Institute of Virology hypothesis remains contested, with a May 2020 assessment noting conditions at the Wuhan lab that could permit accidental release. The article emphasizes calls for transparency and accountability to the public as agency rifts persist.

triage.headline_ja: コロナウイルスの真実が明らかに？米国の科学者がファンディング、ウイルスは中国で作られた！
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はCOVID-19の起源に関する政治的議論と陰謀説の報道であり、進行中の感染症イベントの新たな流行や公衆衛生的な危機を扱っていない。パンデミック初期段階の過去の政策議論と責任追及が主題である。
triage.notes: 本記事は2026年配信と記載されており、COVID-19パンデミック時期の起源論争に関する政治的なレビュー記事である。現在の感染症イベント（流行、集団発生、新規出現症例）ではなく、過去のパンデミック初期段階における米国政府機関の対応と科学的議論の再検討を扱っている。シグナル検知対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Cow Urine Compound Fights Chikungunya: IIT Roorkee Study
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) antiviral activity identified in cow urine distillate (CUD) by IIT Roorkee researchers in Roorkee, India. Lab studies showed CUD reduced CHIKV viral load by over 90% at safe concentrations, with an optimized formulation that combines CUD, thymoquinone (from Nigella sativa), and piperine (from black pepper) achieving 99.85% viral reduction. Key bioactive constituents including benzoic acid, hippuric acid, and oleic acid contribute to antiviral activity by interfering with viral replication proteins. The work, published in ACS Agricultural Science & Technology, used metabolomics, molecular docking, and biochemical analyses to identify synergistic components and mechanisms. Supported by the Ministry of AYUSH and led by Prof. Shailly Tomar of IIT Roorkee, the study bridges Ayurvedic knowledge with modern biotechnology and suggests potential for affordable antiviral therapeutics. Chikungunya is transmitted by Aedes mosquitoes and causes fever and joint pain; further pre-clinical and translational evaluation is required.

triage.headline_ja: 牛尿化合物がチクングニアと闘う：IITロールキー研究
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は既存のチクングニア治療法候補の実験室研究成果報告であり、新規の疾病発生イベント（outbreak signal）ではない。IHR基準およびWPRO基準のいずれにも該当せず、公衆衛生的な緊急性は認められない。
triage.notes: 本記事はインド IIT ロールキーにおける in vitro 研究成果であり、疾病の流行発生（outbreak）や公衆衛生上の新規懸念を示唆するものではない。牛尿抽出物の抗チクングニア活性について学術的に報告されているが、臨床段階にはまだ至っていない。シグナルトリアージの対象は感染症の実発生イベント・リスク信号であり、本件は基礎研究成果のため見送り判定とした。

article.articleHeadline: Пациенты с Эболой сбегают из больниц в ДР Конго из-за голода - Аргументы Недели
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Patients with Ebola virus disease flee from hospitals in the Democratic Republic of the Congo due to hunger - Arguments of the Week
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Ebola virus disease (EVD) patients are fleeing hospitals to find food amid hunger and dire living conditions. At least one incident involved 11 hungry patients with suspected Ebola escaping quarantine due to food shortages, reported by MIR24. Since the end of May, government records show more than 150 such escape events, with other documents attributing exits to food scarcity and poor environs. Hunger is a major barrier to controlling transmission in the outbreak, which in eastern DRC has long been affected by displacement, armed conflict, and widespread hunger affecting about 10 million people. The World Health Organization has previously designated the Ebola outbreaks in DRC and Uganda as an emergency with a high regional risk of spread.

triage.headline_ja: 民主共和国コンゴでエボラ患者が飢餓のため病院から逃げ出す
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の活発な流行が報告されており、患者の隔離解除により感染拡大リスクが著しく高まっている。IHR基準3項目（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）に該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。地域的な医療制御喪失の危機的状況。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでウガンダの言及がWHOリスク評価の参照のみであり、実際のイベント発生地はDRCに集中。患者の自主逃院により隔離管理が喪失し、150件以上の逃院事例が記録されている点が特に危機的。飢餓による医療制御困難がエボラ制御不能状態を招く恐れがある。WHO既にエボラをPHEICとして指定している。

article.articleHeadline: Perú refuerza la vacunación contra el sarampión en su frontera con Brasil y Bolivia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Peru strengthens measles vaccination at its border with Brazil and Bolivia.
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreak in Peru triggers intensified vaccination along the Madre de Dios frontier with Brazil and Bolivia. In border areas, Madre de Dios regional health directorate brigades traverse jungle communities and farm camps to immunize children who have not completed the national schedule. The Iñapari health post, on the border with Assis, Brazil, leads the effort and vaccines are provided free at clinics or by itinerant teams. Authorities issued a June 6 epidemiological alert due to community transmission and high risk of spread, prioritizing vaccination, surveillance, and rapid response to suspected or confirmed cases. The plan targets the outbreak of measles in Puno (border with Bolivia) and risk of propagation to Lima, Callao, and numerous departments, including Arequipa, Cusco, Huancavelica, Moquegua, Amazonas, Loreto, Tacna, Tumbes, Ucayali, Madre de Dios and Apurímac. Latest official data: 501 confirmed cases across 41 districts in eight regions, with 96.59% in Puno.

triage.headline_ja: ペルー、ブラジル・ボリビアとの国境で麻疹予防接種を強化
triage.triage_reason: 発生地域がペルーであり、対象国リスト（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）に該当しない。シグナルトリアージの対象外。
triage.notes: イベント発生地はペルー（対象国リストに含まれない）。Bluedot APIが付与した発生地域にBrazil（3469034）が含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題はペルーでの麻疹流行とペルー国内の予防接種強化であり、ブラジルはペルーとの国境地帯の参照として言及されているのみ。したがって、verified_locationsは空配列。本シグナルは対象監視地域外のため、トリアージスコープ外。

article.articleHeadline: Santé : douze personnes en quarantaine dans le cadre des mesures préventives contre Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health: Twelve people in quarantine as part of preventive measures against Ebola.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-06-19, twelve people are in quarantine at the Sir Anerood Jugnauth Recreation Centre in Riambel as part of preventive measures against the Ebola virus. Most of those isolated have returned from Uganda and are under close medical monitoring; their health is stable, according to Dr. Fazil Khodabocus, Acting Director of Health Services. Mauritius maintains strict health controls for travelers arriving from the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan to prevent introduction of Ebola.

triage.headline_ja: 保健：エボラウイルスに対する予防措置の一環として12人が隔離中
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱は極めて高い致死率を持つ高リスク病原体であり、IHR基準（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）を複数満たす。複数国での検出状況と積極的な疫学対応が確認されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで言及されている国はモーリシャス（検出対象国でない）、ウガンダ（検出対象国でない）、南スーダン（検出対象国でない）、DRC（対象国）。DRCのみが対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に記載。エボラは高リスク病原体で、複数国での検出と国際的な防御体制の構築が報告されており、IHR基準を全て満たす。フルRRA推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Γιατί τα υπάρχοντα εμβόλια δεν βοηθούν σε αυτήν την έξαρση του ιού Εμπόλα
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Why the existing vaccines are not helping in this Ebola virus outbreak.
article.articleSummary: 695 confirmed Bundibugyo ebolavirus cases across the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, with 138 deaths, were reported as of June 12, 2026. The outbreak is driven by Bundibugyo virus, for which no licensed vaccine exists; existing Ebola vaccines target Zaire ebolavirus and do not reliably prevent Bundibugyo transmission. Uganda has imported and connected cases. Transmission occurs via direct contact with blood or bodily fluids, contaminated objects, or unsafe burials; early symptoms resemble malaria (fever, fatigue, myalgia, headache, sore throat), necessitating laboratory confirmation. Some experimental data suggest partial cross-protection, but it is insufficient for outbreak control. Candidate vaccines (VSV-based tailored for Bundibugyo, adenovirus-based, and mRNA) are in development but not yet ready for routine use, given manufacturing, safety, and regulatory timelines. Control relies on case detection, isolation, contact tracing, infection prevention, safe burials, community engagement, and supportive care; no approved targeted therapy exists.

triage.headline_ja: 既存のエボラワクチンがこのエボラウイルスの流行に役立たない理由
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。Bundibugyo ebolavirus による大規模流行で695確認症例、138死亡。対象国DRCで発生しており、フルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus（Zaire系統以外の稀なエボラウイルス）による流行。既存ワクチンが効果的でない点が重大な懸念。ウガンダも輸入・接続事例が報告されているが、記事の主題はDRCでの流行。候補ワクチンが開発中だが未承認。支援体制と感染制御が急務。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : l'OMS constate une accélération de la transmission
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: WHO reports an acceleration in transmission.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) is accelerating, with 896 cases and 232 deaths (case fatality rate 26%) reported by the WHO as of June 19, 2026. The 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC, declared May 15, is caused by the Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no vaccine or specific treatment. Its epicenter is Ituri province in the northeast, with transmission rising in 33 health zones across three provinces. Seventy-five healthcare workers have been infected, 17 of whom have died. The neighboring country Uganda has 19 confirmed cases and 2 deaths, with no new cases in 12 days. WHO has deployed over 115 experts and delivered more than 110 tonnes of emergency supplies; the response capacity includes 516 beds and more than 2,000 tests per day. Access remains hampered by poor roads and armed-group insecurity.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：WHOが感染の加速を報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。進行中の大規模なエボラアウトブレイク、高い致死率（26%）、複数国への拡大、国際的対応が進行中のため、フルRRAに進むべきシグナル。
triage.notes: ウガンダは発生地域フィールドに含まれているが、記事サマリーではウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsに含めていない。DRCは対象国（ID:203312）に該当。アウトブレイク は進行中で、医療従事者への感染（75人）、貧弱なアクセス条件、武装勢力による不安定さなどが管理可能性に影響している。

article.articleHeadline: Megállíthatatlanul terjed a halálos vírus: rájuk különösen veszélyes
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The deadly virus is spreading uncontrollably and is especially dangerous to them.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is exacting a heavy toll on health workers. Since the outbreak's onset, the WHO reports 75 health-care workers infected and 17 dead. Marie Roseline Belizaire, WHO Emergency Director, said the virus likely circulated months before the official May 15 announcement, leaving many health workers exposed without awareness. The situation is worsened by shortages of basic personal protective equipment, including gloves and masks. The DRC has a very low health workforce, with about 11 health professionals per 10,000 people. Belizaire noted that medical teams from China and Uganda are being sent to the country. The WHO is also providing psychological support to health-care workers traumatized by colleagues' illnesses, to help them continue patient care.

triage.headline_ja: 致命的なウイルスが抑制不可能に拡散中：彼らにとって特に危険
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱はIHR基準4項目全てに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目全て該当。医療従事者への深刻な影響、国際的な支援体制、高い死亡率がある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCが主な発生地であることが明確。UgandaはAPI発生地域に含まれるが、サマリーではウガンダでの実際の発症地として記述されていない（医療チーム派遣国として言及）ため除外。Chinaは医療支援チーム派遣国だが、対象国リストに含まれるため記載。DRC内での医療従事者への重大な影響（17死亡）と国際的な支援体制が確立されている点が重要。

article.articleHeadline: Россия первой в мире разработала эффективную тест-систему для диагностики Эболы
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Russia was the first in the world to develop an effective diagnostic test system for Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) diagnostic breakthrough: Russia’s Rospotrebnadzor specialists developed a unique real-time PCR test system for Ebola, now deployed in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda. The system is presented as the first globally and the only Russian test with claimed 100% sensitivity and specificity. Developers say reagents enable DNA/RNA extraction from any virus, including Bundibugyo ebolavirus, and the assay can detect the virus in environmental samples. The Ebola virus has mutated to a new, more contagious Bundibugyo strain; there is no vaccine, so timely detection is essential to stop spread. Seven thousand test systems have been delivered to African countries, with requests from North Korea, Turkmenistan, and Tajikistan. The risk extends beyond Africa to Belgium, France, UAE, Turkey, India, and Canada; EU and UN funds are being mobilized to fight the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアが世界初のエボラ診断用効果的検査システムを開発
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準において4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、新型株の出現による異常性、複数国への国際的拡大、渡航制限リスク）。エボラウイルスの新変異株（Bundibugyo ebolavirus）が高感染性で、ワクチンがなく、アフリカから複数地域への国際的拡大リスクが明確。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが付与した発生地域リストは多数含むが、記事サマリーの実際の発生地は民主コンゴとウガンダ（対象国外）。インドは記事中で「リスク拡大地域」として明記されており、WHO管轄WPRO地域の対象国として含める。新型エボラ変異株（Bundibugyo ebolavirus）、ワクチン未開発、ヒト-ヒト感染能力が高い点が特に懸念される。複数国への国際的拡大傾向と政治的関心（ロシア開発の診断キット、EU・UN資金動員）が顕著。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: OMS constată o accelerare a transmiterii virusului în RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: WHO notes an acceleration in the transmission of the Ebola virus in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-19, the World Health Organization reports accelerated transmission of the Ebola virus in the Democratic Republic of Congo, signaling a potential uptick in spread within the ongoing outbreak. The article provides no concrete case or death counts, no details on laboratory confirmation, transmission chains, or infection sources. It does not specify affected provinces, nor mention imported or exported cases. Clinical symptoms, response measures, or vaccination campaigns are not described in the text. The report is limited to noting increased transmission and offers no granular epidemiological data within the available content. Continued surveillance is implied, but the article does not furnish actionable figures or timelines.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：WHOがDRCでのエボラウイルス伝播の加速を指摘
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、異常/予想外な加速、国際的拡大リスク）、WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数該当。エボラウイルスはPHEIC指定病原体であり、伝播加速の報告は直ちにフルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーには具体的なケース数・死亡数・検査確認情報が記載されていないが、WHO公式報告による『伝播加速』の指摘は信号強度が高い。エボラは国際的に重大な関心事であり、DRCでの加速報告のため直ちにピックアップ。続報で詳細な疫学データの確保が必要。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية: 896 إصابة إيبولا و233 وفاة في جمهورية الكونغو الديمقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: 896 Ebola cases and 233 deaths in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization reports 896 confirmed Ebola cases and 232 deaths in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, about one month after the outbreak was declared. More than 115 experts have been deployed and 110 tonnes of emergency supplies sent to support the response, with 78 patients recovered. The WHO notes ongoing challenges in reaching high-risk areas and implementing thorough contact tracing, and it calls for additional funding to contain the disease. The update underscores laboratory-confirmed case counts and the need for sustained international support to curb transmission and protect affected communities as of 2026-06-19. The response also highlights the struggle to access conflict-affected districts, underscoring the urgent need for safe corridors and partner funding.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関：コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ患者896人、死亡233人
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱は極めて高い致命率（約26%）を示し、公衆衛生への深刻な影響は明白。国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限の可能性がある。WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度、流行しやすさ、管理可能性に該当。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病は国際保健上の最も重大な脅威の一つ。記事では宣言後約1ヶ月で896例、死亡233例の多数の患者と高い致命率を報告。紛争地域へのアクセス困難や接触者追跡の課題があり、さらなる国際支援が必要とされている。

article.articleHeadline: Congo Ebola Death Toll Tops 200 | Sada Elbalad
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-19, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 200 deaths, with 204 confirmed fatalities (including deaths reported in Uganda) and 894 confirmed cases, 875 of which are in the DRC. The first month of transmission marks the highest infection count for Ebola over a similar period, nearly three times larger than the second-largest outbreak. Limited contact tracing persists, with about 4,100 contacts monitored despite estimates that up to 35,000 people may have been exposed. Officials warn the outbreak is far from under control, and unless surveillance and containment measures are significantly strengthened, the risk of further spread remains.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ死亡者数が200人を超える
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大のリスク、渡航・貿易制限のリスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準も全て該当。エボラウイルス病の大規模流行として最高レベルのシグナル。
triage.notes: ウガンダは発生地域に含まれているが、記事サマリーでは確認死亡数に含まれる言及のみで、ウガンダでの主要な発生継続は明記されていない。DRCが主要な発生地域であることが明確。本イベントはIHR通知要件を満たし、フルRRA実施が必須。初月の感染数が過去最大規模（第2位の約3倍）であり、極めて深刻な状況。

article.articleHeadline: Akademisi fakultas kedokteran UI beri edukasi penyakit Hantavirus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Academics from the University of Indonesia's Faculty of Medicine provide education about hantavirus disease.
article.articleSummary: Depok, Indonesia—Dr. Ari Prayitno of the University of Indonesia's Faculty of Medicine educated the public on hantavirus. Hantavirus is an RNA virus in the Hantaviridae family, with rodents as natural hosts; infected animals often show no symptoms but shed the virus in urine, saliva, and feces. Human transmission mainly occurs through inhalation of dust contaminated with rodent excreta, and also via contact with contaminated surfaces; rodent bites are rare and human-to-human transmission is extremely uncommon. Although hantavirus cases in children are rare, infection can progress to severe disease, including Hemorrhagic Fever with Renal Syndrome (HFRS) in Asia and Europe (including Indonesia) and Hantavirus Pulmonary Syndrome (HPS) in the Americas. Early symptoms resemble flu; severe cases involve cough, shortness of breath, abdominal pain, kidney dysfunction, or altered consciousness. Diagnosis uses exposure history and lab tests (antibody assays, PCR); there is no universal antiviral therapy, so care is supportive. Prevention emphasizes hygiene, rodent control, safe food storage, masks and gloves when cleaning dusty areas, and handwashing; parental supervision is important for children in high-risk environments.

triage.headline_ja: インドネシア大学医学部の研究者がハンタウイルス病についての教育を提供
triage.triage_reason: 記事はハンタウイルスに関する教育的コンテンツであり、確認された感染事例や流行の報告ではない。ただし、インドネシアはハンタウイルス感染症の風土病地域であり、公衆衛生認識向上の文脈として注視する価値がある。
triage.notes: 記事は既存のハンタウイルス疾患についての学術的教育活動であり、新規流行事例の報告ではない。インドネシアはHFRSの風土病地域として言及されている。スペイン（カナリア諸島）は発生地域として付与されているが、記事サマリーに記載されていないため verified_locations から除外した。

article.articleHeadline: WHO: 75 Tenaga Medis di Kongo Terinfeksi Ebola, 17 Meninggal Dunia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: 75 health workers in Kongo infected with Ebola, 17 have died.
article.articleSummary: As of June 19, 2026, Ebola in the eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has infected 75 health workers and killed 17. WHO says the virus likely circulated for months before the May 15 government outbreak declaration, contributing to frontline exposure. Health workers face ongoing shortages of basic PPE, including gloves and masks, complicating patient care. The response comes against a health system already strained by a very low workforce density—about 11 health workers per 10,000 people. International support includes medical teams from China and Uganda to bolster frontline services. WHO is also providing psychological support to clinicians traumatized by seeing colleagues become infected, highlighting the substantial emotional and operational toll of the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: WHO: コンゴの75人の医療従事者がエボラに感染、17人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の確定的な国際多地域発生（DRC、ウガンダで確認）。IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。医療従事者の大規模感染と死亡、PPE不足による継続的曝露リスク、国際支援の実施により、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーにより、エボラ発生は東部DRCが主要な発生地。ウガンダは国際支援を提供している国として言及されているが、サマリー上でウガンダ国内での確定感染者報告は明記されていないため verified_locations から除外した。中国は医療チーム派遣国として言及されるが、国内発生の記述がないため除外。情報不足の場合は続報確認が必要だが、本例では十分な深刻性が確認されているためPICKUP判定。

article.articleHeadline: La OIM realiza más de un millón de exámenes de salud y refuerza su respuesta frente al ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The IOM conducts more than one million health screenings and strengthens its Ebola response.
article.articleSummary: Over one million health screenings have been conducted at borders and key cross-border corridors in Uganda and eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo to bolster the Ebola response. At Entebbe International Airport, Uganda, IOM supports traveler screening and real-time data collection to guide the National Response Plan. The outbreak involves North Kivu, South Kivu and Ituri in eastern DRC, with confirmed cross-border transmission to Uganda; as of 18 June, WHO reports 198 deaths and more than 856 infections. IOM is reinforcing surveillance at 110 entry points and 43 additional screening posts along major routes, deploying staff to high-risk border areas. In Ituri, about 16,000 people cross porous borders daily (DTM). Since mid-April 2026, IOM has supported border screening, mobility-data driven risk mapping, and frontline containment efforts. The response is backed by the United States and the European Union, with calls for sustained funding. At-risk neighboring countries include Burundi, Ethiopia, Kenya, Rwanda, South Sudan, Tanzania, and Zambia.

triage.headline_ja: IOMが100万件以上の健康検査を実施し、エボラ出血熱対応を強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外な国際的拡大、渡航制限リスク）。エボラ出血熱の国境を越えた感染確認と急速な感染拡大は、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは、エボラ感染は東部DRC（北キブ、南キブ、イトゥリ）で確認され、ウガンダへの国境越え感染が報告されている。リスク国にはルワンダ、タンザニア、ケニア、ブルンジ、エチオピア、南スーダンなども言及されているが、これらは「リスク隣国」であり、サマリー上での実際の発生確認地は DRC とウガンダ（対象国外）。ただし、ザンビアは具体的な言及があり対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。複数国間での活発な国際協力と米国・EUからの支援要請があり、高度な関心が示されている。

article.articleHeadline: СЗО: Повече от 70 медици от ДР Конго са заразени с ебола от началото на епидемията
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: More than 70 healthcare workers from DR Congo have been infected with Ebola since the start of the outbreak.
article.articleSummary: During the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, a senior WHO official reported that since the epidemic began, 75 health workers have been infected and 17 have died. Authorities first declared the outbreak on May 15, but transmission is believed to have occurred months earlier, exposing many clinicians before the danger was recognized. Persistent shortages of essential protective equipment, including gloves and masks, jeopardize frontline staff in a country already short on health workers, about 11 per 10,000 people. The WHO emergencies director said China and Uganda are sending medical teams to assist. The organization is also providing psychological support to overawed clinicians who have witnessed multiple colleagues become ill. The outbreak remains ongoing in eastern DR Congo, underscoring the urgent need for protective supplies, staffing, and international assistance.

triage.headline_ja: WHO：コンゴ民主共和国の75人以上の医療従事者がエボラに感染、うち17人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルスの確認された流行、医療従事者の多数感染と死亡、国際支援体制の構築、国際的拡大リスク（中国・ウガンダの医療支援派遣）が認められ、フルRRA実施の必要性が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーによると、エボラ流行はDRC東部で発生・進行中。中国とウガンダが医療支援チームを派遣しており、国際的対応が既に開始されている。Bluedotの発生地域にUgandaが含まれているが、サマリーではUgandaは支援国として言及されており、発生地ではないため verified_locations から除外した。5月15日に宣言された流行で、実際の伝染はそれ以前から発生していた可能性が指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: Africa CDC: DR Congo, Uganda record 894 confirmed Ebola cases, 204 deaths
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Africa: Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri province epicentre; 91 confirmed cases, 78% of deaths) and Uganda (Kampala health zone; 19 cases, 2 deaths, 7 recoveries; 100% contact listing) total 894 confirmed Ebola cases and 204 deaths reported as of 2026-06-19, with 74 recoveries in the first month since May 15 declaration. The outbreak has spread to 32 health zones across DRC and Uganda (up from 3 in week 1 to 32 by week 4). Case count rose 38% week over week. About 17,000–35,000 contacts should be listed daily, but only ~6,000 are listed and ~4,000 actively followed. No licensed vaccines/therapeutics for Sudan strain; control relies on case ID, contact listing, and daily monitoring. Burial capacity is severely limited (7 of 49 teams; 7 of 98 vehicles; 84 of 540 personnel). A continental security public health emergency was declared May 18.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカCDC：コンゴ民主共和国とウガンダでエボラ確定患者894人、死亡204人を記録
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラ出血熱の多国家流行で深刻な公衆衛生影響、高死亡率、急速な地理的拡大、国際的な渡航・貿易制限リスクが明確。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC（イツリ州が震源地）とウガンダ（カンパラ保健ゾーン）の両国でのエボラ流行を報告しているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRC（203312）のみ。ウガンダは対象国に含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。5月15日の宣言以来、わずか1ヶ月で32の保健ゾーンに拡大、週単位での症例増加率38%、接触者追跡の著しい不備（目標の17,000～35,000名に対し実追跡は4,000名）、ワクチン・治療薬なし、埋葬能力の深刻な不足など、管理可能性が極めて低い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola spreading 'fast' in DR Congo, WHO warns
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease is spreading fast in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), with the World Health Organization declaring an international health emergency. As of the May 15 outbreak announcement in northeastern DRC, there have been 515 confirmed infections and 91 deaths. Uganda has recorded 19 cases and two deaths, with all but five cases involving Congolese nationals who crossed the border. The outbreak is centered in northeastern DRC; authorities have implemented safe and dignified burials in Ituri Province to curb transmission. WHO leadership visited Uganda to praise its efforts to limit cross-border spread. Laboratory-confirmed cases exist for the 515 infections; infection source remains linked to the ongoing DRC outbreak. The article notes rapid transmission but does not specify clinical symptoms. Published 2026-06-19; ongoing cross-border risk underscores need for border control and regional coordination.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱がDR コンゴで急速に拡大、WHO が警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR 基準の4つすべてに該当。Ebola は極めて重篤な公衆衛生上の影響をもたらし、国際的拡大リスク（既にウガンダで確認）と渡航・貿易制限リスクを伴う。WHO が国際保健上の緊急事態を宣言している。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはウガンダでの症例についても言及しているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため、検証済み地域はDRCのみとする。Ituri Province はDRC の一部として含まれている。本イベントは全てのスクリーニング基準に該当し、WHO による国際保健上の緊急事態宣言があるため、フルのRRA（Rapid Risk Assessment）が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Dinkes Kulonprogo Temukan 14 Kasus HIV pada Remaja, Jadi Alarm Serius
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kulon Progo Regency Health Department Finds 14 HIV Cases Among Adolescents, Raises Serious Alarm.
article.articleSummary: Kulon Progo Regency, Indonesia, reports 513 cumulative HIV/AIDS cases since surveillance began. In 2026 through March, 11 new infections were recorded, including 1 death; adolescents account for 14 HIV cases, with spread across all districts. Health officials attribute adolescent infections to unsafe sexual behavior rather than vertical transmission, prompting intensified prevention. The Kulonprogo Health Department (Dinkes) and the AIDS Prevention Commission (KPA) are expanding programs targeting youths, including school-based education, routine screening for high-risk groups, and treatment services for diagnosed individuals. Deputy Regent Ambar Purwoko, also KPA chair, emphasizes that adolescent HIV is a social and educational issue requiring comprehensive, collaborative solutions involving families and educational institutions to reduce transmission and stigma. Cross-sector coordination and capacity building for educators are highlighted to broaden the reach of prevention and health messaging.

triage.headline_ja: クロンプロゴ県保健局が思春期のHIV感染14例を発見、深刻な警告となる
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアの特定地域における思春期HIV感染の増加は注目すべき公衆衛生上の動向だが、国際的拡大リスクや異常度の明確な証拠に乏しく、現段階では経過観察が適切である。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはインドネシアのクロンプロゴ県における思春期HIV感染の増加傾向を報告している。同地域では累計513例のHIV/AIDS症例が報告されており、思春期の14例はすべての地区に分散している。当局は予防教育と検査の強化に取り組んでいる。死亡例は2026年3月までに1例のみで、現在のところ死亡率や重症度は高くない。インドネシア国内の限定的な地域報告であり、国際的拡大リスクは見当たらないが、思春期のHIV感染増加は公衆衛生上の懸念として継続的に監視する価値がある。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola spreading 'fast' in DR Congo, warns WHO
article.articleSummary: DR Congo Ebola outbreak, Bundibugyo strain (no vaccine), declared 15 May; as of 19 June 2026, 896 confirmed cases and 232 deaths, with 21 new cases in the last 24 hours. 75 health-care workers infected, 17 dead, amid PPE shortages (gloves/masks). Ituri province accounts for >90% of known cases, with spread to North Kivu and South Kivu. Transmission by close contact and infected bodily fluids. Case management capacity expanded from zero to >500 beds; surveillance handles ~400 alerts with capacity for >2,000 tests daily. Contact tracing reached 75% of contacts; WHO target is 95%. Uganda, the only other affected country, reports 19 cases, 2 deaths, 10 recoveries, with no new cases in 12 days.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱がコンゴ民主共和国で「急速に」拡大、WHOが警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、Bundibugyo株（ワクチンなし）による大規模なエボラ熱アウトブレイク。232名の死亡、国際的拡大（ウガンダへの波及）、深刻な公衆衛生上の影響が確認されている。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（Republic of Uganda）はBluedot APIの発生地域に含まれているが、対象国リストに該当しないため verified_locations に含めていない。ただし記事内容からウガンダでの確認例（19例、2死亡）があることは評価に反映済み。Bundibugyo株はワクチン未承認の稀な亜種であり、特に懸念要因。PPE不足や医療従事者感染（75名感染、17名死亡）も深刻。

article.articleHeadline: Santé. Explosion des cas d'Ebola : les Hôpitaux universitaires de Genève suivent de près l'épidémie
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health. Surge in Ebola cases: Geneva University Hospitals closely monitor the outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Surge in Ebola cases triggers close monitoring by Geneva University Hospitals. The Ebola outbreak is centered in northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo, with officials reporting the situation has persisted for just over a month as of mid-June 2026. On June 18, 2026, teams from the Centre for Emerging Viral Diseases at Hôpitaux universitaires de Genève discussed the situation during a medical colloquium. They maintain weekly telephone contact with humanitarian organizations on the ground to track developments and coordinate responses. The article notes an alert at the start of May and highlights ongoing surveillance and information-sharing, but provides no specific figures for cases or deaths. Focus remains on monitoring and cross-field coordination rather than new treatment data.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の患者数が増加：ジュネーブ大学病院が流行を綿密に監視
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上に該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。エボラ出血熱はWHO通知義務疾患であり、コンゴ民主共和国での流行の継続と国際的な医療機関による監視活動が確認されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは流行地をコンゴ民主共和国北東部と明記。ジュネーブは監視活動の場所であり、流行の実際の発生地ではない。具体的な患者数・死亡数が未報告のため重症度判定は不明。エボラ出血熱は高い公衆衛生脅威度の疾患であり、1ヶ月以上継続している流行の国際的監視はシグナル価値が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Nord-Kivu : les femmes commerçantes en première ligne de lutte contre Ebola à Beni - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: North Kivu: Women traders on the front line of the fight against Ebola in Beni - ACP.
article.articleSummary: North Kivu, Beni, Democratic Republic of the Congo — Ebola virus disease is being addressed through community action led by Amacco-Beni, the Congo Mothers Vendors Association at Beni Central Market. The group conducts regular awareness sessions for vendors and customers, ensures handwashing facilities at market entrances and strategic points, and reinforces preventive measures: frequent handwashing, avoiding contact with sick individuals, and promptly reporting suspected symptoms to health services. Led by Mughole Kazi and Marie Kavira, Amacco’s sensitization cell circulates the market to remind people of essential practices and to counter misinformation. They emphasize that informing women protects families and clients, invite questions to quell fears, and rely on trusted treatment centers and medical teams. This community-based effort complements hospital responses, with public health services remaining the main safeguards against Ebola in Beni.

triage.headline_ja: 北キブ：ベニのエボラ対策の最前線に立つ女性商人たち
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の発生が確認されており、IHR基準では潜在的に複数該当の可能性があるが、記事は主に社会的対応・啓発活動に焦点を当てており、流行状況の詳細情報（症例数、死亡数、拡大傾向など）が不足している。続報での状況確認が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は北キブ州ベニでのエボラ対策の社会的取り組みを報道しており、DRC確認。ただし記事サマリーには具体的な症例数、死亡数、感染曲線の傾向などの疫学データが記載されていない。エボラは確認されているが、現在の流行規模や深刻度の詳細が不明。公開日は2026年6月19日。

article.articleHeadline: Bangui en alerte maximale face à l'épidémie d'Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bangui on high alert amid the Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: Bangui, Central African Republic, is on high alert as Ebola virus disease threatens the region near the Democratic Republic of Congo border. Surveillance at Bangui’s entry points is not fully respected, leaving the capital at increased risk of cross-border transmission from Zongo, a DRC town across the river. The situation raises concerns about potential spread into the country. In response, authorities have tightened controls, strengthened surveillance, and intensified public awareness campaigns to limit transmission. As of 19 June 2026, officials emphasize vigilance at entry points and border areas to prevent importation and onward spread of Ebola. The measures respond to an ongoing Ebola outbreak in neighboring DRC and aim to protect both residents and travelers.

triage.headline_ja: バンギはエボラ出血熱流行の危機に直面して最大警戒態勢下にある
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラ出血熱の国境を越えた伝播リスクと地域の高い警戒態勢が示唆される。
triage.notes: 発生地域にCentral African RepublicおよびBeninが含まれていますが、記事サマリーは進行中のエボラ出血熱流行を「隣接するDRC」における事象として述べており、CARはその国境周辺での警戒態勢の対象地域です。対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみであるため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとしました。

article.articleHeadline: 【社会】デング熱流行　タイ保健省が警戒呼びかけ　日系企業も対策強化が必須
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Society: Dengue fever outbreak — Thai Ministry of Public Health urges vigilance; Japanese companies must also strengthen countermeasures.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever outbreak reported in Thailand with rising infections, prompting urgent directives from the Ministry of Public Health to local authorities and healthcare facilities to strengthen containment. Rainy season volumes exceed typical levels, creating mosquito breeding habitats nationwide, with latest Department of Disease Control data showing cases well above the same period last year, especially in Bangkok and surrounding industrial estates. The outbreak threatens Japanese manufacturing firms via potential production slowdowns and workforce shortages, urging employers to boost in-house awareness, conduct regular site disinfection, and provide insect repellent sprays to employees. The Thai-Japanese Association and local subsidiaries are advised to treat health management as part of business continuity planning to withstand peak infection weeks. The ministry is coordinating with pharmaceutical companies and private groups to distribute mosquito larvicides and remove standing water, while bolstering medical supplies for clinics to enable rapid diagnosis and care.

triage.headline_ja: 【社会】デング熱流行　タイ保健省が警戒呼びかけ　日系企業も対策強化が必須
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）、かつWPRO基準複数該当。タイ全国でのデング熱感染増加が報告され、保健省による緊急警戒呼びかけがあり、官民による対策強化の必要性が指摘されている。
triage.notes: 記事はタイ全国でのデング熱流行を主題としており、バンコク及びその周辺工業地帯での感染増加が強調されている。タイ保健省が公式に警戒を呼びかけており、日系企業への影響も記載されているため社会的・政治的関心が高い。雨季による蚊の繁殖環境増加が背景要因として述べられており、継続的な曝露リスクがある。

article.articleHeadline: Leader Ue, 'preoccupa la diffusione del virus Ebola in Congo e Uganda' - Altre news
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: EU leader, 'the spread of the Ebola virus in Congo and Uganda is worrying' - Other News
article.articleSummary: European leaders express concern over the spread of Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda and urge the Council and Commission to monitor the situation and, if needed, define and coordinate priorities. The European Council conclusions welcome rapid emergency funding from the World Health Organization and other international and European partners, enabling an immediate response including epidemiological surveillance, contact tracing, clinical preparedness, and strengthened laboratory capacity. The EU reiterates financial and logistical support to WHO, the African Centres for Disease Control and Prevention, and other frontline humanitarian and health actors in urgent containment and response measures. The text emphasizes the importance of global health governance and coordinated responses through WHO, and notes hantavirus crises as a reminder of strengthening prevention, preparedness, and response at the global level, with EU coordination tools providing added value.

triage.headline_ja: EUリーダー、『コンゴとウガンダにおけるエボラウイルスの拡大が懸念される』 - その他ニュース
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスはIHR上の重大な懸念疾患であり、DRCとウガンダでの確認された発生は4つのIHR基準のうち3つ以上に該当する（重篤な影響、異常/予想外性、国際的拡大リスク）。EU指導部の公式声明による高い社会政治的関心も確認される。
triage.notes: Hantavirus は記事サマリー内では Global health governance の文脈での例及びとして言及されており、本記事の主題はエボラウイルスの DRC とウガンダでの発生である。ウガンダ（発生地域に含まれるが対象国リストに未含）での確認については記事サマリーに記載されているため、国際的な懸念事項として認識されているが、評価対象国リストに基づき verified_locations には DRC のみ記載する。EU機関による公式な懸念表明と WHO からの緊急資金援助により、国際的な初期対応がすでに開始されている。

article.articleHeadline: Epidemia de ebola se propaga rapidamente na RDC, alerta OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola epidemic spreads rapidly in the DRC, WHO warns.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-06-19, the World Health Organization warned that the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is spreading rapidly despite intensified control efforts. WHO Emergency Director for Africa Marie-Roseline Belizaire said the outbreak remains grave and is evolving quickly, with transmission accelerating in the northeast of the country. Health teams are racing against time to confront the worsening situation as they scale up surveillance, case management, and response activities. The briefing emphasizes the urgency of sustained operations, noting no specific case or death counts are disclosed in the report. The rapid spread underscores ongoing strain on local health systems and the need for continued international support to contain the epidemic in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行がDRCで急速に拡大、WHOが警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。エボラ出血熱の急速な蔓延は国際的な懸念を招く重大シグナルであり、フルRRA評価が必要。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は致命率が高く、急速な蔓延の報告はIHRおよびWPRO両基準全項目で該当。DRCでの北東部での伝播加速、ローカル保健システムへの負荷、国際支援の必要性が明記されている。具体的な患者数・死亡数は報告されていないが、緊急レベルの対応が進行中であることが示唆される。

article.articleHeadline: Gripe ou resfriado? Como atravessar a temporada dos vírus respiratórios
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Flu or cold? How to get through the respiratory virus season.
article.articleSummary: As of June 19, 2026, the Distrito Federal reports rising influenza-like illness and SRAG visits as respiratory viruses circulate.
