The MiniDock costs $155; the Pluslife Thermolyse pretreatment device $180; each 30-minute assay $3.60. The push follows COVID-19 disruptions and aid cuts, aligning with WHO’s NPOC approach. Aurum Institute’s Gombe notes country-tailored rollout, with 40–200 sites per nation and cross-country troubleshooting calls. The effort builds on the IMPAACT4TB preventive therapy rollout and a $59 million Unitaid-supported program; the 3HP regimen was reduced to $9.50 per patient.

triage.headline_ja: 13カ国における5,000台の結核ポイントオブケア検査システムの展開が5,000万ドルの資金で開始
triage.triage_reason: 結核診断技術の展開プログラムに関する記事であり、公衆衛生への取り組みとしては重要であるが、新規の疾病流行や危機的状況を報告するものではない。スクリーニング基準には該当するが、社会的・政治的関心の程度が不明であり、情報が限定的である。
triage.notes: 本記事は結核診断技術の展開・資金配分プログラムに関するニュースであり、新規の感染症クラスター、アウトブレイク、または危機的な疾病発生事象ではない。記事にはCOVID-19が疾患として記載されているが、本文中ではCOVID-19パンデミックによる医療の混乱の背景言及に過ぎず、現在のCOVID-19関連の新規事象ではない。Peruは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外した。

article.articleHeadline: बीएमओ ने मलेरिया रथ को हरी झंडी दिखाकर किया रवाना -
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Block Medical Officer flagged off the Malaria Rath.
article.articleSummary: Malaria awareness drive flagged off from Mulatayi District Hospital under the directive of Chief Medical and Health Officer Dr. Manoj Hurmade. The Malaria Rath was launched by Block Medical Officer Dr. Gajendra Meena and will tour development block villages to educate the public about malaria symptoms and prevention. Malaria Inspector Divakar Kinakar stated the vehicle will visit Kolhiya, Hatnapur, Jamgaon, Barai, Parmandal and other villages to spread awareness and promote protective measures. Chandan Bhalavi, in-charge of BCM, and all staff were present. The outreach aims to enhance community understanding of malaria transmission, early signs, and preventive practices, strengthening local public health efforts in the Mulatayi area.

triage.headline_ja: ブロック医療責任者がマラリア・ラスを旗揚げして出発させた
triage.triage_reason: この記事は新規の感染症クラスター発生や異常事態ではなく、ルーチンな啓発キャンペーン（Malaria Rath awareness drive）の実施報告に過ぎない。患者発生数、死亡、重症度に関する情報がなく、IHR基準・WPRO基準のいずれも該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事はマラリア啓発キャンペーン（Malaria Rath）の開始報告であり、感染症クラスター、流行拡大、異常事態の報告ではない。定期的な公衆衛生活動であるため、シグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Die Lage sei deshalb immer noch "ernst": WHO: Ebola-Virus breitet sich in der DR Kongo weiter aus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The situation is still 'serious': WHO: the Ebola virus is spreading further in DR Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo continues to spread rapidly, with Ituri Province especially affected and Bunia as the outbreak’s hub. As of June 19, 2026, the WHO reports 896 confirmed infections and 232 deaths, with 21 new cases in the last 24 hours. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo variant (identified in 2007), for which there is no vaccine or targeted therapy. Transmission occurs through direct contact with bodily fluids of infected individuals. The WHO had declared a health emergency of international concern in mid-May. Containment is challenging because affected provinces are hard to access and have long been sites of armed conflict. Containment measures are being strengthened daily, according to Marie-Roseline Bélizaire, WHO Africa Ebola operations chief, speaking from Bunia.

triage.headline_ja: WHO: エボラウイルスはコンゴ民主共和国で引き続き拡大している
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）し、WPRO基準すべてが陽性。WHO国際保健上の懸念事象宣言済みで即対応が必要。
triage.notes: エボラウイルスBundibugyo亜種による大規模流行。896件の確定症例、232件の死亡が報告されており、ワクチンも標的治療法も存在しない。紛争地域での感染制御の困難さが懸念材料。WHO国際保健上の懸念事象宣言は2026年5月中旬。Ituri州での急速な拡大が継続している。

article.articleHeadline: OBSH: Epidemia e Ebolës në RD të Kongos mbetet serioze me gati 900 raste
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: The Ebola epidemic in DR Congo remains serious with nearly 900 cases.
article.articleSummary: One month after its declaration, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo remains serious and evolving. As of now, 896 confirmed cases and 232 deaths have been reported across 33 health zones in three provinces; 78 people have recovered. Uganda has had no new Ebola infections in 12 days, a positive sign for cross-border containment. The World Health Organization has deployed more than 115 experts and delivered over 110 tonnes of emergency supplies to affected areas to accelerate response. Ongoing needs include limited access in high-risk areas, gaps in contact tracing, and ongoing community deaths, with some transmission chains possibly outside response activities, especially in displacement-affected communities. Rapid diagnosis and quality care remain crucial to save lives, with intensified control measures.

triage.headline_ja: WHO：コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行は約900例で深刻な状態が続く
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5つすべてに該当。エボラウイルス病の国際的に重大な公衆衛生事象として即座にフルRRA対象。
triage.notes: ウガンダは記事内で言及されているが、過去12日間新規感染なしとの報告のため、主要な発生地域はコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。エボラは国際保健規則上の重大感染症であり、WHO専門家115名以上が展開、緊急支援物資110トン以上が配布されている状況から、国際的関心と支援が極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: 35 Japanese Encephalitis cases, 7 deaths reported in Assam
article.articleSummary: Assam has reported 35 Japanese Encephalitis (JE) cases through June 17, with seven deaths verified as JE-related, according to NHM and NCVBDC data. NHM emphasizes AES and JE are distinct illnesses; JE is one cause of AES, but AES cases are not all JE. Figures of 470 AES cases and 32 AES deaths should not be interpreted as JE. Assam is in the AES-JE season (June–August) with ongoing preparedness. Since February 2026, authorities have boosted surveillance, case management, hospital readiness, vaccination activities, and inter-department coordination. Initiatives include training nodal medical officers, deploying district coordinators, issuing guidelines and SOPs, strengthening referrals, ensuring essential medicines, and expanding JE vaccination coverage. NHM Assam requests media and stakeholders report AES and JE data separately to prevent public misunderstanding.

triage.headline_ja: アッサム州でジャパニーズ・エンセファリティス35例、死亡7例が報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目に該当（重篤性、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。ジャパニーズ・エンセファリティスは既知の重大感染症であり、季節的集積（死亡率20%）と官民連携対応が確認されている。
triage.notes: アッサム州はジャパニーズ・エンセファリティスの風土病地域で、6月～8月が流行季。死亡率20%（7/35）と高い。NHMは既に2月から監視強化、ワクチン接種拡大などを実施中で、管理可能性がある。AES（急性脳炎症候群）との区別について当局が強調している点は、公開情報の信頼性を示す。

article.articleHeadline: WHO: Über 70 medizinische Mitarbeiter im Kongo mit Ebola infiziert
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: More than 70 medical staff in the Congo infected with Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has infected 75 healthcare workers since the outbreak began, with 17 fatalities among them as of 19 June 2026. Authorities officially declared the outbreak on 15 May in the eastern, Ebola-affected region, though transmission likely began months earlier when many frontline staff were exposed before the danger was known. Healthcare workers face critical shortages of basic PPE such as gloves and masks, hindering protection. WHO Emergency Director for Ebola, Marie Roseline Belizaire, described the impact on the health system as a very high price, noting Uganda and China are sending medical teams to assist. The WHO is also providing psychological support to staff anxious about treating patients after colleagues fell ill. The report emphasizes ongoing international support and frontline challenges in the eastern DRC.

triage.headline_ja: WHO：コンゴで70人以上の医療職員がエボラに感染
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス感染症の確認、医療従事者の多数感染・死亡、国際的支援派遣が進行中であり、シグナルトリアージ段階で即座にフルRRA対象とする必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCが主要な発生地。Ugandaは医療チーム派遣国として言及されているが、ウガンダ国内での発生確認は明記されていないため対象国リストにないため除外。Chinaは医療チーム派遣国として言及されているが、記事主題はDRCの発生であり、Chinaでの発生地の詳細は不明。対象国リストにあるため暫定的に含める。IHR基準4項目該当かつ全WPROスクリーニング基準該当で即座にPICKUP判定。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية: إصابة 75 عاملاً صحياً بإيبولا ووفاة 17 في الكونجو الديمقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: 75 health workers infected with Ebola and 17 deaths in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Seventy-five health workers infected with Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with 17 fatalities, have been reported since the current outbreak began. The virus is believed to have circulated for months before authorities detected the first cases on May 15, implying early exposure among frontline staff. Widespread shortages of basic personal protective equipment, including gloves and masks, heighten transmission risk in overwhelmed, understaffed health facilities. The country reportedly has about 11 health workers per 10,000 people, underscoring the fragile capacity to contain the outbreak. WHO Emergency Director, speaking via video from eastern DRC, said the outbreak is placing enormous pressure on an already strained health system. China and Uganda have dispatched medical teams to support the response. WHO is providing psychosocial support to infected workers distressed by colleagues' infections.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラに75人の医療従事者が感染し17人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス感染症は公衆衛生への深刻な影響（死亡、医療従事者への感染）、国際的拡大リスク（複数国への波及）、および異常性を示しており、IHR基準3つ以上に該当。緊急対応が必要なシグナル。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの主題はコンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ発生。ウガンダはBluedot APIで発生地域に含まれているが、サマリー上ではウガンダは医療チーム派遣国として言及されており、実際の発生地ではないため除外。医療従事者への感染と複数国からの支援派遣により国際的関心が高い。医療施設の容量不足と個人防護具の不足が懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Fome leva pacientes com ebola a fugir de centros de tratamento no Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hunger drives Ebola patients to flee from treatment centers in Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is driving patients to flee treatment centers amid a severe hunger crisis in the east. Since late May, government reports show more than 150 escapes from Ebola treatment and isolation facilities; in one incident, 11 suspected patients fled a hospital in Bambu near Mongbwalu due to inadequate nutrition support. The outbreak has infected nearly 900 people and killed more than a quarter. The east's chronic hunger—affecting about 10 million—complicates isolation and contact monitoring, with around 6,400 people being watched for exposure. Ituri province accounts for over 90% of confirmed cases. The UN World Food Programme is providing hot meals at centers and to patients, contacts, and families; 590 meals were distributed in one day this week. WFP seeks $175 million by November for Congo operations, including $32 million for Ebola activities.

triage.headline_ja: 飢饉によりコンゴのエボラ患者が治療センターから逃亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラウイルス疾患の確認された流行で、患者逃亡による感染拡大リスク、飢饉による管理困難性が顕著。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで主に言及されているのはコンゴ民主共和国(DRC)のイトゥリ州でのエボラ流行。Bambù/Mangbwalu等の具体的な逃亡事案も全てDRC領域内。発生地域リストにイタリア・ヴェネト州が含まれているが、サマリーにおいてイタリアでの発生は一切記載されていないため、検証済み位置から除外。確認症例約900人、死亡率25%以上、患者逃亡150件以上、接触者監視6,400人という重度の流行状況。

article.articleHeadline: أكثر من 200 وفاة بإيبولا في الكونغو الديمقراطية خلال شهر
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 200 Ebola deaths in the Democratic Republic of the Congo within a month.
article.articleSummary: As of 19 June 2026, Africa CDC reports the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has caused 202 deaths among 875 confirmed cases (case fatality ≈23%). The outbreak, declared on 15 May, involves the Bundibugyo strain and marks the seventh Ebola event in DRC. Cases are concentrated in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu in the northeast, regions beset by armed conflict and large displacements. Response efforts are hampered by weak contact tracing and access difficulties due to security conditions, hindering work by Africa CDC, WHO, and partners. The Red Cross warned the outbreak has not peaked and containment could take up to a year. The epidemic has extended to Uganda, with 19 cases and 2 deaths, largely among travelers from DRC, while cross-border measures have limited further spread.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱により1ヶ月間で200人以上が死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラ出血熱は高い死亡率（23%）を示し、多数の死亡と国際的拡大（ウガンダへの越境感染）が確認されている。紛争地域での発生のため対応困難性も高く、フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではウガンダへの越境感染も言及されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には DRC のみ列挙。発生の主体はDRCであり、ウガンダは二次的な事象。紛争地域での発生、アクセス困難性、Africa CDC等の国際機関による対応が困難な状況が特徴。

article.articleHeadline: L'OIM franchit le cap du million de dépistages sanitaires et intensifie sa réponse à l'épidémie d'Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: IOM Reaches the Milestone of One Million Health Screenings and Intensifies Its Response to the Ebola Outbreak.
article.articleSummary: On 19 June 2026, IOM reports surpassing one million health screenings at borders and along mobility corridors in Ebola-affected or at-risk countries, as it intensifies response to an outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo and into Uganda. As of 18 June, the outbreak has caused 198 deaths and over 856 infections, according to WHO. In the DRC, transmission has occurred in North Kivu, South Kivu and Ituri, with cross-border spread to Uganda; neighboring Burundi, Rwanda and South Sudan remain high risk due to intense movement along regional corridors. IOM is mobilizing additional staff, logistics and funding to strengthen surveillance at 110 entry points and 43 screening sites, deploying personnel to high-risk border areas. Ituri sees about 16,000 cross-border movements. The response relies on population-movement mapping to guide containment, enhance contact tracing, risk communication, and case management, with support from the U.S. government and the EU; call for more contributions.

triage.headline_ja: IOMは100万件の健康スクリーニングというマイルストーンに到達し、エボラアウトブレイクへの対応を強化
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の確定的なアウトブレイク（198死亡、856以上の感染）であり、IHR基準の4項目すべてに該当。東部DRCから隣接するウガンダへの国際的な拡大が確認され、地域内で高い公衆衛生上の影響と渡航制限リスクがある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではエボラアウトブレイクが「eastern Democratic Republic of Congo and into Uganda」と述べられている。対象国リストはDRC（203312）のみを含むため、ウガンダは含めない。South Sudan、Rwanda、Burundiは「at-risk」と記載されているが、確定的な発生地域としては記述されていないため除外。発生地域にはSouth Kivu Province（DRC）とIturi（DRC）が明示されており、DRCが主要な発生国として確認される。IHR基準4/4、WPRO基準5/5の該当により、フルRRA進行が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : le bilan dépasse 200 morts pour 875 cas confirmés
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: the death toll has risen to over 200, with 875 confirmed cases.
article.articleSummary: Eastern Democratic Republic of Congo is confronting an Ebola outbreak caused by the Bundibugyo strain, with 875 confirmed cases and 202 deaths as of June 18, 2026 (Africa CDC), across Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu in 31 health zones. Uganda reports 19 cases and 2 deaths. This is the 17th Ebola outbreak in DRC and the first linked to Bundibugyo, for which no vaccine or specific treatment exists; the Ervebo vaccine protects Zaïre strain only. The response relies on established public health measures: early detection, isolation, contact tracing, and safe, dignified burials. Field capacity has risen to about 400 beds and four laboratories, two of which can process up to ~1,000 samples per day, though WHO deems capacity insufficient. Provisional case fatality among confirmed cases is ~23%. The affected demographic is shifting toward more women and children; insecurity and funeral practices hinder control. A helpline is 151.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ：死者数は200人を超え、確認症例は875件
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラ出血熱の大規模流行で、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダでも確認）、および渡航・貿易制限のリスクがすべて認められ、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株によるエボラの17回目の発生。ワクチン（Ervebo）が有効でない株のため対応困難。WHO評価で応対能力不足。死亡率23%。ウガンダでの事例報告（19症例、2死亡）はあるがDRCが主要発生地。記事上DRCが主題のため、Uganda は verified_locations から除外。

article.articleHeadline: СЗО: 75 медици в ДР Конго са заразени с ебола, 17 починаха
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: 75 healthcare workers in the DR Congo infected with Ebola, 17 have died.
article.articleSummary: As of 19 June 2026, the WHO reports 75 healthcare workers infected with Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo since the start of the current outbreak, with 17 fatalities among staff. The virus is believed to have circulated for months before authorities officially declared an outbreak on 15 May. Health facilities warn PPE shortages, jeopardizing frontline response. Congo's health worker density is about 11 per 10,000 people, among the lowest globally. International support includes medical teams from China and Uganda; the United States indicated it will not admit Ebola patients and plans a treatment center in Kenya for its citizens. The current flare follows a separate Kasai outbreak in September of the previous year that killed 15. The WHO also provides psychological support to distressed clinicians.

triage.headline_ja: WHO: エボラ感染者、コンゴ民主共和国の医療従事者75名が感染、17名が死亡
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病（最高リスク病原体）による集団発生、医療従事者への影響、国際的支援体制の確立、および高い致死率（23%）が確認されており、IHR基準3項目以上該当。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病は国際保健上の最も重要な脅威の一つ。記事サマリーより、DRC での実際の感染発生が主要テーマ。中国からの医療チーム派遣が述べられているため China も verified_locations に含める。ケニア・ウガンダは治療支援センターの設置地としてのみ記載されているため、主要発生国としては除外。米国の不受け入れ姿勢は対応方針を示しているが、主要発生地ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: La República Democrática del Congo eleva a 896 los casos confirmados de ébola y reporta 232 fallecidos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Democratic Republic of the Congo raises the number of confirmed Ebola cases to 896 and reports 232 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo reaches 896 confirmed cases and 232 deaths (case fatality 26%). Health minister Samuel-Roger Kamba reported 21 new infections and 6 deaths in the last 24 hours, with 11 recoveries. The epidemic now affects 33 health zones across Ituri province (epicenter) and parts of North Kivu and South Kivu. Treatment centers currently isolate 383 patients; 78 have been discharged to date. Contact tracing stands at 71%, with a goal of 95%. The outbreak has spread to Uganda, with 19 infections (14 imported from DRC; 2 deaths). The strain is Bundibugyo, whose fatality spans 30–50%; no approved vaccine or targeted therapy exists. The WHO classifies the risk as high in sub-Saharan Africa but low globally, and declared the outbreak an international health emergency on May 17; the epidemic began around May 15 in Ituri.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国がエボラ確認患者数を896人に引き上げ、死者232人を報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、異常な事態、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。スクリーニング基準も複数該当。WHO公式認定の国際保健緊急事態であり、社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの拡大報告（19感染、2死亡）があるが、ウガンダは評価対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。DRCの東部地域（イトゥリ州、南キブ州、北キブ州）で拡大中。Bundibuguoエボラウイルスであり、致死率30-50%と高い。WHOは既に5月17日に国際保健緊急事態を宣言している。

article.articleHeadline: Brote de ébola en la República Democrática del Congo escaló a 896 contagios
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo climbed to 896 cases.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-19, the Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 896 confirmed cases and 232 deaths (case fatality ~26%), spanning 33 health zones across North Kivu, South Kivu, and Ituri, with Ituri as the epicenter. Over the last 24 hours, health authorities counted 21 new infections and six deaths, while 11 patients recovered. Affected facilities are supervising 383 people in strict isolation; official recoveries total 78 since the outbreak began. Contact tracing stands at 71%, below the 95% target considered essential to halt community transmission. The World Health Organization identifies the strain as Bundibugyo, a highly lethal Ebola variant with no approved vaccine or specific treatment. The outbreak has crossed the border into Uganda, reporting 19 cases (14 acquired in Congo) and two deaths there.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行が896例に拡大
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。Bundibugyo型エボラウイルスによる大規模流行でWPRO基準も全て該当。国際的な関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはウガンダへの越境を述べているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には DRC のみを列挙。Bundibugyo型エボラは致死率が高く（26%）、認可済みワクチンや特異的治療法がない。接触者追跡率71%は目標95%に達していない。即座のフルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Kerala reports 120 Shigella cases in June; Nipah contacts test negative
article.articleSummary: Kerala reports 10 new Shigella cases on Friday, taking June’s total to 120 and the year’s to 196, with five June deaths. New cases by district include Kozhikode (3), Thiruvananthapuram (2), Thrissur (2), Malappuram (2) and Palakkad (1). Outbreaks are declared in Kozhikode (36), Wayanad (18), Thrissur (11) and Alappuzha (3). Shigella, a contagious bacterial infection spread through contaminated food, water or poor hygiene, typically causes diarrhoea, fever and stomach cramps. Nip update: the patient remains ventilated at Kozhikode Medical College Hospital; 14 symptomatic contacts tested negative. No new contacts added; 104 people remain on the contact list (4 very high-risk, 14 high-risk, 86 low-risk). Three contacts under observation were discharged; one healthcare worker’s sample collected. Health teams visited 56 houses in Ramanattukara Ward 5; 88 public calls were logged; psychological support provided to 118 people. Nipah is a viral zoonosis; to date no positive tests among symptomatic contacts; monitoring continues.

triage.headline_ja: ケーラタ州が6月に120件のシゲラ症例を報告。ニパウイルス接触者は陰性。
triage.triage_reason: シゲラ症集団発生（6月120件、年間196件、死亡5件）と並行したニパウイルス事例の発生。公衆衛生への深刻な影響が明確で、異常/予想外の複合感染症イベントであり、スクリーニング基準の複数が該当。
triage.notes: ニパウイルス1例（人工呼吸器管理中）とシゲラ症の大規模集団発生が同時に進行。シゲラは汚染された食水・衛生不備を介した伝播が容易で、複数県にまたがる同時多発発生。ニパウイルス患者の接触者追跡は現在陰性だが、動物由来人獣共通感染症として国際的関心も高い。ケーラ州の衛生・水道インフラの問題を示唆。

article.articleHeadline: समीक्षा बैठक: एमएसयू की समीक्षा बैठक - इबोला समेत बरसाती बीमारियों के लिए कार्ययोजना बनाने का निर्देश | Review meeting of MSU - instructions to prepare action plan for rainy season diseases including Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Review Meeting: MSU's Review Meeting — Directive to Formulate an Action Plan for Monsoon-Season Diseases, Including Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Nagpur, India — In the Nagpur Municipal Corporation's Metropolitan Surveillance Unit Executive Committee meeting chaired by Additional Commissioner Ankit, officials reviewed three months of public health measures from April to June. The agenda prioritized surveillance and management of Ebola and monsoon-season communicable diseases, along with heat-stroke illnesses, malaria, and dengue control. A plan to prevent potential Ebola transmission was outlined, including daily inspection of travelers listed in the IHIP portal, and the development of interdepartmental dengue and malaria control strategies for the monsoon period. The meeting also mandated Focus Group Discussions per directives of the National Centre for Disease Control (NCDC), Delhi, and a comprehensive monsoon infection-prevention plan. Data on mosquitoes and larval infections such as Black Spot were to be shared between the municipal health department and the malaria unit to finalize a joint action plan. Attendees included MSU and Nagpur health officials and NCDC Delhi representatives.

triage.headline_ja: レビュー会議：MSUのレビュー会議 — モンスーン時期の病気（エボラを含む）に対するアクションプラン策定の指示
triage.triage_reason: エボラを含むモンスーン期の感染症対策の予防的計画立案に関する行政会議の報告。現在のエボラ患者発生は記事に記載されていないため、異常事態ではなく予防措置のステージと判断される。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はインドのナーグプル市における行政レベルの予防的会議報告であり、既発生のエボラアウトブレイクではない。NCDC（インド国立疾病管理センター）がモンスーン期の感染症対策計画を指示している点は政府レベルでの関心を示すが、現在の患者発生数や重症度に関する具体的データが記事に記載されていない。エボラ、マラリア、デングの3疾患が言及されているが、いずれも予防・サーベイランス強化の段階と解釈される。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية: إصابة عشرات العاملين الصحيين في الكونغو بفيروس إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: Dozens of healthcare workers in the Democratic Republic of the Congo infected with Ebola virus.
article.articleSummary: Dozens of healthcare workers in the Democratic Republic of the Congo have been infected with the Ebola virus, according to a World Health Organization update reported by Cairo News on a breaking bulletin. The report signals a widening Ebola outbreak in the country, as infections and fatalities continue to rise. As of 2026-06-19, international concern is mounting about the Congo’s health system’s ability to contain the crisis and protect frontline workers. The article does not provide exact case counts, laboratory confirmation details, transmission sources, or information on imported/exported cases. The developing situation underscores ongoing transmission risks within healthcare settings and highlights the need for strengthened surveillance, infection prevention measures, and international attention to the outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関：コンゴ民主共和国の医療従事者数十人がエボラウイルスに感染
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルスの医療従事者への感染は深刻な公衆衛生上の影響を示し、国際的な拡大リスクと渡航・貿易制限のリスクが存在する。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが付与した発生地域にはCairoおよびエジプトが含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題はDRC（コンゴ民主共和国）でのエボラ発生であり、エジプトは報道元の位置情報のみ。医療従事者への集団感染は感染予防・制御能力の限界を示唆し、WHO公式情報に基づく信頼度の高いシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: "الصحة العالمية" تؤكد إصابة 75 من العاملين بالمجال الطبي بـ"إيبولا" في الكونغو الديمقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization confirms 75 healthcare workers infected with Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: 75 healthcare workers have been infected with Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with 17 deaths since the current outbreak began. The World Health Organization’s Emergency Director said the toll reflects a heavy burden on a health system already strained by a severe workforce shortage (about 11 health workers per 10,000 people). China and Uganda are sending medical teams to assist, and the WHO is providing psychological support to clinicians anxious about caring for patients after several colleagues contracted the virus. Officials indicate the virus is believed to have circulated for months before the first cases were announced on May 15, suggesting many health workers were exposed before recognition of transmission. The report emphasizes the ongoing outbreak and the strain on health capacity, urging continued international support.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関（WHO）がコンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱による医療従事者75人の感染を確認
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的な拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WPRO基準5つすべてに該当。医療従事者への感染と死亡を伴う重大なエボラ出血熱の流行であり、複数国による支援が既に実施されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはコンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱の流行が主題であり、中国が医療支援チームを派遣していることが明記されている。ウガンダはBluedot発生地域に含まれているが、サマリーでは『ウガンダが医療チームを派遣』と述べられているのみで、ウガンダでの発生は記述されていないため、verified_locationsに含めない。医療従事者への感染と死亡、保健システムへの負荷、数ヶ月間の未検出流行期間、複数国による国際支援の実施がある点で、フルRRA実施の対象となる。

article.articleHeadline: Beni : levée de la résistance face à Ebola dans une aire de santé - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Beni: lifting of resistance to Ebola in a health area - ACP
article.articleSummary: On 19 June 2026, in Beni, North Kivu, Democratic Republic of the Congo, resistance by young members of a pressure group to the Ebola response was lifted after mediation by local authorities. The militants had blocked the transfer of a patient suspected of Ebola to a public facility, but agreed that the patient would be followed and treated by health personnel and left the Kitsa health center where they had been guarding their associate who was being moved to the hospital. Health authorities caution they fear the group may regroup for a restitution meeting that evening at their gathering veranda. The incident underscores tensions in managing a suspected Ebola case within the Mukulya health area, with ongoing concerns about secure patient transfer and community engagement.

triage.headline_ja: ベニ：保健地域でのエボラ対策への抵抗が解除される - ACP
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の確定事例ではなく疑い症例に関する地域的な社会的紛争であり、IHR基準の該当が限定的。ただしエボラという高リスク病原体と関連し、地域レベルでの対応困難を示唆しているため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 本記事は疑い症例の患者移送に対する地域住民グループの抵抗と、それが解除されたという事象を報告している。確定患者数や実際の感染拡大の証拠は記述されていない。ただしエボラへの対応における社会的抵抗は公衆衛生上の懸念事項であり、当局が同グループの再集結を懸念している点から、コミュニティエンゲージメントの課題が存在することが示唆される。疑い症例の検査結果確認が重要。

article.articleHeadline: Casos de Síndrome Respiratória Aguda Grave voltam a crescer, diz Fiocruz
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome cases are rising again, says Fiocruz
article.articleSummary: Brazil reports a renewed rise in Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SRAG) cases across age groups, according to Fiocruz’s InfoGripe bulletin. In 2026, 89,725 SRAG cases have been recorded nationwide, with 44,485 testing positive for a respiratory virus. The increase is driven largely by hospitalizations linked to influenza A and B across children, adults, and older adults; meanwhile the respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) remains the principal cause of hospitalizations among very young children. While growth in cases among children up to four years old shows signs of slowing, several regions continue to experience concern, and severe outcomes persist in multiple demographics. Vaccination guidance: seasonal influenza vaccine protects against influenza A and B and is strongly recommended for children, the elderly, and those with comorbidities. RSV vaccination is advised for pregnant women starting at 28 weeks gestation to shield newborns in early life.

triage.headline_ja: 重症急性呼吸器症候群(SRAG)の症例が再び増加、フィオクルーズが報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）、かつWPRO基準で重症度・流行しやすさ・長期曝露が該当。社会的関心も高く、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 2026年累計で89,725件のSRAG症例、うち44,485件が呼吸器ウイルス陽性。インフルエンザAおよびB、RSVが主要な原因。複数の年齢層での重症者発生及びワクチン接種勧告の発出から社会的関心が高い。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo Ebola cases approach 900 mark as disease spreads rapidly
article.articleSummary: As of 19 June 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 896 confirmed Ebola cases and 232 deaths since the outbreak was declared on May 15. The outbreak is driven by Bundibugyo virus, for which there are no approved vaccines or targeted treatments, and is the 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC. The infection has spread to 33 health zones across Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu. On Wednesday, 21 new cases and six deaths were reported. Healthcare facilities are stretched, with 383 patients in isolation or inpatient care; 78 patients have recovered, including 11 discharged after negative follow-up tests. An additional 151 suspected cases, including 35 deaths, were reported on Wednesday, suggesting the toll may be higher. Officials warn that community transmission is rising and rapid geographic spread remains possible without swift public health measures. Contact tracers monitor 6,367 contacts, though insecurity limited follow-up to 71.1%.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ感染者数が900件に近づく、疾病が急速に拡大
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目すべて該当。確認済みの896症例、232死亡、急速な地理的拡大、治療法なし、国内の管理限界が明確。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus（BEBVワクチンなし）による第17次DRC エボラ流行。33保健地区に拡大、接触者追跡が不完全（71.1%）で、コミュニティ伝播が増加傾向。医療施設の飽和状況が報告されている。国際的支援の緊急性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : 896 cas confirmés, l'OMS sonne l'alerte mondiale face à une souche sans vaccin - Mali Actu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: 896 confirmed cases, WHO sounds a global alert against a strain for which there is no vaccine - Mali Actu
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo escalates in June 2026: 896 laboratory-confirmed cases and 232 deaths reported, with approximately 50 survivors. The strain is Bundibugyo, notable for lacking an approved vaccine. The outbreak spans 31 health zones across Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu provinces and has crossed borders into Uganda, with 19 confirmed cases there. The World Health Organization has declared the event a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC). Management relies on rapid case detection, strict isolation, and contact tracing, with experimental therapies used under protocols whose effectiveness remains uncertain. The crisis is shaped by ongoing conflict and population displacement, complicating response and cross-border cooperation with neighboring countries. No vaccine protection exists for Bundibugyo, underscoring a need for accelerated vaccine development and regional coordination to prevent further spread.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス病（RDC）：896人の確定症例、ワクチンのない株に対してWHOが世界的警報を発令 - Mali Actu
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WHOがPHEIC宣言済みの大規模エボラアウトブレイク。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはUgandaも含まれているが、記事サマリーによれば主要アウトブレイクはDRCであり、ウガンダは越境症例（19確定症例）として二次的。対象国リストではDRCのみが該当するため verified_locations に含める。ワクチン未保有の Bundibugyo 株、既にPHEIC宣言、232人の死亡、紛争と人口移動による対応困難化など、複数の増悪要因が存在。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : plus de 200 morts en seulement un mois , H24info
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: more than 200 deaths in just one month, H24info.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease caused by the Bundibugyo strain is circulating in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with 875 laboratory-confirmed infections and 202 deaths since its appearance in mid-May, a case-fatality rate around 23%. More than 200 deaths occurred within roughly one month. Uganda reports 19 confirmed cases, including two fatalities. The World Health Organization classified this Bundibugyo outbreak as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, while CDC Africa designated it a Continental Public Health Emergency (USPSC). Figures are current as of 2026-06-19. Laboratory confirmation underpins the counts; the article does not detail infection sources or clinical features. The report highlights the unusual Bundibugyo strain and the scale of international health concern and response.

triage.headline_ja: RDCのエボラ：わずか1か月で200人以上が死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な病原体株、国際的拡大の実績と継続中）。WPROスクリーニング基準5項目すべてに該当。WHOによるPHEIC宣言済みの状況。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで主たる発生地域はコンゴ民主共和国(DRC)であることが明確。ウガンダへの波及(19確認例)も記載されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には DRC のみを記載。Bundibugyo株によるエボラ流行で、WHOが既にPHEIC宣告済み。CDC Africaも大陸規模の公衆衛生緊急事態として指定。ケース致死率約23%、1か月間に200人以上の死亡という極めて深刻な状況。

article.articleHeadline: WHO: 75 zdravstvenih radnika zaraženo ebolom u Africi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: 75 healthcare workers infected with Ebola in Africa.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda has infected 896 people with 232 deaths, per the World Health Organization. Among the affected, 75 healthcare workers were infected and 17 died. WHO spokesperson Marie-Roseline Belizaire said it is not always clear whether infections occurred at work or in private life. Efforts are being intensified to equip even small clinics with gloves and protective clothing and to train staff in infection prevention. Of 177 clinics surveyed, only four initially had the capacity and equipment to adequately protect all staff. A major challenge is that only about 10% of infected individuals exhibited typical Ebola symptoms, especially bleeding, leading many to delay seeking care at specialized centers. This delay increased transmission within families and in small clinics. A month after outbreak declaration, the situation remains serious and evolving.

triage.headline_ja: WHO: アフリカでエボラに感染した医療従事者75人
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病の多国家発生（DRC・ウガンダ）であり、深刻な公衆衛生影響（896感染者、232死亡）、国際的拡大リスク、医療システムへの脅威が認められる。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーより、エボラウイルス病の発生はDRCとウガンダの両国で確認されている。DRCは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないが、記事の主題として明示されているため、サマリーに基づく地域検証ルールに従い記載。実際には対象国リスト外である点に留意。WHO通知基準（IHR 2つ以上）および WPROスクリーニング基準（5項目全て）を満たすため PICKUP 判定。

article.articleHeadline: Fome leva pacientes com ebola a fugir de centros de tratamento no Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Famine drives Ebola patients to flee treatment centers in Congo.
article.articleSummary: Famine in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo is driving Ebola patients to flee treatment and isolation centers since May, undermining outbreak containment. The World Food Programme seeks US$175 million through November, including US$32 million for Ebola-related activities, with the agency's budget having fallen about a third in recent years. Government reports note more than 150 patient escapes amid a hunger crisis affecting nearly 10 million people in the region. The Ebola outbreak has infected roughly 900 people and caused over 200 deaths. Ituri province—the region with the largest case load—accounts for more than 90% of infections. Food insecurity, displacement, and disrupted food access hinder contact tracing and isolation of suspected or confirmed patients. WFP is distributing meals at treatment centers, to patients, monitored contacts, and affected families, delivering 590 meals in one day this week.

triage.headline_ja: 飢饉がコンゴのエボラ患者を治療センターからの逃亡に駆り立てる
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の確認された流行で900人超の感染者と200人超の死亡が報告されており、飢饉による患者逃亡により封じ込め対策が著しく損なわれている。IHR基準3つ以上（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な事態、国際的拡散リスク）に該当し、WPRO基準も重症度・流行容易性・管理困難性で該当する。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは確認済みのエボラ流行におけるイツリ州での状況を記述。飢饉による患者150人超の逃亡、900人超の感染者、200人超の死亡が報告されている。治療センターからの患者逃亡により接触者追跡と隔離が著しく阻害されており、封じ込め対策の崩壊リスクが高い。WHOへの通知推奨。

article.articleHeadline: "الصحة العالمية": إصابة عشرات عمال الصحة بإيبولا في الكونغو
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: Dozens of health workers infected with Ebola in the Congo
article.articleSummary: Dozens of health workers in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) have been infected with Ebola, with 75 healthcare workers affected and 17 deaths since the current outbreak began. Infections are believed to have occurred months before the May 15 first reporting of cases, indicating early exposure among medical staff in eastern DRC. WHO Emergency leadership, speaking via video from eastern DRC, warned of a heavy toll on the country’s health system. Ebola has killed more than 200 people in the DRC roughly a month into the outbreak. Africa CDC reports 202 deaths among 875 confirmed infections, a 23% case fatality rate. Wasam Mankola of Africa CDC emphasized that meticulous contact tracing remains a key concern in controlling the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関（WHO）：コンゴでエボラにより数十人の医療従事者が感染
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の確定症例875件、死亡202件という重大な公衆衛生影響を呈しており、医療従事者への感染拡大により管理可能性が低下している。IHR基準3項目以上に該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当する。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病の致死率23%は極めて高く、医療従事者75人の感染と17人の死亡は保健システムの機能障害を示唆している。WHOおよびAfrica CDCが直接言及しており、国際的な支援と関心が極めて高い状況。DRCは対象国リストに含まれている（ID: 203312）。

article.articleHeadline: Confirmado caso de raiva em morcego encontrado na Ilha da Torotama, em Rio Grande | Zona Sul
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Confirmed rabies case in a bat found on Torotama Island, in Rio Grande | South Zone.
article.articleSummary: Rabies virus confirmed in a bat found dead on Torotama Island, Rio Grande, South Zone, the municipality’s first positive case in 2026. The bat was found June 11; confirmation came June 18 from Lacen-RS. Fourteen other bats tested this year were negative; the last positive occurred in 2023 at Castelo Branco–Santa Rosa border. In response, Vigilância Ambiental em Saúde activated Ministry of Health protocols, intensifying epidemiological surveillance in Torotama, launching educational actions in schools and health units, and providing technical guidance to local veterinarians. Public guidance: avoid touching bats, whether alive or dead. Bats classified as nocturnal; daytime flight, ground sightings, or unusual behavior may indicate infection. Do not intervene with colonies or use chemicals; contact via WhatsApp (53) 3233-7289 for trained removal. In domestic animals, rabies causes neurological signs, coordination difficulties, paralysis, photophobia, altered vocalization, and appetite issues; ensure vaccination for dogs and cats and report any bat-related events.

triage.headline_ja: Rio Grandeで発見されたコウモリから狂犬病が確認 | South Zone
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル内の限定的な狂犬病動物感染事例。人への直接的な感染報告なく、疫学的監視と予防措置が実施されているため、現時点ではWATCHとして経過観察を推奨。
triage.notes: 狂犬病の動物での確認であり、人への感染報告なし。ただし潜在的なヒト暴露リスク（コウモリとの接触）と長期曝露の可能性がある。地域保健当局が適切な監視体制を構築しており、公共教育活動も展開中。続報監視により人への感染事例の有無を確認する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: El ébola podría estar transmitiéndose fuera del radar de la respuesta de las autoridades, indica la OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola could be spreading outside the authorities' response radar, says WHO.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri’s Bunia; declared May 15) has reached 896 confirmed cases and 232 deaths (case fatality 26%), with spread to North and South Kivu and across the border to Uganda (19 confirmed cases, two deaths). The Bundibugyo Ebola strain presents a 30–50% fatality rate and currently has no approved vaccine or specific treatment. Diagnostic and treatment capacity is increasing, improving care access and reducing confirmation delays, but community deaths indicate transmission may be occurring beyond the response radar, especially in displacement-affected areas. Access restrictions hinder operations in high-risk zones; contact tracing is 71% per government data, below the level needed to rapidly stop transmission. The WHO has deployed over 115 experts and delivered more than 110 metric tons of emergency supplies to frontline response. Transmission occurs via direct contact with bodily fluids and causes fever, vomiting, diarrhea, and internal bleeding.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱が当局の対応レーダーの外で拡大している可能性、WHO発表
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。エボラウイルス病の国境越え拡大とコミュニティでの未把握伝播は重大なシグナル。
triage.notes: 発生地域にUgandaが列挙されているが、記事サマリーではウガンダの確認症例数は19例で限定的であり、主要な発生地域はコンゴ民主共和国の東部（ブニア、イトゥリ州、北キヴ州、南キヴ州）。ウガンダは border spillover として言及されているため verified_locations には含めず、DRCのみを計上。コミュニティでの未追跡伝播、30-50%の致命率、有効なワクチン/治療法なし、接触者追跡率71%と不十分という複合的なリスク要因を考慮。

article.articleHeadline: Разведка США обнародовала документы по происхождению COVID-19
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: US intelligence released documents on the origin of COVID-19
article.articleSummary: US Office of the Director of National Intelligence released previously classified materials on the origins of COVID-19 and on former NIAID Director Anthony Fauci. In an official statement dated June 18, the intelligence community asserts the released documents and emails contain new information about US-funded coronavirus research at the Wuhan Institute of Virology in China, which is being examined as a possible source of a lab-associated outbreak that sparked the pandemic. The report alleges Fauci influenced IC assessments on the virus’s origin and helped push a natural-origin narrative, while also providing Congress with inaccurate information about contacts with US intelligence. DNI Tulsi Gabbard said the publication results from a lengthy declassification process, and that the public should have full information about pandemic events. Informants report that staff supporting the lab-origin position faced pressure and career risk; some materials were sent to the IC Inspector General for further study.

triage.headline_ja: 米国情報機関がCOVID-19の起源に関する文書を公開
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は2026年6月のCOVID-19起源論争に関する政治的文書公開の報道であり、新規の感染症イベント（発生件数、患者数、死亡例、新規患者発生など）を報告していない。歴史的・政治的な回顧分析である。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年時点の政治的・歴史的文書公開に関する報道であり、COVID-19パンデミックの新規発生イベントではない。過去のパンデミック起源に関する調査報告の公表であるため、感染症イベント探知の対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Dịch Ebola: Báo động số nhân viên y tế tử vong
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak: Alarm over the number of healthcare workers who have died.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda: more than 60 healthcare workers infected, 34 dead, highlighting the heightened risk faced by medical staff during treatment and containment. The Bundibugyo strain outbreak continues to unfold. In response, African leaders and international partners pledged to mobilize 910 million USD to bolster outbreak response, strengthen surveillance, accelerate early detection, and improve preparedness in affected and at-risk countries. The package includes 80 million USD from AU member states. The commitment was announced at the AU Ebola Summit chaired by Burundi President Evariste Ndayishimiye, AU chair. Mahmoud Ali Youssouf, AU Commission chair, urged stronger national and cross-border coordination to prevent cross-border spread, enhance surveillance capacity, and implement effective infection-control measures.

triage.headline_ja: エボラアウトブレイク：死亡した医療従事者数に対する警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全てに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラウイルス感染は高致死率で、医療従事者34名の死亡を含む60名以上の感染は重大。複数国での同時発生と国際的な資金動員が進行中。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは民主共和国コンゴとウガンダで発生と明記されているが、GeoNames IDで対応するのはコンゴ民主共和国のみ（203312）。ウガンダ（226074）はBluedot APIの発生地域には含まれるものの、対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。ブルンジ（433561）はAUサミット開催国として言及されているが、主要な発生地ではないため除外。Bundibugyo株の継続的な発生、医療従事者への高リスク、African Union主導の国際的資金動員（9.1億USD）により、シグナルとしての重要性が極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: WHO: Weiterhin schnelle Ausbreitung von Ebola im Kongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: Continued rapid spread of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of 19 June 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues to spread rapidly: 896 confirmed infections and 232 deaths; 21 new cases in the past 24 hours. Transmission occurs via direct contact with bodily fluids. The outbreak is driven by the Bundibugyo variant of Ebola, first identified in 2007, with no vaccine or targeted therapy available. The affected provinces are hard to reach due to years of armed conflict, notably Ituri province with Bunia as its capital. The WHO regards the situation as still serious and reports intensified containment efforts day by day. The organization declared a health emergency of international concern in mid-May. Statements from WHO Africa emergency chief Marie-Roseline Bélizaire underscore ongoing challenges in containment in this conflict-affected region.

triage.headline_ja: WHO: コンゴにおけるエボラの継続的な急速な拡大
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。また複数のWPRO基準に該当し、WHOが国際的保健上の緊急事態を宣言済みで、社会的・政治的関心が極めて高い。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス（ブンディブギョ型）の有効なワクチンや特異的治療薬が利用できない状況。武装紛争地帯であるイトゥリ州で医療アクセスが極めて限定的。WHOが5月中旬に国際的保健上の緊急事態を宣言済みで、現況報告は定期的に更新されている。フルRRA進行推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola v Konžskej demokratickej republike sa rýchlo šíri, varuje WHO
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola is spreading rapidly in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, WHO warns.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak intensifies in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. As of 19 June 2026, 896 confirmed cases and 232 deaths have been reported since the outbreak began on 15 May, with 21 new cases in the last 24 hours. The disease is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which there is no vaccine. More than 90% of cases occur in Ituri Province in the northeast, with spread to North Kivu and South Kivu. Health capacity is increasing: Ebola beds exceed 500 and laboratories are conducting over 2,000 tests per day. Contact tracing covers about 75% of identified contacts; WHO notes that at least 95% coverage is needed to curb transmission. Uganda reports 19 cases and 2 deaths, but has recorded no new cases in the past 12 days."

triage.headline_ja: エボラがコンゴ民主共和国で急速に拡大、WHOが警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。Bundibugyo ebolavirus感染症の確認例896件・死亡232件の急速な増加、国際拡大（ウガンダへの波及）、複数の医療危機指標が存在し、フルRRA進行が必須。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（対象国外）への波及も記載されているが、記事の主題はコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ集団発生。Bundibugyo ebolavirus株で、ワクチンなしの状況。接触者追跡カバー率が75%であり、WHOが必要とする95%達成に向けた対応強化が課題。

article.articleHeadline: Bill Gates mRNA Ebola Vaccine Grant Matches Deadly Outbreak in the Democratic Republic of The Congo (DRC). "Rare and Deadly Virus Strain"
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo’s Ituri Province was confirmed May 15, 2026, with the WHO declaring a Public Health Emergency of International Concern two days later. The outbreak, amid armed conflict and mass displacement, has hundreds of suspected cases and dozens of deaths. WHO notes there is no licensed vaccine or specific treatment for Bundibugyo Ebola. In January 2026, CEPI awarded 26.7 million USD to Moderna and Oxford University to develop a multivalent mRNA vaccine against several filoviruses, including Bundibugyo; Gates Foundation is a CEPI founding donor, fueling controversy over funding timing. Supporters say the grant targets outbreak preparedness; critics allege conflicts of interest. Separately, the FBI is investigating American virologist Vincent Munster for alleged smuggling of Congo pathogen samples into the United States; reports say he runs Ebola field sites and conducts gain-of-function work. In DRC, distrust grows as hospital tents are burned.

triage.headline_ja: ビル・ゲイツのmRNAエボラワクチン助成がコンゴ民主共和国の致命的な感染拡大と一致。「稀で致命的なウイルス株」
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の株、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHOが国際的懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）を宣言済み。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo Ebolavirus株による確認済み感染拡大。2026年5月15日にイトゥリ州で確認、5月17日にWHOがPHEIC宣言。武力紛争・大量避難民が背景にあり、対応の複雑性が高い。医療施設への信頼低下（テント焼き討ち）も報告。米国での病原体試料走私疑惑は二次的な政治的関心だが、記事の主題はDRC発生地における実際の感染拡大である。

article.articleHeadline: Россия передала тысячи тестов для диагностики вируса Эбола в ДРК
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Russia handed over thousands of tests for diagnosing the Ebola virus to the DRC.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-19, Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo has killed more than 230 people and infected over 900, with active outbreaks in Congo and neighboring Uganda and about 35,000 contacts under surveillance. Russia’s Rospotrebnadzor has donated thousands of diagnostic tests to the DRC. Russian scientists describe a real-time PCR–based testing system with claimed 100% sensitivity and specificity, produced on domestic equipment; seven thousand test systems have already been supplied to Africa, with additional requests from North Korea, Turkmenistan, and Tajikistan. The tests can use any biological material and even environmental samples, enabling rapid case identification and quarantine in the absence of a vaccine. The virus has reportedly mutated to the more contagious Bundibugyo strain. Japanese researchers warn Ebola could spread beyond Africa to Europe (Belgium, France) and may reach the UAE, Turkey, India, or Canada.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア、エボラウイルス診断用の数千検査キットをコンゴ民主共和国に提供
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス感染症は公衆衛生への深刻な影響（230人以上死亡、900人以上感染、約35,000人の接触者監視中）、異常性（Bundibugyo株への変異報告）、国際拡大リスク（ウガンダでの発生、ベルギー・フランス等への拡大警告）、渡航制限リスクを示しており、シグナルとして最優先対応が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーには複数国への拡大警告が含まれるが、対象国リストでの実際の発生地として確認できるのはDRCとインド。Belgium、France、Turkey、UAE、Canada、North Korea、Turkmenistan、Tajikistanは発生地域リストに含まれるが、サマリー上では「拡大の可能性」として言及されており、現在の発生地としては確認されない。ウガンダは隣国での活動中の発生が記載されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため除外。日本の研究者による警告報告あり。

article.articleHeadline: Paciente de Ebola de seis anos retirado de hospital na RD Congo está bem
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Six-year-old Ebola patient discharged from hospital in DR Congo is doing well.
article.articleSummary: Six-year-old Ebola patient discharged from an eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo hospital is doing well. The outbreak, concentrated in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu, has caused more than 230 deaths and nearly 900 confirmed cases. The child and her mother were abducted from an Ebola treatment unit in Butembo and later located; the girl's condition remains stable. Previous attacks on treatment sites underscore safety concerns amid ongoing transmission. The outbreak, declared May 15, is linked to a rare Bundibugyo Ebola strain for which the WHO says there is no vaccine, with months needed for development. Cross-border implications include Uganda reporting 19 confirmed cases, including two deaths, with no new cases since June 5. In DR Congo, the health ministry has reinforced surveillance, contact tracing, and treatment capacity. WHO has pledged about $3.9 million, and Africa CDC about $319 million to the response, as Ituri drives most infections.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国の病院から退院した6歳のエボラ患者は健康な状態である
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病による230人以上の死亡、約900件の確定患者数、Bundibugyo株のまれなひずみ、ウガンダへの国境を越えた拡大（19確定患者）を含む深刻な公衆衛生影響と国際的拡大リスク。
triage.notes: 2026年6月19日時点で、イツリ州、北キブ州、南キブ州を中心とした活動的なエボラアウトブレイク。ワクチン未開発のBundibugyo株による稀なアウトブレイク。ウガンダへの国境を越えた拡大確認（19確定患者）。WHOと Africa CDC による国際的支援体制が構築されている。治療施設への攻撃による患者逃亡事案も報告されており、治療継続と疫学監視に関する管理課題が存在。

article.articleHeadline: Повече от 70 медици са заразени с ебола
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 70 healthcare workers have been infected with Ebola.
article.articleSummary: 75 healthcare workers infected with Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo, 17 deaths, per a WHO official cited by Reuters. The outbreak spread months before it was publicly declared on May 15 by Congolese authorities, leaving many health workers exposed before awareness of the disease. PPE shortages, including gloves and masks, are reported at health facilities. 'This is a really high price the health system pays because we don't have enough health workers in DRC,' said Mari Rozlin Belizer, WHO's Emergency Director for Outbreaks, at a press briefing. The DRC already ranks among the world’s lowest for health workers per capita, about 11 per 10,000 people, highlighting strain on the health system as the outbreak continues as of 2026-06-19.

triage.headline_ja: 75人以上の医療従事者がエボラウイルスに感染
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当。エボラウイルスはWHO通知義務疾患であり、医療従事者への集中感染、死亡事例、PPE不足による継続的な曝露リスク、国際的な拡大懸念がある。
triage.notes: 2026年記事（将来日付）であるため、データの信憑性確認が必要。ただし、シグナル内容としてはエボラウイルスの医療従事者集中感染、死亡事例、PPE不足、WHO公式声明があり、全基準で懸念が高い。フルRRA実施推奨。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : près de 900 cas confirmés d'Ebola et 232 décès un mois après la déclaration de l'épidémie
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: nearly 900 confirmed Ebola cases and 232 deaths one month after the outbreak was declared.
article.articleSummary: As of June 19, 2026, one month after the outbreak was declared in the Democratic Republic of Congo, Ebola has 896 laboratory-confirmed cases and 232 deaths, with a case fatality rate around 26%. Data, presented by Health Minister Samuel Roger Kamba in Bunia (Ituri province, the epidemic's epicenter), come from lab-confirmed tests and were validated with national and international partners including the WHO and Africa CDC. Some deaths are identified retrospectively through field surveillance. Ituri continues to bear the majority of infections; authorities are strengthening epidemiological surveillance, case contact follow-up, and treatment capacity in affected areas. Communities are urged to promptly report suspected cases to improve survival and limit transmission amid a fragile health situation in eastern DRC.

triage.headline_ja: DRC: エボラ出血熱の流行宣言から1ヶ月で確認された症例数は約900件、死亡者数は232人
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の活動的な流行で、確認症例896件、死亡者232件（致命率26%）という深刻な公衆衛生上の影響があり、IHR基準では「深刻な影響」「国際的拡大リスク」「異常性」に該当。WPROスクリーニング基準では「重症度」「流行しやすさ」「管理可能性」に該当。国際機関（WHO、Africa CDC）の対応も確認され、フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は高い致命率と感染性を持つ病原体。DRCのイトゥリ州が流行の震源地。WHOとAfrica CDCが検査結果を検証済み。東部DRCの脆弱な保健状況が懸念される。一月間で症例・死亡者数が急速に増加している点も注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Epidémia eboly sa v KDR šíri rýchlo, a to aj napriek intenzívnym snahám o boj proti vírusu, konštatuje WHO
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola epidemic spreading rapidly in the DRC, despite intense efforts to combat the virus, says WHO.
article.articleSummary: WHO reports the Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is spreading rapidly, with 896 confirmed cases and 232 deaths since the outbreak was declared on May 15. The Ituri province remains the epicenter, accounting for about 90% of cases, with spread to South Kivu and North Kivu and into neighboring Uganda, which has reported 19 cases and 2 deaths. In the past 24 hours, 21 new cases were recorded. Ten patients have recovered. The response has scaled up with Ebola beds rising from zero to over 500; surveillance now reviews about 400 reports daily and conducts more than 2,000 tests per day. Contact tracing has reached 75% of known contacts; reaching 95% is considered essential. The virus is Bundibugyo variant, for which no approved vaccine or treatment exists.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ流行が急速に拡大、ウイルス対策の激しい取り組みにもかかわらず、とWHOが述べている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべて該当（深刻な健康被害、予想外の発生ペース、国際的拡大のリスク、渡航・貿易制限のリスク）。対象国DRCで進行中の大規模エボラアウトブレイク。
triage.notes: 記事では DRC 内での Ituri、South Kivu、North Kivu での発生と、隣接国ウガンダへの拡大が報告されている。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外した。Bundibugyo エボラウイルス変種で、承認されたワクチンまたは治療法が存在しないことが特に懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: AU high-level meeting mobilises US$910 million in pledges for Ebola
article.articleSummary: An AU-level emergency mobilised US$910 million in pledges to accelerate the Ebola Bundibugyo response in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, including US$80 million from African member states. Leaders endorsed rapid disbursement of the full US$518 million required for the Joint Continental Preparedness and Response Plan within four weeks, to fund surveillance, contact tracing, laboratory capacity, case management, infection prevention and control, risk communication, community engagement, logistics, medical countermeasures and cross-border coordination. Africa CDC highlighted continental responsibility for health security and rapid financing, while WHO reaffirmed support for surveillance, response, and health services resilience. If transmission remains unchecked, projected needs could rise to US$1.5 billion. Gaps persist in contact tracing, supply, health worker protection, safe and dignified burials, and access in insecure areas. At-risk countries were urged to finalise preparedness plans, strengthen screening, share data in real time, and avoid unwarranted travel restrictions.

triage.headline_ja: AU高級会議、エボラ対策に9億1,000万米ドルの誓約を動員
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常なエボラ発生、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも全て該当。国際的な資金動員と対応体制の整備が進行中の重要なシグナル。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCとウガンダでのエボラ・ブンディブギョの発生と対応について述べられている。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。国際的な資金動員（9.1億米ドルの誓約）と継続的なニーズ（最大1.5億米ドルの可能性）が指摘されており、世界的な健康安全保障上の重大な懸念。

article.articleHeadline: Prefeitura de São Raimundo Nonato combate à dengue, zika e chikungunya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: City Hall of São Raimundo Nonato fights Dengue, Zika and Chikungunya.
article.articleSummary: City Hall of São Raimundo Nonato, through the Municipal Health Secretariat, is intensifying prevention and control of Aedes aegypti, the vector of dengue, Zika, and chikungunya. Vector-control teams conduct home visits in diverse neighborhoods, offering guidance, identifying potential breeding sites, and implementing preventive measures to curb arbovirus transmission. Daily, health workers traverse communities, sharing information on eliminating breeding grounds and reinforcing the public’s role in this effort. The administration emphasizes that mosquito control is a shared responsibility, urging residents to keep yards clean, seal water tanks, and protect containers that can collect water. These ongoing actions aim to reduce risk and safeguard residents from dengue, Zika, and chikungunya.

triage.headline_ja: サンライムンド・ノナト市がデング熱、ジカ熱、チクングニヤ熱に対抗
triage.triage_reason: 公衆衛生上の深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限のリスクのいずれも明確ではなく、通常の媒介蚊対策プログラムの報告である。社会的・政治的関心も見当たらない。
triage.notes: ブラジルのピアウイ州サンライムンド・ノナト市による定常的な媒介蚊対策キャンペーンの報告。患者数、重症度、死亡例の言及がなく、進行中の通常の予防啓発活動である。WPROスクリーニング基準を満たす異常性や重大性の証拠がない。

article.articleHeadline: Multi-Country Ebola Disease Outbreak Caused By The Bundibugyo Virus Situation Report No. 5
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) caused by Bundibugyo virus (BVD) continues with sustained transmission in eastern provinces and epidemiologically linked cases in Uganda. With insecurity, displacement and high cross-border mobility, IOM supports preparedness and response at 110 points of entry (PoEs) and cross-border points of control (PoCs), disease surveillance, RCCE, IPC and community-based interventions along mobility corridors. On 16 June, IOM activated its Institutional Scale-Up Protocols for DRC and Uganda for three months to boost surge capacity and coordination. During the reporting period, 110 PoEs supported, 43 PoCs activated in the DRC, 1,050,933 health screenings at PoEs/PoCs, 556 frontline workers trained, and 7 simulation exercises conducted. No licensed vaccines or specific therapeutics are available; emphasis remains on early detection, cross-border coordination and IPC to interrupt transmission.

triage.headline_ja: ブンディブギョウイルスによる多国家エボラ出血熱アウトブレイク 状況報告書第5号
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。複数国での持続的な感染伝播、ワクチン・治療法不在、国境警備体制の強化が必要で、高い懸念を示す。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCでのエボラウイルス病（BVD型）の持続的伝播を主題としており、ウガンダは「疫学的関連ケース」として言及されているが、Bluedot APIの発生地域にウガンダ(226074)が含まれていても、verified_locationsには対象国リストにないため除外。DRCは対象国リストに含まれ(203312)、記事の主要な発生地。IOMによる制度的スケールアップ、110カ所の入国地点での対応、556人の最前線作業者訓練が実施されており、公式な多国間対応が展開中。

article.articleHeadline: Santé au travail : Congo Terminal sensibilise ses équipes à la prévention de la tuberculose
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Occupational health: Congo Terminal raises awareness among its teams about tuberculosis prevention.
article.articleSummary: On June 11, 2026, more than 700 Congo Terminal employees participated in a tuberculosis awareness campaign across operational sites and online. Led by Dr. Eléazar Massamba, the company's Medical Advisor, the sessions explained tuberculosis mechanisms, transmission, and health impacts, and emphasized daily preventive practices. The initiative highlighted the importance of early diagnosis and rapid treatment to limit spread, reflecting a proactive occupational health approach. Aristide NDJAWE, Congo Terminal's Human Resources Director, stated that prevention and information are key allies in the fight against TB, helping create a safer, healthier workplace. The program aims to reduce contamination, break taboos, and encourage care-seeking, positioning health awareness as a core pillar of the company's social policy.

triage.headline_ja: 職場衛生：コンゴ・ターミナル社員向けの結核予防啓発活動
triage.triage_reason: 本イベントは企業内の予防啓発キャンペーンであり、既存の感染症流行や公衆衛生上の急性クライシスではない。結核そのものの新規発生、異常な増加、または国際的な拡大リスクを示唆する情報がない。
triage.notes: 本記事は結核という疾患名で検出されたが、実際の内容は企業（コンゴ・ターミナル）が従業員向けに実施した予防啓発セミナーの報告である。発生地域はDRCと示されており、記事サマリーでもコンゴ国内での企業活動として確認される。ただし、これは感染症流行のシグナルではなく、職場衛生施策の報道であるため、シグナルトリアージの対象外と判定される。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RD Congo : une épidémie sans vaccin, des groupes armés et une défiance populaire
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: an outbreak without a vaccine, armed groups and public distrust.
article.articleSummary: Ebola re-emerged mid-May in the tri-border area of the Democratic Republic of Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan, with no vaccine available for this outbreak. Armed groups and public distrust hinder access to affected communities, complicating containment efforts as health authorities race to respond. In DR Congo, Mamadou Kaba Barry, head of ALIMA's mission in the DRC, provides details on the response. The cross-border location raises concerns about regional spread and rapid containment. ALIMA and local health teams are coordinating surveillance, case finding, and treatment under challenging security conditions to curb transmission, protect vulnerable populations, and emphasize community engagement and risk communication amid suspicion and insecurity.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：ワクチンなしの流行、武装勢力と国民の不信
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の流行、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。また多剤耐性がなく管理可能だが、ワクチン不在、武装勢力による障害、国民不信等により対応が複雑化している。三国境地域での発生であり、地域的関心と国際支援ニーズが高い。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはウガンダ（226074）とスーダン（366755）が含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題はDRC（コンゴ民主共和国）でのエボラ再出現である。ウガンダとスーダンは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを記載。三国境地域での発生であることが強調されており、地域的拡大リスクが高い。ワクチン不在、武装勢力による制約、国民不信が対応の複雑化要因。

article.articleHeadline: OMS: Van más de 70 profesionales médicos del Congo contagiados ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: More than 70 medical professionals in Congo infected with Ebola.
article.articleSummary: As of June 19, 2026, the World Health Organization reports that in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, 75 health-care professionals have been infected with Ebola and 17 have died since the current outbreak began. Ebola circulated for months before the official declaration on May 15, exposing many clinicians to risk prior to recognition. The health system is strained, with shortages of basic protective equipment such as gloves and masks. The DRC has one of the lowest health worker densities, about 11 per 10,000 people. China and Uganda are sending medical teams to assist. WHO is providing psychological support to doctors who fear treating patients after witnessing colleagues fall ill, underscoring the heavy toll on frontline staff amid ongoing transmission and PPE scarcities.

triage.headline_ja: WHO: コンゴで70人以上の医療専門家がエボラに感染
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度・流行しやすさ・管理可能性で該当。エボラウイルス病は重篤度が高く、国際支援が既に実施中。
triage.notes: DRC内でのエボラ感染報告が主要な事象。Bluedot APIが付与したUgandaおよびChinaは医療チーム派遣国として記事に言及されているが、エボラ発生地域ではないため verified_locations から除外した。DRC対象国リストに含まれるため pickup対象。医療従事者75名感染、17名死亡という深刻度、長期曝露（5月15日公式宣言前から数か月流行）、PPE不足による管理困難性が指摘されており、WPRoスクリーニング基準5つすべてに該当。

article.articleHeadline: Nipah: three under observation at MCH discharged
article.articleSummary: Nipah virus containment update from Kozhikode, Kerala (2026-06-19). Three persons under Nipah observation at Government Medical College Hospital (MCH) Kozhikode were discharged. All 14 contacts who previously exhibited symptoms tested negative. A sample from a healthcare worker under observation at a private hospital was collected for testing. The Nipah patient remains on ventilator support at MCH. In total, 104 people remain under monitoring, with no new additions to the contact list. House-to-house surveillance covered 56 more homes in Ward V of Ramanattukara municipality. The District Control Room logged 88 public enquiries and stayed in contact with those monitored; the District Mental Health Programme extended psychological support to 118 persons. A seven-member National Joint Outbreak Response Team (NJORT), led by Rameshwar Sorokhaibam (NCDC), arrived to bolster containment and met with District Collector M.S. Madhavikutty.

triage.headline_ja: ニパウイルス：MCHで観察下にあった3人が退院
triage.triage_reason: ニパウイルスの発生は重症度が高く異常であるが、現在の記事は患者退院と接触者陰性化という改善傾向を報じており、新規患者発生報告がない。さらなる情報と経過の監視が必要。
triage.notes: ニパウイルスはIHR基準2項目以上該当し、WPRO基準5項目全て該当する高リスク病原体。現在の報道は患者の臨床的改善を示唆しているが、患者が依然として人工呼吸器管理中であり、接触者追跡が継続中（104名監視中）。国家級の対応チーム（NJORT）が展開されており政府の懸念は高い。PICKUP基準は満たすが、現時点の報道では新規患者の急増がないため、WATCH段階での継続監視が適切と判断。

article.articleHeadline: ‫ الكونغو الديمقراطية.. إصابة 75 من العاملين بالمجال الطبي بـ"إيبولا"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo: 75 health workers infected with Ebola.
article.articleSummary: As of 19 June 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 75 health workers infected with Ebola in the current outbreak, with 17 fatalities among them. WHO Emergency Director Marie-Roseline Belizier highlighted the heavy toll on an already strained health system, noting the country has about 11 healthcare workers per 10,000 people. International support is underway, with China and Uganda dispatching medical teams. The WHO is also providing psychological support to frontline staff wary of treating patients after several colleagues were infected. Officials believe the outbreak spread months before the first cases were publicly announced on 15 May, suggesting widespread earlier exposure among medical personnel. The situation underscores ongoing risks to health workers and the need to bolster health workforce capacity in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：75人の医療従事者がエボラに感染
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当し、医療従事者への深刻な影響と国際的支援が確認されている。WPRO基準も複数該当し、公衆衛生上の重大事象として即座にフルRRA対象とすべき。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、エボラ感染が主にDRC で発生しており、医療従事者75人の感染と17人の死亡が確認されている。China は医療チーム派遣による支援国として記載されているため、実際の発生地はDRC のみだが、国際的関与の観点からChinaを verified_locations に含める。Uganda は医療チーム派遣国として言及されるが、対象国リストに含まれないため除外。本イベントは全IHR基準及び全WPRO基準に該当する最高リスク事象。

article.articleHeadline: Pulgas, carrapatos, verminoses e infecções: os riscos invisíveis que ameaçam a saúde dos cães de estimação
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fleas, ticks, worm infections and infections: the invisible risks that threaten the health of pet dogs.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-19, across various regions of the country, domestic dogs face invisible health risks from fleas, ticks, myiasis (fly larvae infestation), and internal worms. The article notes that prevention is key, as many problems begin subtly and worsen without care. Major conditions include myiasis in wounds and skin folds, ectoparasite infestations causing intense itching and dermatitis, anemia from blood loss or parasite destruction, and diseases transmitted by parasites. Internal worms can trigger diarrhea, weight loss, abdominal distension, and stunted growth. Factors such as warm, humid climates, organic debris, unsanitary environments, and lack of regular parasite control raise risk. Diagnosis combines clinical examination with lab tests like full blood counts and serologies. Prevention emphasizes correct use of antiparasitics, cleaning of yards and objects, regular deworming, and routine veterinary visits to detect early changes. Obesity in dogs is highlighted as a health condition linked to diet and activity, influencing overall wellbeing.

triage.headline_ja: ノミ、ダニ、寄生虫感染症および感染症：ペット犬の健康を脅かす見えないリスク
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はペット犬における一般的な寄生虫疾患（ノミ、ダニ、ウジ症など）の予防啓発記事であり、新規の感染症アウトブレイク、異常事象、または公衆衛生上の重大な危機を示唆していない。動物の一般的な健康リスク教育の範疇である。
triage.notes: 本記事はペット向けの一般的な健康予防啓発コンテンツであり、新規発生、アウトブレイク、異常な流行を報告していない。感染症危機管理の対象外。なお、Tumbu Flyはコクメリオミイエ属の人獣共通のウジ症病原体だが、本記事では特定の患者集団や異常な流行の報告がなく、ルーチンな予防啓発に留まっている。

article.articleHeadline: 剛果難民營爆30死疑伊波拉肆虐　居民拒檢恐釀大流行 - 民視新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 30 Dead in DR Congo Refugee Camp, Suspected Ebola Ravaging the Camp; Residents Refuse Testing, Fear a Pandemic
article.articleSummary: At the Kigonze refugee camp in Bunia, northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, at least 30 people have died since early May from fever, vomiting and other symptoms consistent with Ebola. Residents and families strongly refuse screening, hindering confirmation as five samples have been collected and await laboratory results. The situation highlights a collapsing health system: United Nations data show 2025 funding for water, sanitation and hygiene was slashed by more than half; Mercy Corps reports USAID-funded health programs were scaled back after budget cuts, reducing beneficiaries from about 120,000 to under 19,000, while sanitation facilities are severely lacking and often overflowing. In this overcrowded setting, more than 5 million displaced people in eastern Congo face a heightened risk of a widespread Ebola transmission.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国の難民キャンプで30人が死亡、エボラ出血熱の疑い；住民が検査を拒否、パンデミックの懸念
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）。エボラ出血熱の疑い、30人の死亡、検査拒否、過密な難民キャンプ環境、520万人の変位民という極めて重大なシグナル。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱の強い疑い（5検体採取済みで検査待機中）。Kigonzeキャンプでの発症は5月初旬から、現在30人死亡報告。住民の検査拒否が対応を困難にしている。保健システムの崩壊（資金削減、USAID支援削減）と過密環境（520万人の変位民）が大流行リスクを高める。DRCは対象国リストに含まれる（ID:203312）。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola može da ostane skrivena u mozgu godinama: Nova studija otkriva kako se virus ponovo aktivira u organizmu preživelih
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola can remain hidden in the brain for years: A new study reveals how the virus reactivates in the bodies of survivors.
article.articleSummary: As of 19 June 2026, Ebola can persist in brain tissue and reactivate months to years after recovery, potentially fueling new outbreaks. A Nature Microbiology study using lab-grown 'mini-brains' shows Ebola infecting brain cells, including astrocytes and microglia, with immunological defenses failing to fully clear the virus, indicating mechanisms for long-term persistence. Researchers also detected defective viral genomes in later infection stages, suggesting the virus may survive in altered, weakened forms, with some mutations potentially reducing replication under standard conditions. The findings may relate to survivor complications such as inflammatory conditions of the eyes, meningitis, or other central nervous system issues. The study highlights lesser-studied filoviruses—Reston, Tai Forest, Bombali, Bundibugyo—and comes amid new Ebola cases in Africa, with hundreds infected and nearly 200 deaths in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and spread to Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: エボラは脳に数年間潜伏する可能性：新研究が生存者の体内でウイルスが再活性化する仕組みを明らかに
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の再活性化メカニズム、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限の可能性）。進行中のDRC・ウガンダでの新規感染と新知見の組み合わせがシグナルとなる。

verified_locations.name: Uganda (注：Republic of Uganda はWPRO対象国リストに直接含まれていないが、DRCでの進行中の流行に付随する地域として記事主題に含まれる)

triage.notes: 記事は学術研究の発表（Nature Microbiology）と同時にDRC・ウガンダでの進行中の流行（数百人感染、約200人死亡）を報じている。脳内長期潜伏メカニズムの証明は再活性化リスク増加を示唆し、既存感染制御の有効性に新たな課題を呈示する。対象国リストではウガンダが明示されていないため、記事の主要焦点であるDRCのみを verified_locations に含める。ただし、ウガンダへの拡大記述も記事本体で確認され、地域的な流行の広がりを示唆している。

article.articleHeadline: DC Kohima issues African Swine Fever containment order
article.articleSummary: African Swine Fever outbreak in Kohima district, Nagaland, India, with an infected zone around T Khel Model village, Khikha colony, and Thizama village within 1 km, and a 10 km surveillance zone. Lab-confirmed on June 11, 2026, by the Office of the Chief Veterinary Officer, Department of Animal Husbandry and Veterinary Services. A complete ban on import, export, and movement of live pigs and pork products within, into, or out of the zones, and closure of all pork markets and butchery shops in the designated areas until further notice. Pig farmers are told to restrict visitors, disinfect premises, and report unusual illness or deaths; the public urged to report suspected pig deaths and avoid meat from unknown sources. Carcasses must be disposed of by safe burial per official protocols; dumping in open areas or water bodies is prohibited. Violators face action under the Prevention and Control of Infectious and Contagious Diseases in Animals Act, 2009.

triage.headline_ja: コヒマ地区がアフリカ豚熱の封じ込め命令を発令
triage.triage_reason: アフリカ豚熱（ASF）は家畜疾患であり、公衆衛生への直接的な深刻な影響は限定的だが、畜産業および地域経済への顕著なリスクがある。情報確度は高いものの、人間への感染リスクや国際的拡大の可能性について明確な記載がなく、フルRRA前の続報監視が適切。
triage.notes: ASFは家畜疾患（豚）であり、人間への感染例は報告されていない。しかし、記事に家畜の感染確認、製品流通制限、大規模な移動禁止措置が述べられており、地域畜産業および貿易への実質的な影響がある。IHR基準では2つ該当（異常性と貿易制限リスク）。WPRO基準では4つ該当。ただし公衆衛生への深刻な影響（人間への死亡・重症例等）は記載されていないため、WATCH判定とした。ASFは家畜間での伝播力が高く、南アジア地域での拡大監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: El brote de ébola en el Congo se convierte en el más mortal de la historia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in Congo becomes the deadliest in history.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreaks in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri Province) and neighboring Uganda as of 19 June 2026 have become the deadliest, with about 800 laboratory-confirmed cases and 74 recoveries reported across the region. Unlike past Congo outbreaks driven by Zaire ebolavirus, which has vaccines, this outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo, a rarer strain with no approved vaccines or therapies. The outbreak is concentrated in Ituri, accounting for over 90% of cases, with spillover into North and South Kivu provinces and 19 confirmed cases and 2 deaths in Uganda. Contact tracing remains severely challenged by insecurity and displacement, including nearly one million people uprooted. Only around 4,000 of an estimated 17,000–35,000 contacts have been traced. Experimental treatments, including monoclonal antibodies, are under evaluation. Funding shortfalls persist: nearly $1 billion pledged but only $90 million disbursed; Africa CDC notes 540 responders are needed but 84 are deployed.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのエボラ流行が史上最も致命的となる
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外なBundibugyo株、国際的拡大とウガンダへの波及、隔離措置のリスク）。WPRO基準でも5つ全て該当。エボラ出血熱という高致命性病原体の歴史的規模のアウトブレイクであり、フルRRA評価を要する。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRC（Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu各州）とウガンダでの発生を記載。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。Bundibugyo ebolavirus という稀なワクチン未承認株による史上最大規模のアウトブレイク（約800確定例、74回復例）、資金不足、接触者追跡不十分、国内避難民約100万人という深刻な管理上の制約が存在する。

article.articleHeadline: At least 30 deaths at Congo camp show Ebola could be spreading fast
article.articleSummary: At least 30 people have died since early May in Kigonze camp, Bunia, in northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo, raising fears Ebola is spreading quickly among displaced residents (over 15,000). Reported Ebola-like symptoms include headaches, fever, and vomiting; residents and relatives have refused testing for the living or the dead. Five victims’ samples have been collected and await laboratory confirmation. Ten burials occurred this week; the camp previously averaged 1–3 deaths per month. The outbreak was officially declared on May 15, with concerns about undetected transmission across eastern Congo’s displacement camps that hold more than 5 million people in Ituri province. Sanitation is severely constrained by overflowing latrines and crowded tents. Funding cuts to WASH programs have hampered response efforts, while another camp in Ituri has Ebola deaths and accounts for the majority of the province’s nearly 900 confirmed cases.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ難民キャンプでの30人以上の死亡がエボラの急速な拡大の可能性を示唆
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準を4項目すべて満たす。エボラウイルス病の確認事例と疑い事例が複数地域で発生しており、深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、および渡航制限のリスクが認められる。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病は国際保健規則(IHR 2005)で常に報告対象である。本事例は難民キャンプという極めて脆弱な集団での発生であり、500万人以上の難民が集中する東部コンゴの複数キャンプへの感染拡大リスク、および衛生インフラの崩壊(WASH資金削減)により対応能力が著しく限定されている。ただし5件のサンプル採取は確認されているが、まだ検査確認待ちの状態であることに留意。フルRRA実施が不可欠。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Outbreak Spreads In DR Congo And Uganda As Cases Hit 894, Deaths Reach 204
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda continues, with 894 cases and 204 deaths; 74 recovered since the May 15 declaration. Uganda has 19 cases and 2 deaths (7 recoveries), with all contacts listed in a Kampala health zone. Ituri Province in the DRC is the hotspot with 91 confirmed cases and about 78% of deaths. Insecurity in North Kivu hampers access, surveillance, and contact tracing. The outbreak now spans 32 health zones in both countries, up from 11 by late May, with a 38% rise in the latest period. Contact tracing remains far below targets: around 6,000 contacts listed (roughly 20% of the 17,000–35,000 expected daily) and about 4,000 actively followed (<15% capacity). With no approved vaccines or treatments for the Sudan strain, containment relies on early detection, tracing, and community monitoring. Africa CDC declared a continental public health emergency on May 18.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行がコンゴ民主共和国とウガンダで拡大、症例894件、死亡者204人に達する
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常・予想外、国際的拡大、渡航制限のリスク）し、WPROスクリーニング基準も全て該当。Africa CDCが大陸規模の公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言している重大事象。
triage.notes: DRCとウガンダにおけるエボラ出血熱（スーダン株）の現在進行中の大規模流行。894症例、204死亡（症例致命率23%）。接触者追跡が目標の15%以下の能力に留まり、感染拡大の抑制困難な状況。アフリカCDCが大陸規模の公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言済み。ウガンダも患者を有する二国間流行だが、記事の主要焦点はDRCの流行拡大。verified_locationsはDRCのみとしたが、ウガンダ（対象国外）でも患者が存在する点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: 'Serious and spreading very fast': WHO on Ebola outbreak in DR Congo
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak caused by the Bundibugyo strain is spreading rapidly, with Ituri province accounting for over 90% of cases and transmission reaching North Kivu and South Kivu. Declared May 15, the outbreak remains serious and evolving quickly; Bunia is the epicenter. Transmission is believed to have circulated undetected before declaration. The Bundibugyo strain currently has no vaccine or specific treatment. As of now, 896 confirmed cases and 232 deaths, with 78 recoveries and 21 new cases in the last 24 hours. Contact tracing covers about 75% of known contacts; the target is 95%. Treatment capacity has grown from zero beds to more than 500. Delays in seeking care—often from traditional healers or staying home—complicate response amid conflict-affected access.

triage.headline_ja: 「深刻で非常に速く拡大している」DRコンゴのエボラ流行についてのWHO声明
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）、WPRO基準5項目全て該当。確認症例896、死亡232、Bundibugyo株で治療法・ワクチン不在。緊急の国際対応が必要。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株による大規模エボラ流行。5月15日宣言、現在896確認症例・232死亡。Ituri州が90%以上の症例を占め、Bunia市が震源地。North Kivu・South Kivu州への拡大も確認。ワクチン・特異的治療なし。紛争地域での接触追跡率75%（目標95%）。急速な拡大傾向で高リスク。
