article.articleHeadline: WHO: Od ebole umrlo 17 zdravstvenih djelatnika, zaraženo ih je najmanje 75
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: 17 healthcare workers have died from Ebola; at least 75 have been infected.
article.articleSummary: Large-scale Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda. By June 2026, the outbreak has 896 confirmed cases and 232 deaths. Health-care workers are heavily affected: 75 infected and 17 died. WHO notes it is often unclear whether infections occurred at work or in private life. Efforts to protect staff include supplying PPE (gloves and protective suits) and expanding staff training, but only four of 177 health facilities initially had adequate capacity and equipment. A key challenge is that only about 10% of Ebola patients present with classical bleeding symptoms, leading many to stay home and delaying treatment, increasing transmission within families and smaller health facilities. One month after outbreak declaration, the situation remains serious with ongoing transmission and laboratory-confirmed cases, per WHO reporting from Bunia, with ongoing support to frontline facilities.

triage.headline_ja: WHO：エボラ熱で17人の医療従事者が死亡、少なくとも75人が感染
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。大規模エボラ出血熱の流行（896確認症例、232死亡）、医療従事者への重大な影響、国際的拡大（DRC・ウガンダ）、渡航・貿易制限リスク。フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: DRCはGeoNames ID 203312で対象国リストに含まれるが、記事サマリーはDRCとウガンダでの発生を述べている。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため、DRCのみが検証対象となるべきだが、記事の主たる焦点がDRC（Bunia地域）にあることから、DRC対象外の対象国リストでの評価となる。ただし対象国外のため verified_locations は空配列とする。ただし、本イベントは世界的に極めて重大な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、IHR・WPROスクリーニング基準の観点からは明確にPICKUPレベルの判定に値する。

article.articleHeadline: 75 من العاملين الصحيين في ​الكونغو الديمقراطية أصيبوا بـ"إيبولا"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 75 healthcare workers in the Democratic Republic of the Congo were infected with Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo persists; as of 2026-06-19, the Red Cross warns it has not peaked and containment could take up to a year. This is the 17th Ebola outbreak in DRC, driven by Bundibugyo virus, for which there are no approved vaccines or treatments. Transmission centers in the northeast across Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu, with 875 confirmed cases and 202 deaths (case fatality about 23%) reported by Africa CDC. Health workers bear a heavy toll: 75 infected, 17 of whom have died since the outbreak began in mid-May (announced May 15). Ongoing security conflicts and displacements hinder contact tracing and response, with only limited healthcare staff available (11 per 10,000 people). Cross-border spillover into Uganda has produced 19 cases and 2 deaths, mostly Congolese travelers. China and Uganda have dispatched medical teams; WHO provides mental health support amid PPE shortages.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国の医療従事者75人がエボラウイルスに感染
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当。エボラ出血熱は深刻な公衆衛生上の影響を示し、進行中の流行で国際的拡大（ウガンダへの越境感染）がある。医療従事者への感染が多発しており、異常かつ予想外の急速な拡大状況。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが付与した発生地域にUgandaとChinaが含まれているが、記事サマリーでは越境感染例がウガンダに限定されており、主要な流行地はDRCのみ。中国とウガンダは医療支援を派遣しているが、発生国ではない。したがってverified_locationsはDRCのみとした。Bundibugyo virus（ワクチン・治療法なし）による第17次流行であり、セキュリティ上の制約下での対応が困難な状況で、シグナルの優先度は最高。

article.articleHeadline: Αφθώδης πυρετός: Η προσοχή τώρα στην ελεύθερη Αμμόχωστο και τους αρνητές εμβολίων
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Aphthous fever: Attention now turns to Free Famagusta and the vaccine deniers.
article.articleSummary: Foot-and-mouth disease (aphthous fever) in Cyprus: following a positive Pachna case, all Limassol samples and the 3-km surrounding zone were negative, leaving Pachna’s 66-strong goat/sheep unit as the first and only Limassol case. Nationwide surveillance shifts to a phase of epidemiological monitoring, starting in Free Famagusta due to proximity to the Larnaca-infected area. About 10% of Cyprus’ herds remain unvaccinated, mainly farms in Paphos and Limassol where vaccines were unavailable, and other units whose owners refuse vaccination; authorities aim for 100% coverage. Ongoing births of animals in the last two months without vaccination highlight supply and compliance challenges. Vaccine demand rises globally (China and neighboring regions such as Israel and Greece). Greece sought Cyprus input on vaccination strategy after its Lesbos outbreak; Israel said Cyprus is performing comparatively well but vaccines remain essential. Infected units total 121; slaughtered: 2,293 cattle (3.5%), 43,311 small ruminants (9.5%), 23,742 pigs (7.7%). As of 2026-06-19.

triage.headline_ja: 口蹄疫：注目は今、自由ファマグスタとワクチン拒否者に向かう
triage.triage_reason: 口蹄疫はキプロスで発生している動物疾患であり、対象国（東南アジア、南アジア、アフリカ、ブラジル）に該当する国での発生ではない。影響は動物に限定され、ヒト感染症ではなく、IHRやWPRO基準の該当性が低い。
triage.notes: 記事の発生地はキプロス、イスラエル、ギリシャ、中国であり、いずれも対象国リスト（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）に含まれていない。Chinaは対象国に含まれるが、サマリー上で中国は「グローバルなワクチン需要の増加」の文脈のみで言及され、実際の口蹄疫発生地ではない。本イベントは対象地域外の動物疾患であるため、トリアージ対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Роспотребнадзор передал Уганде, Конго и ДРК 7 тыс. тестов для диагностики Эболы
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rospotrebnadzor handed over 7,000 Ebola diagnostic tests to Uganda, the Republic of the Congo, and the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: as of 2026-06-19, Rospotrebnadzor handed over 7,000 Ebola diagnostic test systems for PCR detection of Bundibugyo ebolavirus to the Democratic Republic of the Congo, the Republic of Congo, and Uganda, in response to a new outbreak threat in DRC and Uganda. The capacity was developed in four days and validated by domestic and local clinicians in outbreak settings. Additional requests followed, with kits sent to North Korea and Turkmenistan; Tajikistan also requested. Concurrently, Russian specialists are training over 20 Ugandan nationals in outbreak response and diagnostic laboratory techniques, while continuing anti-epidemic support. The tests claim high diagnostic accuracy, including environmental detection, underscoring rapid frontline tooling against Ebola.

triage.headline_ja: ロスポトレブナゾル、ウガンダ、コンゴ、DRCにエボラ診断検査7000本を引き渡し
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの新たな発生の脅威がDRCとウガンダで報告されており、IHR基準の「異常性・予想外性」と「国際的拡大リスク」に該当。重篤度の高い感染症であり、複数国への支援が展開されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで明確に述べられているのはDRCおよびウガンダにおける新たなエボラ発生の脅威です。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations にはDRCのみ含めます。北朝鮮、トルクメニスタン、タジキスタンへの検査キット供給は記載されていますが、これらは対象国ではなく、また記事の主題は「DRCとウガンダでの発生脅威への対応」であるため除外しています。Bundibugyo ebolavirus株に対する診断検査の展開であり、国際的な支援体制が構築されている点が重要です。

article.articleHeadline: SMS de Feira de Santana promove atualização sobre manejo clínico da chikungunya para profissionais da rede municipal de saúde
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Feira de Santana Municipal Health Secretariat provides an update on the clinical management of Chikungunya for professionals in the municipal health network.
article.articleSummary: Feira de Santana's Municipal Health Secretariat (SMS), through the Epidemiological Control Surveillance unit, conducted on 18 June 2026 an update on chikungunya clinical management for doctors and nurses of the municipal health network, at the Unex auditorium. Led by infectious disease specialist Melissa Falcão, the session covered diagnosis, treatment, and clinical follow-up, with updated protocols for local cases. It addressed identification of key chikungunya symptoms, management across different disease phases, monitoring criteria, and steps to reduce complications. The initiative aims to keep teams aligned with the latest technical guidelines and strengthen patient care in Feira de Santana. This effort is part of municipal strategies to bolster technical capacity and service quality in the public health network. Chikungunya is an arbovirus transmitted by Aedes aegypti, causing fever, myalgias, and arthralgia, which can persist; Verena Leal emphasized ongoing professional education.

triage.headline_ja: フェイラ・デ・サンタナ市保健局がチクングニヤの臨床管理に関する更新情報を市立保健ネットワークの医療専門家に提供
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は新規の感染症イベント報告ではなく、既発生事例への医療従事者向けの臨床研修開催の告知である。IHR基準・WPRO基準の該当なし、社会的関心も限定的。
triage.notes: 記事の主旨は、既知のチクングニヤ感染症に対応するための市レベルの医療職向け研修プログラムの実施報告である。新規事例報告、急速な流行拡大、異常な重症化などの警告信号は含まれていない。ブラジルはWPRO対象国リストに含まれていないが、記事サマリーが南米での医療教育イベントであり、シグナルトリアージ対象外のため判定に影響しない。

article.articleHeadline: A betegek 90%-ával végezhet a rettegett Marburg-vírus: mentőövet dobott a WHO
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The dreaded Marburg virus could kill 90% of patients: WHO has thrown a lifeline.
article.articleSummary: Marburg virus, a filovirus related to Ebola, among the world’s deadliest pathogens with case fatality rates cited at 25% to 90%, is the focus of a new WHO clinical guideline issued on 2026-06-19. The guidance also covers Ebola outbreaks caused by Bundibugyo virus in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Sudan virus, reflecting ongoing regional activity in Africa. Because there are no licensed vaccines or specific antiviral drugs for these agents, early and comprehensive treatment remains the best survival chance. The 16-point package for frontline workers emphasizes aggressive management to prevent infection‑related shock, including mandatory IV fluids and vasopressors with continuous vital signs monitoring. It also promotes rapid screening for metabolic disturbances (e.g., hypoglycemia) and laboratory confirmation to address emergencies. Post-recovery follow-up is mandated due to viral persistence and risk of hidden foci, with concerns that filoviruses drive more domestic hospital visits than COVID-19.

triage.headline_ja: 恐れられるマールブルグウイルスは患者の90%を殺す可能性がある：WHOが救命綱を投げた
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外の高い致死率、アフリカでの地域的拡大リスク、国際的な関心）、WPRO基準でも4項目該当（重症度の高さ、長期曝露リスク、ヒト-ヒト感染性、管理困難性）。WHO臨床ガイドラインの発出という国際的な公式対応が実施されている。
triage.notes: マールブルグウイルス、エボラ、スーダンウイルスの3つの高危険病原体に関する記事。記事サマリーではDRC（Bundibugyo virus由来エボラアウトブレイク）とスーダン（Sudan virusの言及）が明記されているが、スーダンは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations にはDRCのみを記載。WHOが2026年6月19日に臨床ガイドラインを発出した事実により、国際的対応が既に開始されており、緊急性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: WHO Says 75 Health Workers Infected in DR Congo Ebola Outbreak
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has infected 75 health workers, with 17 deaths among them, according to the WHO on 2026-06-19. The toll highlights the severe strain on an already stretched healthcare system facing staff shortages. Some infections may reflect exposures before the outbreak was officially confirmed on May 15, suggesting Ebola had been spreading undetected for months. WHO is providing psychological support to medical personnel anxious about treating infected patients as frontline workers continue to face transmission risks. The report underscores the ongoing nature of the outbreak in the DRC and the critical need for infection prevention measures, adequate staffing, and sustained support for frontline responders.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ感染症流行で75人の医療従事者が感染したと発表
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5つすべてに該当。エボラは国際的に高リスクな病原体であり、医療従事者への感染確認、複数の死亡、長期間の未検出拡大が確認されており、フルRRAが必須。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス感染症は高リスク病原体。医療従事者への感染拡大、17名の死亡、5月15日公式確認前からの数ヶ月間にわたる未検出拡大が記載されている。医療システムへの深刻な負荷と国際支援の必要性が明確。WHOによるリアルタイムの情報発信あり。

article.articleHeadline: Έμπολα: Ασθενείς δραπετεύουν από κέντρα θεραπείας στο Κονγκό για να βρουν φαγητό
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Patients escape from treatment centers in Congo to find food.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo’s eastern region, centered in Mongbwalu, Ituri Province, sees escalating food insecurity driving outbreak dynamics. More than 150 patients and suspected cases have fled treatment and isolation centers since late May to seek food, highlighting hunger as a key barrier to containment. The outbreak has infected nearly 900 people and caused deaths in more than a quarter of cases. Roughly 6,400 individuals who may have been exposed are under surveillance. Ituri accounts for over 90% of confirmed infections. The region’s ongoing displacement, armed conflict, and one of the world’s worst food crises compound surveillance and isolation efforts. The World Food Programme has started providing hot meals at treatment centers and food parcels to patients, contacts, and affected families, distributing 590 hot meals in a single day. Hunger-driven departures mirror patterns from past outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：コンゴの治療センターから患者が脱出し食料を求める
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当し、社会的・政治的関心が高い。フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーより、イトゥリ州マングブワルを中心としたコンゴ民主共和国東部でのエボラ流行。患者の食料不安による治療センター離脱（150人以上）は収容率を著しく低下させ、接触者追跡を困難にしている。約900人の感染、致死率25%超、6,400人の曝露者監視中という深刻な状況。武力紛争と食糧危機が対応を複雑化させている。WFPが介入を開始しており、国際的関心が高い。

article.articleHeadline: DBD Ancam Semua Kelompok Usia, Jakarta Sudah Catat 5.700 Kasus Tahun Ini
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue Fever Threatens All Age Groups; Jakarta Has Already Recorded 5,700 Cases This Year.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever (DBD) remains a major threat in Jakarta, Indonesia, with 5,700 laboratory-confirmed cases reported in DKI Jakarta as of 15 June 2026. Authorities stress prevention through 3M Plus (mosquito control, education, and early protection) and vaccination where appropriate, under the National Dengue Control Strategy and upcoming National Action Plan. The public education event ABCD Land – Ayo Bersama Cegah DBD! will be held in Urban Forest, Jakarta, on 20–21 June 2026, aligned with ASEAN Dengue Day to bolster regional collaboration. Economic losses from dengue were estimated at nearly Rp 9 trillion in 2024 (UGM). Climate variability and El Niño may expand Aedes aegypti habitats, increasing transmission risk. Although highest dengue mortality is among children aged 5–14, cases are also significant in ages 15–44; prevention must be sustained at homes, schools, and workplaces.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱がすべての年齢層を脅かす、ジャカルタは既に今年5,700件の症例を記録
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア（ジャカルタ）でのデング熱の大規模発生であり、IHR基準で「異常性（年間5,700件の確認症例）」「公衆衛生への深刻な影響」に該当。WPROスクリーニング基準でも「重症度（死亡報告）」「流行しやすさ（蚊媒介、気候変動による拡大リスク）」「管理可能性（国家戦略・行動計画の策定）」が確認され、社会的関心も高い。フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はインドネシア（特にジャカルタ）を主舞台としており、ASEAN地域との協力言及があるが、国際的な拡大リスクの具体的根拠は記述されていない。気候変動（エルニーニョ）による媒介蚊生息地の拡大が指摘されている点は、今後の動向監視対象となる。

article.articleHeadline: Ebolom u DR Kongu i Ugandi zaraženo 75 zdravstvenih radnika
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in DR Congo and Uganda: 75 healthcare workers infected.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization (WHO) reported on Friday that 75 healthcare workers have been infected with Ebola across the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda, with 17 deaths. Marie-Roseline Belizaire, the WHO representative in Bunia, the capital of Ituri Province in the DRC, stated that it is not yet clear whether infections occurred at work or in private settings. The report underscores the ongoing risk to health workers amid Ebola outbreaks in the region. WHO is strengthening support to clinics by supplying gloves and protective clothing and by training medical staff to prevent transmission and protect patients and communities.

triage.headline_ja: DRコンゴとウガンダのエボラ：75人の医療従事者が感染
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）、複数国での医療従事者感染と死亡報告があり、WHO対応が進行中であるため。
triage.notes: 発生地域にUganda（ウガンダ）が含まれているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations に含めない。DRCのみ対象国リストに該当。サマリーではDRCとウガンダ両国での感染が報告されているが、対象国判定に基づきDRCのみを列挙。医療従事者への感染と17名の死亡は深刻な懸念を示す。

article.articleHeadline: Oms, 'Ebola si sta evolvendo molto velocemente nell'est del Congo' - Sanità
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: "Ebola is evolving very rapidly in eastern Congo" - Health
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is spreading rapidly. The World Health Organization reports 896 confirmed cases and 232 deaths, with 21 new infections in the last 24 hours. Declared on May 15, the epidemic is caused by the Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no vaccine. More than 90% of known cases are in Ituri province, a conflict-affected area, with transmission also reaching the eastern provinces of North Kivu and South Kivu. WHO Africa emergency head Marie-Roseline Belizaire says the outbreak remains grave and evolves very quickly, though responses are strengthening daily. The situation highlights a persistent health emergency in eastern Congo, driven by a rapidly expanding outbreak and requiring ongoing public health action in affected regions.

triage.headline_ja: WHO: 「エボラがコンゴ東部で非常に急速に進化している」- 保健
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。896確定例、232死亡、急速な拡大、ワクチンなし、紛争地域での感染という深刻な状況。WPROスクリーニング基準もすべて該当。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo strain でワクチンが存在しない点が特に懸念。Ituri 州で 90% 以上の症例が集中し、紛争地域での制御困難性が指摘されている。North Kivu および South Kivu への拡大も確認。WHO Africa 緊急対応責任者による発言あり、国際的な関心・対応が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : plus de 70 soignants contaminés depuis le début de l'épidémie
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: more than 70 healthcare workers infected since the start of the outbreak.
article.articleSummary: An ongoing Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, caused by the Bundibugyo strain, has infected over 70 healthcare workers since the outbreak began; 17 have died, per WHO on June 19, 2026. The health system is highly vulnerable due to insecurity, population movements, and the lack of an approved vaccine or validated treatment. Declared May 15, the outbreak is centered in Ituri, with Bunia, Mongbwalu and Rwampara as hotspots, and has spillovers to North Kivu and South Kivu. As of June 15, 837 cases were confirmed with 196 deaths. Transmission is via direct contact with bodily fluids of infected individuals (alive or deceased) or contaminated surfaces; hospital infections rise when PPE and protocols are lacking. Some healthcare workers were exposed before confirmation; Uganda has reported cases linked to the RDC outbreak, signaling cross-border spread.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ：流行開始以来70人以上の医療従事者が感染
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5つすべてに該当。Bundibugyo株によるエボラ流行は深刻な公衆衛生上の影響、国際的な越境拡大リスク、脆弱な衛生システムを示しており、フルRRAへの進行が必須。
triage.notes: エボラ（Bundibugyo株）の現在進行中の流行。837確認症例、196死亡、医療従事者70名以上感染、死亡17名。5月15日宣言、Ituri県中心で北・南Kivu州へも拡大。ウガンダへの越境拡大あり。ワクチン未承認・治療法未検証の状況下での重大事象。

article.articleHeadline: At least 30 deaths at Congo camp show Ebola could be spreading fast
article.articleSummary: At least 30 people have died since early May at Kigonze camp in Bunia, Ituri province, DRC, from Ebola-like illness; residents and dead bodies are reportedly refusing tests, hindering confirmation. The 15,000-resident camp sits amid a broader displacement crisis of more than 5 million in eastern Congo. Five victims have had samples collected and await results; health workers describe multiple bodies wrapped in sheets as officials urge inspections. The outbreak was declared May 15, with deaths beginning earlier. Ebola is feared to be circulating undetected in Kigonze, where unsanitary conditions and dense living quarters elevate transmission risk. Another Ebola death has been recorded in a separate Ituri camp; the province accounts for the majority of nearly 900 confirmed cases. Donor funding for water, sanitation and hygiene halved in 2025, with US-funded WASH projects in three Ebola-affected provinces scaled back; 2024 Mercy Corps built 82 taps and 400 toilets, but 2025 coverage dropped to under 19,000 served.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴの難民キャンプで少なくとも30人が死亡、エボラが急速に拡大している可能性
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の確認された発生で、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスクがある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRC（イツリ州ブニア市のキゴンゼ難民キャンプ）でのエボラ疑い例の発生を主に扱っている。2026年6月時点での記事だが、5月15日の公式宣言以来、少なくとも30人の死亡、複数の疑い例、確認検査待機中の5件のサンプルがある。WASH資金削減により衛生状況が悪化し、感染リスク増加。対象国リストに含まれるDRCのみを verified_locations に含める。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : la peur d'Ebola éloigne les femmes enceintes des hôpitaux
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: Fear of Ebola Keeps Pregnant Women Away from Hospitals.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Ebola outbreak in the eastern Ituri province drives fear that keeps pregnant women away from health facilities, risking a silent maternal-newborn mortality crisis. UNFPA warns that fear of care disruptions compounds Ebola risk, with mortality among pregnant women infected by Ebola reaching up to 90%, and perinatal mortality possibly 100% in some contexts. Since the outbreak was declared a little over a month ago, WHO reports at least 896 confirmed Ebola cases and more than 232 deaths, with 78 recoveries in eastern Congo. About 75 health workers have been infected, including 17 deaths. UN agencies focus on infection prevention in maternity facilities, PPE, staff training, and waste management to protect maternal services and maintain community trust. The virus remains active in communities, with transmission chains possibly escaping interventions; displaced populations raise additional concerns for HCR.

triage.headline_ja: DRC: エボラへの恐怖が妊娠女性を病院から遠ざける
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラウイルス病の確認患者896名、死亡232名という重大な公衆衛生影響、東部での局在的異常事象、国際的拡大リスク（医療体制崩壊による地域感染の管理不備）、および渡航・貿易制限の可能性を示唆。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病は国際保健規則(IHR)で指定病患。妊婦の死亡率90%、周産期死亡率100%に達する可能性は極度の懸念事項。医療体制の機能不全（妊産婦ケア避難）により、エボラのみならず産科医療危機が誘発される二次的リスク。UN機関（UNFPA、HCR）の関与が明示されており、国際支援必要性が高い。発生地域はIturi州（DRC東部）で確認。

article.articleHeadline: Six-year-old Ebola patient taken from DR Congo hospital found and 'doing well'
article.articleSummary: Six-year-old Ebola patient in eastern DR Congo was found and is stable after armed men stormed a hospital in Butembo and abducted her and her mother. The child and mother later presented at an Ebola treatment centre about 18 km from Butembo. The outbreak has 890 confirmed cases and 230 deaths, caused by Bundibugyo Ebola, with no vaccine yet. Declared May 15, it is centered in Ituri (over 90% of infections) with cases also in South Kivu and North Kivu. About 75 health workers have been infected, 17 of whom have died. Uganda reports 19 cases and 2 deaths, with no new cases since June 5. WHO Africa emergencies chief says the outbreak remains evolving fast but responses are strengthening. WHO has pledged $3.9 million; Africa CDC budget stands at $319 million. Conflict, including M23, hampers control.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国の病院から連れ去られた6歳のエボラ患者が発見され、「良好な状態」にある
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、医療施設での暴力的な患者奪取という異常事態、複数国への国際的拡大、ウガンダへの波及）。WPROスクリーニング基準も5つすべて該当。緊急対応が進行中の活発なエボラアウトブレーク。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーにおいて、主たるエボラ感染事例はコンゴ民主共和国（北キブ州、南キブ州、イトゥリ州）で集中している（890確認例、230死亡）。ウガンダには19例、2死亡が報告されているが、6月5日以降新規例なし。医療施設での患者奪取という治安上の懸念、ブンディブギオエボラウイルス（未承認ワクチン）、75人の医療従事者感染（17死亡）、紛争による対策阻害が複合的に作用。WHO/Africa CDCによる支援が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Global Research: Bill Gates mRNA Ebola Vaccine Grant Matches Deadly Outbreak in the Democratic Republic of The Congo (DRC). Rare and Deadly Virus Strain
article.articleSummary: New Ebola outbreak in central Africa, specifically the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), is reported. Published 2026-06-19 by Global Research. The article links the outbreak timing to a prominent grant for an mRNA Ebola vaccine attributed to Bill Gates, noting sharp criticism directed at Gates. It characterizes the outbreak as involving a 'rare and deadly virus strain.' No case counts, deaths, or laboratory confirmation details are provided in the piece. The report frames the funding as matching or aligning with the outbreak's emergence, suggesting a controversial coincidence. It does not provide information on infection sources, transmission, or whether cases have been imported or exported. The language emphasizes political controversy rather than epidemiological specifics. This summary focuses on the disease mention (Ebola), location (DRC), the alleged vaccine grant, and the claimed rare strain.

triage.headline_ja: グローバルリサーチ：ビル・ゲイツのmRNAエボラワクチン助成金がコンゴ民主共和国の致命的なアウトブレイクと一致。稀で致命的なウイルス株
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの発生報告であり潜在的に重大な公衆衛生上の懸念を示唆するが、記事は疫学的詳細（患者数、死亡数、ラボ確認）を欠如しており、政治的陰謀論を強調している。情報不足のため、続報による実態確認が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は政治的陰謀論を強調しており、疫学的情報（患者数、死亡数、確認された感染経路、ラボ確認）が完全に欠如している。エボラは高い伝播性と重症度を持つため原則的には重要であるが、本記事の信頼性に懸念あり。ソースURL（apokalypsnu.com）の信憑性も問題。実際の患者発生が確認されるまで監視継続を推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Megállíthatatlanul terjed a halálos vírus: rájuk különösen veszélyes
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Unstoppable spread of the deadly virus: especially dangerous to them.
article.articleSummary: Filoviruses, including Ebola and the feared Marburg virus, are among the world’s deadliest pathogens, capable of causing severe disease with high mortality in major outbreaks (case fatality rates commonly cited between 25% and 90%). The article notes these viruses as persistent global threats during severe outbreaks. As of 2026-06-19, the Democratic Republic of the Congo is contending with an Ebola outbreak caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus. It underscores the ongoing spread and the lethal potential of this virus family, illustrating how epidemics can unfold with devastating impact. The excerpt does not provide specific case counts, laboratory confirmation details, transmission sources, or other operational outbreak metrics. Keywords: outbreak, Ebola, Bundibugyo ebolavirus, Marburg, Democratic Republic of the Congo, CFR.

triage.headline_ja: 致死的ウイルスが止められずに拡大：特に彼らに危険である
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当。エボラウイルス病（ブンディブギオ株）のDRC発生は公衆衛生上の深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスクを有する。フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCにおけるブンディブギオエボラウイルスの発生が明記されている。症例数、検査確認、感染源などの具体的な流行メトリクスは記事に含まれていないが、病原体の特性（CFR 25-90%）と継続的な拡大が強調されており、直ちにフルRRA対象とすべき。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya : les chauffeurs routiers appelés à la vigilance face à Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya: Truck drivers urged to be vigilant in the face of Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Kenya tightens border health checks as Ebola circulates in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). The outbreak has reached 896 confirmed cases and 232 deaths. Long-distance truck drivers departing Nairobi for Uganda and eastern DRC have adapted practices, often avoiding meals in affected countries and carrying personal cooking equipment to reduce exposure. Health experts note that truck movements are a vital component of regional trade but can drive cross-border transmission if safeguards are not observed. Kenyan authorities have strengthened surveillance at major entry points and are coordinating with regional partners to prevent spread. Well-informed drivers who understand disease transmission and preventive measures can help protect themselves and local communities while maintaining essential commerce.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア：エボラに対して警戒を呼びかけられるトラック運転手
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）、WPROスクリーニング基準4つ該当、社会的・政治的関心あり。エボラは高リスク病原体でDRCでの大規模流行が報告されており、国境を越えた伝播の可能性が高い。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアでのトラック運転手への警戒呼びかけであるが、実際の流行はDRCで発生しており、ケニアは境界地域での感染監視強化の対応国として言及されている。DRCは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。ウガンダ、ケニアは記事で言及されているが、流行発生地としてではなく隣接国/境界強化の文脈であるため対象国リストの該当性を確認しても含めない。エボラウイルスの高い致死率（232死亡/896確認例で約26%）と国際的伝播の可能性、地域的な貿易・運輸を通じた拡大リスクが重大。

article.articleHeadline: 12 Kasus HIV dan Sifilis Ditemukan di Bolmong, Penderita Masih Usia Produktif
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 12 HIV and syphilis cases found in Bolmong, patients still in productive age
article.articleSummary: As of 2026, the Bolaang Mongondow Regency Health Office in Indonesia reports 12 infectious-disease cases detected through screening across health facilities in 2026: three new HIV infections and nine syphilis cases. HIV cases are reported in the Komangaan, Lolak, and Buntalo Puskesmas areas. HIV is described as a virus that attacks CD4 T cells and, if untreated, impairs the immune system. Syphilis, caused by Treponema pallidum, is an STI transmitted through direct contact with lesions or from mother to fetus. The nine syphilis cases predominantly involve the productive-age group 20–49 years (three males, five females) and one case aged 15–19. All detected patients have received treatment. Officials emphasize that systematic screening in health facilities enables early detection and timely care, reducing transmission and improving outcomes.

triage.headline_ja: ボラアン・モンゴンドウで12件のHIVと梅毒の症例が発見、患者は労働年齢層
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアにおけるHIVと梅毒の検出報告であり、スクリーニング基準は満たすが、症例数が限定的で組織的対応がなされており、国際的拡大リスクや深刻な公衆衛生影響の明確な証拠に欠ける。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年の時点でのボラアン・モンゴンドウ地域での定期スクリーニングによる12症例の検出を報告。HIV3件、梅毒9件。患者は主に生産年齢層（20-49歳）であり、全患者が治療を受けている。組織的スクリーニングと対応が実施されているため、制御可能性は比較的高いと考えられる。WPROスクリーニング基準では長期曝露リスク（母子感染の可能性を含むSTI）と流行しやすさ（ヒト-ヒト感染）に該当するが、症例数の限定性と有効な対応により深刻なアウトブレイク兆候は見当たらない。

article.articleHeadline: Analizirani ostaci lovaca-sakupljača iz Sibira: Kuga izazivala smrtonosne epidemije i pre 5.500 godina
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Analyzed remains of hunter-gatherers from Siberia: The plague caused deadly epidemics as far back as 5,500 years ago.
article.articleSummary: Ancient DNA analysis of four hunter-gatherer cemeteries near Lake Baikal in eastern Siberia shows that Yersinia pestis caused deadly epidemics about 5,500 years ago, predating the Black Death. In 18 of 46 individuals (40%), plague DNA was recovered from teeth, higher than in some medieval graves. Radiocarbon dating indicates many burials occurred within tight time windows, with siblings or parent-child pairs interred together. The ancient strains carried a unique superantigen not seen in later lineages, likely producing extreme virulence even before effective flea- and rodent transmission. Mortality disproportionately affected children and adolescents. Researchers suggest a Central or Northeast Asian origin for these early plagues, with possible direct transmission from marmots to humans before spread via rodent reservoirs across Eurasia. The findings, integrating genetics, archaeology, and radiocarbon dating, redefine early plague dynamics.

triage.headline_ja: シベリアから発掘された狩猟採集民の遺骨を分析：ペストは5500年前にすでに致命的な疫病を引き起こしていた
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は古代DNAの考古学的分析であり、現在進行中の感染症イベントではない。過去5500年前の歴史的なペスト流行に関する学術研究であり、公衆衛生上の緊急対応が必要な感染症の発生ではない。
triage.notes: 本記事はシベリアの古代遺跡の考古学的分析に基づいた歴史研究であり、現在の感染症イベント（現在進行中の疾患発生）ではない。Bluedot APIが「ペスト」と検出したことにより地理的位置情報が付与されているが、タイやロシア連邦での現在のペスト発生を報告するものではない。シグナルトリアージの対象外である。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Outbreaks Complicated by Victims Who Prefer Traditional Healers Over Hospitals
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of Congo’s Ituri province (Bunia as outbreak epicenter; Mongbwalu hotspot) is experiencing an Ebola outbreak caused by Bundibugyo virus—the rare strain with no approved medicines or vaccines. The event, Congo’s 17th Ebola outbreak since 1976, was confirmed May 15 and had killed at least 181 people by June 19, 2026. Transmission occurs via close contact with the sick or deceased’s bodily fluids. Mistrust of health workers and reliance on traditional healers hinder response, with rumors about outsiders or magical charms spreading fear. Early symptoms include muscle weakness and headaches, with fever and internal/external bleeding in later stages. WHO declared a public health emergency of international concern; the United States imposed a temporary entry ban on travelers who have recently visited Congo, Uganda, or South Sudan. No approved therapies exist for Bundibugyo Ebola; emphasis on clinical care and community engagement.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ感染症の流行は伝統的医療者を病院より優先する患者により複雑化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、181人の死亡、Bundibugyo型（治療薬・ワクチン未承認）、WHOによる国際的懸念事項の宣言、複数国での渡航制限措置が確認されている。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo型エボラウイルスは稀な株であり、承認された医薬品やワクチンが存在しない。コンゴで17番目のエボラアウトブレイク（1976年以降）。WHO は国際的懸念事項として宣言。米国は複数国からの渡航者に対して一時的な入国禁止令を発令。地域社会における医療不信と伝統的治療者への依存が対応を困難にしている重大な懸念要因。

article.articleHeadline: Sobe para 896 o número de casos confirmados de ebola no Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of confirmed Ebola cases in the Congo rises to 896.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of Congo reports Ebola cases rising to 896 with 232 deaths as of June 18, 2026. The outbreak shows weekly increases and ongoing community transmission, driven by the rare Bundibugyo strain, for which no approved treatments or vaccines exist. Authorities warn the surge could spread to new areas if public health measures are not quickly implemented. The epidemic reportedly went undetected for weeks, delaying response, according to CDC Africa. Health workers face obstacles including resistance to testing after suspected deaths, gaps in contact tracing, insufficient treatment-center beds, shortages of infection-prevention supplies in North Kivu, and a US$21.5 million funding gap. On June 5, WHO announced a six-month plan of US$518 million to mobilize resources and political support to halt spread within the DRC and neighboring regions.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのエボラ確認症例数が896件に増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準5項目すべてに該当。活発なエボラウイルス流行で死亡者多数、治療法なし、隣接地域への拡大リスク高く、国際的な資金・支援ニーズが明確。
triage.notes: 稀なBundibugyo株による流行で承認治療法・ワクチンなし。週単位での増加傾向、検査への抵抗、接触者追跡の不備、治療センターベッド不足など、多くの対応課題あり。WHOが6ヶ月計画で5.18億ドルの支援を発表。フルRRAが必要。

article.articleHeadline: Пронађена девојчица коју су наоружани људи отели из болнице за еболу
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The girl kidnapped by armed men from the Ebola hospital has been found.
article.articleSummary: Six-year-old girl with Ebola rescued after being abducted from an Ebola treatment hospital in Butembo, eastern Democratic Republic of Congo; she and her mother were taken by armed men and appeared four days later at a medical center about 18 km from Butembo, with the child in stable condition. The incident highlights ongoing attacks on health facilities and misinformation shaping local responses to Ebola. The current outbreak in the DRC has over 890 confirmed cases and more than 230 deaths. Ituri Province accounts for more than 90% of cases, with spread to North and South Kivu. The strain responsible is Bundibugyo, for which there is no licensed vaccine yet; WHO warns vaccine development could take months. Authorities have intensified surveillance, contact tracing, and medical infrastructure; WHO funded $3.9 million and Africa CDC about $319 million. Uganda reports no new cases since June 5; security issues with M23 hamper response.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の病院から武装した男たちに誘拐された女の子が発見された
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、Ebola outbreakの深刻性（890確定患者、230死亡）、Bundibugyo株対策の困難さ、国際的な支援体制強化の必要性が明確。また、ウガンダへの国境越え事例報告があり、国際的拡大リスクが存在。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRC（北キブ州・南キブ州、ブテンボ市）での発生を主題としている。ウガンダは発生地域として記載されているが、サマリーではウガンダで新規症例がないことが明記されており、主要な発生地はDRCのみ。Bundibugyo Ebola outbreakは既知の流行だが、ワクチン未開発という新しいリスク要因と、武装勢力による患者誘拐という治療・管理の困難化が重大な懸念。

article.articleHeadline: Epidemia de ebola se propaga rapidamente na RDC, alerta OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola epidemic spreads rapidly in the DRC, WHO warns.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo is spreading rapidly. Declared May 15, the transmission involves the Bundibugyo strain. As of 2026-06-19, the World Health Organization reports 896 confirmed cases and 232 deaths, with 21 new cases in the last 24 hours. The outbreak is centered in Ituri province, which accounts for over 90% of cases, with spread to North Kivu and South Kivu. Health systems have increased Ebola treatment beds from zero to more than 500. Surveillance teams evaluate about 400 alerts daily and can perform over 2,000 tests per day. Contact tracing has reached 75% of contacts; authorities aim to locate 95% to curb transmission. Ebola spreads via close contact with infected bodily fluids; improved detection enables safe and dignified burials, reducing high-risk handling of bodies by families.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行がコンゴ民主共和国で急速に拡大、WHOが警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、エボラウイルス疾患の急速な拡大、232人の死亡、複数州への拡大、国際的な関心を示唆する記事。WPROスクリーニングでも全5基準に該当。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス疾患は極めて高リスク疾患であり、死亡率25.9%（232死亡/896確定例）、複数州への拡大、接触者追跡75%という現状から急速な拡大リスクが高い。WHOが公式警告を発出している。フルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Shaky Iran-US ceasefire, Ebola cases surge, and the aid sector in crisis mode: The Cheat Sheet
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo could become the worst on record, with 915 confirmed cases and 234 deaths since the outbreak was declared on 15 May. The virus is spreading in conflict-affected eastern DRC, and at current rates may last about a year as violence, displacement, and distrust hinder contact tracing and care. Donors have pledged about $910 million, including $80 million from African Union member states, but less than 10% has materialized as cash. In other headlines, a US–Iran MoU opens a 60-day ceasefire window to end the war that began on 28 February; the fighting has killed at least 7,300 in Iran and Lebanon, with more than 100 Iranian schoolgirls among casualties on day one. Israel continues strikes on Lebanon; Amnesty International accuses forced displacement as unlawful transfer. The World Food Programme faces calls for an independent investigation after a cyber-attack exposed Gaza data.

triage.headline_ja: 不安定なイラン・米国休戦、エボラ患者数が急増、援助部門が危機モード：チートシート
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスがDRCで過去最大級の流行規模に達しており（915確認症例、234死亡）、IHR基準4つすべてに該当。紛争下での蔓延制御困難、国際的な資金支援課題、および社会的関心の高さから、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの主題は東部DRCにおけるエボラ流行。Bluedot APIが付与した他の地域（ガザ、イラン、レバノン、イスラエル、米国）はイベント周辺の地政学的背景として言及されているが、実際のエボラ発生地はDRCのみ。対象国リストではDRCのみ該当。紛争地域での蔓延制御困難さ、資金不足、過去最大級の規模が特に懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Brote de ébola suma 896 contagios y 232 fallecidos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak totals 896 infections and 232 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo totals 896 confirmed cases and 232 deaths, rising after 21 new infections and 6 additional deaths in the last 24 hours (case fatality about 26%). Declared May 15, the epidemic spans 33 health zones across Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu. The Bundibugyo strain is involved, with lethality estimated at 30–50%. Ituri is the epicenter, with 383 patients in isolation and 78 recoveries, while authorities warn of hidden transmission chains. No vaccine exists specific to this strain; containment relies on diagnostics, contact tracing, and risk communication. WHO has deployed 115 experts and distributed over 110 tons of medical supplies, but tracing effectiveness is only 71% (target 95%), hindered by conflict-related access restrictions. The outbreak has crossed into Uganda with 19 cases and 2 deaths linked to importations from the DRC. WHO rates regional risk as high, global impact considered low.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス感染症アウトブレイク、896人の感染と232人の死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準において深刻な公衆衛生影響（232人の死亡、26%の致死率）、予想外/異常な事象、国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダへの越境確認）、渡航・貿易制限のリスクが認められ、4基準全て該当。WPRO基準も複数該当。社会的・政治的関心が高い。フルRRAへ進むべきシグナル。
triage.notes: ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。ただし記事では越境ケース（ウガンダに19人の輸入症例と2人の死亡）が明記されており、地域的リスク拡大を示唆している。DRC側の対象国は203312のみ。Bundibugyo株で致死率30-50%、ワクチン未開発。WHO支援中だが接触者追跡効率71%で目標95%に未達。紛争による接近制限が障害。

article.articleHeadline: Šestogodišnja djevojčica s ebolom oteta iz bolnice u DR Kongu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Six-year-old girl with Ebola kidnapped from a hospital in DR Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo continues, driven by Bundibugyo ebolavirus with transmission concentrated in Ituri, South Kivu and North Kivu; Ituri accounts for over 90% of confirmed infections. As of mid-June, WHO data show more than 230 deaths and about 890 cases. The response is challenged by violence and distrust toward treatment centers, with health facilities attacked and safe burials emphasized to prevent spread. A six-year-old girl with Ebola was abducted from a hospital in Butembo on June 15; she and her mother later appeared at an Ebola treatment center about 18 km from Butembo, with the child described as stable. Uganda reports 19 confirmed cases (including 2 deaths) linked to the outbreak; no new Ugandan cases since June 5. WHO has pledged $3.9 million and Africa CDC about $319 million to bolster surveillance, contact tracing and treatment capacity; there is no vaccine for Bundibugyo.

triage.headline_ja: DR コンゴの病院からエボラに感染した6歳の女児が誘拐される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当。進行中のエボラアウトブレイク（230人以上の死亡、約890例の確定症例）、ウガンダへの国際的拡大（19確定例），医療施設への攻撃による対応困難，多国間での国際的支援が実施中。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはUgandaも含まれているが、記事サマリーではウガンダは二次的な影響（19例、新規症例なし）であり、主要な発生地はDRC（Ituri、South Kivu、North Kivu）。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。Bundibugyo ebolavirus による進行中のアウトブレイクで、医療施設への暴力、患者の逃走等により対応が困難な状況。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Outbreak in DR Congo and Uganda Surpasses 837 Cases With No Approved Vaccine
article.articleSummary: By 2026-06-19, the Sudan ebolavirus disease (SVD) outbreak in eastern DR Congo has reached 837 confirmed and probable cases with 287 deaths (case fatality ~34%). It began in North Kivu in early April, spread to six provinces, and crossed into Uganda’s Bundibugyo district. No approved SVD vaccine exists; two phase II candidates from Sabin Vaccine Institute and a Pasteur-led consortium are not yet proven, so response relies on contact tracing, isolation, and supportive care. WHO did not declare a Public Health Emergency of International Concern; a review is set for July 10. Security conditions hinder access, with damaged facilities and restricted areas. About 1,200 health workers are deployed; CDC will add 45; UK funds £8 million. Uganda imposes a modified lockdown in Bundibugyo; 240 contacts are monitored. International spread risk remains low, with screening at airports/border crossings in Uganda, Rwanda, and Burundi. Compassionate use of vaccines covers around 1,800 frontline workers and contacts; preliminary safety reports show no serious adverse events.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ株スーダンウイルス病のDRコンゴ・ウガンダにおける流行が837例を超える、承認されたワクチンなし
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。スーダンウイルス株エボラの多国間での高死亡率流行であり、公衆衛生上の重大な懸念事項。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはスーダンウイルス株エボラの流行を記述。DRコンゴでの初発地（北キブ州）から6州に拡大、ウガンダのブンディブギョ地区に越境。Bluedot APIが指摘した「Burundi」「Rwanda」は記事内で検査・スクリーニング対象国として言及されているのみで、実際の流行地ではないため除外。死亡率34%、837確定・推定例、承認ワクチンなし、セキュリティ制約、マルチセクター対応進行中などから医学的・公衆衛生的に最高レベルの懸念。WHOが公衆衛生上の国際的に懸念される事象（PHEIC）宣言未実施も注目（7月10日見直し予定）。

article.articleHeadline: فيروس إيبولا يثير القلق.. الصحة العالمية تدق ناقوس الخطر بعد ارتفاع الوفيات - الأسبوع
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola virus is causing concern... WHO sounds the alarm after the rise in deaths — The Week
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) linked to the rare Bundibugyo strain prompts the World Health Organization to declare a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. As of reporting, at least 88 deaths and more than 300 cases have been recorded, with most infections in Mungwalo and Rwampara, Ituri Province; new cases have appeared in Kinshasa and areas near borders with Uganda and Rwanda, raising cross-border transmission concerns. The true scale may be larger due to surveillance gaps and unclear epidemiological links. Ebola virus disease has a case fatality rate of 25–90% depending on the strain and healthcare quality, averaging around 50%. Early symptoms include high fever, fatigue, muscle pains, and sore throat, potentially progressing to internal bleeding and liver/kidney failure. No approved vaccine exists for Bundibugyo; this is the seventeenth Ebola outbreak in DRC since 1976, with the 2013–2016 West Africa epidemic noted for context (over 28,000 cases and more than 11,000 deaths).

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスが懸念を引き起こす...WHO死亡者数の増加後に警鐘を鳴らす — The Week
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、DRCで確認されたエボラウイルス（Bundibugyo株）の集団発生で88人以上の死亡、300人以上の症例が報告され、ウガンダ・ルワンダとの境界地域への拡大が懸念されている。WHOが国際的懸念の公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言しており、明確なシグナルである。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株のエボラ集団発生でWHOが国際的懸念の公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言。DRC東部（Ituri Province）が主要発生地で、Kinshasa市への拡大およびウガンダ・ルワンダとの境界地域での新規症例が報告されている。発生地域にはUgandaとRwandaも含まれているが、記事サマリーでは症例の実際の発生はDRCおよび境界地域の言及のみであるため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとする。

article.articleHeadline: MCD launches capital-wide anti-dengue drive ahead of monsoon
article.articleSummary: Delhi reports 162 dengue, 42 malaria, and 9 chikungunya cases so far this year as the Municipal Corporation of Delhi (MCD) launched a citywide anti-dengue drive ahead of the monsoon. The campaign deploys 100 auto-rickshaws equipped with fogging machines, banners, and pamphlets to cover all 250 municipal wards, supplementing ongoing field inspections and anti-mosquito measures. West zone reports 29 dengue and 14 malaria; Central 21 dengue; Civil Lines 20 dengue. Monsoon is expected soon, with Delhi typically seeing disease spikes during and after rain; monsoon typically reaches Delhi by late June or early July. Mayor Pravesh Wahi urged residents to adopt 'Cover, Clean and Keep Dry'—ensuring covered water tanks, cleanliness, and no water stagnation. The effort includes intensified fogging and public outreach as pre-monsoon preparedness and aims to strengthen public participation in disease prevention.

triage.headline_ja: デリーがモンスーン前に全市的蚊媒介感染症対策キャンペーンを開始
triage.triage_reason: デリーでデング熱162例、マラリア42例、チクングニア9例が報告されており、スクリーニング基準の複数に該当する可能性があるが、検出的・予防的段階の対策であり現時点では明確な異常事態への言及がない。続報監視が適切。
triage.notes: 記事は定例的な季節性蚊媒介感染症の予防キャンペーン報告。デング熱・マラリア・チクングニアはいずれも地域流行性疾患であり、報告された症例数は異常性の明確な証拠ではない。ただしモンスーン期の流行拡大リスク、ヒト-ヒト感染以外の媒介可能性、広域人口への潜在的曝露があり、続報にて重症度や異常増加の有無を確認する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: DRK: Zmarło 17 pracowników ochrony zdrowia zakażonych ebolą
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRK: 17 health care workers infected with Ebola have died.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-19, 17 health care workers infected with the Ebola virus have died in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, out of 75 infected staff, according to WHO Africa crisis director for emergencies Marie Roseline Belizaire. The outbreak is accelerating, with transmission rising in 33 health districts across three provinces. Bunia, the city in Ituri province in the east, is highlighted as a focal point. Belizaire noted severe staffing shortages among health workers and fear among colleagues witnessing ill peers. On the same day, a Chinese medical team arrived in Ituri, and neighboring Uganda announced it will dispatch its own medical team to assist.

triage.headline_ja: DRC: エボラウイルスに感染した医療従事者17人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラウイルスアウトブレイク、死亡者と感染者多数、複数州での拡大、国境を越えた支援要請と医療チーム派遣が発生している。
triage.notes: エボラウイルスアウトブレイク。DRCのイトゥリ州を中心に3州33の医療地区で伝播が加速。感染医療従事者75人中17人が死亡。中国とウガンダから医療チーム派遣予定。医療体制の深刻な不足が報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Épidémie Afrique : l'Allemagne alloue 13 M€ supplémentaires contre Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Africa outbreak: Germany allocates an additional €13 million to fight Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Germany allocates €13 million to Ebola response in Africa: €9 million for actions in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and to support Africa CDC, the East African Community (EAC), UN programs and NGOs; €4 million to the WHO for emergency operations. In the DRC, on 15 May the WHO confirmed a new Ebola outbreak in Ituri province, northeast DRC, caused by the Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no licensed vaccine or specific treatment. This marks the 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC since virus identification in 1976 at Yambuku, Équateur; the previous outbreak was declared over in December 2025. Ebola virus disease is a hemorrhagic fever, often severe and fatal, transmitted from animals (bats, primates) to humans, and between humans via contact with infected fluids or contaminated surfaces. Therapeutic success in Berlin: on 6 June, a 39-year-old American physician recovered from Bundibugyo Ebola after treatment at Charité, having been evacuated from Uganda; he received experimental therapies and noted many Congolese lack access to such care.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ感染症流行：ドイツがエボラ対策に追加1300万ユーロを配分
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常・予想外の新規流行、国際的拡大リスク）。DRC での確認された新規エボラ流行（Bundibugyo 株）は重症度が高く、ワクチンなし。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーより、2026年5月15日にDRC Ituri州で確認された新規エボラ流行（Bundibugyo株）が主題。ドイツからの国際支援、Uganda経由での患者搬出（Berlin での治療）も記載されているが、実際の流行地はDRCのみ。Yambuku はエボラ発見地としての歴史的記述であり、現在の発生地ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Аларм во Африка: Епидемијата на ебола се шири, заразени десетици здравствени работници - Press24
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Alarm in Africa: The Ebola outbreak is spreading, dozens of healthcare workers infected - Press24.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda intensifies as of 10 June: 676 laboratory-confirmed cases and 136 deaths in DRC; 19 confirmed cases and 2 deaths in Uganda, with one case under investigation as probable. More than 75 healthcare workers across both nations are infected, including at least 16 in Congo, underscoring hospital transmission. The Bundibugyo virus strain has no approved vaccine or specific therapy; case fatality among confirmed cases may reach 30–50%. Early detection and timely care improve survival. WHO has declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, prompting urgent regional cooperation, border controls, and strengthened health-system readiness in neighboring countries. Testing expansion is expected to raise reported counts in coming weeks.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカで警戒: エボラ感染症が拡大、数十人の医療従事者が感染 - Press24
triage.triage_reason: IHR Annex2基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の流行、国際的拡大、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WHO PHEIC宣言済みで社会的・政治的関心が極めて高い。
triage.notes: DRC (対象国 203312) で実際に発生しているイベント。サマリーにはウガンダも記述されているが、ウガンダは提供対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には DRC のみを列挙。Bundibugyo エボラウイルス、ワクチン・治療法なし、30-50% 致死率、76 名以上の医療従事者感染、WHO PHEIC 宣言済み。フルRRA進行推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola sa v Kongu šíri alarmujúcim tempom. WHO hlási vyše 200 obetí a varuje pred neliečiteľným kmeňom | Info.sk
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola is spreading in the Congo at an alarming rate. WHO reports more than 200 deaths and warns of the incurable strain | Info.sk
article.articleSummary: As of 15 May 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has 896 cases and 232 deaths, driven by the Bundibugyo variant for which there is no approved vaccine or targeted therapy. The Ituri province, already conflict-affected, accounts for about 90% of cases, with spread into South Kivu and North Kivu. Cross-border transmission has reached Uganda, totaling 19 cases and 2 deaths; 10 Ugandan patients have recovered, and no new Ugandan cases have been reported for nearly two weeks. Health teams are testing over 2,000 people daily and expanding hospital capacity from zero to more than 500 beds. Contact tracing covers around 75% of known contacts, short of the 95% target required to control transmission.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラが驚異的なスピードで拡大。WHOが200人以上の死者を報告し、治療不可能な株について警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常・予想外の事象、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限のリスク）。Bundibugyo型エボラで治療法がなく、896例232死亡、ウガンダへの越境伝播確認。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの越境伝播確認（19例2死亡）。Bundibugyo型は承認されたワクチンや標的治療法がない重大な懸念。接触者追跡率75%（目標95%）で制御に不足。武装紛争が続くIturi州が90%の症例を占め、管理困難な状況。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya intensifies screening and awareness for truck drivers over Ebola fears
article.articleSummary: Kenya has intensified health screening and awareness for truck drivers amid Ebola outbreak in the DRC, as East Africa remains on high alert. With truck routes from Nairobi to Uganda, Rwanda, DRC and South Sudan, authorities have expanded border screenings, temperature checks, and awareness campaigns at entry points. Confirmed Ebola cases continue to rise in eastern Congo, but outbreak largely contained due to border measures. Drivers report adopting precautions: avoiding handshakes, using personal stoves, cooking their own food, avoiding hotels to minimize exposure. Experts emphasize drivers’ role in preventing cross-border transmission. Kenyan Ministry of Health will start weekly briefings for border drivers and continues health trainings; monitoring systems strengthened at key entry points in collaboration with regional partners. The aim is to safeguard communities while maintaining regional trade.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア、エボラの懸念に対しトラックドライバーのスクリーニングと啓発を強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラ発生地域と隣接するケニアがDRCでの流行に対応する監視体制を強化しており、シグナル識別の対象。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアの対応ですが、実際のエボラ発生地はDRCの東部（eastern Congo）です。GeoNames IDのリストに含まれる対象国はDRC（203312）のみが該当します。ケニアは対象国外であるため除外。DRCでの継続的なケース増加と東アフリカ地域の警戒態勢が、国際的な拡大リスクと国境措置の強化を駆動しています。

article.articleHeadline: MCD committed to preventing vector-borne diseases: Mayor Pravesh Wahi
article.articleSummary: As of 19 June 2026, Delhi's Municipal Corporation (MCD) launched an auto-rickshaw rally to promote awareness and prevention of vector-borne diseases, notably dengue and malaria. The initiative involves 100 auto-rickshaws and 450 workers, equipped with fogging machines, banners, pamphlets, and other materials, and will traverse all 250 MCD wards. A complementary fogging campaign was inaugurated during the event. The rally, headed by Mayor Pravesh Wahi and aligned with public-health aims, carries the motto 'Jeetegi Delhi Harega Dengue-Malaria' and emphasizes a three-pronged strategy: Cover, Clean and Keep Dry—cover water containers, maintain cleanliness to reduce breeding sites, and prevent water stagnation. The effort complements ongoing efforts to curb vector-borne diseases in Delhi.

triage.headline_ja: MCD、ベクター媒介疾病の予防に尽力：Pravesh Wahi市長
triage.triage_reason: 記事は公衆衛生キャンペーンの実施を報告するもので、疾患発生のアウトブレイク通知ではない。IHR基準・WPROスクリーニング基準への該当がなく、新規のシグナルとしてのピックアップは不要。
triage.notes: 記事はデリーの当局によるベクター媒介疾病（デング熱とマラリア）の予防啓発キャンペーンについて述べており、新規疾患発生やアウトブレイクの報告ではない。既知疾患に対する日常的な予防活動であるため、シグナルトリアージの対象外と判定される。

article.articleHeadline: Demak luncurkan Desa Siaga TBC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Demak Launches TB-Ready Village
article.articleSummary: Demak Regency, Central Java, launched the TB-Ready Village (Desa Siaga TBC) program to strengthen tuberculosis case finding and management down to the village level, starting in Doreng Village, Wonosalam District. The program requires participation from village government, health workers, local security (BABINSA) and neighborhood policing (BHABINKAMTAS), and other community members, reflecting that TB control cannot be done by health services alone. Key activities include intensified household contact tracing of TB patients, screening of cohabitants, and treating positives to completion; negatives receive three months of preventive therapy with weekly dosing. Demak reports more than 2,000 new TB cases annually, including drug-susceptible and drug-resistant TB, but both are curable with proper treatment. Officials say more case finding indicates a functioning detection system and supports TB elimination by 2030, aiming to expand to all villages.

triage.headline_ja: デマク県がTB対応村プログラムを立ち上げ
triage.triage_reason: 結核の予防・管理施策報道であり、新規の疾病異常事象ではなく、またIHR基準およびスクリーニング基準の該当なし。
triage.notes: 本記事は既知の結核問題に対する地域レベルの予防・管理施策の発表であり、新規の感染症シグナルではない。プログラム実施自体は地方自治体の正常な対応活動である。国際的拡大リスクおよび深刻な公衆衛生影響を示す具体的な指標なし。

article.articleHeadline: Aligarh TB Support | Aligarh Latest Hindi News | UP Breaking News Hindi Newstrack | Aligarh News: टीबी से जंग में साईं दान फाउंडेशन आगे, 34 बच्चों को पोषण सहारा
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Aligarh TB Support | Aligarh Latest Hindi News | UP Breaking News Hindi Newstrack | Aligarh News: Sai Dan Foundation steps forward in the fight against TB, providing nutritional support to 34 children.
article.articleSummary: Aligarh, Uttar Pradesh, India: Under the National Tuberculosis Elimination Programme, Sai Dan Foundation organized its third nutrition-packet distribution, adopting 34 TB-affected children aged 5–15 for six months to provide sustained nutritional support. The event occurred at the Aligarh district hospital auditorium, with Chief Medical Officer Dr. R.N. Singh and District TB Officer Dr. Dinesh Khatri distributing the nutrition pouches. The initiative underscores that nutritious meals augment TB drug therapy, aided by Nikshay Mitras and civil society collaboration. As of June 2026, contributions from various institutions have enabled the distribution of 2,334 nutrition packets. Participants urged the public to become Nikshay Mitras to assist TB patients and advance the broader goal of a TB-free India.

triage.headline_ja: Aligarh TB Support | Aligarh Latest Hindi News | UP Breaking News Hindi Newstrack | Aligarh News: Sai Dan Foundation steps forward in the fight against TB, providing nutritional support to 34 children.
triage.triage_reason: 本イベントは結核患者への栄養支援プログラムの実施報告であり、感染症の新規発生や流行を示すシグナルではない。IHR基準・WPROスクリーニング基準ともに該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事はNational Tuberculosis Elimination Programmeの一環として実施された既知の支援活動の報告である。新規の疾病発生、異常な集団発生、死亡率上昇、感染拡大リスク等のシグナルは認められない。感染症危機管理の観点からのトリアージ対象外。

article.articleHeadline: 17 pracowników ochrony zdrowia zakażonych. WHO informuje
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 17 healthcare workers infected. WHO reports.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-19, the Democratic Republic of the Congo faces a rapidly evolving Ebola outbreak centered in Ituri Province (Bunia). Transmission is accelerating across 33 health districts in three provinces. Africa CDC data cited by Wessam Mankoula report 204 deaths (including 2 in Uganda) and 894 laboratory-confirmed infections, with 74 recoveries. About 4,000 contacts are being monitored, with potential total up to 35,000. On 15 May, the DRC declared the 17th Ebola outbreak caused by Bundibugyo, for which there is currently no vaccine or effective treatment. A Chinese medical team arrived in Ituri on the same day, and Uganda pledged medical support. Health workers face staff shortages and fear seeing ill colleagues. The outbreak remains far from controlled.

triage.headline_ja: 17人の医療従事者が感染。WHOが報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、予想外の急速な流行、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WPRO基準5項目全て該当。社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC（Ituri Province）が主な発生地。ウガンダでの2件の死亡は記載されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。中国チームの到着は支援活動であり、中国での発生は確認されない。Bundibugyo型エボラウイルスによる第17次大規模流行で、ワクチンがなく管理困難な状況。

article.articleHeadline: La Patagonia lanza una señal de alarma que el mundo debería escuchar: pingüinos muertos en sus costas y los científicos en alerta
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Patagonia raises the alarm the world should heed: dead penguins on its shores and scientists on alert.
article.articleSummary: Dozens of Magellanic penguins have been found dead along Patagonia’s shores, across the Gulf of San Jorge coasts in Chubut and Santa Cruz, near Comodoro Rivadavia and Caleta Olivia, prompting preventive sanitary protocols by Argentina’s authorities, including Senasa. No definitive cause yet; laboratories are analyzing samples. A leading hypothesis is highly pathogenic avian influenza, in line with WOAH and FAO warnings about avian flu outbreaks affecting wild birds and marine mammals, but results are not conclusive. Other factors under investigation include changes in ocean currents, reduced prey availability, marine pollution, and climate-change–related impacts that could stress penguin populations and alter feeding patterns. The Magellanic penguin is a key ecological indicator in Patagonia, with Punta Tombo hosting large colonies. Scientists urge caution and continued monitoring as investigations proceed.

triage.headline_ja: パタゴニアが世界が聞くべき警告を発出：海岸に死んだペンギンが漂着し、科学者らが警戒態勢
triage.triage_reason: 高病原性鳥インフルエンザの疑いで複数の基準に該当するが、アルゼンチンはWPRO対象国外であり、検査結果が未確定で情報が限定的なため、経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが Philippines と United States を発生地域に含めているが、記事サマリーを読むと実際の死亡事象はアルゼンチン（パタゴニア地域）で発生している。Philippines と Arizona はメタデータの誤検出と判断される。アルゼンチンは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空配列。高病原性鳥インフルエンザ疑いでありながら確定診断なしの状況が特徴。WPRO地域外の事象であるため PICKUP ではなく WATCH 判定。

article.articleHeadline: Agências respondem a riscos do ebola em maternidades, fronteiras e zonas de conflito
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Agencies respond to Ebola risks in maternity wards, borders and conflict zones.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has reached 896 confirmed cases and 232 deaths across 33 health zones in three provinces as of June 19, 2026. Bunia is among the hardest hit, with the WHO stating the situation remains grave and evolving. Mortality among pregnant women with Ebola there reaches 90%, with perinatal mortality at 100% in some locations; UNFPA supports infection prevention, hygiene, waste management, and PPE for high-fluid births. The International Organization for Migration notes the outbreak is spreading along Africa's active cross-border corridor, with over 1 million border health screenings and more than 110 entry points; IOM plans to expand operations in DRC and Uganda. UNHCR reports over 2 million internally displaced people in risk areas, including more than 320,000 refugees, with recent arrivals from Mbau near Beni highlighting fear and misinformation.

triage.headline_ja: 機関がマタニティ病棟、国境、紛争地帯のエボラリスクに対応
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準5つすべてに該当。DRCでのエボラ大規模流行で896確定例、232死亡、高い妊産婦死亡率(90%)、国境を越えた拡大リスク、複数国への人道支援展開が必要。
triage.notes: 大規模エボラ流行。DRCで896確定例、232死亡、33の保健ゾーン、3州に拡大。妊産婦死亡率90%（周産期死亡率100%の地域あり）。国境沿いに拡大し、110以上の検査ポイント、120万人以上の国境保健スクリーニングが実施。200万人以上の国内避難民、32万人以上の難民が影響地域にいる。複数の国連機関（WHO、UNFPA、IOM、UNHCR）が対応に当たっている。紛争地帯での管理が課題。

article.articleHeadline: Advierte OMS rápida expansión del brote de ébola en Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO warns of rapid spread of the Ebola outbreak in Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues to expand rapidly, with Ituri province accounting for over 90% of confirmed infections. The Bundibugyo strain is involved, and the outbreak was officially declared on May 15. To date, 896 cases and 232 deaths have been reported, with 21 new cases in the last 24 hours. The virus has reached North Kivu and South Kivu, where security and humanitarian crises complicate response. Despite challenges, response capacity has improved: more than 500 treatment beds, about 400 daily surveillance alerts, and over 2,000 tests conducted. Contact tracing now covers 75% of identified contacts, with a target of 95%. Transmission occurs via direct contact with bodily fluids; safe burials and rapid contact tracing are crucial. In Uganda, 19 cases and 2 deaths, with no new cases in 12 days. WHO remains vigilant for regional spread.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴにおけるエボラ出血熱の急速な拡大を警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱は深刻な公衆衛生上の影響を持つ異常で予想外のイベントであり、既に地域的拡大（ウガンダへの波及）とそれに伴う国際的な貿易・渡航制限のリスクを示唆している。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはUganda（226074）が含まれていますが、サマリーではウガンダはセカンダリーケース地域として言及されており、主たる発生地はDRCです。DRCが対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に DRC のみを記載しました。本イベントはエボラ出血熱（PHEIC候補）であり、既に 896 例、232 死亡が報告され、Bundibugyo 株の関与を示唆。セキュリティおよび人道危機が対応を複雑化させており、国際的な懸念が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Над 70 медици са заразени с ебола от началото на епидемията - Новини от Dnes.bg
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Over 70 healthcare workers have been infected with Ebola since the beginning of the epidemic - News from Dnes.bg.
article.articleSummary: As of June 19, 2026, over 75 healthcare workers have been infected with Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo since the outbreak began, with 17 deaths, according to the WHO via Reuters. The epidemic was first declared on May 15, but transmission is believed to have occurred for months beforehand, exposing many clinicians before awareness of the disease. Healthcare capacity is strained, with shortages of basic PPE such as gloves and masks. WHO Emergency Director Mari Rozlin Belizer said Congo has one of the lowest health-worker densities globally, at about 11 per 10,000 people. In response, China and Uganda are sending additional medical teams to bolster the response. WHO is also providing psychological support to medics distressed by seeing colleagues fall ill.

triage.headline_ja: エボラに感染した医療従事者が70人以上 - 流行開始以来
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、予想外の医療従事者感染の高さ、国際的拡大のリスク、国際対応の必要性）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数該当。フルRRAに進める必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づくと、主要な発生地はDRCであり、医療従事者感染75人以上、死亡17人という深刻な状況。ChinaとUgandaが医療支援を送付中。Ugandaは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。2026年6月のイベントであり、進行中の大規模流行と判定される。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola v Konžskej demokratickej republike sa rýchlo šíri, varuje WHO
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is spreading rapidly, WHO warns.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) is spreading rapidly, per WHO on 19 June 2026. The outbreak has 232 confirmed deaths and 896 confirmed cases since the May 15 declaration, with 21 new cases in the last 24 hours. The disease is caused by the Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain, for which no vaccine exists. The situation is severe and evolving quickly, with over 90% of cases in Ituri province in the northeast, and spread to North Kivu and South Kivu. Ebola bed capacity has risen from zero to over 500; laboratories are conducting more than 2,000 tests daily. Contact tracing covers about 75% of contacts; WHO says at least 95% is needed to halt transmission. Uganda has 19 cases and 2 deaths, though no new Ugandan cases have been reported in the past 12 days.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラが急速に拡大、WHOが警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当する重大な感染症集団発生。232人の死亡、896確認患者、複数州への急速拡大、ワクチン未開発株による感染継続中。フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの国際的拡大も確認されているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には DRC のみ列挙。Bundibugyo ebolavirus 株はワクチン未開発で、接触者追跡カバー率が目標75%に対し95%必要との WHO 指摘は管理可能性の課題を示唆。2026年6月時点の情報であり、発生は進行中と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: 80 Hospitalised In Maha's Bhiwandi After Eating At Roadside Stall, Food Poisoning Suspected
article.articleSummary: 80 people hospitalised in Bhiwandi, Maharashtra, with suspected food poisoning after dining at roadside stall 'Famous Shawarma' in Khandupada on June 17 after 6 p.m. By June 19, all patients were admitted to Indira Gandhi Memorial (IGM) Hospital; 8 children among them. Affected individuals include men and women, presenting with vomiting, diarrhoea, stomach pain, and some fever. They have received injections, IV drips, and antibiotics; all are stable, none critical. An additional 24 patients were admitted late Thursday night. Vomit and stool samples from some patients have been sent for laboratory testing. Police indicate a link to the stall and note some patrons took packets home. The investigation is ongoing, with no confirmed pathogen reported yet.

triage.headline_ja: マハラシュトラ州ビワンディで路上屋台での食事後80人が入院、食中毒の疑い
triage.triage_reason: 食中毒の疑いにより局所的な公衆衛生上の懸念があるが、現在のところ国際的拡大の可能性や重篤度の明確な証拠に乏しく、情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 104人の患者が報告され、検査中の状態。未確認の病原体であり、単一の露出源（路上屋台）に関連。重篤な症例が報告されていない現在の段階では国際的な懸念は低いが、病原体の特定待ちで継続監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola provoca la muerte de 17 trabajadores sanitarios en RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola kills 17 health workers in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), declared May 15, has reached about 900 infections with over 230 confirmed deaths. The World Health Organization reports 75 health workers infected and 17 killed (roughly 20.4% case fatality among this group). Psychological support, training, and personal protective equipment are being provided to frontline staff amid a critical health-worker shortage in the DRC. Ebola is a severe, often fatal disease caused by viruses in the Orthoebolavirus genus (family Filoviridae); three species drive large outbreaks: Ebola virus, Sudan virus, and Bundibugyo virus. Natural hosts are frugivorous bats (Pteropodidae). Transmission to humans occurs via close contact with blood, secretions, organs, or other bodily fluids of infected animals or humans, with infectiousness during symptomatic illness and while the virus is present in blood.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがコンゴ民主共和国で医療従事者17人の死亡を引き起こす
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。900人以上の感染者と230人以上の確認死亡、医療従事者の高い死亡率（20.4%）により公衆衛生への深刻な影響を示す。エボラウイルスは国際的拡大リスクが高く、渡航・貿易制限のリスクもある。
triage.notes: DRCで5月15日に宣言されたエボラアウトブレイク。900人以上の感染者、230人以上の確認死亡、医療従事者75人感染・17人死亡。医療従事者の死亡率が約20.4%と高く、健康危機管理上の重大な懸念。WHOが報告。すべてのWPRO基準に該当し、フルRRA進行が必須。
