article.articleHeadline: Rabies post exposure risk assessment form and calendar
article.articleSummary: Rabies risk alert: falsified rabies vaccine identified in circulation in India in early 2025, labeled as 'Abhayrab' batch KA24014, with discrepancies in formulation, packaging, labeling, and manufacturing compared with legitimate Abhayrab vaccines. UKHSA is reviewing records of individuals who received rabies vaccine as part of post-exposure treatment in India and is contacting general practitioners if patients may require additional vaccines to complete their post-exposure treatment course. Healthcare professionals worried that a patient may have received the falsified vaccine can contact the UKHSA Rabies and Immunoglobulin Service (RIgS) for further advice. Disease: rabies. Locations: India, United Kingdom (via referral and follow-up). No outbreak numbers are reported. This highlights risks in the vaccine supply chain and the need for post-exposure treatment follow-up.

triage.headline_ja: 狂犬病の暴露後リスク評価フォームおよびカレンダー
triage.triage_reason: インドで流通する偽造狂犬病ワクチンが検出され、英国で暴露後治療を受けた患者の追跡・再ワクチン接種が必要となる公衆衛生上の深刻な問題。国際的な医療供給チェーンリスクを示すシグナル。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、偽造ワクチンの主な発生地はインドであり、英国は暴露後治療を受けた患者の追跡・対応地域として位置付けられている。インドは対象国に含まれるため verified_locations に追加。英国は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。医療供給チェーンの完全性に関わる重大な公衆衛生上の懸念。

article.articleHeadline: Патник од Малдиви донесе зика вирус во Македонија, се инфицирал од комарец
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A passenger from the Maldives brought the Zika virus to Macedonia, contracting it from a mosquito.
article.articleSummary: Imported Zika virus case in Macedonia: A traveler returning from the Maldives (May 20–28) developed fever, muscle and joint pains, mild fever, and later a body rash during travel. After returning, the Virology Department of the Institute of Public Health confirmed Zika infection. The patient was not hospitalized and is recovering at home, currently in good health. Authorities describe it as an imported case and say there is no immediate public health concern. However, with increased travel to tropical destinations such as the Maldives, Thailand, Indonesia, Brazil, and Caribbean nations, additional cases among travelers could occur. The Institute of Public Health urges travelers to tropical regions to use mosquito bite protection and follow official health guidance.

triage.headline_ja: モルドバからの旅行者がジカウイルスをマケドニアに持ち込む、蚊に感染
triage.triage_reason: 輸入症例1例の報告で、現地での公衆衛生上の直接的な脅威は限定的。ただし、熱帯地域への旅行増加に伴う追加症例の発生リスクが指摘されており、情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はマケドニア（対象国ではない）への輸入症例報告。発生地域リストに含まれるBrazil、Indonesia、Thailandは旅行リスク要因として言及されているが、これらの国での新規発生は記事サマリーに明示されていない。マケドニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。IHR基準は2つ該当するが、確認症例が1例で重症度も低く、医療管理可能であるため、本格的なRRA前の経過観察段階が適切と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : le gouvernement déploie neuf centres de traitement
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: the government deploys nine treatment centers.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) progresses with nine treatment centers now operational across affected areas, totaling 500 beds, and mobile laboratories capable of analyzing up to 2,000 samples per day to speed detection. Debriefing in Bunia on June 18 by Health Minister Samuel Famba and partners highlighted these measures as central to the response. After 33 days since the official declaration, the outbreak has 896 confirmed cases and 232 deaths (case fatality rate 26%), with 78 recoveries. The epidemic now spans 33 health zones nationwide, including 20 in Ituri, which accounts for about 91% of cases. More than 6,000 contacts are under surveillance. About $50 million has been mobilized with partners to fund treatment centers, mobile labs, and epidemiological surveillance teams. Despite gains, resistance to prevention and care persists in some areas; greater community engagement is needed.

triage.headline_ja: DRCでのエボラ：政府が9つの治療センターを展開
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。エボラウイルス病は極めて重大な感染症であり、896例の確定患者と232例の死亡（致死率26%）、複数の保健ゾーンへの拡大が確認され、国際的懸念事項となる。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病は極めて深刻な感染症。896確定患者、232死亡、致死率26%、33の保健ゾーンに拡大。政府は積極的な対応（9つの治療センター、500床、移動検査室、接触者6,000人以上の監視）を実施中。約5,000万ドルが動員されている。地域住民の一部で予防・治療への抵抗が報告されており、コミュニティ参加の強化が課題。DRCはアフリカにおける対象国であり、国際的支援が必要な重大な公衆衛生上の脅威である。

article.articleHeadline: В Конго расследуют десятки смертей в лагере на фоне угрозы Эболы
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Congo, dozens of deaths in a camp are under investigation amid the threat of Ebola.
article.articleSummary: At least 30 people have died since early May in the Kigonze camp for internally displaced persons in Bunia, Ituri Province, northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, amid fears of Ebola virus disease (EVD) spread. Deceased individuals showed symptoms typical of Ebola, including fever, headache, and vomiting, but laboratory confirmation has not yet been obtained as patients and relatives previously declined testing until recently. Bunia is identified as the epicenter of Congo’s Ebola outbreak, raising concerns about transmission to more than 5 million internally displaced people in the eastern region. The situation is under investigation, with authorities describing the mortality as unprecedented and stressing the need for testing, surveillance, and rapid public health measures to prevent wider spread.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ脅威の中、難民キャンプでの数十人の死亡が調査対象に
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。エボラウイルス疾患の疑い症例集積、確認されていない病原体による高い死亡率、地域内での大規模な脆弱人口（国内避難民500万人以上）、国際拡大リスクが明白。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス疾患の疑い症例が集積している。検査確認がまだ得られていないが、典型的な症状（発熱、頭痛、嘔吐）が報告されている。難民キャンプという脆弱な人口集団での発生で、国内避難民500万人以上への拡大リスクが高い。ブニアはコンゴのエボラ流行の震源地とされており、国際的な支援と迅速な対応が必要な状況。

article.articleHeadline: Прв случај на Зика вирус во Македонија, заразениот бил на Малдиви | GPRESS.
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: First case of Zika virus in Macedonia, the infected person had been to the Maldives | GPRESS..
article.articleSummary: First confirmed Zika virus infection in Macedonia; imported case. On 17 June 2026, the Institute for Public Health’s Virology Department reported a positive Zika result to the Epidemiology of Infectious Diseases unit. The patient had been in the Maldives (May 20–28, 2026), where mosquito bites were reported. Symptoms began May 24: fever, myalgia and arthralgia, with a fine rash appearing four days later. After return, he was assessed at the Clinic for Infectious Diseases; dengue was initially suspected. Lab testing for dengue, Zika and chikungunya yielded positive Zika serology and PCR. The patient was managed as an outpatient and is in good health. The Institute considers population risk low but warns of potential further imported cases due to travel to tropical destinations (Maldives, Thailand, Indonesia, Brazil, Caribbean). Aedes albopictus in Europe may enable transmission; travelers should use repellents, wear long sleeves/pants, nets, and avoid outdoor activity at peak mosquito hours.

triage.headline_ja: マケドニアで初のジカウイルス感染確認、患者はモルドバを訪問
triage.triage_reason: 輸入症例（単一患者）であり、地域内流行リスクは低いと当局が評価。ただし複数のベクター媒介性感染症（Zika、Chikungunya、Dengue）の同時検査報告があり、アエデスの分布拡大と国際的な旅行リスクが存在するため経過観察を要する。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はマケドニアの初輸入症例だが、対象国リストに該当する国はない（North MacedoniaおよびMaldivesは対象外）。ただし患者の曝露地（Maldives）および警告対象地域（Thailand、Indonesia、Brazil）が記事に明示されているため、これら対象国を verified_locations に含める。地域検証では、実際の感染イベント発生地はマケドニア（非対象国）だが、旅行リスク警告の対象として対象国が言及されている。

article.articleHeadline: Mais de 70 profissionais de saúde foram infectados pelo ebola desde início do surto, diz OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 70 healthcare workers have been infected with Ebola since the start of the outbreak, says WHO.
article.articleSummary: As of June 19, 2026, Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has infected 75 healthcare workers and caused 17 deaths since the outbreak began. The outbreak is believed to have circulated for months before it was officially declared on May 15, underscoring early exposure of medical staff. Basic PPE stocks, including gloves and masks, are running low, worsening an already fragile health system with about 11 health workers per 10,000 people. China and Uganda are sending medical teams to bolster the response, while the WHO is providing psychological support to healthcare workers distressed after many colleagues fell ill. WHO emergency chief Marie Roseline Belizaire spoke via videoconference from eastern DRC highlighting the strain on health services.

triage.headline_ja: WHOによると、エボラ感染者数が70人を超える医療従事者が感染、アウトブレイク開始以来
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPRO基準5項目すべてに該当。エボラは国際的に極めて重大な脅威であり、複数国での対応と国際支援が進行中。
triage.notes: Ugandaは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。DRCがアウトブレイクの主要発生地であり、Chinaは医療チーム派遣による対応国として記事に明記されている。医療従事者75人の感染、17名の死亡、基本的PPE不足、複数国による医療チーム派遣などからWHO通知相当のシグナル確実。

article.articleHeadline: Iz bolnice oteta devojčica (6) obolela od ebole: ''Veoma besni'' muškarci odvezli nju i njenu majku, zdravstveni centri sve više meta napada tokom epidemije
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A 6-year-old girl sick with Ebola abducted from a hospital: "Very angry" men took her and her mother away, health centers increasingly targeted by attacks during the epidemic.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-19, Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo continues, with more than 890 confirmed cases and at least 230 deaths. The virus is Bundibugyo, for which there is currently no vaccine. The hardest-hit regions are Ituri, South Kivu, and North Kivu. In neighboring Uganda, 19 cases have been reported (2 deaths), with no new cases since June 5. Authorities have intensified surveillance, contact tracing, and treatment capacity; the World Health Organization has allocated $3.9 million for the response. In Butembo, armed men abducted a six-year-old girl with Ebola and her mother from a hospital on June 15; they later presented at an Ebola treatment center about 18 km away, and their condition is stable. Attacks on health facilities and distrust of centers hinder control efforts, as clashes with the M23 insurgency continue.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ患者の6歳女児が病院から奪取される：「非常に怒った」男たちが彼女と母親を連れ去る、流行中に医療センターがますます攻撃対象に
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響：890症例230死亡、国際拡大リスク：ウガンダでの症例確認、予想外の阻害要因：武装勢力による患者奪取と医療施設攻撃）。WPRO基準も複数該当し、国際的関心が高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダも地理的に記事に言及されているが、サマリーの焦点はコンゴ民主共和国の発生地域（イツリ州、南キブ州、北キブ州、ブテンボ）での流行の主管理。ウガンダの19症例は境界接触による二次的なケースと位置付けられており、本流行の主体はDRC。Bundibugyo ebola virus（ワクチン未開発）による深刻な流行、武装勢力による医療施設攻撃と患者奪取による制御困難性が顕著。

article.articleHeadline: Risks of Ebola among displaced people in DR Congo remain high: UN
article.articleSummary: DR Congo faces high Ebola risk among over 2 million displaced people as the outbreak expands in Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu; Ituri accounts for about 95% of cases. As of a situation update issued late June 18, 2026, 896 laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases and 232 deaths have been reported across 31 health zones in Congo. Uganda reports 19 cases and 2 deaths; none of the confirmed cases were refugees. UNHCR warns that population movements—including about 2,250 people recently travelling to Oicha from Mbau near Beni—raise transmission risks and stress response resources. The agency stresses aligning public health with protection, countering misinformation, and engaging community leaders to maintain trust and access to care. UNHCR has appealed for $14 million for Ebola preparedness and response from July–November in Congo, Uganda, and neighboring Burundi, Rwanda, and South Sudan as part of an inter-agency effort.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国における避難民の間のエボラ出血熱リスクは高い状態が続く：国連
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の確認済み多数症例（896例、死亡232例）、複数地域での活動的な流行、国際的な拡大（ウガンダで確認）、および脆弱な人口（200万人以上の避難民）への高いリスクがIHR基準4つすべてに該当。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は最重症度の感染症。記事はDRC内での流行の拡大とウガンダでの確認症例について述べている。発生地域にはスーダン、ルワンダ、ウガンダ、ブルンジが含まれているが、サマリーの主題はDRCでの流行拡大と避難民への高リスク。ウガンダでの19症例は二次的な拡大として報告されているが、主要な発生地はDRCである。国際支援の必要性は明示されており（$14百万の資金要請）、複数国にまたがる地域対応が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: केरल में शिगेला के 10 और मामले सामने आए हैं, कुल संक्रमितों की संख्या 120 हुई
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ten more Shigella cases reported in Kerala, total infections reach 120.
article.articleSummary: Kerala reports 10 more Shigella cases, bringing June's total to 120 and 196 cases year-to-date, with five deaths this month. New cases: Kozhikode 3; Thiruvananthapuram 2; Thrissur 2; Malappuram 2; Palakkad 1. Shigella, a rapidly spreading bacterial infection from contaminated food, water, or sanitation lapses, typically causes diarrhea, fever, and abdominal cramps. The June surge accounts for most of the year’s cases. Separately, three Nipah-exposed patients at Kozhikode Medical College Hospital have been discharged; no suspected Nipah infections remain under hospital surveillance, though one Nipah-infected patient remains on life support. Nipah is a virus transmitted from animals to humans and can spread via close contact.

triage.headline_ja: ケーララ州でシガ菌10例が追加報告、感染者数は120人に
triage.triage_reason: Shigella感染の集団発生が報告されており、スクリーニング基準（異常性、重症度、流行性）を複数満たす。ただし、記事の主題はShiellaであり、Nipahは二次的情報（既に終息段階）のため、現時点では継続的な経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事はShigella（細菌性赤痢）の集団発生が主題で、6月単月で120例、年間196例、死者5名を報告。食糧水汚染と不衛生環境による急速な感染拡大が指摘されており、公開衛生への影響および流行リスクは高い。Nipahに関する記述は、既存患者の退院・経過観察終了と、一例の人工呼吸器装着患者の継続治療にとどまり、新規感染の報告はない。ケーララ州の複数地区（コーチン、ティルヴァナンタプラム、スルール、マラプラムなど）での広域分布と5月開始の高い感染数から、IHR基準2つとWPRO基準4つを満たす。国際拡大リスクと渡航制限リスクは現時点では低いが、衛生環境改善の課題と継続的な監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: CIA Official Confirms Sudden Shift in COVID-19 Origin Assessment
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 origin assessment by the CIA shifted from favoring a laboratory source to a neutral stance, according to a newly released document. CIA analysts had believed the virus originated from a high-level laboratory in Wuhan, China, near where the first cases were detected in 2019. The agency reversed its position over five days in 2021 after an encounter with a person or exposure to new information, the document states. Senior CIA officer James Erdman III told lawmakers in May that the change was precipitated by that encounter/information. The document's release confirms the abrupt pivot and highlights that the Wuhan-lab linkage was part of the earlier assessment, not the final conclusion.

triage.headline_ja: CIA高官がCOVID-19起源評価の急激な転換を確認
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はCIA評価の政治的・歴史的変化についての報道であり、現在の感染症イベント（新規発生、流行、アウトブレイク）ではなく、過去の起源論争の文書公開に関するものである。公衆衛生上の現在の脅威や流行状況に関する新規情報ではない。
triage.notes: 本記事は2019年の過去のCOVID-19起源に関するCIA評価の方針転換についての政治報道であり、現在の感染症イベント検知システムの対象外である。社会的・政治的関心は存在するが、シグナルトリアージの対象となる現在の公衆衛生上の脅威ではない。

article.articleHeadline: جمهورية الكونغو الديمقراطية: كيف يكافح العاملون في مجال الرعاية الصحية الإيبولا؟
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo: How are healthcare workers fighting Ebola?
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak centered in Bunia, the capital of Ituri province in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, remains the most severely affected area. Frontline healthcare workers are described as increasingly overwhelmed as they confront an outbreak described as unprecedented in scale. The report emphasizes the intense strain on medical teams fighting Ebola amid scarce details on case counts, fatalities, symptoms, or laboratory confirmation within Ituri. It provides no information on infection sources or on imported/exported cases. The narrative underscores the ongoing, deadly challenge of Ebola in Ituri, with Bunia at the epicenter of response efforts, as of 2026-06-19.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：医療従事者はどのようにしてエボラと戦っているのか？
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4/4該当、WPRO基準で5/5該当。エボラ出血熱の流行は重篤な公衆衛生上の影響、異常な規模、国際的拡大リスク、医療体制の崩壊の可能性を示唆している。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱の流行は「前例のない規模」と報道されており、医療従事者が極度に疲弊している状況が報告されている。イトゥリ州ブニアが流行の中心地。ただし具体的な患者数、死亡者数、確認事例数の詳細情報が記事に不足している。フルのRRA実施が推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: Over 16.4 lakh persons screened for TB in Delhi since December 2024: Govt
article.articleSummary: Delhi reported progress under the TB Mukt Bharat Abhiyan 2.0, with over 16.4 lakh vulnerable individuals screened since December 2024, including 7.4 lakh chest X-rays and 3.5 lakh NAAT tests. TB preventive treatment coverage reached 45% (national average 29%), and upfront NAAT testing stood at 88% (national 83%). The campaign ran 1,953 Ayushman Arogya camps (Mar 24–Jun 15), including 486 in high-risk wards and 149 in congregate settings, screening over 3.19 lakh people. Outcomes included more than 2.03 lakh chest X-rays, 70,070 NAATs, and 26,761 TB patient notifications. Ni-kshay Mitras distributed 16,096 food baskets to TB patients; 203 MPs/MLAs/councillors participated in Jan Bhagidari activities. Nikshay Poshan Yojana disbursed over Rs 36 crore to more than 65,900 beneficiaries. Focus remains on stronger referrals, expanded screening and preventive treatment, and enhanced Centre-state collaboration.

triage.headline_ja: 2024年12月以来、デリーでTB患者164万人以上がスクリーニング実施：政府発表
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はインド政府のTB制御プログラム（TB Mukt Bharat Abhiyan 2.0）の進捗報告であり、公衆衛生施策の成功事例である。新規発生や異常な疾患クラスター、国際的拡大リスク、重症度の急増など、シグナルトリアージの対象となるような緊急の感染症イベント（新規の流行兆候、管理不能な感染拡大、予期しない疾患発生）の報告ではない。
triage.notes: 本記事は既知の結核感染症の定期的な公衆衛生キャンペーン進捗報告である。スクリーニング数、検査結果、予防治療カバレッジなどの指標は良好な管理を示唆し、危機管理シグナルには該当しない。ルーチン監視対象ではあるが、シグナルトリアージレベルでのピックアップ対象ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Un nuevo test portátil detectará la tuberculosis en menos de una hora para mejorar el diagnóstico de la enfermedad infecciosa que más mata
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A new portable test will detect tuberculosis in less than an hour to improve the diagnosis of the deadliest infectious disease.
article.articleSummary: TB near-point-of-care molecular test will deliver results in under one hour, expanding to 13 countries—Benin, Cameroon, Ethiopia, Kenya, Nigeria, South Africa, Uganda, Zambia, Bangladesh, Indonesia, Philippines, Vietnam, and Peru—over 12 months with three million tests. Led by The Global Fund to Fight AIDS, TB and Malaria, with CIFF and implemented by Institute Aurum, the portable, battery-powered devices are designed for primary care and rural clinics, including tongue-swab sampling for patients who cannot produce sputum. The initiative aligns with WHO’s March guidance to use rapid molecular tests as the initial diagnostic tool for adults and adolescents with pulmonary TB, replacing traditional sputum smear microscopy. Device cost is about $355; per-test cost around $3.60 (versus approx. $8 for centralized tests), enabling faster treatment initiation and reducing the diagnostic gap (46% of patients lack access; ~2.4M TB cases undiagnosed). Note: cannot assess drug resistance on day one; positive cases require further testing (e.g., GeneXpert).

triage.headline_ja: 新しいポータブルテストが1時間以内に結核を検出し、感染症の診断を改善
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は結核診断技術の展開に関するニュースであり、疾病の流行や危機ではなく、診断ツール普及のポジティブなイニシアティブについての報道である。IHR基準およびWPRO基準の該当がないため、シグナルではなく経過観察対象。
triage.notes: 本イベントは結核診断技術の新規展開（Global Fund主導の診断ツール普及キャンペーン）についての報道であり、新規感染症流行やアウトブレイク、危機的状況ではない。記事内で言及される対象国のうち、評価対象国は4カ国（ザンビア、インドネシア、フィリピン、ベトナム）。社会的関心はあるが、医療インターベンション記事のため感染症危機としてのシグナル性はない。

article.articleHeadline: Assam: 2 Deaths Due to Japanese Encephalitis Recorded in Barpeta
article.articleSummary: On 2026-06-19, two people died of Japanese Encephalitis in Barpeta district, Assam, as monsoon-driven transmission rises. Health authorities confirm infections, with at least four people in Barpeta testing positive. The deceased are Subhash Chandra Baishya (Gorotari village, Chenga) and Jahidul Islam (Pakabetbari village, Bhawanipur). Officials have intensified surveillance and preventive measures, including fogging and expanded medical outreach. Residents are urged to avoid stagnant water, use mosquito nets, and maintain proper hygiene. Japanese Encephalitis is a mosquito-borne viral brain infection and remains a recurring challenge in Assam during the rainy season, with ongoing monitoring as cases are tracked.

triage.headline_ja: アッサム州: バルペタでの日本脳炎による2人の死亡が記録される
triage.triage_reason: インド（アッサム州バルペタ地区）で日本脳炎による死亡が確認され、既に4人以上の陽性者が報告されている。異常/予想外性、重症度（死亡例あり）、流行の可能性（雨季の蚊媒介増加）が複数の基準に該当し、IHR基準2つ以上に適合するため。
triage.notes: アッサム州バルペタ地区での日本脳炎事案。雨季による蚊媒介感染の増加が背景。当局による監視強化と予防措置が実施中。インド国内での季節的な周期疾患であるが、死亡例と複数の陽性確認により医公衆衛生上の関心事項として識別。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: The real reason a hantavirus disaster was averted - AOL
article.articleSummary: Hantavirus outbreak near MV Hondius was averted through rapid cross-continental public health coordination. On Ascension Island, a sick passenger prompted diagnostic testing that ruled out common causes. A cross-meeting involving Ascension, the UK Overseas Territories programme infection doctor, the ship’s medical adviser, and a colleague from South Africa’s National Institute for Communicable Diseases traced samples from medevaced cases to hantavirus in South Africa. Diagnosis triggered WHO and national public health responses, preventing the ship from continuing to Cape Verde and stopping potential international spread by passengers incubating the virus. The UKOT programme, funded by the Foreign Office and run by UKHSA, is highlighted for its lean, communicative model in supporting vulnerable UKOT health services. Separately, Dr. Brian Jones notes ongoing risks in DRC and Uganda's Batwa pygmies amid Bundibugyo Ebola, a variant with no approved vaccine or specific treatment, underscoring global inequities in access to public health measures.

triage.headline_ja: ハンタウイルスの大惨事が回避された本当の理由 - AOL
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で異常性・予想外性と国際的拡大リスクが該当（2つ以上）。ハンタウイルスの船上での診断と国際的な多機関連携による災害回避、ならびにコンゴとウガンダのBundibugyo Ebola継続リスクが組み合わさっており、公衆衛生上の重要性が高い。
triage.notes: 記事はハンタウイルスの船上での事例とDRC・ウガンダのBundibugyo Ebola継続リスクを報道。Ascension Island（英領海外領土）での診断とSouth Africa国立感染症研究所との国際連携が報告されているが、実際の感染確認地はサウスアフリカに限定される情報。ただしDRCとウガンダのEbola流行継続が別途記載されており、DRCは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。船舶由来の国際的拡大リスク、ワクチン未承認のBundibugyo variant存在、公衆衛生格差の強調により、PICKUP判定とする。

article.articleHeadline: Alarm iz Afrike: Ebola se širi među zdravstvenim radnicima
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Alarm from Africa: Ebola is spreading among healthcare workers.
article.articleSummary: 75 health workers infected with Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda, with 17 deaths, as WHO warns of a worsening outbreak. As of one month after declaration, total confirmed cases reach 896 and 232 deaths. Of 177 clinics surveyed, only four initially had capacity and protective equipment to safeguard all staff. Only about 10% of infections exhibit Ebola-typical symptoms, notably bleeding, leading to delayed care for diseases such as malaria and increased transmission risk within households and small clinics. It is unclear whether many infections occurred at work or in private life. WHO is supplying gloves and protective clothing and training healthcare workers to curb spread, focusing on Ituri Province and Bunia in DR Congo, with cross-border concerns for Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカからの警報：エボラがヘルスケアワーカーの間で広がっている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラウイルスによる大規模かつ重症の集団発生で、国際的な拡大リスク（ウガンダへの越境拡大）と、感染対策不備による医療従事者への高い曝露リスクが存在。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーにはウガンダの言及がありますが、サマリーの主要な焦点はDRC（Ituri Province、Bunia）での発生です。ウガンダは越境懸念として言及されているのみで、実際の確認患者・死亡者数の記述がDRCに集中しているため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとしました。エボラ出血熱は高い致死率と医療従事者への感染リスクが特徴で、防護具不足による施設内感染の継続リスク、および典型的な出血症状の欠如による診断遅延が大きなリスク要因です。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola gana terreno en África: casos se disparan y preocupa expansión regional - El Imparcial de Oaxaca
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Gains Ground in Africa: Cases Surge and Regional Expansion Raises Concerns
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) continues to expand, with Ituri province the epicenter as transmission accelerates. As of the latest report, 896 confirmed cases and 232 deaths have been recorded, with 21 new infections in the last 24 hours. Declared on May 15, the outbreak involves the Bundibugyo lineage, a rare strain that circulated undetected early on. More than 90% of cases are in Ituri, but transmission has reached North Kivu and South Kivu provinces, where conflict and displacement hinder surveillance and care. International response has grown: over 500 treatment beds established, about 400 alerts daily, and more than 2,000 diagnostic tests per day. Contact tracing monitors 75% of contacts, with a 95% target. Transmission occurs via direct contact with infected bodily fluids; safe burials are reinforced. In Uganda, 19 cases and 2 deaths, with 10 recovered; no new cases in 12 days; cross-border risk persists.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカでエボラが勢いを増す：症例数が急増し、地域拡大が懸念される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当：エボラウイルスは極めて高い致死率で公衆衛生への深刻な影響を及ぼし、複数国への国際的拡大が既に発生しており、渡航・貿易制限のリスクが高い。また、WPRO基準でも異常性・重症度・管理可能性が全て該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダでも19症例・2死亡が記録されているが、記事サマリーの主たる焦点はDRCの発生状況であり、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations に含めない。エボラは WHO緊急事態宣言対象疾患であり、複数州での同時伝播、紛争地域での対応困難、国際的な治療体制整備など、全てのシグナル基準を満たす。

article.articleHeadline: قلق بالغ إزاء المخاطر التي يشكلها الإيبولا على مجتمعات النازحين في الكونغو الديمقراطية وخارجها
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Serious concern over the risks posed by Ebola to displaced communities in the Democratic Republic of Congo and beyond.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo strain Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo raises serious concerns for displaced communities and host populations across the region. As of June 17, 2026, UNHCR reports 896 confirmed Ebola cases and 232 deaths across 31 health zones in DRC, with Uganda reporting 19 cases and two deaths. No infections have yet been recorded among refugees, but transmission risk among internally displaced people remains high, with over two million people displaced inside DRC, including more than 320,000 refugees, living in outbreak-affected areas. Cross-border movement elevates transmission risk to Uganda, Rwanda, Burundi, Tanzania, and South Sudan. UNHCR is coordinating readiness with governments and WHO, strengthening surveillance and testing, infection prevention, risk communication, and WASH services at refugee-hosting areas and border crossings. The agency seeks $14 million for July–November to support displaced and host communities in DRC and Uganda and enhance preparedness in Burundi, Rwanda, and South Sudan.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国およびその周辺の国内避難民コミュニティに対するエボラ出血熱がもたらすリスクについて深刻な懸念
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準において4項目すべてに該当。Bundibugyo株エボラ出血熱の大規模発生（896確定例、232死亡）、複数国への国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダで既に19例報告、ルワンダ、ブルンジ、タンザニア、南スーダンへの越境感染リスク高い）、深刻な公衆衛生影響を認める。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで確認されたエボラ発生地は民主共和国（DRC）および対象国リストに含まれるウガンダ。しかし、主題のイベント（Bundibugyo株エボラ発生）はDRCで発生しており、ウガンダで報告された19例はDRCでの流行に起因する越境感染。verified_locationsはサマリーの主題である実際の発生地に限定しDRCのみを列挙。隣接国への拡大リスク（ルワンダ、ブルンジ、タンザニア、南スーダン）は地理的記載であり、実発生地ではない。UNHCRが1400万ドルの支援を求めており、国際的関心および管理困難性が極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: The real reason a hantavirus disaster was averted
article.articleSummary: On Ascension Island, an astute clinician identified a cluster of hantavirus on the MV Hondius, using newly developed diagnostics to rule out common causes. A cross-continental review—Ascension, the UK Overseas Territories infection doctor, the ship’s medical adviser, and a NICD colleague who traced samples medevaced to South Africa—led to hantavirus confirmation. This diagnosis alerted the World Health Organization and national public health bodies and prevented a wider outbreak by stopping the ship before it reached Cape Verde; passengers incubating hantavirus would have dispersed homeward. The piece contrasts this success with the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda’s Batwa pygmies, noting no approved vaccine or specific treatment for that variant. It emphasizes global health inequities and credits the UKOTs programme’s close communication and service strengthening as critical to outbreak aversion.

triage.headline_ja: ハンタウイルス災害が回避された本当の理由
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。ハンタウイルスの船舶クラスタが検出され、WHOおよび各国公衆衛生機関が関与した多国間対応が実施されており、アウトブレイク回避に至った重要な事例。DRCでのブンディブギョ型エボラとの対比で健康格差が浮き彫りになっている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはアセンション島（英国領土）での船舶内ハンタウイルスクラスタの検出と、WHOおよび国際的な公衆衛生対応を中心に述べている。記事はDRC・ウガンダのブンディブギョ型エボラとの対比を通じて健康格差を強調しており、DRCは対象国に含まれるため verified_locations に含める。南アフリカ、ケープベルデ、ウガンダは発生地域リストに含まれるが、記事サマリーでは主題のイベント発生地として直接述べられていない（対比・背景情報として言及）ため、厳密には除外する。ただし、サマリー上「ハンタウイルスはアセンション島で船舶上で検出」「ケープベルデ到着前に船を停止」と述べられており、ケープベルデへの拡大リスク回避が明記されている。しかし対象国リスト外であるため除外。DRCのエボラについては明示的に述べられているため DRC を含める。

article.articleHeadline: مرگ ۳۰ نفر در اردوگاه آوارگان کنگو نگرانی‌ها از گسترش سریع ابولا را افزایش داده است
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 30 deaths in a refugee camp in Congo have raised concerns about the rapid spread of Ebola.
article.articleSummary: 30 people have died in Kigunze refugee camp near Bunia, Ituri province, Democratic Republic of Congo, since early May, raising alarms about rapid Ebola spread. Victims showed fever, headache, and vomiting—symptoms consistent with Ebola—but exact causes remain unconfirmed as families refused testing for living patients and the deceased through May 28. Kigunze hosts more than 15,000 residents, with the wider eastern Congo refugee population exceeding five million, where scarce health services and poor sanitation could accelerate transmission. Five samples have been collected and await results. Earlier Ebola deaths have been reported in another Ituri camp; Ituri accounts for the majority of Congo’s confirmed cases. Aid workers warn that reduced funding for water, sanitation, and health programs worsens outbreak control. The outbreak was declared on 25 Ordibehest, amid rising mortality in the camp.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴの難民キャンプで30人が死亡、エボラの急速な拡大への懸念が高まる
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の疑い事例が難民キャンプで発生し、死亡者30名、15,000人以上の密集した人口、検査確認前の状態、国際的拡大リスク、及び管理能力の不足が確認されるため、IHR基準3つ以上及びWPRO基準5つ全て該当。
triage.notes: 記事はペルシャ語配信だが、サマリーから検査未確認のエボラ疑い例の集団発生が明確に述べられている。難民キャンプという高リスク環境での死亡者数の増加、検査拒否による確認遅延、地域内の広大な難民人口（500万人以上）が国際的懸念を高めている。5検体の採取と結果待機中。確定診断前であるが、臨床症状（発熱、頭痛、嘔吐）がエボラと一致し、既知の感染症流行地域（Ituri州）での事例である点が重要。

article.articleHeadline: Агентства ООН предупреждают: угроза Эболы в ДР Конго и соседних странах сохраняется
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: UN agencies warn: the Ebola threat in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and neighboring countries persists.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) persists, expanding to new regions. WHO reports 896 confirmed cases and 232 deaths; 75 health workers infected, 17 dead. About 90% of patients lack hemorrhagic symptoms, delaying diagnosis as some seek self-treatment or traditional healers. Safe burials remain essential to prevent transmission. WHO has deployed 115 specialists and delivered over 110 tons of supplies; diagnostics and care are expanding, though security constraints hinder access and contact tracing. UNFPA warns women and girls are at disproportionate risk; pregnant women face high mortality. In eastern DRC, 153 midwives operate; a 17.1 million-dollar appeal supports reproductive health and protection services. UNHCR reports over 2 million IDPs and 320,000 refugees, with displacement raising spread and distrust of health services (Kipanga camp, Ituri). Regional risk extends to Uganda, Rwanda, Burundi, Tanzania, and South Sudan; IOM expanding operations in DRC and Uganda, including health checks at borders.

triage.headline_ja: 国連機関が警告：コンゴ民主共和国とその隣国におけるエボラの脅威は続いている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病の現在進行中の流行で、232人の死亡、国際的な地域波及リスク、複数国への拡大と渡航制限の可能性がある。フルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが複数の周辺国（スーダン、ルワンダ、タンザニア、ウガンダ、ブルンジ）を発生地域として列挙しているが、記事サマリーは「DRCで流行が継続し、ウガンダ、ルワンダ、ブルンジ、タンザニア、南スーダンへの地域的リスク拡大」と述べている。実際の確認済み症例はDRCのItsuriで報告されており、他国は潜在的リスク地域として言及されているのみ。対象国リストに該当するのはDRC（203312）のみ。スーダン、ルワンダ、タンザニア、ウガンダ、ブルンジは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。2026年6月の日付は将来の日付であるが、記事情報として受け取った。

article.articleHeadline: Truck drivers lead East Africa's Ebola surveillance
article.articleSummary: Heightened Ebola alert in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has shifted focus to long-distance truck drivers who move cargo across East Africa from Nairobi, Kenya, to Uganda, Rwanda, South Sudan and DR Congo. With thousands of trucks daily, drivers at a major Kenyan logistics hub have introduced health protocols to curb transmission, complemented by measures at border crossings regionwide. Changes include avoiding handshakes in favor of fist bumps or waves, and adjusting daily routines to minimize exposure. Kenyan authorities and neighboring states have implemented temperature checks, health screenings, and awareness campaigns at borders. Experts say informed drivers can slow the virus’s spread, while regional health officials stress ongoing training and monitoring. Drivers are increasingly treated as a key part of the first line of defense against Ebola transmission as cross-border cargo continues.

triage.headline_ja: トラック運転手がエボラ出血熱の東アフリカサーベイランスを主導
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱（重篤で国際的拡大リスク高）の検出で、複数の東アフリカ国での国境対策と地域協調対応が報道されており、IHR基準3項目該当（異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。DRコンゴでの発生と複数国への拡大防止の実施例から、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域フィールドにはケニア、ウガンダ、ルワンダ、南スーダン、モザンビークも含まれるが、記事サマリーの主題は『DRコンゴでのエボラ警報による東アフリカ地域への波及と対応』であり、実際の患者発生地点はDRコンゴと特定される。対象国リストに含まれる国はDRコンゴのみであるため、verified_locationsはDRコンゴで確認。ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。記事日付は2026年6月で将来の日付だが、提供されたデータとして処理。

article.articleHeadline: El ECDC insta a los países europeos a reforzar su preparación ante un hipotético caso importado de ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The ECDC urges European countries to bolster their preparedness for a hypothetical imported case of Ebola
article.articleSummary: Ebola preparedness: The European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control published an operational guide for preparation and response to imported Ebola cases, urging EU member states to review procedures. The guide covers entry points, community settings, transport, medical evacuation, and designated isolation hospitals. It follows the Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda that began last May. Although importation and secondary transmission are considered minimal and EU/EEA infection risk remains very low, authorities stress readiness for any eventuality given Ebola's severity. The ECDC is expanding on-the-ground support via the EU Health Working Group, with experts deployed to Africa CDC headquarters in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia, to assist regional response, alongside the DGs for Civil Protection and Humanitarian Aid, International Partnerships, and the GOARN. ECDC maintains routine epidemiological intelligence and coordinates with international health partners and the European Commission to align guidance with evolving conditions.

triage.headline_ja: ECDC、エボラウイルス輸入症例に対する準備の強化をヨーロッパ各国に促す
triage.triage_reason: エボラアウトブレイクはDRC・ウガンダで発生中（IHR基準2つ該当）だが、本記事の主題はEU準備状況であり、対象地域での実際の流行拡大ではない。情報不足により判定を留保。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus アウトブレイクはDRC・ウガンダで発生中だが、記事の主題はEUの準備体制・対応ガイドラインの発行。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations に含めない。EU域内での感染例は報告されておらず、importation risk は minimal と評価されている。DRC でのアウトブレイク情報について、より詳細な疫学情報の継続的な収集が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Congo-Kinshasa: L'exaspération de la population brouille la riposte à l'épidémie d'Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo-Kinshasa: The population's exasperation hampers the response to the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, centered in Ituri province, with 808 confirmed cases and 192 deaths as of June 15, 2026. The Bundibugyo strain has no licensed vaccine or approved treatment. The outbreak was declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17 due to cross-border risk. Infection-prevention capacity in Ituri health facilities averages below 30%. Community anger and eroding trust—driven by years of other crises (malaria, HIV, cholera, malnutrition)—hamper the response, with frontline workers perceived as neglecting broader health needs. Officials call for a holistic approach, engaging religious and traditional leaders and improving water, sanitation, hygiene, security, and management of malaria, measles, Mpox, alongside Ebola. The outbreak began about five months after the end of the previous Ebola outbreak, underscoring the need to rebuild health systems and trust.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ・キンシャサ：人口の不満がエボラ流行への対応を阻害
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。Bundibugyo Ebola株による確認症例808件、死亡192件、国際的懸念の公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）宣言済み、国境を越えたリスク、ワクチン・承認治療なし。
triage.notes: WHOによるPHEIC宣言（2026年5月17日）済み。Bundibugyo株はワクチン・承認治療が存在しない。地域の信頼喪失と社会的混乱が対応を著しく阻害。複合感染症（マラリア、HIV、コレラ、麻疹、Mpox）への対応も必要とされている。ただしこのイベント情報にはMulti-disease situationが含まれているため、本トリアージはEbola outbreak主要事象に基づく。

article.articleHeadline: إصابة عشرات العاملين بالمجال الطبي بإيبولا في الكونغو الديمقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dozens of healthcare workers infected with Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Dozens of healthcare workers infected with Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. So far, 75 health workers have been infected and 17 have died since the current outbreak began, with first cases reported on May 15 after the virus is believed to have circulated for months. Persistent shortages of basic PPE, including gloves and masks, hinder response. WHO emergency director warns the health system is paying a heavy price, noting the DRC has roughly 11 health workers per 10,000 people. China and Uganda are sending medical teams to bolster capacity. WHO is also providing mental health support to frontline staff anxious about caring for patients as outbreaks persist, underscoring vulnerable health workforce and ongoing needs for PPE and infection control.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱に感染した医療従事者が数十人
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準を4つすべて満たす。エボラ出血熱による医療従事者への感染拡大、死亡事例が報告されており、国際的な医療支援の必要性が確認されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで明確にコンゴ民主共和国での医療従事者への感染拡大（75名感染、17名死亡）が報告されており、医療システムの脆弱性が強調されている。中国とウガンダが医療チームを派遣との記載があるが、サマリーの主題は東アフリコ（Uganda）ではなく、あくまでDRCでの発生が中心であるため、Ugandaは実際の発生地としては verified_locations から除外した。中国については医療支援派遣国として記載されているが、発生地としても列挙されているため含める。PPE不足と感染制御の課題が継続している。

article.articleHeadline: СЗО: Повече от 70 медици в Конго са заразени с ебола от началото на епидемията
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: More than 70 healthcare workers in Congo have contracted Ebola virus disease since the beginning of the outbreak.
article.articleSummary: 75 healthcare workers in the Democratic Republic of Congo have been infected with Ebola virus disease, with 17 deaths, since the outbreak began. The outbreak was officially announced on May 15, but Ebola is believed to have circulated for months prior, exposing many health workers before detection. Ongoing PPE shortages, including gloves and masks, strain the health system in DRC, which has about 11 healthcare workers per 10,000 people, one of the lowest densities globally. China and Uganda are sending medical teams to assist. The WHO is providing psychological support to some medics fearful to treat patients after seeing many colleagues fall ill. The remarks came during a video briefing from eastern DRC.

triage.headline_ja: WHO: コンゴでエボラ出血熱に感染した医療従事者が70人以上、流行開始以来
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク）。医療従事者の高い感染率、死亡事例、継続的な曝露リスク、国際的な医療チーム派遣が既に実施されている。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが「People's Republic of China」を発生地域に含めているが、記事サマリーではChina/Ugandaは医療チーム派遣国として言及されており、エボラの実発生地はDRCのみ。Ugandaは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。記事は2026年6月19日配信で、5月15日に公式発表されたDRCのエボラ流行の継続を報じている。医療従事者への影響が高く、PPE不足、心理的支援の必要性など、管理可能性への課題が明確。フルRRA推奨。

article.articleHeadline: কঙ্গোতে ইবোলো ভাইরাসে ৩০ জনের মৃত্যু, ব্যাপক প্রাদুর্ভাবের আশঙ্কা
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 30 killed by Ebola virus in Congo, fears of a widespread outbreak.
article.articleSummary: By 19 June 2026, Ebola virus has killed 30 people at Bunia's Kigonge displacement camp in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo since May, raising fears of a wider outbreak. Camp officials and Aid group Caritas say mortality is unprecedented; the deceased displayed headache, fever, and vomiting—symptoms consistent with Ebola. The camp houses over 15,000 residents; relatives have resisted health checks, hindering laboratory confirmation. Five samples have been collected, with results pending. The broader displacement crisis in eastern Congo, affecting more than 500,000 people, heightens transmission risk amid severe sanitation deficits. UN data show sanitation funding cut by more than half for 2024–2025, with Congo allocated about $38 million of a requested $80 million; only roughly 21% of needed funds have been funded. The outbreak status remains under investigation as authorities monitor spread and public health responses.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラウイルスにより30人が死亡、大規模流行の懸念
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスによる死亡事例が確認され、IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。150万人以上の難民キャンプという高リスク環境での発生であり、国際的拡大リスクが極めて高い。
triage.notes: エボラウイルスの確認事例（30人死亡）、難民キャンプという高密度環境、衛生設備不足、実験室確認待ち中という状況から極めてハイリスク。ルワンダへの国際的拡大リスクも存在するが、記事サマリーではルワンダでの実際の発生は報告されていないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en Ituri : le gouvernement renforce la prise en charge des
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Ituri: the government strengthens the management of
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak continues in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo's Ituri province, with the government strengthening protections for affected children. In Bunia, on June 18, Minister Ève Bazaiba reported expanded psychosocial, nutritional, and medical support for 0–17-year-olds whose parents have died or are being treated for Ebola. Response sites now host dedicated spaces, nurseries, and child-protection structures staffed by nannies, physicians, nurses, and psychologists to monitor medical and psychosocial needs and reduce contamination risks. Measures aim to reduce parental stress and address stigma against orphans, with UNICEF support to protect and integrate them. Interventions also cover displaced populations, emphasizing barrier measures and preventive care for children, among the most vulnerable amid the ongoing outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: イトゥリ州のエボラ熱：政府が子どもたちの管理強化を推進
triage.triage_reason: エボラ熱の継続的な流行がDRC東部で確認されており、IHR基準4項目全て該当。政府による対応強化が報道されており、国際的な支援（UNICEF）も関与している。
triage.notes: DRCはWPRO対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。ただしこれは対象国外のシグナルとして認識される。エボラ熱は高リスク感染症であり、DRCでの継続的な流行と政府対応の強化が報道されていることから、フルRRA（Rapid Risk Assessment）の実施が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola v Konžskej demokratickej republike sa rýchlo šíri, varuje WHO
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is spreading rapidly, WHO warns.
article.articleSummary: As of 19 June 2026, Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is intensifying, with 896 confirmed cases since the outbreak began on 15 May and 232 deaths; 21 new cases were reported in the last 24 hours. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no vaccine. More than 90% of cases are in Ituri province, in the northeast, with spread to North Kivu and South Kivu. WHO notes capacity is increasing: Ebola beds exceeding 500 and laboratories conducting over 2,000 tests daily. Contact tracing covers about 75% of contacts, but WHO emphasizes the need to reach at least 95% to halt transmission. The outbreak has reached Uganda, reporting 19 cases and 2 deaths, though no new Ugandan cases have been recorded in the past 12 days.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラウイルスが急速に拡大、WHOが警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo株）の大規模outbreak（896確定症例、232死亡）であり、DRCからウガンダへの国際的拡大を確認。重症度が高く、国際対応が必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでウガンダ（19症例、2死亡）への拡大が言及されているが、ウガンダは対象国リスト外のため verified_locations に含めない。DRCはリスト内であり、実際の主要outbreak国として含める。接触者追跡率75%でWHO目標95%に達しておらず、制御能力に懸念あり。ワクチン未利用株（Bundibugyo）による大規模outbreak。

article.articleHeadline: Usia Produktif Dominasi Kasus DBD, Waspada Risiko Komplikasi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Working-age population dominates dengue fever cases; be wary of complications.
article.articleSummary: Indonesia faces dengue fever transmitted by Aedes aegypti as a broader age threat beyond children. Ministry of Health data through January 2026 show mortality concentrated in 5–14-year-olds (41% of 2025 dengue deaths). Over the past five years, the largest share of cases has been among 15–44-year-olds (42% of 2025 cases). This underscores adult risk and potential for serious complications such as dengue shock syndrome, highlighting the need for early recognition and comprehensive prevention. Experts from IDAI and PAPDI emphasize multi-faceted protection, including vaccination for children and adults 18–60. Comorbidity markedly raises risk: hypertension 2–3×, diabetes 3–5×, kidney disease up to 7×, asthma/ chronic lung disease 2–12×. Dengue burden in Indonesia has nearly tripled in five years; public education events like ABCD Land in Jakarta (June 20–21, 2026) aim to enhance prevention.

triage.headline_ja: 生産年齢層がデング熱患者の大多数を占める、合併症のリスクに注意
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアでデング熱の患者数が5年間でほぼ3倍に増加し、成人層での重症化リスク（デング出血熱、デング休克症候群）が明らかになっている。IHR基準で重篤性と異常性が該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度、流行しやすさ、管理可能性で複数該当。地域的な公衆衛生上の懸念が顕著である。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーによると、インドネシアのデング熱患者数は過去5年間でほぼ3倍に増加。従来は小児中心と認識されていたが、15-44歳の成人層が2025年の患者の42%を占める。死亡者は5-14歳に集中（2025年デング関連死の41%）だが、成人の重症化リスク（デング休血熱、デング休克症候群）が強調されている。保健省データに基づき、予防接種キャンペーン（ABCD Land in Jakarta、2026年6月20-21日）が計画されている。基礎疾患（高血圧、糖尿病、腎臓病、喘息/慢性肺疾患）がリスクを著しく増加させることが指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : face à Ebola, le défi du financement
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: Facing Ebola, the Funding Challenge.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues after a May 15 declaration, with transmission accelerating and the death toll exceeding 200. Funding remains a major challenge: Action Against Hunger reports only 35% of the response plan funded. The African Union announced about 910 million USD in funding pledges, including roughly 80 million from African member states. In early June, WHO and Africa CDC launched a 518 million USD intervention plan to bolster surveillance, prevention, and patient care. International donors respond: World Bank emergency aid of 220 million USD; the United States mobilized over 300 million USD for the regional response, in addition to 1.8 billion USD in broader humanitarian aid. The G7 welcomed EU support of 493 million euros for emergency relief, vaccines, and health systems strengthening; Germany added 13 million euros. Congo’s Health Minister Dr. Samuel Roger Kamba commits transparent, decentralized fund management.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：エボラに直面する資金調達の課題
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も全て該当。進行中のエボラ出血熱の大流行で200人以上の死亡、国際的な資金協力と支援が活発化しており、明らかなシグナルである。
triage.notes: 現在進行中の大規模エボラ出血熱流行。5月15日宣言以降、死者200人超、感染が加速。WHO・アフリカCDCが5.18億ドルの介入計画を発表。米国、世銀、EU、G7など国際的な資金支援が活発化。公式な対象国（DRC=203312）での発生であり、シグナルとして確実にピックアップすべき案件。

article.articleHeadline: 【短訊】加巴德卸任前揭露 福奇涉武漢實驗室研究 | 新冠病毒 | 美國國家情報總監 | 蝙蝠冠狀病毒
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Text Message: Gabbard Reveals Before Stepping Down That Fauci Was Involved in Wuhan Laboratory Research | COVID-19 | U.S. Director of National Intelligence | Bat Coronavirus
article.articleSummary: On June 18, 2026, on the eve of stepping down as U.S. Director of National Intelligence, Tulsi Gabbard released previously unpublished communications and documents alleging that Dr. Anthony Fauci used U.S. taxpayer funds to finance dangerous gain-of-function research at the Wuhan Institute of Virology (WIV) on bat coronaviruses prior to the COVID-19 pandemic. Gabbard asserts this research at the WIV involved enhancing viral properties and has been widely regarded as a potential source of the SARS-CoV-2 laboratory leak responsible for the COVID-19 outbreak. She also released what she describes as unprecedented correspondence suggesting Fauci manipulated intelligence assessments concerning the virus's origins. The disclosures frame the revelations as an attempt to reveal the truth about the origins of COVID-19, with implications for debates over biosafety research in the United States and China.

triage.headline_ja: 短信：ガバード退任前に暴露 フォーチ武漢実験室研究に関与 | 新型コロナ | 米国家情報長官 | コウモリコロナウイルス
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は過去のCOVID-19に関する政治的主張・歴史的論争の報道であり、現在進行中の感染症アウトブレイクではなく、新規の病原体検出やイベント発生を示す証拠がない。
triage.notes: 本記事は2026年6月19日の米政治家による過去のCOVID-19起源に関する主張の報道である。現在進行中の新規感染症イベント、新規ケースの発生、アウトブレイク、または公衆衛生上の直接的なリスクを示す情報は含まれていない。歴史的・政治的関心事項であり、シグナルトリアージの対象外と判定する。

article.articleHeadline: Oms: "L'Ebola si sta evolvendo molto velocemente nell'est del Congo"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: "Ebola is evolving very quickly in eastern Congo."
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is spreading rapidly, according to WHO, with the outbreak declared May 15 and driven by the Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain for which there is no vaccine. The latest WHO update reports 896 confirmed cases and 232 deaths, with 21 new cases in the last 24 hours. The disease remains grave and is evolving very quickly, says Marie-Roseline Belizaire, WHO Africa emergencies chief. More than 90% of known cases are concentrated in Ituri province in eastern Congo, a region torn by conflict, with spread extending to North Kivu and South Kivu provinces. Despite intensified response efforts, WHO emphasizes a race against time to contain transmission.

triage.headline_ja: WHO: コンゴ東部でエボラが急速に進化している
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目中3項目以上が該当し、深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、および高い致死性を伴う進行中のエボラ多国間アウトブレークがピックアップ基準を満たす。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain による進行中のアウトブレークで、既に896確定患者、232死亡が報告されており、24時間以内に新規症例が継続発生中。紛争地域での制御困難性、複数州への拡大、ワクチン非対応株の存在が重大リスク因子。WHOによる緊急対応声明により政府・国際的関心が極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Six-year-old Ebola patient taken from DR Congo hospital found and 'doing well'
article.articleSummary: Six-year-old Ebola patient taken from a hospital in eastern DR Congo’s Butembo by armed men and later found 18 km away at an Ebola treatment centre; her condition is stable. The incident underscores fear and misinformation fueling attacks on treatment facilities amid the ongoing outbreak, which has already caused more than 230 deaths and 890 confirmed cases. Outbreak activity is concentrated in Ituri, South Kivu and North Kivu, with Ituri accounting for over 90% of infections. Uganda reports 19 confirmed cases, including 2 deaths, with no new cases since 5 June. DR Congo authorities have intensified surveillance, contact tracing, and dedicated treatment centres. WHO has pledged $3.9 million to the response; Africa CDC has allocated a $319 million budget. The M23 rebel group controls areas of North and South Kivu, further hampering containment efforts.

triage.headline_ja: DR コンゴの病院から連れ去られた6歳のエボラ患者が発見され「容態は良好」
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病の確認流行で230人以上の死亡、890確認症例、複数国への国際拡大、国境を越えた医療対応が必要な状況。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでウガンダの症例報告（19確認症例、2死亡）も言及されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。DRC のエボラ流行は進行中で、武装勢力による治療施設への妨害行為、住民の不信感、誤った情報が対策を複雑化させている。WHO と Africa CDC が大規模な資金を投入している。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola se širi među zdravstvenim radnicima
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola is spreading among healthcare workers.
article.articleSummary: As of June 19, 2026, the World Health Organization reports Ebola infections among healthcare workers in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, with 75 infected and 17 dead. WHO spokesperson Marie-Roseline Belizaire said infections were identified in Bunia, the capital of Ituri Province in the DRC, but it remains unclear whether some cases were contracted at work or in private life. Only four of 177 clinics surveyed initially had the capacity and equipment to adequately protect all staff. WHO is supplying PPE and training to smaller clinics to prevent further spread. Notably, only about 10% of infected individuals exhibited classic Ebola symptoms, especially bleeding, hindering early detection.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがヘルスケアワーカーの間で拡大している
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準において公衆衛生への深刻な影響（死亡17名を含む75名感染）、異常性（医療従事者への集中感染）、国際的拡大リスク（DRCとウガンダの複数国での発生）の3つが該当。また、WPRO基準でも重症度（死亡率22.7%）、流行しやすさ（ヒト-ヒト感染、医療施設での感染）、管理可能性（PPE供給不足）が該当。国際的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCとウガンダの両国が言及されているが、主要な発生地はBunia（DRC内Ituri州）であり、詳細な症例数や死亡者数はDRCに関連している。ウガンダについては「infections were identified in...Uganda」と述べられているが、詳細な場所や症例情報が記事内に明示されておらず、対象国リストにもウガンダは含まれていないため verified_locations ではDRCのみとする。医療従事者への感染という異例性、高い致命率（17/75≈22.7%）、医療施設での人-人感染リスク、PPE不足による管理不十分が全てのリスク基準を満たしている。

article.articleHeadline: केरल में शिगेला से 5 मरीजों की मौत, 10 नए केस मिलने से अलर्ट, एक महीने में 120 संक्रमित
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Kerala, 5 patients died of Shigella; alert issued after 10 new cases were detected; 120 infected in one month.
article.articleSummary: Kerala reports a Shigella outbreak with 196 cases this year, including 120 in June, and 5 deaths this month. Ten new Shigella cases were detected on Friday, raising June’s totals in Kerala’s districts: Kozhikode (3), Thiruvananthapuram (2), Thrissur (2), Malappuram (2), and Palakkad (1). Shigella spreads via contaminated food or water and poor sanitation, typically causing diarrhea, fever, and abdominal cramps. Health authorities issued an alert after the June surge. As of June 19, 2026, the state continues monitoring the outbreak with cases concentrated in southern and central districts. In a Nipah virus update, one patient at Kozhikode Medical College Hospital was on life support; three Nipah-exposed individuals were discharged from surveillance, and no suspected Nipah cases remain under hospital monitoring.

triage.headline_ja: ケーラ州でシゲラ菌により5人が死亡、10の新規症例検出後に警戒発令、1か月間に120人が感染
triage.triage_reason: 見出しはNipahを記載していますが、記事サマリーの主題はShigellaアウトブレイクです。記事本文がないため詳細確認ができませんが、サマリーから判断するとShigellaは既知感染症で、ケーラ州での通常的な水系感染症です。Nipahについては「1患者が生命維持装置上にいる」という限定的な情報のみで、主題となっていません。IHR基準・WPROスクリーニング基準を厳密に評価すると、Shigellaは既知の感染症で予想外性が低く、情報不足が多いため、シグナルピックアップの判定基準に達しません。
triage.notes: 記事の題名にはNipahが記載されていますが、サマリーの主要内容はShigella菌のアウトブレイクです。Nipahについては補足情報のみ（1患者が生命維持装置上、3人が監視から退院、病院監視中の疑い症例なし）。Shigellaは既知感染症で、ケーラ州での水系感染症は周期的に報告される現象です。記事本文がないため、詳細な評価が制限されます。

article.articleHeadline: V Kongu unesli matku s dcerou nakažené ebolou. Policie chrání těla mrtvých střelbou
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Congo, a mother and daughter infected with Ebola were kidnapped. The police guard the bodies of the dead with gunfire.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease continues to drive a fast-growing outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, concentrated in Ituri, South Kivu and North Kivu, with Ituri home to over 90% of cases. By 19 June 2026, the epidemic records 75 infections among health workers and 17 deaths; WHO notes an extremely rapid evolution in the eastern region. The outbreak, officially declared on 15 May, is driven by the Bundibugyo strain, for which no licensed vaccine exists. A six-year-old girl infected with Ebola and her mother surrendered to a treatment center about 18 kilometers from Butembo; the attackers who raided the hospital remain unclarified. Attacks on health facilities and distrust hinder response, including Mongbwalu police firing into the air to deter bodies from being seized and Rwampara residents burning isolation tents over handling of highly infectious remains. Uganda reports 19 cases and 2 deaths, with no new cases since early June.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴで母娘がエボラウイルス感染で誘拐。警察は銃撃により死体を守る
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）、かつWPRO基準も全て該当。東アフリカ地域で急速な流行が進行中、健康労働者への感染と複数の死亡、医療施設への攻撃による対応阻害が確認される。フルRRA実施必要。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱の急速な流行が2026年5月15日に公式宣言。イトゥリ州が全症例の90%以上を占める。医療従事者への感染75件、死亡17件が記録されている。Bundibugyo株による流行で有効ワクチンなし。医療施設への暴力的攻撃と社会不信により対応が著しく阻害されている。ウガンダでも19症例、2死亡の報告あり。国境を越えた感染拡大が確認されている。

article.articleHeadline: مخاوف من تفشي إيبولا بعد وفاة 30 شخصا في مخيم شرق الكونغو - الوطن
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fears of an Ebola outbreak after 30 people died in a camp in eastern Congo - Al-Watan
article.articleSummary: As of June 19, 2026, at least 30 people have died since early May in the Kijonzi refugee camp in Bunia, northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo, fueling fears of an Ebola outbreak. Local authorities note that the victims exhibited fever, headache, and vomiting—symptoms consistent with Ebola—but some patients and relatives refused examinations or post-mortem testing, delaying confirmation. The camp, with more than 15,000 residents, normally records 0–3 deaths per month, making the current fatalities unusually high. Health teams have collected samples from several suspected cases and await laboratory results amid challenges, including symptom overlap with diseases such as cholera and a strained health system with limited cooperation. The situation follows prior Ebola activity in the region and underscores the risk of undetected transmission until lab confirmation.

triage.headline_ja: 東コンゴの難民キャンプで30人が死亡、エボラ流行の懸念
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の異常死亡率、国際的拡大リスク）、WPRO基準4項目該当（異常な死亡数、高い重症度、難民キャンプでの長期曝露リスク、ヒト-ヒト感染可能性）、国際的な関心が高まっている可能性。フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、イベントは明確にDRCの北東部Buniaの難民キャンプで発生している。5月初旬以来30人の死亡、症状がエボラと一致、検査確認待ちという状況。15,000人以上の難民が居住する環境での感染拡大リスクは極めて高い。ラボ確認まで待機中だが、公衆衛生上の即時対応が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : le gouvernement comorien redoute l'arrivée du virus et active ses mesures d'urgence
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: the Comorian government fears the arrival of the virus and activates its emergency measures.
article.articleSummary: On 19 June 2026, Comoros’ Council of Ministers formally examined the threat of Ebola introduction, with Health Minister Ahamadi Sidi Nahouda presenting notes on the risks of the virus arriving and the need to bolster prevention and response measures. A second memo outlined preparations to prevent introduction and to avert a major health crisis if an imported case occurs. The concern coincides with an Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, where in May 2026 the WHO raised its risk assessment due to ongoing transmission and rising suspect cases, highlighting regional spread risks from cross-border movement. No Ebola cases have been reported in Comoros to date. Authorities emphasize entry-point surveillance, early detection of suspected cases, health-system readiness, and population awareness; no alert has been triggered, though preparedness remains a national priority, alongside ongoing mpox containment efforts with WHO and UNICEF support.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：コモロ政府はウイルスの到着を懸念し、緊急対策を発動
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行と地域的なスプレッドリスクが報告されており、コモロが予防的対応を準備している段階。現在のコモロでの確認患者はなく、情報不足が多いが、地域リスク上昇を示唆する内容のため経過観察対象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはコモロ政府の予防的準備を主題としているが、実際のエボラ発生はDRCで確認されており、コモロではまだ確認患者がない。地域検証に基づきDRCのみを verified_locations に含める。IHR基準2つ該当・WPRO基準4つ該当により PICKUP 判定も可能だが、コモロでの確認患者がなく、主に予防的対応段階であることから WATCH とした。DRCでの流行続行と地域スプレッドリスク、複数省庁による対応が報告されており、続報注視が重要。

article.articleHeadline: OMS avertizează că transmiterea virusului Ebola se accelerează în RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO warns that Ebola virus transmission is accelerating in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization warns Ebola transmission is accelerating in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), despite strengthened outbreak response. The 17th Ebola outbreak, declared on May 15, centers in Ituri province, with transmission reported across 33 health zones in three provinces. The Bundibugyo strain has no vaccine or specific treatment. As of OMS figures, 896 laboratory-confirmed cases and 232 deaths in DRC (case fatality ~26%). In neighboring Uganda, 19 confirmed cases and 2 deaths, with no new infections in the past 12 days. Responding measures include deployment of over 115 health experts and more than 100 tonnes of emergency medical supplies. Health system capacity: 516 hospital beds available; daily testing capacity surpassing 2,000. Challenges persist: difficult access due to security, limited resources; contact tracing at 75% (target 90%). A Chinese medical team arrived in Kinshasa; IOM reports over 1 million border checks along routes in RDC and neighboring countries.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、DRCでのエボラウイルス伝播が加速していることを警告
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダへの越境感染確認）、深刻な死亡事例、かつ異常・予想外の状況に該当。IHR基準3つ、WPROスクリーニング基準5つすべてに該当し、国際的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはウガンダ（対象国外）も記載されているが、記事サマリーではウガンダは隣接国としての二次的なコンテキストであり、主要な発生地はDRC。DRCのみを verified_locations に含める。エボラ出血熱の国際的拡大リスク、高い致死率（~26%）、複数州での広域伝播、国際的な支援体制の動員が確認される。

article.articleHeadline: مسؤولة أميركية تفجر مفاجأة.. طبيب متهم بإخفاء أصل كورونا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An American official drops a bombshell... a doctor accused of concealing the origin of the coronavirus.
article.articleSummary: On his last day as United States Director of National Intelligence, Tulsi Gabbard released emails and documents alleging Anthony Fauci, director of the NIH’s NIAID, funded millions of dollars in high-risk coronavirus research at China’s Wuhan Institute of Virology, potentially linked to a lab-origin SARS-CoV-2 event tied to the COVID-19 pandemic. The documents claim Fauci directly influenced U.S. intelligence assessments on the virus origin and worked with intel officials to suppress information about laboratory origins. He is accused of lying to Congress in 2024 about knowledge or participation in discussions on the viral research. The release followed a year-long declassification review and includes whistleblower testimony about marginalization and threats against analysts challenging official conclusions. Fauci allegedly played three roles: funding risky research toward so-called universal vaccines, pushing the intel community toward a natural-origin narrative, and publicly commenting on the pandemic. Intelligence reportedly followed his recommendations; NIAID-funded scientists advised U.S. intelligence on origin. Locations: United States and Wuhan, China; disease: COVID-19 (SARS-CoV-2).

triage.headline_ja: 米国の高官が爆弾発言... コロナウイルスの起源隠蔽で医師を非難
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は政治的な非難・陰謀論争に関するもので、新規の感染症イベント（発症者、患者集団、感染症アウトブレイク）を報告していない。公衆衛生的インパクトや異常な感染症の発生を示す具体的なデータがない。
triage.notes: 本記事は2020年のCOVID-19パンデンドから数年後の2026年における、SARS-CoV-2の起源についての政治的論争・調査報道である。現在進行中の新規感染症イベントではなく、過去のパンデミックに関する歴史的・政治的議論に分類される。シグナル検出対象外。

article.articleHeadline: На каких популярных зарубежных курортах может появиться вирус Эбола?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: At which popular foreign resorts could the Ebola virus appear?
article.articleSummary: A hot spot in Congo with hundreds infected raises concerns that Ebola could reach major global hubs via daily flights. Japanese researchers analyzed air routes and estimate that infected air passengers from Africa could reach Europe and the Middle East within a month. Under worst-case assumptions, the probability of a 'zero patient' arriving is 92% for Belgium, 91% for France, 88% for the United Arab Emirates, and 86% for Turkey. Both UAE and Turkey are popular resorts for Russians. Screening is ineffective during the incubation period, as asymptomatic individuals can pass checks; they are not contagious until symptoms appear. Transmission is not airborne and requires close contact when symptomatic. With proper epidemiological history-taking and strict use of personal protective equipment by healthcare workers, the risk of spread can be mitigated. The article notes several factors that could limit outbreak scale, though they are not detailed.

triage.headline_ja: 人気の海外リゾートにエボラウイルスが現れる可能性がある場所は？
triage.triage_reason: コンゴでのエボラ熱の流行が確認されており、国際的な拡大リスク（IHR基準3つ該当）が指摘されている一方で、記事は主にモデリング分析と理論的リスク評価であり、実際の国際的な症例確認には至っていない。情報の確実性と緊急性に不確実性があるため、WATCH段階で続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴでの実際の流行を報告し、国際的な拡大リスクを理論的・モデリング分析により評価している。ただしベルギー、フランス、UAE、トルコなどへの『ゼロ患者』到着の確率は予測であり、現時点での実際の国際的症例確認ではない。対象国リストではDRCのみが該当する。フランス、ベルギー、UAEはIHR通知対象国ではあるが、記事の主題は『可能性がある』という警告・分析であり、実際の患者報告ではないため、継続的な情報収集が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Refuerzan medidas en aeropuerto de Kinshasa debido a ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Reinforced measures at Kinshasa airport due to Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) prompts reinforced border controls at Kinshasa's N'djili International Airport. Since the outbreak was declared on May 15, the DRC has confirmed 896 Ebola cases and about 200 deaths. Travelers must now complete a digital health form for entry or exit, generating a QR code that must be validated before boarding or leaving the terminal, per the National Border Hygiene Program. Airlines have been notified to strengthen screening. Border zones implement health checks and temperature screening, among other hygiene measures. In Ituri province, the outbreak epicenter, health authorities emphasize active case finding as a positive development. Health Ministry reports nearly 6,000 contacts are being monitored, with a 71% follow-up rate, below the 95% target. The response aims to improve early detection and contact tracing.

triage.headline_ja: キンシャサ空港でのエボラ対策強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（重大な公衆衛生上の影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。確認事例896件、死亡200件の進行中のエボラ流行であり、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: DRCで2026年5月15日に宣言されたエボラ流行。確認事例896件、死亡約200件。イトゥリ州が流行の中心地。キンシャサ国際空港で強化された国境管理（デジタル健康フォーム、QRコード検証）が実施中。6,000近くの接触者が監視下にあるが、追跡率71%と目標95%に未達。IHR・WPROの両基準で高リスク判定。

article.articleHeadline: PSO: Konge Ebola užsikrėtė daugiau kaip 70 medicinos darbuotojų
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: In Congo, more than 70 healthcare workers contracted Ebola.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-19, the World Health Organization reports 75 healthcare workers infected with Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo during the current outbreak, with 17 deaths. The outbreak was officially declared on May 15, though cases likely circulated for months earlier, fueling transmission among nurses and doctors. Health workers face shortages of basic PPE, such as gloves and masks. WHO Emergency Director Marie Roseline Belizaire notes the strain’s toll on the health system, with Uganda and China dispatching medical teams and WHO providing mental health support to affected staff. Ebola spreads through direct contact with infected bodily fluids, with an incubation period up to three weeks. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo strain (Bundibugyo ebolavirus) first identified in 2007, with a case-fatality rate reported around 30–50%.

triage.headline_ja: WHO：コンゴでエボラに感染した医療従事者が70人以上
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準全5項目該当。エボラウイルス病の集団発生は国際的な懸念事項であり、複数国への支援要請とWHO対応が進行中。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではコンゴDRCが主要な発生地。ウガンダは医療チームを派遣している支援国として言及されているが、ウガンダ自体での集団発生状況は記事に明記されていない。中国も医療チームを派遣しているが、発生地ではなく支援国として記載されている。対象国リストにはDRCが含まれるため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: Adadin waɗanda suka harbu da cutar Ebola ta kusa 900 a Congo
article.articleSummary: DR Congo reports a 24-hour Ebola surge in eastern Ituri and the North and South Kivu provinces, with six deaths and 24 new infections. The outbreak strain has reached 33 health facilities across Ituri’s eastern districts and the northern and southern parts of Kivu. Health authorities warn that weekly increases in new cases indicate rapid spread unless swift action is taken to contain transmission. To date, at least 383 people are isolated or hospitalized due to infection, while about 78 have recovered. The update underscores the growing burden in the affected regions and highlights the need for intensified public health measures to curb further spread.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ熱患者が約900人に達したと報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも5つ全て該当。エボラ出血熱は最高リスク疾患であり、複数州での急速な感染拡大、高い重症度、国際的拡大リスク、社会的・政治的関心が極めて高い。フルRRAが必須。
triage.notes: 24時間で6人の死亡と24人の新規感染例が報告。イトゥリ州および北キヴ州・南キヴ州で急速な拡大の兆候。33の保健施設で検出。383人が隔離・入院中で、78人が回復。記事サマリーでは「約900人」という表現だが、詳細では現時点での確定症例数は明示されていない点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: 刚果（金）埃博拉疫情持续扩散 联合国机构警告跨境传播和流离失所者面临高风险
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues to spread; UN agencies warn that cross-border transmission and internally displaced persons are at high risk.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) continues to spread, with 896 confirmed cases and 232 deaths (case fatality 26%) as of 17 June 2026; Uganda reports 19 cases and 2 deaths (plus one suspected death) as of 18 June, including 14 importations and 5 secondary transmissions. Since 13 June, the DRC added 220 cases (96 deaths), aided by improved testing. Ituri Province bears 91.1% of DRConly infections (817 cases, 186 deaths), with cases also in North Kivu and South Kivu. In total, 6,367 contacts identified; 4,525 under follow-up in DRC; Uganda has 826 contacts, 122 under active monitoring. Cross-border transmission is confirmed; no sustained Uganda community transmission yet, with exposure mainly in health facilities and cross-border movement. WHO flags very high risk in the DRC and high in Uganda; neighboring borders high, broader Africa and global risk low. UNHCR warns of over 2 million displaced persons; IOM conducts extensive border health screenings and routing, while WHO does not recommend travel/trade limits.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ疫情が継続的に拡大。国連機関が国境を越えた伝播と国内避難民の高リスクを警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、複数国への国際的拡大、渡航制限の潜在リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも全5項目該当。国連機関による公式警告があり社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの輸入症例と二次感染も報告されているが、記事の主題はDRCでの疫情拡大である。DRCは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。ウガンダ（対象国リストに非含）での症例は参考情報として扱う。死亡率26%、200例以上の新規症例、国連複数機関による警告、200万人以上の国内避難民という極めて深刻な状況。国境越え伝播が確認され、隣接国への拡大リスク高。フルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Dourados confirma 15ª morte por chikungunya e concentra 68,2% dos óbitos em MS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dourados confirms 15th chikungunya death and concentrates 68.2% of the deaths in Mato Grosso do Sul
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya death toll in Dourados reaches 15 in 2026, accounting for 68.2% of Mato Grosso do Sul's 22 fatalities to date. A 19-year-old Indigenous resident of the Dourados Indigenous Reserve developed symptoms March 14 and died May 29 at the University Hospital of the Federal University of Grande Dourados (UFGD). Three additional deaths remain under investigation: a 74-year-old woman with chronic kidney disease and hypertension; a 71-year-old man with diabetes; and a 43-year-old man with no comorbidities, all urban residents. Since the outbreak began, Dourados records 9,772 chikungunya notifications (5,242 probable, 4,745 confirmed, 4,530 discarded, 497 under investigation). In the Indigenous Reserve, 3,151 notifications (2,343 probable, 2,184 confirmed, 808 discarded, 159 under investigation). Hospitalizations have fallen from 52–58 at peak to 20 currently (14 at UFGD; others at Regional, Unimed, Cassems, and Hospital da Vida). Dourados remains the state's epicenter with ongoing vector-control and surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: ドゥラードスがチクングニア熱で15人目の死亡を確認し、マット・グロッソ・ド・スル州の死亡の68.2%が集中
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル国内での局所的なチクングニア熱流行であり、死亡例が増加しているが、国際的拡大のリスクや国家的危機の示唆に乏しく、情報が限定的であるため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: チクングニア熱は周知の蚊媒介疾患であり、ブラジルでの流行は珍しくない。死亡数は増加しているが、主にドゥラードス市（マット・グロッソ・ド・スル州）に限定されており、国家規模での対応能力や国際的懸念の詳細情報が不足している。蚊媒介制御と監視が進行中とのこと。WPROスクリーニング基準で3つ該当するが、IHR基準は1つのみのため、フルRRAの前に追加情報収集が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: A Toupeira " A Palavra da Vet #3: Dengue: Cães e gatos não pegam a doença, mas o mosquito esconde outro perigo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Mole "The Vet's Word" #3: Dengue: Dogs and cats don't get the disease, but the mosquito hides another danger.
article.articleSummary: Dengue does not infect dogs or cats; however, Aedes aegypti can transmit dirofilariasis, or heartworm disease, primarily to dogs and occasionally to cats. Transmission occurs when a mosquito bites an infected animal and then another; worms lodge in the heart and vessels, causing cough, fatigue, difficulty breathing, weight loss, and potentially heart failure. The disease often progresses silently until significant health decline. Mosquito control remains essential to protect people and pets. Preventive measures include eliminating standing water, keeping yards clean, and following veterinarian-recommended preventives. The article underscores a One Health approach—protecting humans, animals, and the community. The piece is by Dr. Ana, a veterinarian from Santo André, São Paulo, Brazil.

triage.headline_ja: 獣医からのメッセージ第3弾：デング熱：犬と猫は感染しないが、蚊は別の危険を隠している
triage.triage_reason: 記事の主題は家庭のペット（犬・猫）への蚊媒介性心虫症についての教育的コンテンツであり、人間の感染症アウトブレイク・公衆衛生危機を扱っていない。デング熱そのものの流行に関する疫学的警告ではなく、獣医学的な予防啓発記事。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル・サンパウロ州の獣医師による教育コンテンツ。蚊媒介性疾患の家庭レベルの予防啓発が主眼であり、集団感染の警告・疫学的異常の報告ではない。One Health概念の普及啓発という性質。シグナルの閾値を満たさない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en Ituri : le gouvernement exclut tout confinement de Bunia et mise sur la mobilisation communautaire
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Ituri: the government rules out any lockdown of Bunia and bets on community mobilization.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in Ituri, Democratic Republic of Congo, continues to spread with Bunia not to be locked down; authorities prioritize high-impact response over confinement. Health Minister Roger Kamba said the strategy focuses on strengthened outbreak response, rapid case detection, free treatment, and community engagement. Emphasis is on testing symptomatic individuals quickly and encouraging prompt presentation to health facilities, as early care improves recovery chances and avoids concealing patients. Despite concerning epidemiology, authorities report rising recoveries at Ebola treatment centers across the province, with Ituri remaining the epicenter of the DRC’s 17th Ebola outbreak, declared a month and three days earlier. The government urges community leaders, media, civil society, and local authorities to intensify awareness campaigns to counter rumors and misinformation, while Kinshasa stresses vigilance, community buy-in, and adherence to preventive measures rather than fear or confinement.

triage.headline_ja: イトゥリ州のエボラ：政府はブニアの封鎖を除外し、コミュニティ動員に賭ける
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の進行中の流行で、複数地域での患者発生、高い重症度、ヒト-ヒト感染リスク、国際的拡大懸念があり、IHR基準3項目以上該当。DRCでの活動オンゴーイング流行でありWPRO基準も複数該当。
triage.notes: DRC第17次エボラ流行、イトゥリ州での継続的な蔓延。キンシャサでも患者発生報告あり。政府は厳格な封鎖ではなくコミュニティ動員戦略を採用。治療センターでの回復例増加報告も、流行は継続中。国際的なリスク評価を要する。

article.articleHeadline: Selenggarakan ABCD Land, Takeda Perkuat Langkah Pencegahan DBD bagi Keluarga Indonesia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Host ABCD Land, Takeda Strengthens Dengue Fever Prevention Measures for Indonesian Families.
article.articleSummary: Takeda, with Indonesia’s Ministry of Health, professional bodies, and communities, expands the Langkah Bersama Cegah DBD dengue-prevention initiative ahead of ASEAN Dengue Day. Dengue Fever (DBD) burden in Indonesia increases with climate change and an 80% El Niño likelihood (June–August 2026), potentially expanding Aedes aegypti habitats. A Gadjah Mada University study estimates 2024 dengue costs at nearly Rp9 trillion, with over 2 million hospitalizations; BPJS Kesehatan covers about Rp3 trillion, patients/families ~Rp3.5 trillion in direct costs and lost income, and non-BPJS patients ~Rp2.2 trillion. The National Dengue Control Strategy 2021–2025 guides current work; a forthcoming National Action Plan will stress 3M Plus, vaccination, education, and cross-sector collaboration. In Jakarta, 15 June 2026 data show 5,700 dengue cases; deaths are highest among 5–14 years (41% of 2025 deaths), while 15–44 years account for 42% of cases.

triage.headline_ja: ABCD Land開催、武田薬品がインドネシア国民向けデング熱予防対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアにおけるデング熱の継続的な公衆衛生上の負担が認識されており、El Niño現象による媒介蚊の生息地拡大リスクが存在するため、経過観察が必要。ただし、本記事は予防啓発キャンペーン発表であり、緊急事態シグナルとしての直接的な危機性は低い。
triage.notes: 記事の主体はデング熱予防キャンペーンの発表だが、インドネシアにおけるデング熱の継続的な高い負担（2024年で約200万人以上が入院、総コスト約9兆ルピア）と、気候変動・El Niño現象による2026年6月～8月の媒介蚊生息地拡大リスク（El Niño発生確率80%）が指摘されている。ジャカルタでは2026年6月15日時点で5,700例の症例報告があり、特に5～14歳の死亡率が高い（2025年死亡の41%）。ただし、この記事自体は新規の緊急事態や流行拡大を報告するものではなく、既知の課題に対する政府・製薬企業による対策強化の発表であるため、フルRRA前段階ではWATCH判定とする。今後、感染者数増加や死亡数増加の報告があれば、PICKUPへの昇格を検討。

article.articleHeadline: Cuaca Picu Peningkatan Kasus DBD, Kategori Ini Rentan Alami Komplikasi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Weather Triggers an Increase in Dengue Cases, This Group Is Prone to Complications.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever (DBD) in Indonesia is driven by Aedes aegypti transmission. A Gadjah Mada University study estimates the 2024 economic burden at nearly Rp9 trillion with over 2 million hospitalizations. BPJS Kesehatan covers about Rp3 trillion; BPJS participants and families pay roughly Rp3.5 trillion; non-BPJS patients and households about Rp2.2 trillion. Climate trends, including an El Niño forecast with 80% probability from June–August 2026 and over 90% by year-end, could raise temperatures and rainfall, expanding vector habitat and accelerating transmission, increasing outbreak risk. The government’s Stranas 2021–2025 and upcoming RAN aim to strengthen education, 3M Plus vector control, and vaccination. Jakarta reported 5,700 confirmed dengue cases as of 15 June 2026. Deaths are now most common in 5–14-year-olds (41% of 2025 deaths); 15–44-year-olds account for 42% of cases, underscoring broad risk. Officials emphasize prevention and vaccination.

triage.headline_ja: 天候がデングイム熱患者数の増加を引き起こし、このグループは合併症が起こりやすい
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアにおけるデング熱の既知の流行で、2024年に200万人以上の入院患者、2026年6月時点でジャカルタのみで5,700例の確定例が報告されている。El Niño現象による気候変動がベクター生息地の拡大と伝播加速のリスクを高めるという予測的なリスク要因が明記されており、IHR基準およびWPRO基準の両方で複数の該当項目が確認される。
triage.notes: 記事はインドネシアの既知の全国的デング熱流行について報じており、特に気候パターンの変化がベクター伝播を加速させるリスクに焦点を当てている。政府の対応（Stranas 2021-2025およびRAN）と予防・ワクチン接種の強調が確認される。5-14歳での死亡が報告死亡の41%を占め、15-44歳が全症例の42%を占めるなど、広範な人口集団に影響が及んでいる。WPRO基準で4項目の該当により、フルRRA実施の対象。

article.articleHeadline: Food poisoning: 34 hospitalised after eating pizza from outlet
article.articleSummary: Suspected food poisoning in Bhiwandi town, Thane district, Maharashtra: 34 people, many children, were hospitalised after eating a shawarma pizza from a local outlet on Wednesday night (June 17, 2026). Symptoms began Thursday afternoon, with stomach ache, giddiness, nausea and loose motions; hospital admissions started around 6 pm Thursday and continued into Friday morning. All patients are out of danger. An offence has been registered against the outlet owner under the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, and a probe has been launched. Food samples from the item have been collected for laboratory analysis to identify the contaminant or cause. The incident is treated as a suspected food-poisoning outbreak linked to a single outlet; no deaths reported to date, and authorities are investigating the infection source and preventive measures.

triage.headline_ja: 食中毒：ピザ店での食事後34人が入院
triage.triage_reason: 限定的な食中毒事件で、単一の食事提供施設に関連し、死亡なし、患者全員が危険から脱している。国際的拡大リスクや渡航・貿易制限のリスクがなく、IHRおよびWPRO基準を満たさない。
triage.notes: 食中毒は単一施設での限定的なイベント。患者34名全員が危険から脱しており、死亡者なし。疾患の原因は未確定だが、食物由来の可能性が高い。地元当局による調査が進行中であり、国家レベルの懸念は限定的。定期的な食品衛生事件の範囲内。

article.articleHeadline: Três bairros de Limeira terão mutirão da dengue neste sábado | Rápido no Ar
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Three neighborhoods in Limeira will host a dengue control drive this Saturday | Rápido no Ar
article.articleSummary: On Saturday, June 20, 2026, Limeira, São Paulo, Brazil, will host another dengue-control outreach campaign in the Jardim Nova Suíça, Jardim Barão de Limeira, and Vila Santa Lúcia neighborhoods. The operation runs from 7:30 a.m. to 12:00 p.m. and involves about 90 health agents. Field teams will visit homes to educate residents and identify and eliminate potential Aedes aegypti breeding sites. Uniformed agents will wear identification badges throughout the activity. Residents are advised to welcome the teams and cooperate with inspections, which are crucial to interrupt mosquito proliferation. The initiative is part of ongoing municipal dengue-control efforts and highlights the importance of community participation to remove containers that collect standing water, thereby reducing the risk of dengue transmission.

triage.headline_ja: リメイラの3つの地域で土曜日にデング熱対策キャンペーンを実施 | Rápido no Ar
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はデング熱対策の予防的キャンペーン告知であり、新規感染事例の報告や異常な発生状況ではない。公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、重症度のいずれも認められない。
