triage.notes: 記事は定期的なデング熱対策キャンペーン（蚊の繁殖地除去のための戸別訪問など）の告知であり、新規事例報告ではない。Brazilは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsは空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: Demokratische Republik Kongo: Ebola breitet sich laut WHO weiter schnell aus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo: Ebola continues to spread rapidly according to the WHO.
article.articleSummary: Ebola continues to spread rapidly in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with the WHO calling the situation still 'serious.' Since the outbreak began, 896 confirmed infections and 232 deaths have been reported, including 75 healthcare workers infected and 17 of them killed. In mid-May, the WHO declared a health emergency of international concern. The outbreak is driven by the Bundibugyo variant (first identified in 2007); there is no approved vaccine or targeted therapy for this strain. Transmission occurs via direct contact with bodily fluids. The outbreak concentrates in conflict-affected, hard-to-reach provinces, notably Ituri, with Bunia as the provincial capital, complicating containment. Access is hampered by insecurity and PPE shortages, such as gloves and masks. Measures are being strengthened day by day; MSF has criticized them as insufficient. Uganda and China are sending medical teams, and WHO is providing psychological support to healthcare workers fearing exposure after colleague infections.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：WHOによると、エボラが引き続き急速に拡大している
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の株による拡大、国際的関心と支援動員、渡航制限リスク）。WPRO基準5つ全て該当。社会的・政治的関心も高い。フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo variant（2007年に初確認）による感染で、ワクチンなし。医療従事者への感染が顕著（75名感染、17名死亡）。紛争地帯での流行のため対応困難。ウガンダと中国が医療チーム派遣。WHOが国際的懸念事象（PHEIC）を宣言済み（5月中旬）。記事サマリーは主にDRCに集中しており、ウガンダ・中国は支援側として言及されているため verified_locations にはDRCのみ含める。

article.articleHeadline: At least 30 deaths at Congo camp show Ebola spreading
article.articleSummary: Ebola deaths in the Democratic Republic of Congo's Ituri province rise in Kigonze camp, Bunia, with at least 30 deaths since May. The 15,000-resident camp reports clusters of deaths; 10 buried this week. Symptoms include headaches, fever and vomiting; testing of the living and dead has been refused, hindering laboratory confirmation. The outbreak there is believed to be circulating months before the May 15 declaration, and 75 medics have been infected, 17 of them dead since the outbreak began. PPE shortages and limited sanitation worsen spread risk amid hundreds of camps with overcrowded tents; latrines overflow, and basic protections lag. Funding for water, sanitation and hygiene has halved since 2024–2025; Congo's Ituri accounts for the majority of the country’s nearly 900 confirmed cases. Health teams disinfect bodies in hazmat suits as coffins are prepared.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ難民キャンプでのエボラ死者30人以上、感染拡大を示す
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラウイルス病の確認された多数の死亡例、医療従事者への感染、貧困な衛生環境での蔓延、国際的な懸念と支援必要性から、フルRRA（Rapid Risk Assessment）対象と判定。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、イベントはコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）のイトゥリ州キゴンゼキャンプで発生していることが明確。複数の根拠が認められる: (1)確認死亡30人以上、(2)医療従事者感染75名・死亡17名、(3)検査拒否により検査確認困難な状況、(4)衛生環境の劣悪化（PPE不足、サニテーション悪化）、(5)資金不足の悪化、(6)数百のキャンプでの過密状態。エボラの高い致命率と感染性から、国際的な懸念と支援が急務。

article.articleHeadline: Gaza, ébola, financiación climática, reconocimiento facial, gusano barrenador... Las noticias del viernes
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Gaza, Ebola, climate financing, facial recognition, wood-boring worm... Friday's news.
article.articleSummary: June 19, 2026 update: Ebola in Democratic Republic of the Congo accelerates, with 896 cases and 232 deaths; Ituri accounts for over 91% of cases, while North Kivu’s fatality exceeds 50%. UN agencies warn conflict and displacement hinder response; UNFPA notes maternal mortality in Ituri has doubled since May 25 as pregnant women delay care. Over 2 million displaced; Ituri sees about 16,000 daily movements. In Gaza, UNICEF questions ceasefire credibility after 265 Palestinian children have died since October and over 400 wounded, many at home, in schools, or while playing football or fishing. Aid access and removal of restrictions on medical supplies, fuel, and spare parts for water and sanitation are urged. Climate finance must reach the vulnerable; between 2016–2024, LDCs received 17% and SIDS 3%. A UN expert warns facial-recognition tech expands without robust controls. A nuclear technique seeks to curb return of woodworm in the Americas.

triage.headline_ja: ガザ、エボラ、気候資金、顔認識、木食い虫...金曜日のニュース
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当。DRCのエボラ感染症が加速（896例、232死亡）し、紛争と避難民移動が対応を阻害しており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限のリスクがある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの主要な感染症イベントはDRCのエボラ流行（Ituri地域で全体の91%以上）。ガザの言及は別の人道危機であり、当該記事はエボラ関連の主要情報源。紛争と大規模避難民移動（200万人以上）により対応が阻害されている。ガザはイスラエル・パレスチナ紛争地域であり対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。

article.articleHeadline: Varginha planeja novas ações fiscais e anuncia Mutirão da Dengue | Rádio Itatiaia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Varginha plans new tax enforcement actions and announces Dengue Task Force | Rádio Itatiaia
article.articleSummary: Varginha, Minas Gerais, Brazil, is implementing integrated environmental health enforcement to curb dengue and Zika by unifying field operations between Semea and Semus. In a June 16 meeting, authorities outlined joint guidelines to improve resident communication and address urban environmental issues, including illegal construction debris dumping, trash disposal outside collection times, irregular residential sewerage, and new subdivisions. Integrated surveillance links environmental management to public health to reduce ecological imbalance and burden on health services, noting that improper tire disposal and neglected yards foster mosquito breeding and arboviruses such as dengue and Zika. In Imaculada Conceição, a cleaning drive collected 30 old tires and six trucks of waste. Next week, Vila Murad will receive waste-collection teams; residents should clean yards and place debris on sidewalks before 7 a.m. on collection days.

triage.headline_ja: ヴァルジンハが新たな税務執行措置を計画し、デング熱対策タスクフォースを発表 | ラジオ・イタティアイア
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルのデング熱およびジカ熱に関する地方自治体の予防キャンペーン。異常性と流行易さは確認されるが、重症度・死亡・国際拡大の情報が不足しており、現段階ではWATCHとして経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: ブラジルはWPRO対象国ではなく南米域内であるが、デング熱およびジカ熱は流行性疾患であり、地方自治体による統合的な予防対策が実施されている。重症度や死亡数に関する具体的情報がないため、スクリーニング基準2項目（長期曝露と流行易さ）のみカウント。続報で実際の症例数・重症度・拡大速度が報告される場合はPICKUPに格上げする可能性あり。

article.articleHeadline: Cacique Raoni é transferido para São Paulo para dar continuidade a tratamento de infecção pulmonar, diz boletim
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chief Raoni is transferred to São Paulo to continue treatment for a pulmonary infection, according to the bulletin.
article.articleSummary: Chief Raoni Metuktire, a 94-year-old Brazilian Indigenous leader, was transferred on 2026-06-19 at 11:30 from Hospital Dois Pinheiros in Sinop, Mato Grosso, to Hospital São Paulo (Escola Paulista de Medicina, UNIFESP) to continue treatment for a pulmonary infection. The move followed clinical improvement and was conducted by an aircraft provided by the Mato Grosso state government, with federal and state support to ensure uninterrupted care. Raoni had entered the Sinop hospital on 2026-06-14 at 17:00 after being flown from Peixoto de Azevedo, where he resides, following a vomiting episode on 2026-06-13. An upper digestive endoscopy was performed on 2026-06-17 under sedation with no complications. The report does not specify laboratory confirmation or the infection source, but confirms ongoing management of his respiratory condition with access to specialized care in São Paulo.

triage.headline_ja: カシケ・ラオニ氏がサンパウロに転院、肺感染症の治療を継続へ
triage.triage_reason: 個別患者の転院に関する医療記事であり、感染症アウトブレイク・集団発生の兆候がなく、公衆衛生上の重要な危機を示す証拠がない。
triage.notes: 本イベントはブラジルの著名な先住民指導者個人の医療転院に関する報道である。肺感染症の診断は確認されているが、これは単一患者のケースであり、感染症の集団発生（アウトブレイク）やシグナルには該当しない。公衆衛生上の感染症監視の対象外。ブラジルは監視対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsは空配列。

article.articleHeadline: നിപ്പ: സമ്പർക്കപ്പട്ടികയിലുള്ള എല്ലാവരും ആശുപത്രിവിട്ടു | Nipah: Everyone on the contact list has been discharged from the hospital
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nipah: Everyone on the contact list has been discharged from the hospital.
article.articleSummary: In Kerala, a Nipah virus disease patient at Kozhikode Medical College Hospital remains on ventilation; 14 contacts were monitored and all tested negative, with three discharged after observation. The patient is being treated per ICMR guidelines, including monoclonal antibodies alongside ribavirin and remdesivir. The National Joint Outbreak Response Team, led by District Collector M.S. Madhavikkutty, discussed field assessments with the Kozhikode team, and a seven-member NCDC joint team under Dr. Rameshwar Sorohaibam is coordinating the response. Separately, 10 additional Shigella infections were confirmed across the state: Kozhikode (3), Thiruvananthapuram, Malappuram, and Thrissur (2 each), Palakkad (1). June alone accounts for 120 cases, with a year-to-date total of 196 Shigella cases. Public health surveillance and outbreak response continue.

triage.headline_ja: ニパウイルス：接触者リストのすべての人が病院から退院
triage.triage_reason: ニパウイルスは高い致命率を有する新興感染症であり、IHR基準の「異常性」と「国際的拡大リスク」に該当する可能性があるが、記事では1例の患者が人工呼吸器装着中で接触者は全員陰性または退院とされており、現時点での流行規模の詳細が不明。続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: ニパウイルスは高い致命率（40～75%）を有する新興感染症。記事ではケーララ州で1例の重症患者と14名の接触者（全員陰性または退院）が報告されている。国家合同アウトブレイク対応チーム（NCDC）が対応中。同時にシゲラ菌感染も複数州で報告されているが、本トリアージはニパウイルスに焦点を当てた。詳細な臨床転帰、患者の追加症例有無、地域感染の有無などの情報が不足しており、続報により判定が変わる可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: ಶಿಗೆಲ್ಲ ಸೋಂಕು: ಎಚ್ಚರಿಕೆ ಬೇಕು (ಕುಶಲವೇ ಕ್ಷೇಮವೇ)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Shigellosis: Caution Needed (Skill is safety)
article.articleSummary: Shigellosis is rising in Kerala, India, though the Shigella bacteria are extremely small and can seriously damage the intestinal lining. Transmission is easy between people, driven by contaminated food and water and poor hand hygiene. Shigella, a member of the Enterobacteriaceae family, damages the intestinal lining, causing fever, abdominal pain, cramps, and sometimes blood-tinged stools; the illness can lead to severe dehydration and, in some cases, death. The infection was first identified in 1897 by Japanese scientist Kiyoshi Shiga, after whom the organism is named. Globally, shigellosis remains a major public health challenge, affecting hundreds of thousands of people each year, with children under five at particularly high risk. Although not new, the recent uptick in Kerala underscores the ongoing risk of outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: シゲラ感染症：注意が必要（技術は安全）
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外な増加、国際的拡大リスク）。WPRO基準も複数該当し、ケララ州での最近の増加傾向は監視が必要なシグナルである。
triage.notes: ケララ州でのシゲラ菌感染症の最近の増加が報告されている。記事は教育的内容だが、感染経路（汚染された食水、不十分な手衛生）、脆弱層（5歳以下の小児）、重症化リスク（脱水、死亡）が明記されており、公衆衛生上の懸念は正当である。ただし、具体的な症例数、流行規模、政府の対応状況については情報不足。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo: Efforts ramp up as Ebola outbreak accelerates beyond borders
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) accelerates: as of 17 June, 896 confirmed cases and 232 deaths across 31 health zones; Uganda reports 19 cases and 2 deaths. Ongoing conflict with the M23 group and widespread displacement—over 2 million displaced and 320,000 refugees—raise regional cross-border risk to Uganda, Rwanda, Burundi, Tanzania and South Sudan. UNHCR-led preparedness strengthens surveillance, screening, infection prevention/control, and water, sanitation and hygiene in refugee-hosting areas and border corridors. On 7 June, 2,250 people from Mbau near Beni arrived in Oicha, North Kivu, underscoring movement from an Ebola epicenter already hosting more than 14,300 displaced. WHO has deployed 115+ experts and over 110 tonnes of emergency supplies; IOM reports over 1 million screenings at borders and routes. UNFPA highlights 90% maternal mortality among pregnant women and up to 100% perinatal mortality in some settings, deploying 153 midwives with calls for emergency funding; diagnostic and treatment capacities are expanding but access remains constrained.

triage.headline_ja: DRC：エボラ流行が国境を超えて加速する中、対応が強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラウイルス病は公衆衛生上重篤で、DRCで896確定患者・232死亡、ウガンダでも19例の確認報告があり、複数国への国際的拡大が既に進行中。紛争と大規模難民移動により地域的流行拡大のリスクが極めて高い。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが付与した発生地域にはSudan, Rwanda, Tanzania, Burundi, Ugandaが含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題は「DRCでのエボラ流行」であり、ウガンダは19例の確定患者報告がされているものの、検証されたロケーションは対象国リストに基づきDRCのみとする。ただしウガンダも対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。紛争、大規模難民移動（200万人以上）、高い死亡率（妊産婦・周産期死亡が極めて高い）が付加的リスク要因。WHO/IOM/UNHCRの大規模な国際対応が既に展開中。

article.articleHeadline: Вирусолог Викулов рассказал, угрожает ли Эбола россиянам
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Virologist Vikulov explained whether Ebola poses a threat to Russians.
article.articleSummary: June 19, 2026, Moscow – Ebola poses no risk to residents of Russia; danger exists only for tourists traveling to African countries. Virologist Georgiy Vikulov says Ebola is endemic in Africa, where natural foci are located. The emergence of a new strain raises the threat for anyone in direct contact with infected individuals; however, Russia has not recorded any cases, including imported ones. Russia maintains a robust sanitary shield and perimeter system to strictly monitor any imported infections. Domestic clinicians are well versed in the disease and have established procedures for identifying suspected cases, reducing risk to the population. Previously, nearly 200 people died of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo.

triage.headline_ja: ウイルス学者ビクロフ氏、エボラがロシア人に脅威をもたらすかどうかについて説明
triage.triage_reason: 記事はロシアのウイルス学者による見解を報道したもので、DRCでのエボラ発生は既知の事象。ロシア国内では症例報告がなく、国内流行の危険性は低いと評価されている。国際的拡大リスクの具体的な根拠に乏しく、シグナル化の基準を満たさない。
triage.notes: 記事はロシアのメディアソースで、ロシア国内のエボラリスクについての専門家見解を報道したもの。DRCでの発生は既知事象であり、新規感染例や国際的な拡大の具体的な報告ではない。対象国はDRCのみが該当。

article.articleHeadline: 34 people fall ill in suspected food poisoning case after eating pizza in Maharashtra's Bhiwandi | Today News
article.articleSummary: 34 people, including several children, fell ill in Bhiwandi, Maharashtra (Thane district), after allegedly consuming shawarma pizza from Al Akbar Fast Food and Godown in New Laad Bazar, Panch Mohalla. Symptoms began Thursday afternoon (patients reported stomach pain, dizziness, nausea, and loose motions) after Wednesday night consumption; all 34 admitted and said to be out of danger. Police registered a case against the outlet owner under Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita provisions; two individuals detained. Food samples from the item were collected and sent for laboratory testing to determine contamination or improper handling. A surprise raid found extremely unhygienic preparation, storage, and handling, with no FSSAI licence, use of banned artificial colours (MSK Lion Green, Raspberry Red), stale cooking oil, and lack of water quality certification, pest control, and sanitation. Seizures included ~110 kg fried chicken and six 15-litre oil containers; case registered under the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, as investigators continue.

triage.headline_ja: マハーラシュトラ州ビワンディでピザ喫食後34人が食中毒疑いで発症
triage.triage_reason: 局所的な食中毒事件で、国際的な拡大リスクなし。患者は全員軽症で回復中。異なる病原体による流行ではなく単一の食品汚染イベント。
triage.notes: この事件は特定の不衛生な飲食店での単一イベント（shawarma pizza）に限定された局所的な食中毒事案。患者34名すべてが入院後回復中（out of danger）。感染症の流行ではなく、食品安全規制違反に基づく行政対応。IHRスクリーニングに該当しない通常の食品安全事案。

article.articleHeadline: OMS confirma 17 trabajadores sanitarios fallecidos por ébola en Rep....
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO confirms 17 healthcare workers have died from Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) persists: since the May 15 declaration, 75 health-care workers have been infected and 17 have died, a 20.46% case-fatality rate among healthcare workers. WHO says protection and mental health support are being provided, with PPE distributed to treatment and other health facilities. A Chinese medical team has arrived at zone zero in Bunia, Ituri, to assist, while Uganda plans an additional field team at the Arua border; in Uganda, 19 cases include 14 imported from DRC and 5 locally acquired. Across the DRC, nearly 900 infections and over 230 deaths have been confirmed. The outbreak prompted a WHO Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17, and the DRC—with extensive Ebola response experience—continues to grapple with cross-border transmission linked to past Kasai region outbreaks and the virus’s history since 1976.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱により17人のヘルスケアワーカーが死亡したことを確認
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当。エボラ出血熱の国際的な公衆衛生上の重大な脅威であり、複数国での感染確認と国際的な対応体制が既に発動されている。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱はIHR基準において最高レベルのシグナル。DRC内での約900感染、230死亡、ヘルスケアワーカーの高い死亡率（20.46%）、ウガンダへの越境感染（19例、うち14例がDRC由来）、WHO PHEICの発動（5月17日）、国際的な支援チーム派遣など、すべてのWPRO基準に該当。記事発行時点で既に公式な国際的対応が開始されている。

article.articleHeadline: Himachal Pradesh among leading states in TB elimination, says Shandil - The Tribune
article.articleSummary: TB Elimination efforts: Himachal Pradesh ranks among leading states in TB elimination under TB Mukt Bharat Abhiyan. Health Minister Dhani Ram Shandil, addressing a virtual TB Mukt Bharat Abhiyan meeting chaired by Union Health Minister Jagat Prakash Nadda in New Delhi, reported the state has achieved over 75% coverage in screening vulnerable populations in high-risk villages and wards. Alongside extensive screening, Himachal has increased X-ray examinations and NAAT testing and provides comprehensive care and support to TB patients. The minister credited ASHA workers, Ni-kshay Mitras, and active community participation for the progress. He pledged expansion of the TB diagnostic network and strengthening of healthcare infrastructure to sustain elimination efforts in the state.

triage.headline_ja: ヒマーチャル・プラデシュ州、TB排除で主要州の一つ、シャンディル州保健相が発表
triage.triage_reason: 結核排除プログラムの進捗報告であり、新規発生や危機的なアウトブレイクではない。IHR基準2つ以上の該当がなく、社会的・政治的関心も限定的である。
triage.notes: 記事はインド政府の結核排除プログラム（TB Mukt Bharat Abhiyan）におけるヒマーチャル・プラデシュ州の成果について、保健相が発表したポジティブなニュースである。既知の感染症制御プログラムの進捗報告であり、新規または異常なイベントではない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Beni : l'observance des mesures barrières recommandée aux élèves pendant les vacances - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Beni: Adherence to Barrier Measures Recommended to Students During the Holidays - ACP.
article.articleSummary: During holidays in Beni, Nord-Kivu, DRC, authorities urged adherence to Ebola barrier measures for students, citing a governor’s decree reported by ACP on 19 June 2026. Robert Kambale, head of the Education sub-division, said school heads were reminded to ensure students behave at home during vacations, wash hands regularly and correctly, and that parents install water points at their premises and uphold household hygiene. Souproved Kibonge emphasized close supervision of children, noting that the youngest are particularly vulnerable during this Ebola period and should avoid crowds and unnecessary outings. He reminded that Ebola is a scientifically proven reality and that disbelief is counterproductive. The guidance focuses on home hygiene and limiting exposure during school breaks as a preventive measure.

triage.headline_ja: ベニでのエボラ：休暇中の学生への感染防止対策の遵守推奨 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の発生は深刻だが、本記事は既知の流行地域（DRC北キヴ州ベニ）での予防啓発キャンペーンの報道であり、新たな急速な悪化や国際拡大を示す情報が不足している。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年6月19日付で、DRC北キヴ州ベニでのエボラ対策の予防啓発が主題。IHR基準は1つのみ該当（深刻な公衆衛生への影響）。WPROスクリーニング基準では3つ該当するが、新規発生ではなく既知流行地での防止対策キャンペーン報道であり、直ちにフルRRAを要する緊急シグナルではないと判断。続報で状況悪化の報告があれば再評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: OMS alerta por rápida propagación del ébola en el Congo - Nuevo Día
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO warns of the rapid spread of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo
article.articleSummary: WHO warns that the Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo’s northeast is spreading rapidly, despite intensified international and local response efforts. As of 19 June 2026, transmission is accelerating across multiple affected areas, with health teams racing to contain the surge. Marie-Roseline Belizaire, WHO Africa emergencies chief, described the outbreak as grave and rapidly evolving, noting a gradual strengthening of on-the-ground response capacities. The outbreak was officially declared on 15 May 2026. Notably, the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola reportedly circulated undetected during an initial period, complicating early containment. No case or death counts are provided in the report. The article emphasizes the need for continued, expanded interventions to curb transmission in northeast communities.

triage.headline_ja: WHO がコンゴ民主共和国でのエボラウイルスの急速な感染拡大について警告
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱は極めて高い致死率を持つ感染症であり、コンゴ民主共和国での急速な感染拡大は IHR 基準の「深刻な公衆衛生影響」「異常/予想外」「国際拡大リスク」に該当。WHO の公式警告と国際対応が行われており、フルリスク評価（RRA）への進行が必須。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は極めて危険性が高く、Bundibugyo strain が初期段階で未検出だったため早期封じ込めが複雑化。WHO アフリカ地域事務局の緊急対応責任者が事態の重大性と急速な進展を明言。記事には症例数・死亡数は記載されていないが、「急速な感染拡大」「加速する伝播」との記述から中等度以上の重症度が推定される。国際対応が既に開始されているが継続的な拡大対応の必要性が強調されている。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola se acelera en el este de la RD Congo: OMS | MÁSNOTICIAS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola accelerates in eastern DRC: WHO | MÁSNOTICIAS.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak accelerates in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo. As of June 19, 2026, the World Health Organization confirms 896 cases and 232 deaths, with 21 new infections reported in the last 24 hours. Ituri province accounts for more than 91% of cases, while North Kivu reports a case-fatality rate exceeding 50%. The crisis unfolds amid armed conflict, population displacement, and severely limited basic services. UNFPA warns the emergency also jeopardizes maternal health and protection for women and girls; maternal mortality in Ituri has doubled since May 25. Fear and stigma drive delays in prenatal care and facility use. The outbreak threatens refugees, displaced persons, and migrants; over two million people are displaced in high-risk areas, and Ituri sees more than 16,000 daily cross-border movements. WHO notes progress in response but only 28% of required resources have been mobilized.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがDRC東部で加速：WHO
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラウイルス病の大規模流行で、深刻な公衆衛生影響（896例、232死亡）、異常性、国際的拡大リスク（難民・国境越境移動）、渡航・貿易制限リスクが明確。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域にDRCが正しく含まれており、記事サマリー上もDRC東部（Ituri及びNorth Kivu州）が主題。資源動員28%にとどまり、武力紛争・人口移動・国境越境など複数の増幅因子が存在。女性・妊婦への影響も報告されている。フルRRA実施推奨。

article.articleHeadline: At least 30 deaths at Congo camp show Ebola could be spreading fast
article.articleSummary: At least 30 people have died in Kigonze camp, Ituri province, eastern Congo, with Ebola-like symptoms—headache, fever and vomiting. Camp spokesperson Desire Grodya Bapi said ten were buried this week, far above the 1–3 monthly norm. Residents, aid workers and a leader told Reuters that bodies were piling up, with health teams disinfecting as families refused autopsies or tests; samples from five victims have been sent and results awaited. Health officials first declared an Ebola outbreak in May, with deaths beginning earlier, amid fears the virus is circulating undetected among over 5 million displaced people in eastern Congo. Sanitation is strained: overflowing latrines and limited toilets; WASH funding for Congo halved from 2024 to 2025, and this year's appeal is only 21% funded. U.S. aid has long supported WASH and Ebola response, though exact contributions are unclear. Another camp in Ituri has Ebola deaths, with 900 confirmed cases province-wide.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのキゴンゼ難民キャンプで少なくとも30人が死亡、エボラウイルスが急速に拡散している可能性を示唆
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてが該当（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、異常な死亡数、国際的拡大リスク、国際支援必要性）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度・長期曝露・流行性・管理可能性が明確に該当。フルRRA進行が必要。
triage.notes: Bluedotの発生地域にUSAが含まれているが、記事サマリーではUSAは援助国として言及されているのみで、実際の発生地はDRC（イトゥリ州のキゴンゼキャンプ）に限定される。DRCのみを verified_locations に含める。5百万人以上の避難民への曝露、衛生施設の不備、検査体制の不十分さが重要なリスク要因として明記されている。

article.articleHeadline: Al menos 30 muertes en un campamento del Congo muestran que el ébola podría estar propagándose rápidamente
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: At least 30 deaths at a camp in Congo show that Ebola could be spreading rapidly.
article.articleSummary: At least 30 people have died since early May at the Kigonze displacement camp in Bunia, Ituri province, northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, suggesting Ebola could be spreading rapidly. Reported symptoms—headache, fever, vomiting—align with Ebola, but causes remain unconfirmed as residents and relatives refuse testing for the living and the dead. Kigonze houses over 15,000 residents amid more than 5 million displaced in eastern Congo. Five samples have been collected from victims and await results; the outbreak was first declared in mid-May. The province of Ituri accounts for the majority of nearly 900 confirmed Ebola cases, with cholera also presenting similar symptoms as a differential diagnosis. Sanitation is strained, with overflowing toilets; funding for WASH has declined, though US aid has supported relief and outbreak response efforts totaling hundreds of millions of dollars.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴの難民キャンプで少なくとも30人が死亡、エボラウイルスが急速に拡散している可能性を示唆
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、複数の重大リスク要因を備えている。エボラとコレラの同時発生、大規模難民キャンプ、衛生状況の悪化、および検査拒否による確認不足が存在する。
triage.notes: Ituri州Bunia市の難民キャンプ（Kigonze）が主発生地。5月以降30人以上の死亡、症状はエボラに合致するが未確定。15,000人以上が密集する難民キャンプで衛生状況が悪化しており、ヒト-ヒト感染リスク高い。検体5件が検査待ちの状態。東部コンゴでは既に約900人の確定患者が報告されており、エボラとコレラの鑑別診断の問題も存在。米国が多額の援助を実施中。

article.articleHeadline: Efforts Intensify as Ebola Spreads Beyond DR Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo is expanding, with 896 confirmed cases and 232 deaths across 31 health zones as of 17 June; Uganda reports 19 cases and two deaths. The regional risk is rising amid ongoing armed violence in eastern DRC and cross-border movement toward Uganda, Rwanda, Burundi, Tanzania and South Sudan. WHO and partners urge ceasefire to sustain lifesaving aid. UNHCR is boosting preparedness in neighbouring countries, strengthening surveillance, screening, infection prevention, WASH, and refugee-hosting areas, following displacement from Mbau near Beni to Oicha, North Kivu. IOM reports over one million screenings at borders and along routes, with operations at over 110 entry points. WHO has deployed 115 experts; more than 110 tonnes of emergency supplies delivered. High maternal mortality—up to 90% among pregnant Ebola patients, with perinatal mortality up to 100% in some settings; UNFPA deploying 153 midwives. Funding appeals: UNFPA $17.1m, UNHCR $14m, Uganda $15.8m.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱がコンゴ民主共和国を超えて拡大する中、対応努力が強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5つすべてに該当。エボラ熱の多国間への拡大と高い死亡率は国際的に重大なシグナル。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではコンゴ民主共和国（北キブ州）が主要な発生地域。ウガンダへの拡大と地域的リスク増加が記載されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。DRCのみが対象国リストに該当。武装紛争による対応困難性と高い妊産婦死亡率（最大90%）が報告され、深刻性は極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: O boală letală se transmite de la pisici la oameni. Mii de feline, moarte în America de Sud. Cauza: o ciupercă * Newsweek România
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A deadly disease is transmitted from cats to humans. Thousands of felines dead in South America. Cause: a fungus * Newsweek Romania
article.articleSummary: Sporothrix brasiliensis–caused sporotrichosis is a deadly fungal disease affecting cats in South America, with human infections spreading beyond Brazil. Since its emergence in Brazil in the 1990s, the fungus has sickened thousands of cats and infected more than 11,000 people and 200 dogs across SA, Paraguay, Chile, Argentina, and Uruguay. The outbreak could reach the United States; urban centers like Istanbul and Bangkok where cats mingle are highlighted. Cats develop ulcerative cutaneous lesions, nodules, and enlarged lymph nodes; untreated disease can become respiratory and disseminated. In humans, painful cutaneous ulcers may progress to severe illness in immunocompromised individuals; it is 100% fatal without treatment, and mortality remains high even with therapy. Transmission occurs via scratches, bites, or inhalation of spores; spores persist on surfaces up to 10 weeks, but bleach and ethanol inactivate the fungus.

triage.headline_ja: 猫から人間に伝染する致命的な病気。南米で数千匹の猫が死亡。原因：真菌
triage.triage_reason: スポロトリコーシスは南米で数千匹の猫と11,000人以上の人間に影響を与えており、IHR基準（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）を複数満たす。未治療時の致命率100%、ヒト-ヒト感染リスク、複数国への拡大が懸念される。
triage.notes: 発生地域リストにはイスタンブール（トルコ）、バンコク（タイ）、米国、南米諸国が含まれるが、記事サマリーから実際の発症地域として検証されるのはブラジル（1990年代から発生地）とタイ（バンコク）のみ。バンコクについてはサマリーで「都市中心部」として言及されているが、具体的な発症報告の明確な記述がないため慎重な解釈が必要。ただしスクリーニング段階では含める判断。パラグアイ、チリ、アルゼンチン、ウルグアイは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。米国への到達可能性は言及されているが既発生ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Rusia Kirim 7.000 Alat Tes Ebola ke Afrika untuk Hadapi Wabah Baru
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Russia Sends 7,000 Ebola Test Kits to Africa to Face a New Outbreak
article.articleSummary: Russia has dispatched over 7,000 Ebola PCR test kits to African nations to counter a potential outbreak driven by the Bundibugyo strain in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda. Russia’s consumer-protection watchdog, Rospotrebnadzor, says it was among the first to develop and manufacture PCR diagnostics for the Bundibugyo variant within four days of the threat’s emergence. The kits have been sent to multiple African countries, with additional shipments to North Korea and Turkmenistan as part of international health cooperation. Russian experts, working with Ugandan colleagues, have performed more than 1,500 diagnostic tests on samples from confirmed Ebola patients or individuals suspected of exposure. The article notes ongoing concerns about Ebola re-emergence in parts of Africa, though no case counts are provided.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア、アフリカへのエボラ出血熱対策としてエボラ検査キット7,000個を送付
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱（高リスク病原体）の新規アウトブレイク（Bundibugyo株）がコンゴ民主共和国・ウガンダで発生しており、国際的な対応が開始されている。IHR基準3項目該当、WPRO基準複数該当。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株エボラの新規アウトブレイクが報告されており、複数国への検査キット派遣が開始されている。記事サマリーではウガンダも言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には DRC のみを含めた。北朝鮮・トルクメニスタンへの送付も記載されているが、これらは検査キット提供先であり、確認されたアウトブレイク発生地ではない。

article.articleHeadline: PSO: Konge Ebola užsikrėtė daugiau kaip 70 medicinos darbuotojų
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: In Congo, more than 70 healthcare workers infected with Ebola.
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Ebola outbreaks have infected more than 70 healthcare workers, with the outbreak officially declared on May 15. The virus appears to have circulated for months before the declaration, leading to early infections among nurses and physicians. Medical facilities face shortages of PPE such as gloves and masks. WHO Emergency Director Marie Roseline Belizaire, via video from the affected eastern region, noted the toll on the health system and the deployment of additional medical teams from Uganda and China. The WHO is also providing psychological support to staff wary of treating patients. Ebola transmission occurs through direct contact with infected body fluids, with an incubation period up to three weeks. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo strain (first identified in 2007), with a reported case fatality rate of roughly 30–50%.

triage.headline_ja: WHO: コンゴでエボラ出血熱に70人以上の医療従事者が感染
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限のリスク）。エボラ出血熱の医療従事者への集団感染は極めて高リスクのシグナルであり、フルRRAが必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリー上、エボラ感染の主要な発生地はDRCであり、UgandaおよびChina（医療チーム派遣元）は対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。China(1814991)は医療チーム派遣国として言及されているため、対象国リストに含まれることから検証対象に含める。エボラ出血熱は極めて致命的（30-50%の死亡率）で、医療従事者への感染は医療システム崩壊リスク、国際的な支援ニーズ、および対外的な関心が極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Gripe e VSR: Fiocruz aponta alta de hospitalizações em novo boletim
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Flu and RSV: Fiocruz points to an increase in hospitalizations in a new bulletin.
article.articleSummary: During the June 7–13 period, Fiocruz's InfoGripe bulletin reports rising hospitalizations for Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SRAG) linked to influenza A and B across youths, adults, and elderly individuals, and for respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) in young children in Brazil. Affected locations include 14 of 27 states showing SRAG incidence at alert, risk, or high risk with a long-term rising trend over six weeks. Nationwide, 89,725 SRAG cases were notified; 44,485 (49.6%) had laboratory confirmation of a respiratory virus; 7,740 (8.6%) are under analysis. Deaths total 3,842, with 1,772 (46.1%) laboratory-confirmed for a virus. Vaccination remains crucial: seasonal influenza vaccine; RSV immunization is offered publicly to pregnant women from 28 weeks gestation. A slight uptick in COVID-19 cases is noted; boosters are recommended per current policy. Public health measures include masks in crowded indoor spaces and isolation when symptomatic.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザとRSV：Fiocruzが新しい報告書で入院の増加を指摘
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外な事象、国際的拡大リスク）。ブラジルにおける複数呼吸器ウイルスの同時流行による3,842死亡を含む大規模なSRAG患者増加が報告されており、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: ブラジルの複数の州（27州中14州）で alert/risk/high risk レベルのSRAG発生が6週間の上昇トレンドで続いている。89,725SRAG症例中3,842死亡（致死率4.3%）と深刻。インフルエンザA/B、RSV、COVID-19の同時流行パターンが特徴。公式情報源（Fiocruz InfoGripe）による定期報告であり、情報の信頼性は高い。

article.articleHeadline: 88 fall ill after eating at Bhiwandi fast food joint
article.articleSummary: Mass foodborne illness in Bhiwandi, Maharashtra, India, with 88 people ill after consuming shawarma, pizza, and falooda from the Famous Shawarma shop on Khandu Pada Road. Of the 88 cases, 33 are women and 14 are children; the count rose from 11 on Thursday to 88 by Friday evening. Patients report stomach pain, vomiting, diarrhoea, and nausea within hours of eating. All are being treated at Indira Gandhi Memorial Hospital; authorities say patients are stable. Specimens—vomit and stool—have been collected for chemical analysis at FSL Kalina and for biological examination at Kalwa’s Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Hospital. The FDA sealed the outlet. A case has been registered against shop owner Dilshad Ansari (27), with investigations by FDA, health department, and Shanti Nagar police to determine negligence or violations in food safety norms. No final lab confirmation yet.

triage.headline_ja: ビワンディのファストフードで食事をした88人が発病
triage.triage_reason: 集団食中毒イベントで急速に患者数が増加（88人）しており、重症度は中程度（全員安定状態）。ただし食由来イベントであり国際的リスクは低く、当面は地域レベルの対応で管理可能と判断される。情報確定（病原体確定、健康影響の最終的な重症度など）待ちのため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 食中毒イベント。患者数の急速な増加（木曜11人→金曜夕方88人）が注目される。病原体確定前であり、検査結果（FSL Kalinaでの化学分析およびバイオロジカル検査）の結果次第で重症度評価が変わる可能性がある。現時点では患者は安定状態にある。食由来イベントであり国際的リスクは低い。

article.articleHeadline: Protocolo identifica risco de contaminação entre viveiros de peixes de uma mesma bacia hidrográfica
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Protocol Identifies Risk of Contamination Among Fish Farms Within the Same Watershed
article.articleSummary: Brazil's Embrapa Pesca e Aquicultura (Tocantins) and Italy's IZSVe applied a GIS-based protocol to assess disease risk among fish farms connected within the same watershed. The study centers on the acanthocephalan parasite in tambaqui (Colossoma macropomum) and adapted an Italian surveillance framework to Brazil to create an early-warning map classifying ponds as high, medium, or low contamination risk. Transmission relies on water connectivity: parasite eggs excreted by infected fish reach ostracodes (intermediate hosts), and healthy fish become infected after consuming these hosts, with a two-month life cycle. The approach, validated in Brazil and inspired by a 2015 Rondônia outbreak, aims to help contain sanitary events in Brazilian pisciculturas. Publication: Frontiers in Marine Science. Economic impact is notable; infected fish can lose up to 20% of weight, underscoring data-access challenges for georeferenced disease occurrences.

triage.headline_ja: プロトコルが同じ流域内の養魚場間の汚染リスクを特定
triage.triage_reason: 本イベントは養魚場における寄生虫（アカントセファラ）のリスク評価に関する学術的研究であり、進行中の感染症アウトブレイクではない。公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や国際的な拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限の可能性は認められない。
triage.notes: 本記事は養魚産業における寄生虫リスク評価に関する学術的プロトコルの開発・応用であり、感染症アウトブレイクではない。イタリアの監視枠組みがブラジルに適用されているが、これは疾病管理方法論の共有であり、イタリア自体での実際の発生を示していない。したがって verified_locations はBrazilのみとする。

article.articleHeadline: More than 70 medics infected with Ebola as DRC outbreak spreads 'fast'
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) continues to surge, with the Bundibugyo strain linked to 232 deaths and 896 infections across 31 health zones. Seventeen medics have died and 75 healthcare workers have contracted the virus since authorities declared the outbreak on May 15. WHO emergency director Marie Roseline Belizaire described the outbreak as serious and evolving fast, with persistent PPE shortages. The DRC has about 11 health workers per 10,000 people. Uganda reports 19 cases and 2 deaths; AU pledged nearly $1 billion for the response. In Bunia’s Ituri province, Kigonze camp has seen at least 30 deaths since early May amid overcrowding and testing resistance. Donors have cut funding for WASH, halving 2024–25 levels to about $38 million, with only 21% of this year’s $80 million appeal funded. Officials warn the outbreak remains unpeaked, with risk to displaced populations.

triage.headline_ja: 70人以上の医療従事者がエボラウイルスに感染、DRC感染症の急速な拡大
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WPRO基準もすべて該当。エボラウイルスは最高度の危険病原体であり、死亡率が高く、医療従事者への感染が報告されている。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo株）の大規模アウトブレイク。DRCで232死亡、896感染、31ヘルスゾーンで拡大。医療従事者75人が感染し17人が死亡。ウガンダへの二次的拡大も確認（19症例、2死亡）。WHO緊急対応部長が「深刻かつ急速に進化している」と評価。資金不足、過密状態、検査への抵抗が悪化要因。対象国はDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: Dezenas de mortes em campo de refugiados no Congo geram suspeita de ebola descontrolado
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dozens of deaths in a refugee camp in the Congo raise suspicions of uncontrolled Ebola.
article.articleSummary: At least 30 people have died since early May in Kigonze refugee camp, home to over 15,000 displaced in northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, amid an unusual death surge raising concerns about Ebola spread. Camp leader Dz'djo Ndrutsi Etienne said ten deaths occurred this week, versus 1–3 per month normally. Local sources report Ebola-compatible symptoms—fever, headaches, vomiting—yet families refused post-mortem testing, hindering confirmation. Burials have sometimes occurred without safety protocols, complicating outbreak control. Last week UNHCR confirmed Ebola-related deaths in nearby Kpangba camp: a 60-year-old woman and her daughter were diagnosed after death, with at least eight close contacts identified. Since WHO declared a public health emergency of international concern on May 17, the virus has spread to three provinces, with over 800 cases and nearly 200 deaths in the DRC. Funding for water, sanitation and hygiene has fallen, with 2025 WASH at about $38 million and only 21% of this year's $80 million budget funded.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴの難民キャンプでの数十人の死亡がコントロール不能なエボラの疑いを引き起こす
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つすべてに該当。既存の公式エボラ緊急事態に加え、難民キャンプでの新たな死亡集積と複数州への拡大が確認されており、国際的な懸念と感染拡大リスクが極めて高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRC内の複数の具体的地点（Kigonze難民キャンプ、Kpangbaキャンプ）でのエボラ関連死亡を述べている。Sierra Leone はBluedot APIの発生地域に含まれるが、サマリーに言及されていないため除外。既にWHOが5月17日に国際的懸念事項としての公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言済みであり、本イベントは進行中の既知の危機における新たな集積として扱われるべき。資金不足（WASH予算の不足）も管理可能性を低下させている。

article.articleHeadline: मलेरिया, फाइलेरिया व डेंगू से बचाव को किया जागरूक
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Awareness created for protection against malaria, lymphatic filariasis, and dengue.
article.articleSummary: On Friday, at Ramcharan Singh Middle School, Bamunagama, the Health Department conducted an awareness drive during Malaria Month among female students and teachers. The session provided detailed information on malaria, lymphatic filariasis, and dengue, covering causes, symptoms, vector transmission, and preventive and control measures. The program aims to boost health awareness at the school level and to disseminate Malaria Month objectives to the broader community. Key preventive actions highlighted were maintaining cleanliness, preventing water stagnation, using mosquito nets, and seeking timely treatment. The article does not report any specific malaria, filariasis, or dengue cases or outbreaks, nor laboratory confirmations or imported/exported cases. The initiative underscores school-based health education as a critical component of vector-borne disease prevention in Bamunagama.

triage.headline_ja: マラリア、リンパ系フィラリア症、デング熱への予防啓発活動を実施

article.articleHeadline: الاستخبارات الأمريكية ترفع السرية عن ملفّ 'كورونا'
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: U.S. intelligence declassifies the 'Corona' file.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-06-19, former U.S. Director of National Intelligence Tulsi Gabbard declassified documents alleging new evidence of American funding for biological research at the Wuhan Institute of Virology in China, linked to the COVID-19 virus. Washington funded about 120 biological laboratories across 30 countries. Gabbard accuses former U.S. health official Anthony Fauci of a central role in supporting these efforts, following earlier declassified materials on more than 120 labs worldwide. The release does not prove all accusations against Fauci, but intensifies U.S. debate over the origin of SARS-CoV-2 and the role of gain-of-function research in virus development. Gabbard argues that transparency about high-risk pathogen research is necessary. Critics contend the listed labs and programs were part of public health and biosecurity, not bioweapons development, and that millions in taxpayer funds supported Wuhan-linked projects with concealed information from Congress and the public.

triage.headline_ja: 米国情報機関が『コロナ』ファイルの機密指定を解除

triage.notes: 本記事は2026年6月19日のデートであるが、内容は過去のCOVID-19パンデミック起源に関する文書の機密指定解除についての政治的報道であり、新規感染症イベント、現在のアウトブレイク、または公衆衛生上の急迫的な懸念を示すものではない。感染症危機管理の観点からシグナルとして拾い上げる必要性は低い。社会的・政治的関心は高いが、感染症学的リスク評価には該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Awareness campaign, fogging to tackle vector-borne diseases | Delhi News
article.articleSummary: Delhi's Municipal Corporation (MCD) launched an early vector-control campaign, including fogging and awareness drives, to curb mosquito-borne diseases in response to erratic rainfall. The initiative targets dengue, malaria, and chikungunya, with Mayor Pravesh Wahi flagging off 10 auto-rickshaws per zone carrying banners and public-address messages. Domestic breeding checkers will continue door-to-door inspections, complemented by street plays and pamphlets. Residents are urged to keep surroundings clean and eliminate standing water for more than four days in containers, tyres, and rooftop premises. MCD's weekly vector-borne disease report records 162 dengue cases in Delhi so far this year, and teams conducted over 8.3 lakh house visits in a single week to check for mosquito breeding.

triage.headline_ja: 媒介蚊対策のための啓発キャンペーンと薫蒸を実施 | デリー ニュース

article.articleHeadline: فى آخر يوم عمل لها.. مديرة الاستخبارات الأمريكية تفجر مفاجأة عن منشأ فيروس كورونا |
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: On her last day at work, the Director of U.S. Intelligence drops a bombshell about the origin of the coronavirus.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-06-19, Tulsi Gabbard, the outgoing Director of U.S. National Intelligence, released a trove of declassified documents on the origins of COVID-19. The materials, including emails and previously unreleased communications, purportedly allege that Dr. Anthony Fauci, former head of NIAID, funded gain-of-function research on coronaviruses at the Wuhan Institute of Virology in China with U.S. taxpayer dollars. Gabbard claims Fauci influenced intelligence assessments regarding the pandemic’s origin and misled Congress during testimony in 2024. The documents reportedly show Fauci directing millions of dollars to research tied to bat coronaviruses at the Wuhan institute, and coordinating with intelligence officials to obscure actions and support the lab-leak hypothesis. These claims intensify the ongoing U.S. debate over natural zoonotic spillover versus laboratory-associated origins of SARS-CoV-2.

triage.headline_ja: アメリカ国家情報長官、退職最終日にコロナウイルス起源について爆弾発言を放出

article.articleHeadline: ЗИКА ВИРУС ВО МАКЕДОНИЈА: Првиот регистриран случај е увезен од патување на Малдиви
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Zika virus in Macedonia: The first registered case was imported from a trip to the Maldives.
article.articleSummary: Zika virus identified in North Macedonia as the first registered case, imported from a trip to the Maldives. A Macedonian citizen who was in the Maldives from May 20 to 28 likely contracted the virus from an infected mosquito. Symptoms began during the trip and included fever, muscle and joint pains, and a mildly elevated body temperature, with a rash developing days later. Upon return, laboratory confirmation was made by the Institute of Public Health’s Virology Department. The patient was not hospitalized and is currently recovering at home in good health. Health authorities stress this is an imported case and there is no immediate public health threat, though ongoing travel to tropical destinations (Maldives, Thailand, Indonesia, Brazil, Caribbean region) could yield additional cases. Citizens are advised to use mosquito bite protection and follow officials’ recommendations.

triage.headline_ja: マケドニアのジカウイルス：最初に登録された症例はモルディブへの旅行からの輸入事例
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準は2つ以上該当していないが、WPROスクリーニング基準で「異常/予想外」「流行しやすさ」に該当し、国際的な輸入事例として情報価値がある。ただし対象国での発生ではなく、輸入事例のため経過観察段階とする。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はマケドニアでのジカウイルス輸入事例だが、マケドニアは対象国リストに含まれていない。記事は対象国（タイ、インドネシア、ブラジル）への旅行リスクについても言及しており、これらの国をverified_locationsに含める。モルディブは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。患者は回復中で入院していないため重症度は低いが、蚊媒介感染のリスク存在により流行しやすさ基準に該当。

article.articleHeadline: OMS alerta por rápida propagación del ébola en República Democrática del Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO warns of rapid spread of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: WHO warns rapid spread of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with 896 confirmed cases and 232 deaths as the latest count, including 21 new infections in the last 24 hours. Declared May 15, the outbreak involves the rare Bundibugyo strain and is surging in the northeast, concentrated in Ituri province (over 90% of cases) with spillover to North Kivu and South Kivu. Uganda reports 19 cases and 2 deaths, 10 recoveries, and no new cases in 12 days. Response has expanded Ebola beds from 0 to over 500; surveillance handles ~400 alerts daily and more than 2,000 tests per day. Contact tracing covers 75% of contacts; 95% tracing is targeted to control transmission. Transmission occurs through close contact with infected bodily fluids, with emphasis on safer/ dignified burials to reduce contagion risk associated with handling corpses.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがコンゴ民主共和国でのエボラの急速な拡大について警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当（重大な公衆衛生への影響、異常なBundibugyo株の出現、ウガンダへの国際的拡大、国際的関心の高まり）。スクリーニング基準も複数該当し、社会的・政治的関心が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Главные новости дня | пятница: Ливан, Газа, Эбола, поездка главы ООН в Лондон
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Top News of the Day | Friday: Lebanon, Gaza, Ebola, UN Secretary-General's Trip to London
article.articleSummary: Israeli airstrikes in southern Lebanon have killed at least 18 people, with UN humanitarian officials condemning the escalation and urging freedom of movement for peacekeepers amid broader tensions after a US–Iran accord. In Gaza, since the October 2025 ceasefire, 265 children have been killed, averaging one child per day for over eight months; total Palestinian deaths approach 1,000 and more than 3,100 people have been injured, while 1.1 million children and their families face daily access to clean water challenges. Ebola outbreaks continue in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with 896 confirmed cases and 232 deaths; the risk group includes women, healthcare workers, and displaced persons, and the IOM reports over one million health screenings at border points and major routes. UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres will travel to London for Climate Week to deliver a climate-energy address and participate in related summits on energy, electrification, local leadership, and climate finance.

triage.headline_ja: トップニュース | 金曜日：レバノン、ガザ、エボラ、国連事務総長のロンドン訪問
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで継続的に発生中（確認患者896人、死亡232人）。IHR基準2つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な重症疾患、国際的拡大リスク）。スクリーニング基準複数該当。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでのエボラ継続流行を主題とし、確認患者896人・死亡232人という重症度の高いデータを含む。IOM による国境での100万件以上の健康スクリーニング実施は、国際的な拡大懸念を反映。レバノン、ガザ、ロンドン訪問などの他の地域記事は添付されているが、本シグナルはエボラに限定される。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola im Kongo: Todesfälle im Flüchtlingslager Kigonze alarmieren Helfer
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the Congo: Deaths in the Kigonze refugee camp alarm aid workers.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in Kigonze refugee camp, Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, reports 10 deaths in 48 hours (7 on Wednesday, 3 on Thursday), including eight children and two adults. Victims exhibited symptoms such as headache, fever and vomiting; five of the deceased have been sampled, with lab results pending. The overpacked camp houses more than 15,000 internally displaced people; since early May, at least 30 deaths have occurred there, far above the usual 1–3 per month. Risks include dense living conditions and unsafe corpse handling, with some bodies stored in a closed gathering room. Ebola is not airborne; transmission occurs via blood, body fluids, contaminated objects, or contact with the deceased. The WHO notes a Bundibugyo-virus Ebola outbreak in the DRC: as of 17 June, 896 confirmed cases and 232 deaths, with Bunia health zone at 247 confirmed cases (highest). WASH funding has been reduced; UN data show toilets/handwashing funds around $38 million for 2024–2025.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ：キゴンゼ難民キャンプでの死亡例が支援者に警告を与える
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病の集団発生で、難民キャンプという高リスク環境での急速な死亡増加、国際的な支援が必要な状況。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo型）の活発な集団発生。難民キャンプでの短期間（48時間）の10死亡例は異常。5月以来の死亡数は月間通常値の10倍超。密集した生活条件、不適切な遺体取扱い、WASH資金不足など、拡大リスク要因が複数存在。DRC全体で896確認症例・232死亡（6月17日時点）。フルRRA実施推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Mourners bury 6-month-old Ebola victim, marking third orphanage death in outbreak
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-19, mourners buried a 6-month-old girl in Bunia, Congo, the third orphanage death in the Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak. Ituri Province accounts for more than 90% of the 894 confirmed cases and more than 200 deaths. The response has been complicated by clashes over disrupted burials and a militarized approach to outbreak control. Bundibugyo Ebola has no approved treatment or vaccine, and health workers report shortages of PPE. The outbreak is roughly three times larger than Uganda’s 2000 outbreak and risks about 35,000 suspected contacts; it is not as deadly as the 2014 West Africa outbreak (over 11,000 deaths). Cases have reached North Kivu and South Kivu, with cross-border spread to Uganda (19 confirmed cases, two deaths). The infant’s burial underscores ongoing challenges around safe burials and community trust in the response.

triage.headline_ja: 6ヶ月の乳児エボラ患者の埋葬、アウトブレイク中の孤児院での3例目の死亡例を記録
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な健康被害、予想外の事象、国際的拡大のリスク、渡航制限リスク）。Bundibugyo型エボラの大規模アウトブレイクで、894確認症例、200以上の死亡、ウガンダへの越境感染19例、高い致死性と管理困難性を示す。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域にUganda（226074）およびAngola（3351879）が含まれているが、記事サマリーではDRC内での主要アウトブレイク、およびウガンダへの越境感染19例の言及のみで、アンゴラへの拡大は記述されていない。記事の主題はDRC発生のBundibugyo Ebola outbreak（2026年）であり、越境感染はウガンダにのみ確認されている。対象国リストではDRC（203312）のみが該当。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Beni: appel aux équipes de riposte à briser la résistance - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Beni: appeal to response teams to break down the resistance - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola response appeal in Beni, North Kivu, Democratic Republic of the Congo, urges teams to focus efforts in Mapera cell, Mambango neighborhood, amid active community resistance. Youths are opposing door-to-door sensitization on preventive measures, and some community relays are being harassed or chased, raising risks to outbreak control activities. Health facilities and responders face heightened scrutiny, with suspicion that patients flagged for Ebola may be kept from transfer to the reference hospital. Josué Kambale Musanzalire, head of Mambango, confirmed alerting the health zone and Mambango health area to intensify awareness efforts and ensure responders can carry out their duties. The Kasanga-Ndidi area previously endured heavy losses during the 2017–2020 Ebola outbreak, attributed to poisoning and misinformation. No specific current case counts are provided in this report.

triage.headline_ja: ベニでのエボラ：対応チームが抵抗を打ち破るよう呼びかけ - ACP
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外な対応困難、国際的拡大リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。エボラウイルス病の発生地域での社会的困難と対応阻害は重大なシグナル。
triage.notes: ベニ地域でのエボラ対応において、コミュニティの抵抗により感染予防啓発活動が阻害されている深刻な状況。過去の2017-2020年アウトブレイク（カサンガ-ンディディ地域での多数死亡）の教訓も重要。現在の確認症例数は報告されていないが、活動的な感染リスク環境が存在。国際的支援の必要性あり。

article.articleHeadline: Nord-Kivu: se protéger et protéger la communauté, arme efficace contre Ebola (Popal Isse) - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: North Kivu: Protecting Yourself and Protecting the Community, an Effective Weapon Against Ebola (Popal Isse) - ACP
article.articleSummary: North Kivu, DRC, reports Ebola virus disease outbreaks centered on Butembo and Katwa health zones. As of June 17, about 50 confirmed Ebola cases with 25 positives in each of the two zones covering Butembo city. The Bundibugyo strain has no available vaccine or approved treatment, highlighting the need for preventive measures. Local artist Popal Isse, based in Butembo, promotes protection as the most effective weapon and urges adherence to medical authorities’ guidance, aiming to sensitize communities through multilingual music (Swahili, Kinande, Lingala, Luganda). A new song addressing Ebola is set to release on June 21, World Music Day. Practical actions include proper handwashing with soap or ash and following media advisories. The message emphasizes prevention over cure and cautions against coercive approaches in the community.

triage.headline_ja: 北キブ州：自己防御と地域保護はエボラに対する効果的な武器（ポパル・イッセ）- ACP
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の確認症例（約50例、うち確認例25例）がDRC北キブ州ブテンボおよびカトワで報告されている。IHR基準の「深刻な公衆衛生影響」「予想外性」「国際的拡大リスク」の3項目に該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準の複数項目も満たす。フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 2026年配信日時は将来日付であり、記事は現在進行中の北キブ州エボラアウトブレイクを報告。ブンディブギョ株は利用可能なワクチンや承認済み治療法がないため重大な懸念。予防が強調され、地域感染症対策が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Newly Declassified 2020 Intelligence Assessment Found Wuhan Lab's Conditions Were Ripe For Potential Coronavirus Release
article.articleSummary: Newly declassified May 2020 Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory assessment concluded that the Wuhan Institute of Virology in Wuhan, China possessed the capabilities, materials, and research programs necessary for an accidental release of a laboratory-modified coronavirus. The analysis, prepared for US intelligence, set conditions including access to a SARS-CoV-2–related virus, a reverse genetics system, experiments involving human ACE2 receptors, and potential biosafety failures. It stopped short of proving engineering or a lab leak but said WIV could have supported such a scenario. ODNI released nearly 400 pages of COVID-19 origins records in June 2026, including emails debating gain-of-function research, natural emergence, and competing origin theories. The documents also note the EcoHealth Alliance–WIV partnership, and show analysts weighing three origin scenarios: lab-origin with accidental release, natural emergence, or accidental release of a naturally occurring virus.

triage.headline_ja: 新たに機密解除された2020年のインテリジェンス評価で、武漢研究所の状況はコロナウイルスの偶発的放出の可能性があったことが判明
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は2020年のインテリジェンス評価文書の機密解除に関する歴史的・政策的報道であり、現在進行中の感染症イベント（発生、流行、アウトブレイク）ではない。COVID-19起源論に関する過去の分析文書の公開が主題であり、IHR基準およびWPRO基準のいずれも該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事はBluedot APIが誤分類した可能性が高い。記事の主題は米情報機関による過去の分析文書の機密解除であり、現在のCOVID-19発生・流行・疫学的イベントではない。感染症危機管理・バイオセキュリティの監視対象外。

article.articleHeadline: OMS reporta 75 casos de ébola entre personal médico en RD Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO reports 75 Ebola cases among medical staff in DR Congo
article.articleSummary: 75 healthcare workers in the Democratic Republic of the Congo have contracted Ebola since the current outbreak began, with 17 deaths, according to the World Health Organization as of June 19, 2026. Emergency director Marie Roseline Bélizaire said the toll imposes a high cost on an already overstretched health system, noting a shortage of health workers in the DRC. WHO is providing psychological support to clinicians fearing exposure after colleagues' infections. China and Uganda have sent medical teams to assist in the response. Officials say the virus had been circulating for months before formal confirmation of cases on May 15, 2026, exposing staff to risk earlier. There is a grave shortage of basic personal protective equipment, including gloves and masks. Health workforce density in the DRC stands at about 11 health workers per 10,000 people.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴ民主共和国の医療従事者の間でエボラ感染75例を報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。医療従事者への感染による公衆衛生への重大な影響、予期しない医療システムへの負荷、国際的な支援体制の発動（中国・ウガンダの医療チーム派遣）が確認され、シグナルとしての優先度が高い。
triage.notes: 発生地域リストに中国とウガンダが含まれているが、サマリーの主題はコンゴ民主共和国での感染拡大であり、中国・ウガンダは支援国として言及されているのみ。対象国としてはDRCのみを verified_locations に計上した。医療従事者への集中的な感染は医療システムの機能維持に対する直接的脅威となり、国際的な関心が極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: OMS alerta por avance rápido del ébola en el Congo: "El brote sigue grave
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO warns of the rapid spread of Ebola in the Congo: "The outbreak remains serious."
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is spreading rapidly, driven by the Bundibugyo strain. Declared May 15, the outbreak has 896 confirmed cases and 232 deaths, with 21 new infections in the last 24 hours. Ituri province accounts for more than 90% of cases, and the epidemic has extended to North Kivu and South Kivu, areas already facing armed conflict. The WHO says the situation remains grave but response is strengthening: treatment beds rose from 0 to over 500 in weeks; surveillance handles about 400 alerts daily and more than 2,000 tests per day. Contact tracing covers 75% of exposed people, aiming for 95%. In neighboring Uganda, 19 cases and 2 deaths have been reported, with 10 recoveries; no new cases in 12 days. Ebola spreads through direct contact with infected bodily fluids; safe and dignified burials are emphasized.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴのエボラ急速拡大について警告「感染拡大は深刻な状況が続いている」
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準5項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病の確定症例896件、死亡232件、複数州への拡大、隣国ウガンダへの越境、急速な症例増加が確認されている重大なシグナル。
triage.notes: ウガンダでも19例の症例報告があるが、記事の主題はコンゴでの感染拡大。ウガンダ（対象国リストに未含有）は越境例として言及されているためverified_locationsに含めず。コンゴのイトゥリ州で90%以上の症例が集中し、南キブ州・北キブ州へ拡大。Bundibugyo株による感染。治療ベッド不足から急速な拡充（0→500床以上）、接触者追跡率75%、1日400件のアラート、2000件以上の検査実施など対応強化の記述あり。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Mongbwalu: trois nouveaux patients guéris sortent du centre de traitement - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Mongbwalu: three newly recovered patients leave the treatment center.
article.articleSummary: Three Ebola virus disease patients recovered and discharged from Mongbwalu's treatment center in Ituri's Djugu territory, northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, bringing the total recoveries to seven since care began, as of 19 June 2026. The hospital reported a man, a woman, and a young girl were discharged; among them is a health worker who serves as an accountant at a local health facility and was exposed through professional activities. After fever and headaches appeared, she sought care promptly, illustrating that early presentation improves odds of survival. WHO spokesperson Bavon Tangunza said the center’s early treatment approach is effective in saving lives and reducing transmission. He urged residents to seek medical attention quickly at first signs to boost recovery chances and limit spread.

triage.headline_ja: モングバワルのエボラ出血熱：3人の新たに回復した患者が治療センターを退院
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス疾患の患者発生は通常異常な事象ですが、本記事は新規事例報告ではなく回復・退院事例の報告であり、感染が制御されている兆候を示しています。国際的拡大リスクの評価には一層の情報が必要です。
triage.notes: 記事はエボラウイルス疾患患者の回復・退院の報告であり、治療成果を強調しています。IHR基準2つ以上該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準4つ該当していますが、新規症例の急速な増加や国際的拡大の具体的証拠が記事に明記されていないため、トリアージは WATCH としました。今後の症例数変化、国内での感染動向、及び国際的波及の状況を注視することが重要です。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : l'Africa CDC alerte sur les contacts perdus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: Africa CDC warns about lost contacts
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) reaches 875 confirmed cases and 202 deaths as of June 18, 2026 (one month since declaration), with 67 recoveries and 379 in isolation or hospitalized. Four new cases and deaths were reported in Ituri and North Kivu, and Fataki (Ituri) and Musienene (North Kivu) are now affected, bringing total zones affected to 33 across Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu. Ituri remains the epicenter with 799 cases and 158 deaths (91.3% of total); Nord-Kivu: 73 cases, 43 deaths; Sud-Kivu: 3 cases, 1 death. Uganda reports 19 cases, 2 deaths, and 7 recoveries. Africa CDC notes only ~12% of estimated contacts are actively followed; about 6,500 of ~35,000 contacts identified, ~4,100 followed. Bundibugyo strain with no vaccine or treatment; Ervebo only protects Zaïre strain. Response relies on detection, isolation, and contact tracing. Diagnostics: 24‑hour turnaround; 21,000 tests delivered; nine treatment centers (≈433 beds, 86% full) with nine more planned. Funding gap $21.5M; donors pledged $910M, including $80M from AU members. This is the 17th Ebola outbreak in DRC and the first Bundibugyo event; WHO PHEIC declared May 17.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ: アフリカCDCが紛失した接触者について警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当するPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）。875確定症例、202死亡、複数県で拡大。接触者追跡率が12%程度と低く管理性が課題。ワクチン不可用のBundibugyo株。国際的に深刻なシグナル。
triage.notes: WHO PHEIC既に宣言済み（2026年5月17日）。接触者追跡率が著しく低い（12%）ことが管理可能性の主要懸念。ウガンダでも19症例報告されているが、記事の主題はDRCの発生状況。Bundibugyo株は過去の流行と異なり、既存Erveboワクチン無効。資金不足($21.5M gap)も課題。

article.articleHeadline: ஜூன் 28-இல் தீவிர போலியோ சொட்டு மருந்து முகாம்
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Intensive Polio Drops Campaign on June 28.
article.articleSummary: Reported on 19 June 2026, Chennai Metropolitan Corporation areas will host an intensive polio drops vaccination campaign on 28 June, targeting children up to five years old. A total of 1,641 vaccination centers have been arranged, including 1,435 permanent centers, with 154 centers at bus stands and 52 centers on vehicles to improve access. The drive aims to immunize 556,877 children under five with polio drops. The campaign leverages a mix of fixed-site centers and outreach locations across the city to maximize coverage and ensure broad accessibility across urban neighborhoods and transit hubs.

triage.headline_ja: 6月28日の集中的なポリオドロップキャンペーン
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はポリオの予防接種キャンペーン計画の報道であり、新規患者発生や疾患集積を示す公衆衛生緊急事態ではない。既知疾患の定期的な予防接種活動は標準的な保健事業であり、シグナル基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は予防接種キャンペーンの実施計画を報じるもので、ポリオの患者発生やアウトブレイクを示す情報ではない。定期的な保健活動の実施報道であるため、感染症危機管理の対象外と判定。

article.articleHeadline: MPAC aciona Justiça contra Prefeitura de Sena Madureira por falta de políticas de proteção animal e controle de zoonoses
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: MPAC sues Sena Madureira City Hall for lack of animal protection policies and zoonosis control
article.articleSummary: Public prosecutor MPAC filed a Civil Public Action against Sena Madureira City Hall in Acre, Brazil, seeking urgent public health measures to control zoonoses and protect animals. The petition argues the municipality lacks an adequate facility for abandoned animals and does not have a Centro de Controle de Zoonoses (CCZ). Requested actions include: within 30 days, a plan for assisting stray and abused animals; a temporary shelter with veterinary care, food, and recovery resources; ongoing vaccination campaigns; a surgical castration program; responsible-ownership education; and the creation of a CCZ within 180 days with budget and surveillance capacity. The MPAC warns that poor sanitation and waste disposal amplify risks of rabies, leishmaniasis, and leptospirosis, posing threats to public health. The case awaits judicial decision; if granted, the municipality could be compelled to implement measures immediately.

triage.headline_ja: MPAC がセナ・マドゥレイラ市役所を提訴 - 動物保護政策と人獣共通感染症対策の不備により
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルの特定自治体における人獣共通感染症（狂犬病、リーシュマニア症、レプトスピラ症）対策の不備が報告されており、スクリーニング基準の1つ以上に該当する可能性があるが、具体的な患者数や発症報告がないため情報が不足している。継続的な監視が必要。
triage.notes: 本記事は具体的な患者発症の報告ではなく、市当局による人獣共通感染症対策の不備を理由とした法的措置の申し立てである。狂犬病、リーシュマニア症、レプトスピラ症のいずれも発症確認が記載されていないため、確定的なシグナルとは判定できない。ただし貧困層が多いセナ・マドゥレイラ市における衛生不良と動物管理の不備は、これらの病原体への継続的な曝露リスク（prolonged_exposure）と流行性（epidemic_prone）を示唆している。政府部門（検察庁）の関心が確認されている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en Ituri : Patrick Muyaya lance une mobilisation générale contre la contamination - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Ituri: Patrick Muyaya launches a general mobilization against contamination.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) outbreak in Ituri province, North-East Democratic Republic of the Congo, centered on Bunia, prompted a general mobilization on 19 June 2026. Government spokesperson Patrick Muyaya announced concerted efforts to halt transmission, after inspecting hospitals and treatment centers to assess response effectiveness and patient care quality. He stressed community awareness and rapid health-seeking at initial symptoms—fever or headache—to improve survival. Officials highlighted medical management progress, noting a substantial reduction in case fatality compared with early outbreaks. Strict adherence to preventive measures was urged, including regular handwashing, following health authorities’ guidance, and avoiding contact with bodies of the deceased outside the supervision of specialized teams. Misinformation was condemned, with a call to rely on official communications and health professionals. The government pledged continued action amid security challenges to restore peace and protect communities.

triage.headline_ja: イトゥリ州のエボラ：パトリック・ムイヤが汚染に対する総動員を開始
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）、WPROスクリーニング基準で4項目該当。エボラウイルス病のアウトブレイクは高い懸念疾患であり、ただちにフルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病は極めて高いリスク疾患。イトゥリ州ブニア中心のアウトブレイク、政府による総動員宣言、感染制御強化措置、セキュリティ上の課題などが報告されている。記事は2026年6月19日付で、現在の状況把握が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Franklin Graham dice que brote de ébola es
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Franklin Graham says that the Ebola outbreak is.
article.articleSummary: As of June 19, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo prompted Samaritan's Purse to open two 40-bed Ebola Treatment Centers in Bunia and Nyankunde (northeast DRC). About 70 disaster-response staff are on site; local clinicians operate Nyankunde’s center. The operation faces major logistical hurdles: unreliable power, water purification, and on-site generators. Full PPE is essential, with workers limited to roughly 30 minutes per shift. All arrivals are treated as potential malaria or Ebola due to nonspecific early symptoms. Government-run diagnostics can take 4–8 days; the group hopes to establish its own lab for faster results. Intravenous fluids are the main treatment, with hope for antibody therapies. The outbreak appears to be increasing; Samaritan's Purse does not plan more centers but aims to model its response for others, while staff rotate and cross-border restrictions complicate deployments.

triage.headline_ja: フランクリン・グラハムがエボラ出血熱の流行は当初考えられていたよりもはるかに悪いと述べている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数項目該当。エボラ出血熱は極めて高い致死率と流行性を持つ疾患であり、DRCでの流行拡大は国際的懸念事項である。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーからBuniaはDRC北東部に位置する具体的な発生地を示しており、DRCが対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に DRC を含める。エボラ出血熱の流行拡大、不十分な医療インフラ、国際支援体制の構築、保健従事者の安全リスクなど、複数の重大な懸念要因が存在する。

article.articleHeadline: OMS alerta por la rápida propagación de ébola en el Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO warns of the rapid spread of Ebola in the Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues spreading rapidly, according to the World Health Organization. As of June 19, 2026, 896 cases and 232 deaths have been confirmed, with 21 new infections in the last 24 hours. Most cases remain in Ituri Province, but the virus has also reached North Kivu and South Kivu. WHO Africa Emergency Director Marie-Roseline Belizaire cautioned that transmission remains accelerated, despite improvements in surveillance, diagnostics, and hospital capacity. Health authorities aim to trace at least 95% of contacts of confirmed cases to contain further transmission. The report underscores ongoing efforts to strengthen outbreak response and monitoring, while acknowledging continued spread in the region.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがコンゴでのエボラの急速な拡大について警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱は極めて重篤な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、複数州での拡大は国際的なリスクを示唆している。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで複数州（Ituri Province、North Kivu、South Kivu）での拡大が報告されており、WHOが直接警告を発出している。確認例896件、死亡232件という重大な数字。国際的支援と監視強化の必要性が明記されている。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola: pelo menos 30 mortes em campo no Congo apontam para propagação rápida
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: at least 30 deaths in the field in Congo indicate rapid spread.
article.articleSummary: At least 30 people have died since early May at Kigonze internally displaced persons camp in Bunia, Ituri province, northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo, amid an Ebola outbreak. Victims showed headache, fever and vomiting, consistent with Ebola, prompting fears of rapid, undetected spread among more than 5 million IDPs in eastern DRC. Testing of living and dead in Kigonze has been repeatedly refused by patients and families, preventing laboratory confirmation. Camp officials note a sharp rise in deaths this week (about ten buried), up from prior monthly totals of 1-3. The outbreak was declared May 15; Ituri accounts for the vast majority of nearly 900 confirmed Ebola cases nationwide. Funding cuts for water, sanitation and hygiene exacerbate transmission, with US support fluctuating and unclear for Kigonze.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：コンゴの現地で少なくとも30人の死亡が急速な感染拡大を示唆
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。エボラウイルス疾患の急速な感染拡大が示唆されており、IDPs（国内避難民）5百万人以上への曝露リスクがある。
triage.notes: エボラ検査の実施拒否により検査室確認が困難な状況。資金不足により水・衛生環境が悪化し、感染リスク上昇。米国支援の不確定性が懸念される。IDP集団における急速な感染拡大の可能性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Dourados confirma 15ª morte por Chikungunya; paciente tinha 19 anos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dourados confirms 15th death from chikungunya; patient was 19 years old.
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya in Dourados, Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil, reaches 15th death: a 19-year-old Indigenous patient who first showed symptoms March 14 and died May 29 at Hospital Universitário da UFGD. Eleven of the fatalities are Indigenous residents of Bororó and Jaguapiru. Three additional deaths remain under investigation (a 74-year-old woman with chronic kidney disease and hypertension; a 71-year-old man with diabetes; and a 43-year-old man without comorbidities), all from the urban perimeter of Dourados. The epidemiological report records 9,772 notified cases, with 4,745 confirmed, 5,242 probable, 4,530 discarded, and 497 under investigation. In the Indigenous Reserve, 3,151 notified, 2,184 confirmed, 159 under investigation. Hospitalizations fell to 20 (14 at HU-UFGD, others at Regional, Unimed, Cassems, and Hospital da Vida). Epidemic curve shows peak in Week 12 (1,207 notifications) and a decline through Week 23 (194).

triage.headline_ja: ドゥラードスがチクングニア熱による15番目の死亡を確認；患者は19歳
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルのマット・グロッソ・ド・スル州ドゥラードスでチクングニア熱による死亡例が確認されており、IHR基準（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外な重症度）に該当する。死亡者数の増加と確定症例数の規模から、シグナルとしてフルRRA対象となる。
triage.notes: チクングニア熱による死亡例（15例）と確定症例数（4,745例）が報告されている。先住民地域での集中的な発生（2,184例が確定）が特徴。流行曲線はWeek 12でピークを示した後、減少傾向にあるが、依然として活動的な伝播が続いている。3例の死亡が調査中で、最終的な死亡者数がさらに増加する可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: Delhi MC launches citywide fogging rally to spread awareness on dengue, malaria - The Tribune
article.articleSummary: Delhi, India, launches citywide vector-borne disease awareness campaign ahead of the monsoon to curb dengue, malaria and other mosquito-borne illnesses. The Municipal Corporation of Delhi (MCD) deployed 100 auto-rickshaws fitted with fogging machines and awareness materials, supported by about 450 MCD workers, to cover all 250 wards. Mayor Pravesh Wahi flagged off the rally from the Civic Centre and announced a fogging drive as part of the effort. The campaign emphasizes prevention and public participation, with the slogan Jeetegi Delhi, Harega Dengue-Malaria, and a three-point strategy: Cover, Clean and Keep Dry. Residents are urged to cover water tanks/containers, keep surroundings clean, and prevent water from stagnating to reduce mosquito breeding. The initiative aligns with broader cleanliness and public health messages linked to PM Modi's tenure.

triage.headline_ja: デリー市庁舎がデング熱・マラリア啓発のため市全域フォギング集会を開催
triage.triage_reason: デング熱とマラリアは重要な公衆衛生上の脅威であるが、本記事は既知の季節的な予防・啓発キャンペーンの開始に関するものであり、新規の異常な感染症イベントではない。情報不足により詳細なリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はデリーでの予防キャンペーン実施に関するもので、新規の異常な感染症クラスターや流行の報告ではない。スクリーニング基準2つ該当（長期曝露・流行しやすさ）するが、社会的関心の有無や実際の感染状況の詳細が記事に明記されていない。季節的なモンスーン時期の対策活動であり、既知のルーチン対応である可能性が高い。続報により実際の症例数・死亡例などの重症度情報が提供されれば評価を変更する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Criação ilegal de javalis acende alerta para riscos sanitários e prejuízos à pecuária em Pernambuco - CompreRural
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Illegal breeding of wild boars raises alarm over sanitary risks and losses to livestock farming in Pernambuco - CompreRural
article.articleSummary: Illegal breeding of wild boars in Pernambuco, Brazil, raises sanitary and economic concerns as the invasive species threatens livestock health and farm productivity. Wild boars, an exotic invasive species with breeding prohibited by environmental law, can rapidly proliferate, disturb habitats, contaminate water sources, damage crops and fences, and compete with native species. Experts warn they may harbor and transmit diseases to cattle and swine, amplifying herd health risks and increasing costs of control and surveillance. Of particular concern is the potential introduction and spread of African Swine Fever through these animals, challenging biosafety programs in swine production. The Pernambuco case underscores the need for integrated action among environmental agencies, rural defense, security forces, and producers to curb expansion and prevent further outbreaks. Published 2026-06-19.

triage.headline_ja: ペルナンブッコ州での違法なイノシシ飼育が衛生リスクと畜産業への被害に警告を発する
triage.triage_reason: アフリカンスワインフィーバー（ASF）の潜在的リスクが指摘されているが、実際の感染確認ではなく、違法飼育されたイノシシを通じた導入リスクの警告段階。情報不足により判断を留保。
triage.notes: 記事はASFの潜在的導入リスクについて警告していますが、実際の感染事例の報告ではなく、予防的な警告段階です。違法飼育されたイノシシ個体群の拡大と疾病伝播リスクが主要な懸念。WPROスクリーニング基準では異常性、長期曝露可能性、流行しやすさ、管理必要性の4項目で該当しますが、IHR基準は1項目のみの該当となるため、WATCH判定とし続報を注視する必要があります。

article.articleHeadline: Американското разузнаване със шокиращи данни за Ковид-19 - Свят -- Новини Стандарт
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: American Intelligence with Shocking Data about COVID-19 - World - Standard News
article.articleSummary: Declassified documents cited by Tulsi Gabbard, a former director of U.S. National Intelligence, allege shocking details about COVID-19 origins. The materials accuse Dr. Anthony Fauci of manipulating and financing dangerous research in Wuhan, from which the coronavirus is believed to have leaked. The documents imply Fauci steered U.S. funds toward experiments to enhance coronavirus function in bats and pressured investigators to conceal the laboratory origin. Gabbard argues the records reveal links between U.S.-funded research, the Wuhan Institute of Virology, and government efforts to shape public perception of the pandemic’s origin. She also asserts Fauci lied to Congress under oath in 2024. The documents are described as part of a broader declassification push initiated by the agency she leads. Publication note: 26 February, 10:15.

triage.headline_ja: アメリカの情報機関がCOVID-19に関する衝撃的なデータを公開 - ワールド - スタンダードニュース
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は過去のCOVID-19起源に関する政治的議論・陰謀論報道であり、新規の感染症イベント（感染拡大、アウトブレイク、新規患者発生など）を報告するものではない。現在進行中の公衆衛生上の危機を示す証拠がない。
triage.notes: 記事はCOVID-19の歴史的起源に関する政治的声明・陰謀論の報道であり、現在進行中のイベント（新規患者発生、感染拡大）を報告していない。過去の疫学的データや政策議論のみであり、トリアージ対象の「感染症イベント」ではない。社会的関心は存在するが、公衆衛生上の即時対応を必要としない。

article.articleHeadline: اخبارك نت | مسؤولة أميركية تفجر مفاجأة.. طبيب "متهم" بإخفاء أصل كورونا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Akhbarak Net | An American female official drops a bombshell... a doctor 'accused' of concealing the origin of the coronavirus.
article.articleSummary: On her last day as the U.S. Director of National Intelligence, Tulsi Gabbard released declassified emails and documents accusing Dr. Anthony Fauci of concealing the pandemic’s origins. The materials allege Fauci funded high-risk coronavirus research at the Wuhan Institute of Virology in China with taxpayer money, and directly influenced intelligence assessments on origins. Gabbard says Fauci worked with intelligence officials to suppress lab-origin information and lied to Congress in 2024 about his knowledge or involvement. A year-long declassification review, with whistleblower testimony, depicts analysts challenging official conclusions as marginalized and threatened. Fauci allegedly played three roles: funding risky research linked to universal vaccines, pressuring intelligence to embrace a natural-origin theory, and publicly commenting on the pandemic. The intelligence community reportedly followed his recommendations, with NIH/NIAID-funded scientists advising on origins. Gabbard called for transparency and accountability.

triage.headline_ja: アメリカの政府高官が爆弾発言...コロナウイルスの起源隠蔽で『容疑者』とされた医師
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はCOVID-19の起源をめぐる政治的論争・陰謀説に関する報道であり、新たな感染症イベント（流行、患者発生、アウトブレイク）を報告するものではない。感染症危機管理のシグナルとしては該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事は2026年配信の架空シナリオと考えられる。内容はCOVID-19パンデミック起源に関する過去の論争を基にした政治的報道であり、現在進行する感染症イベント（新規患者発生、アウトブレイク、流行）ではない。EBS活動のシグナルトリアージ対象外。

article.articleHeadline: More than 70 medics infected with Ebola as DRC outbreak spreads 'fast'
article.articleSummary: More than 75 healthcare workers have contracted Ebola since the outbreak was declared on May 15, 2026, with 17 medics dead, as cases surge in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). The outbreak has killed 232 and infected 896 across 31 health zones, centered in eastern DRC. The rare Bundibugyo Ebola strain is driving transmission, including in displacement camps amid aid cuts and poor sanitation. Basic protective equipment remains in short supply, hampering the ability of doctors, nurses, and other staff to protect themselves. The DRC already has one of the world's lowest health‑worker ratios, about 11 per 10,000 people. WHO emergency director Marie Roseline Belizaire warns the outbreak remains serious and evolving rapidly. China and Uganda are sending medical teams; WHO provides psychological support to affected medics. The response is hampered by a health system weakened by conflict, displacement and chronic underfunding.

triage.headline_ja: 70人以上の医療者がエボラに感染、DRCの感染拡大が「急速に」進行
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。Ebola outbreak with 232 deaths, 896 cases across 31 health zones, healthcare worker infections, international spread risk (Uganda/China involvement), and significant public health impact.
triage.notes: Uganda listed in Bluedot locations but not mentioned as confirmed outbreak location in article summary; China mentioned only as sending medical teams, not as outbreak location. Only DRC included in verified_locations. High-risk Bundibugyo strain, healthcare worker infection surge (75+ infected, 17 dead), displacement camp transmission, and systemic health system weaknesses indicate urgent need for full RRA.

article.articleHeadline: Congo ziet stijgende ebola-gevallen en moeilijke aanpak van crisis
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo Sees Rising Ebola Cases and a Difficult Response to the Crisis
article.articleSummary: As of 19 June 2026, Ebola virus disease outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda continue to expand.
