Africa CDC reports at least 894 confirmed infections, while the Congolese government cites 896 cases and 232 deaths. The outbreak is concentrated in Ituri Province, DR Congo, accounting for about 90% of cases, with additional transmissions in North and South Kivu. Uganda has reported 19 infections and 2 deaths after cross-border spread. Contact tracing is severely hampered by conflict and poor infrastructure: while 17,000–35,000 contacts should be followed, only about 4,000 have been traced (<15%). International donors are mobilizing substantial funds: about €90 million from the U.S. CDC, nearly €80 million from the African Union, and €493 million from the European Union to medical and humanitarian aid, vaccine research, and health-system strengthening. No approved vaccine or medicine yet; treatments are being tested for the Bundibugyo variant.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ患者が増加し、危機対応が困難に直面
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当。エボラウイルス病の多国間拡大（DRC・ウガンダ）、894確認感染者・232死亡、接触追跡が5%未満という危機的状況、国際的な資金動員が進行中。
triage.notes: 発生地域にウガンダが含まれていますが、記事サマリーではウガンダは二次的な越境感染（19感染・2死亡）として言及されており、主たる発生地はDRC（特にIturi Province）です。DRCは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に収録。接触者追跡の著しい不足（<15%）、紛争による対応阻害、未承認ワクチン・治療など複数の懸念要素がある。

article.articleHeadline: Ten more cases of shigellosis reported in Kerala
article.articleSummary: Ten more shigellosis cases were reported in Kerala on Friday, taking the year’s total to 196, with 120 cases in June. The new shigellosis cases by district: Kozhikode 3, Thiruvananthapuram 2, Thrissur 2, Malappuram 2, and Palakkad 1. Dengue fever cases continue to rise, tallying 98 across districts. Leptospirosis also spiked, with 21 cases reported on Friday; Ernakulam accounted for 45 of the 90 cases reported statewide. In Mpox news, a single imported case was diagnosed in a 43-year-old man from Kilimanoor, Thiruvananthapuram, who had returned from Saudi Arabia; he is in an isolation ward at Government Medical College Hospital, Thiruvananthapuram.

triage.headline_ja: ケララ州でシゲラ症患者10人が新たに報告される
triage.triage_reason: 複数の感染症（シゲラ症196例、デング熱98例、レプトスピラ症90例、Mpox1例）が同時に発生しており、シゲラ症は6月だけで120例と急増。Mpoxは海外からの輸入症例で、国際的拡大リスクがある。
triage.notes: 記事はケララ州（インド）でのシゲラ症、デング熱、レプトスピラ症、およびMpoxの複合発生を報告している。Mpoxは海外（サウジアラビア）からの輸入症例であり、国際的リスク要因として重要。サウジアラビアは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsはIndiaのみとした。

article.articleHeadline: Dolientes dan el último adiós a una bebé de 6 meses fallecida por ébola en Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mourners bid a final farewell to a 6-month-old baby girl who died of Ebola in Congo.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, centered in Ituri and Bunia, has 894 laboratory‑confirmed cases and more than 200 deaths, with Bundibugyo Ebola virus identified as the cause. A 6‑month‑old girl died earlier this week, marking the third child death at an orphanage as authorities struggle to contain the outbreak. Ituri accounts for over 90 percent of reported cases; cases have also appeared in Kivu Nord and Kivu Sud, with spread to Uganda (19 cases, 2 deaths). Health workers face community resistance and shortages of protective equipment, complicating safe burial operations restricted to trained professionals. The outbreak is described as more than three times deadlier than Uganda’s 2000 outbreak but not as lethal as the 2014 epidemic. Approximately 35,000 potential contacts are at risk; Bundibugyo Ebola has no approved vaccines or treatments.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴで6ヶ月の赤ちゃんがエボラで死亡、遺族が別れを惜しむ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全てに該当。894件の検査確認例、200人以上の死亡、ウガンダへの国際拡大、Bundibugyo型エボラの致命性の高さ、コミュニティ抵抗による管理困難性から、フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にウガンダが含まれているが、記事サマリーではウガンダはセカンダリスプレッドの19例・2死亡のみで、主要な発生地はDRC（イトゥリ・ブニア）。DRCのみを verified_locations に含める。Bundibugyo型エボラはワクチン・治療法なし。コミュニティ抵抗と防護具不足が対応を大幅に困難化。

article.articleHeadline: Csendben terjedhet az ebola a kongói táborokban, ijesztően megugrott egy hét alatt a halottak száma
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola could be spreading quietly in Congolese camps, with the death toll alarmingly jumping in a week.
article.articleSummary: In northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, the Kigonze camp in Bunia, housing more than 15,000 people, has recorded at least 30 Ebola-related deaths since early May, with ten in a single week—a sharp rise from 1–3 monthly deaths. Officials have not confirmed Ebola yet; testing is declined by patients and relatives, though all observed symptoms include headache, fever, and vomiting. Five samples from deceased individuals have been collected and await laboratory results. The surge raises fears of covert transmission among East Congo’s internal refugees, estimated at over five million. Caritas workers saw wrapped corpses and health staff disinfection. International WASH funding cuts, including by the Trump-led US, reduced support from 2024–2025 to about $38 million, with only 21% of an $80 million request funded this year. Mercy Corps notes drastic reductions in taps and toilets, limiting services to fewer than 19,000 refugees.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴの難民キャンプでエボラが静かに蔓延の可能性、1週間で死亡者数が劇的に増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。難民キャンプ内での急速な死亡者増加、検査未確認ながら症状が一致、500万人以上の避難民集団への曝露リスク、資金不足による感染管理体制の脆弱化が見られ、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス未検査だが、臨床症状（頭痛、発熱、嘔吐）がエボラに一致し、1週間で死亡者が1-3人/月から10人に跳上。15,000人以上が居住する難民キャンプ内での確認症例、避難民500万人以上への潜在的曝露。国際的な衛生関連資金の大幅削減により感染管理体制が脆弱化している。検体5件がラボ検査待機中。確定診断に向けた急速な検査体制強化が急務。

article.articleHeadline: Máxima alerta por brote descontrolado de ébola y el Congo con olor a muerte
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Highest alert for an out-of-control Ebola outbreak in Congo, with a smell of death.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri province) caused by the Bundibugyo strain has prompted the WHO to declare a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, with no vaccine available for this strain. Since May, 60 health workers have been infected and 34 have died. Ituri, the outbreak's epicenter, is amid persistent conflict where nearly five million people live in war zones; about a quarter require humanitarian assistance and one-fifth are displaced internally. Ebola spreads through close contact with infected bodily fluids, so improved detection and safe burials are critical to reduce mortality risk. Ongoing violence is driving people and aid workers to flee, complicating contact tracing and timely care delivery in crowded camps.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ熱流行に最高警戒、制御不能な状況で「死の匂い」
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準5つすべてに該当。エボラ熱の新規流行で、WHOが国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言し、紛争地域での感染拡大リスクが極めて高い。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株に対するワクチンが利用不可。5月以来、保健従事者60人が感染し34人死亡。イトゥリ州で持続的な紛争が進行中であり、500万人がいわゆる紛争地域に住んでいる。接触者追跡とタイムリーなケア提供が困難化している。WHO公開宣言済み。

article.articleHeadline: إعصار إيبولا يضرب شرق الكونغو.. سلالة نادرة "بلا لقاح" تحصد مئات الأرواح - اخبار ليبيا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola hurricane strikes eastern Congo... a rare 'no-vaccine' strain has claimed hundreds of lives - Libya News
article.articleSummary: As of June 19, 2026, eastern Democratic Republic of Congo faces an Ebola outbreak driven by Bundibugyo, a rare and highly lethal strain. The outbreak totals 875 laboratory-confirmed cases and 202 deaths (case fatality ~23%), with Ituri province accounting for about 95% of cases and spread extending to North Kivu and South Kivu; Uganda reports 19 cases and 2 deaths across the border. Africa CDC warns the surge could worsen without rapid containment. The Bundibugyo strain currently lacks a specific approved therapy or vaccine. The situation evokes 2013–2017 West Africa, which saw ~30,000 cases and >11,000 deaths (Guinea, Liberia, Sierra Leone). The World Health Organization declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern to galvanize international response, highlighting the risk of regional spillover if not controlled.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ台風が東コンゴを襲撃...ワクチンのない希少な株が数百人の命を奪う - リビア・ニュース
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も全項目で該当。エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo株）による大規模アウトブレイク、高い致死率、国際的な拡大リスク、WHOによるPHEIC宣言があり、緊急のフルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 記事では東DRC（Ituri州、South Kivu州、North Kivu州）での発生が主題。ウガンダでの国境越え拡大（19症例、2死亡）も記載されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。Bundibugyo株による希少かつ高致死率（23%）のアウトブレイク、ワクチン・特異的治療の不在、過去のWest Africaアウトブレイク（2013-2017年）との類似性、WHOによるPHEIC宣言により、国際的対応が急務。

article.articleHeadline: வெள்ளக்கோவிலில் ஜூன் 28-இல் போலியோ சொட்டு மருந்து முகாம்
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Polio drops vaccination camp on June 28 in Velakkovil.
article.articleSummary: Polio drops vaccination camp scheduled for June 28, 2026 in the Velakkovil area and adjoining localities. The campaign will administer oral polio vaccine drops to children aged five years and under, aiming to protect them from poliomyelitis and its potential paralysis. Target areas include Velakkovil, Kurukkaththi, Kachcherivalasu, Muthanayakkanvalasu, Puthuppai, Nachchipalayam, Uppupalaiyam, Kambaliyampatti, and Muthur. The initiative reflects a focused public health effort to sustain polio immunity among young children and reduce risk of transmission within these communities. It emphasizes preventive care through routine childhood vaccination. This outreach underscores ongoing vaccination campaigns to maintain region-wide protection against poliovirus among the youngest residents.

triage.headline_ja: ベラッコービルで6月28日にポリオワクチン接種キャンプを実施
triage.triage_reason: これはポリオの新規発生報告ではなく、定期的な予防接種キャンプの実施告知である。IHR基準・WPROスクリーニング基準いずれにも該当せず、シグナルとしては適切でない。
triage.notes: 記事は予防接種キャンプの実施予定を報じるもので、ポリオ患者の発生・流行、異常な疾病増加などの感染症危機を示唆していない。定期的な公衆衛生活動であり、シグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Голод сильніший за вірус: у ДР Конго пацієнти з Еболою збігають з карантину -- Bloomberg
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hunger is stronger than the virus: Ebola patients in the DRC escape quarantine — Bloomberg
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak continues in Ituri Province, eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, amid a humanitarian crisis driven by WFP funding shortfalls that leave patients undernourished. Hunger prompts some patients to flee isolation and seek food at local markets, raising transmission risk; in Mongbwalu, 18 suspected Ebola patients escaped a treatment center following an attack. Ongoing armed conflict and security incidents undermine medical response, with distrust leading to arson of medical tents and obstructed care. The outbreak centers on Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a strain with no approved vaccine or specific treatment. The World Health Organization has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern and has called for hundreds of millions of dollars to strengthen on-the-ground response and prevention efforts.

triage.headline_ja: 飢えはウイルスより強い：コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ患者が隔離から逃げている — Bloomberg
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全てに該当し、WHO公衆衛生緊急事態宣言済み、国際的懸念高、WFP資金枯渇による人道危機とエボラ拡大の複合危機。
triage.notes: WHO PHEIC宣言済み。Bundibugyo ebolavirus株（ワクチン・治療法未承認）。武力紛争・セキュリティインシデント、医療への不信（医療テント放火など）により対応阻害。人道危機（WFP資金不足による栄養不良）が患者逃走・感染拡大リスク増加の主因。複合的な公衆衛生脅威。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : neuf centres de traitement opérationnels avec 500 lits disponibles (OMS) - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: Nine treatment centers operational with 500 beds available (WHO) - ACP.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) with nine treatment centers now operational and 500 bed capacity to treat patients, WHO reports from Bunia. Holistic patient care, including psychosocial and nutritional support, is provided with assistance from the World Food Programme and UNICEF. Laboratory testing has surged from about 20 tests per day to over 2,000 daily, improving surveillance, though detected community deaths indicate ongoing transmission. The outbreak, initially in three health zones, has expanded to 33 zones: 21 in Ituri, 11 in North Kivu, and one in South Kivu. Authorities oppose city confinement in Bunia, arguing it would hinder the response. The Health Minister notes the peak has not yet been reached; Ituri remains the epicenter with more than 800 cases.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱（EVD）：コンゴ民主共和国で9つの治療センターが稼働、500床が利用可能（WHO）
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、国際拡大のリスク、旅行・貿易制限のリスク）し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数該当。エボラウイルス病の広域流行で、対応の強化が報告されている。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱の流行は33の健康ゾーンに拡大（イトゥリ州21ゾーン、北キヴ州11ゾーン、南キヴ州1ゾーン）し、800以上の症例が報告されている。WHOは治療センター、検査体制の大幅な拡充を報告。保健大臣は「ピークに未だ到達していない」と述べており、事態の深刻性が高い。国際的な保健機関（WFP、UNICEF）が関与し、国際支援の必要性が明確。

article.articleHeadline: Голод сильнее вируса: в ДР Конго пациенты с Эболой сбегают из карантина -- Bloomberg
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hunger is stronger than the virus: In DR Congo, Ebola patients flee quarantine.
article.articleSummary: Rare Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain is circulating in Ituri province, eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, with the Ebola outbreak intensified by a humanitarian crisis. World Food Programme funding shortages leave patients inadequately fed, prompting some to abandon isolation and seek food at local markets, raising transmission risk. In Mongbvalu, 18 patients with suspected infection fled after an attack on a treatment center. Ongoing security crises, armed attacks, and mistrust toward health workers fuel arson of medical tents and impede containment efforts. WHO has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern due to cross-border spread risk; Ituri remains the epicenter amid long-standing conflict and mass displacement that hinder medical response. The Bundibugyo strain has no approved vaccine or specific treatment, underscoring the urgent need for substantial funding and strengthened on-site response.

triage.headline_ja: 飢饉はウイルスより強し：コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ患者が隔離施設から逃げ出す――ブルームバーグ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（重篤な公衆衛生影響・国際拡大リスク・渡航制限リスク）。希少なBundibugyo株の流行、WHO緊急事態宣言、隔離破棄による感染リスク上昇が認められ、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus（希少株）の流行、WHO PHEIC宣言済み、人道危機・食糧不足による隔離離脱、武装攻撃による医療施設被害、ワクチン・治療法なし。DRC内Ituri州が流行中心地だが、対象国リストにDRCが明示的に含まれていないため検討。ただしIturi (215709) も同じDRC内の行政区画。記事実質は DRC での Ebola 流行であるため verified_locations に DRC は含めない。該当対象国なしのため verified_locations は空配列。

article.articleHeadline: У ДР Конго хворі на Еболу тікають із лікувальних центрів через голод
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Ebola patients flee from treatment centers due to hunger.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues as patients flee treatment centers in search of food, with more than 150 such cases since late May. Ituri province accounts for over 90% of confirmed infections, with nearly 900 people infected and over 25% fatalities reported. In one incident, 11 suspected patients escaped a hospital in Bambu, about 40 km from the epicenter near Mongbvalu, due to food shortages. Ongoing food insecurity in eastern DR Congo—affecting about 10 million people—complicates isolation and contact tracing; authorities are monitoring roughly 6,400 contacts. The World Food Programme (WFP) plans to mobilize $175 million in DR Congo by end of November, including $32 million for Ebola-related activities, while budgets have fallen ~33% in 2–3 years. WFP provides hot meals at Ebola treatment centers and to patients, under monitoring, and affected families. The WHO has declared Ebola outbreaks in DR Congo and Uganda a PHEIC.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国（DRC）でエボラ患者が飢餓を理由に治療センターから逃げている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外な状況、国際的拡大リスク）に該当。エボラウイルス病の大規模流行でWHOがPHEIC宣言済み。
triage.notes: 記事で主に報告されているのはDRC（イトゥリ州）でのエボラ流行。ウガンダも言及されているがサマリーの主題はDRC。イタリア（Bambù, Veneto）の座標は誤りの可能性が高く、実際の発生地はDRC内のBambuを指している。WHOがすでにPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）を宣言しており、治療センターからの患者逃走は隔離・接触者追跡を困難にしており、深刻な管理可能性問題を示唆している。

article.articleHeadline: United Nations High Commissioner for Refugees (UNHCR) warns Ebola outbreak threatens displaced communities in Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and beyond
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus disease in eastern DRC expands with 896 confirmed cases and 232 deaths reported across 31 health zones as of 17 June; Uganda has 19 cases and two deaths, none among refugees. More than 2 million forcibly displaced people, including over 320,000 refugees, live in risk areas, raising concerns about population movements fueling transmission. On 7 June, about 2,250 people fled Mbau near Beni to Oicha in North Kivu, an Ebola-affected zone hosting over 14,300 displaced. On 3 June, distrust at the Kpangba site near Bunia led to temporary blocking of response teams. UNHCR stresses community-led measures, training for over 100 community leaders, and chlorinated handwashing stations in refugee-hosting villages in Ituri. Regional risk extends to Uganda, Rwanda, Burundi, Tanzania and South Sudan; border closures are viewed as ineffective. A $14 million inter-agency appeal (July–November) aims to strengthen preparedness and response in DRC, Uganda, Burundi, Rwanda and South Sudan.

triage.headline_ja: 国連難民高等弁務官事務所（UNHCR）がエボラウイルス病の流行がコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）およびその周辺の避難民コミュニティを脅かしていると警告
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の確認症例896例・死亡232例という深刻な公衆衛生への影響、複数国への国際的拡大の現実（ウガンダで既に19例）、200万人以上の避難民が危険地域に居住し人口移動による感染拡大リスク、およびIHR基準2つ以上に該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCが主要な発生地であり、ウガンダでも確認されているが、対象国リストではDRCのみ該当。スーダン、ルワンダ、タンザニア、ブルンジ、ウガンダは地理的リスク地域として言及されているが、サマリー上では確認症例がDRCとウガンダに限定されており、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。2026年6月という未来日付データであるが、感染症シグナルとしての評価は妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Главные новости дня | пятница: Ливан, Газа, Эбола, поездка главы ООН в Лондон
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Top News of the Day | Friday: Lebanon, Gaza, Ebola, the UN Secretary-General's trip to London.
article.articleSummary: Israel airstrikes in southern Lebanon killed at least 18 people, with UN OCHA urging freedom of movement for peacekeepers as they monitor developments around a recent US-Iran peace framework. In Gaza, since the October 2025 ceasefire, 265 children have been killed, bringing total Palestinian deaths to about 1,000 and injuries to over 3,100; UNICEF warns 1.1 million children and their families face daily challenges obtaining clean water. The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo continues to spread to new areas, with 896 confirmed cases and 232 deaths reported by WHO; women, healthcare workers, and internally displaced people are at special risk. The International Organization for Migration has carried out more than one million health screenings at border points and along major routes.

triage.headline_ja: 今週の主要ニュース | 金曜日：レバノン、ガザ、エボラ、国連事務総長のロンドン出張
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病がコンゴ民主共和国で896例確認、232例の死亡報告があり、IHR基準の「重大な公衆衛生影響」「異常性」「国際的拡大リスク」および「管理可能性」の複数基準に該当。また社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事は複数地域（レバノン、ガザ、米国、イラン、イスラエル、パレスチナ）を扱っているが、対象国リストに該当する実際の発生地はコンゴ民主共和国のみ。エボラ症例数（896例）と死亡数（232例）、高リスク集団（女性、医療従事者、国内避難民）の言及、国際的な検診体制の構築が記載されており、WHO通知基準を満たす。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية: ارتفاع إصابات إيبولا لـ 896 حالة مؤكدة و232 وفاة فى الكونغو - اليوم السابع
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: Ebola infections rise to 896 confirmed cases and 232 deaths in Congo - Youm7
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo virus disease (BVD), an Ebola virus disease, is driving an outbreak in Central Africa. The World Health Organization reports updated figures through June 17: the Democratic Republic of the Congo has 896 confirmed BVD cases and 232 deaths. In neighboring Uganda, 19 confirmed cases and one probable death are linked epidemiologically to Congo’s outbreak via imported and secondary transmission. Health authorities in both countries, with WHO support, are escalating response efforts under a regional African preparedness framework, emphasizing contact-tracing and protection of health workers. Uganda has had no new cases since June 5, suggesting limited containment effectiveness to date, while the DRC situation remains under close monitoring due to rapid spread. Laboratory confirmation remains essential; cross-border transmission from Congo appears to be the infection source, with ongoing measures to prevent exportation and further spread.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関：コンゴでのエボラ感染者が896件の確認症例および232人の死亡に増加 - ユーム7
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo virus）の多数の死亡症例と確定患者、国境を越えた二次伝播、国際的拡大リスクが明確に存在し、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響がある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではウガンダでの症例（19確定例、1可能性例）も記載されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。DRCでの896確定症例、232死亡、急速な拡大、国境越え伝播が報告されており、エボラ出血熱としての高いリスク。WHOサポート下での対応が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: У ДР Конго понад 150 пацієнтів з підозрою на Еболу втекли з лікарні з кінця травня, -- Bloomberg
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In DR Congo, more than 150 patients suspected of Ebola escaped from a hospital since the end of May — Bloomberg.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the eastern Democratic Republic of Congo: authorities are tracking about 6,400 potential contacts. Since late May, more than 150 patients diagnosed or suspected of Ebola have escaped from health facilities, due to food shortages and poor ward conditions. In Bambu, about 40 km from the outbreak epicenter near Mongbwalu, 11 suspected Ebola patients left a hospital because of hunger. The region’s crisis is worsened by conflict and mass displacement, with a food crisis affecting around 10 million people. Nearly 900 Ebola infections have been reported in the area, with more than a quarter fatal. Ebola is a Filoviridae virus transmitted via direct contact with bodily fluids or contaminated objects. Symptoms include fever, weakness, muscle and throat pain, vomiting, diarrhea, rash, and sometimes bleeding. No universal cure; vaccines and experimental therapies have been used to contain spread where available. A May incident in Rwampara involved arson at a care center after attempting to retrieve a relative’s body.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラウイルス感染が疑われる150人以上の患者が5月末以降に病院から逃亡—ブルームバーグ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当する。エボラウイルス感染症の集団発生で公衆衛生への深刻な影響、患者の病院逃亡による接触追跡困難化、国際拡大リスク（イタリア・ルワンダの位置情報検出）、および渡航制限の可能性が認められる。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでエボラ発生地はコンゴ民主共和国東部（Mongbwalu近郊）が主題であることが明確である。ItalyとRwandaは発生地域フィールドに含まれているが、サマリーではコンゴ民主共和国での発生が主要な内容であり、これらの国での実際の発生は述べられていない。患者逃亡による追跡不可能な感染源の出現は、公衆衛生上の重大リスク。紛争地域での医療施設の脆弱性も顕著。

article.articleHeadline: Прв случај на зика вирус во Македонија. Се инфицирал на Малдиви
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: First case of Zika virus in Macedonia. He contracted it in the Maldives.
article.articleSummary: First confirmed Zika virus infection in North Macedonia, an imported case. A Macedonian national who vacationed on the Maldives between 20-28 May 2026 developed symptoms on 24 May (fever, myalgia/arthralgia, low-grade fever) with later a small, dense rash. At the Institute for Public Health Virology Department, lab testing yielded positive serology and molecular results for Zika. The patient was not hospitalized and is recovering at home in good general condition. The Maldives, along with other areas Thailand, Indonesia, Brazil, and the Caribbean region, are identified as destinations with documented Zika circulation transmitted by Aedes mosquitoes. The European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control notes ongoing travel-associated cases; traveler risk is low to moderate, domestic risk is currently low. Authorities advise adherence to mosquito bite prevention measures.

triage.headline_ja: マケドニアで初のジカウイルス症例。モルディブで感染
triage.triage_reason: 輸入症例（単発）であり、国内流行の兆候はない。ただし対象国（インドネシア、タイ、ブラジル）での流行背景があり、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: マケドニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。記事サマリーで確認される対象国内での流行背景（インドネシア、タイ、ブラジルでのジカ流行）により、これらの国を verified_locations に含める。患者は輸入症例で軽症であり、国内流行リスクは低いと評価される。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en Ituri : "des malades commencent à venir d'eux-mêmes dans des centres", se réjouit Roger Kamba qui en appelle à une forte mobilisation
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Ituri: "patients are starting to come to centers on their own," rejoices Roger Kamba, who is calling for a strong mobilization.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Ituri, Democratic Republic of Congo: 933 confirmed cases and 246 deaths reported, with over 400 patients currently under treatment; 80 recoveries recorded as of 19 June 2026. Health authorities led by Dr. Roger Kamba presented the situation from Bunia, noting a concerning epidemiological trend but a positive shift in community engagement, as patients increasingly seek care at centers even in previously resistant areas. The government continues mobilizing resources and partners to contain transmission and mitigate impact on affected populations. The report highlights ongoing surveillance and response efforts in Ituri, emphasizing the importance of sustained public health measures and community cooperation to improve case management and outcomes.

triage.headline_ja: イトゥリ州のエボラ：「患者が自ら治療センターに来るようになった」とロジャー・カンバが喜び、強い動員を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。確定症例933名、死亡246名の大規模エボラ流行であり、国際的拡大リスク、深刻な公衆衛生影響が明らかである。
triage.notes: DRC東部イトゥリ州での大規模エボラ流行。933確定症例、246死亡という深刻な状況。コミュニティ参加の改善傾向が報告されているが、持続的な感染制御が必須。国際的な支援が必要と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: Surto de ebola cresce 40% e já soma mais de 200 mortes
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak grows by 40% and now totals more than 200 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda has surged about 38-40% in one week, with 894 confirmed cases and more than 200 deaths in the first month; up to 35,000 people exposed. In eastern DRC, 32 health zones are affected, over 90% of cases in Ituri province; infections also appear in North Kivu and South Kivu, with 19 cases and two deaths across the border in Uganda. The epidemic is driven by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a rare strain with no approved vaccine or treatment and limited early tests; Zaire ebolavirus does have a vaccine but is not the cause here. Tracking is hampered by conflict, isolation, and mass displacement in Ituri, with only ~4,000 contacts traced (<15%). Funding remains inadequate: >$900 million pledged, only ~$90 million released; 84 field responders vs a need of about 540, per CDC Africa's Wessam Mankoula.

triage.headline_ja: エボラアウトブレイクが40%増加し、すでに200人以上の死亡者
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。コンゴ民主共和国とウガンダでエボラウイルス病の大規模流行が発生、894確認症例、200人以上の死亡、35,000人曝露、国境越え感染あり。
triage.notes: 稀少なBundibugyo ebolavirus株によるアウトブレイク。ワクチン・治療法未承認。紛争・大規模人口移動により接触追跡が困難（4%のみ追跡）。資金不足（9億ドル以上必要だが9,000万ドルのみ配分）。流行対応力が著しく不足している（必要540人に対し現有84人）。ウガンダへの越境感染も確認されているが、記事サマリーの主題発生地はDRCであり、Uganda（1269750）は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo's deadly Ebola outbreak is 'evolving fast', WHO warns
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-19, DR Congo's Ebola outbreak caused by the Bundibugyo strain with no vaccine is evolving rapidly, centered in Ituri's Bunia and spreading to North Kivu and South Kivu. There have been 896 confirmed cases and 232 deaths, with 21 new cases in the last 24 hours. Declared May 15, transmission had been undetected earlier. The virus spreads by close contact and bodily fluids. Public health capacity rose from zero to more than 500 treatment beds; surveillance handles about 400 alerts and over 2,000 tests daily. About 75% of known contacts are traced (target 95%). DR Congo has 78 recoveries; 75 health workers are infected, 17 of whom died. A Chinese medical team is en route to Bunia; Uganda reports 19 cases, 2 deaths, 10 recoveries. The UN migration agency has screened over a million people at borders.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行は「急速に進展している」とWHOが警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当。エボラ出血熱の継続的流行で深刻な公衆衛生影響、Bundibugyo株による異常な状況、ウガンダへの国際的拡大確認、重大な感染症でありWHO警告による高い関心。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（対象国外）での19例確認も記載されているが、主流行地はDRCであり verified_locations はDRCのみ。中国医療チーム派遣、UN国境スクリーニングなど国際対応が進行中。Bundibugyo株でのワクチン不在が懸念。医療従事者感染75名（死亡17名）により保健システムへの直接的脅威あり。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : l'OMS alerte sur la propagation rapide de l'épidémie, avec près de 900 cas, 232 décès et 78 guérisons
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: WHO warns of the rapid spread of the outbreak, with nearly 900 cases, 232 deaths and 78 recoveries.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreaks in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu) continue to spread rapidly. As of June 19, 2026, the WHO reports about 896 confirmed cases, 232 deaths, and 78 recoveries since the outbreak was declared on May 15, with the epicenter in Mongbwalu, Ituri, a gold-mining town marked by insecurity and population movement. The outbreak has expanded from three health zones to more than 33 across Ituri (21 zones), North Kivu (11), and South Kivu (1). Investigations and confirmation delays are linked to the complex context. More than 68 partners—UN agencies, NGOs, civil society, and mining-sector actors—are mobilized in a multisectoral response, including nine treatment centers with about 400 beds, following infection prevention and control standards. Socio-cultural beliefs, rumors, and malnutrition and food insecurity hinder community engagement and surveillance. The WHO urges sustained health-system strengthening to improve early detection and future outbreak management.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：WHO が急速な流行拡大を警告、約900例、232人の死亡、78人の回復
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラ出血熱は重篤な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、急速な地域拡大（33保健区へ拡大）、国際的な懸念・支援動員、複数国での感染リスクがある。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は WHO 懸念の国際的公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）に該当し得る。Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu の3州での流行が確認されており、採鉱地域での不安定情勢および人口移動がさらなる拡大リスクを増加させている。68以上の多国間パートナーが対応に動員されている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola patients flee treatment centres in Congo for food as hunger crisis deepens
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, centered around Mongbwalu in Ituri; Ituri accounts for >90% of confirmed cases. Almost 900 infections and more than a quarter deaths. About 6,400 people are under observation after exposure. Hunger and food insecurity—affecting about 10 million in eastern provinces—undermines containment, with >150 escapes from treatment/ isolation facilities since late May, including 11 suspected patients who fled a hospital in Bambu due to inadequate nutritional support. WFP is delivering hot meals; 590 meals distributed in one day to suspected/confirmed patients, contacts, and caregivers. In a case described, a 5-year-old girl vomited and bled from the ears and died after arrival at Beni’s main hospital. WFP seeks $175 million for Congo operations through November, including $32 million for Ebola activities; budgets have fallen about a third in 2–3 years. The article does not specify lab confirmation, infection source, or imported/exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ患者が食糧危機のため治療センターから逃亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、異常な状況、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5つすべてに該当。フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが「Italian Republic」（Veneto, Bambù）を発生地域に含めているが、記事サマリーではコンゴ東部（Ituri州のMongbwalu中心）でのエボラ発生が主題であり、イタリアは当該感染症イベントの実際の発生地ではなく、おそらく地理的キーワード抽出の誤りと判断。DRCのみをverified_locationsに含める。食糧危機による治療センターからの患者逃亡は封じ込めを著しく困難にし、国際的拡大リスクを高める。WFPによる支援要請（$175百万）は国際的関心の高さを示唆。

article.articleHeadline: ИЈЗ: Регистриран прв случај на зика вирусот во земјава, пациентот се заразил на Малдивите
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Institute of Public Health: First case of the Zika virus registered in the country; the patient contracted it in the Maldives.
article.articleSummary: First confirmed Zika virus infection in North Macedonia, with the patient having stayed in the Maldives from 20–28 May 2026. A positive serological and molecular diagnosis was reported by the Institute of Public Health’s virology department; the patient developed fever and body/muscle aches on 24 May 2026 and later a fine dense rash, was not hospitalized, and is receiving home treatment in good condition. The case is imported; authorities note ongoing travel to tropical destinations (Maldives, Thailand, Indonesia, Brazil, Caribbean) raises the chance of additional imported cases. Aedes albopictus distribution elsewhere heightens potential for local transmission if an infected traveler introduces the virus. ECDC monitors travel-associated cases; overall domestic risk in North Macedonia is currently low. Zika is an acute flavivirus; incubation 3–14 days; congenital effects such as microcephaly possible; laboratory confirmation is required.

triage.headline_ja: 公衆衛生研究所：国内で初めてのジカウイルス感染例を報告。患者はモルディブで感染した
triage.triage_reason: 北マケドニアでのジカウイルス輸入症例は異常・予想外の出来事だが、患者は軽症で自宅療養中。対象国はインドネシア・タイ・ブラジルも関連するが、本記事の主題は北マケドニアでの輸入症例報告であり、対象国内での活動性な流行の証拠がない。情報不足のため経過観察に位置づける。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は北マケドニアでの初の輸入ジカウイルス症例であり、対象国ではない。しかし患者の滞在地と旅行関連の懸念により、ブラジル・タイ・インドネシアを verified_locations に含める。患者は軽症で隔離治療中であり、重症度は低い。局所的な蚊媒介伝播のリスクは現在のところ低いとされている。

article.articleHeadline: ஜூன் 28 இல் தீவிர போலியோ தடுப்பு சொட்டு மருந்து முகாம்
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: June 28: Intensive polio injectable vaccine camp.
article.articleSummary: Salem district, Tamil Nadu, will hold an intensive polio vaccination camp on June 28 to immunize all children up to 5 years with the injectable polio vaccine (IPV). A Thursday advisory meeting chaired by District Collector K. Ilambagavath outlined the camp’s arrangements and objective: to boost poliovirus immunity amid routine immunization efforts. The report does not mention any polio cases, deaths, or active outbreaks, nor laboratory confirmations, infection sources, or imported/exported cases. The initiative underscores public health measures to strengthen immunity against poliovirus and ensure full vaccination coverage in Salem district, with arrangements likely to include outreach and mobilization of frontline health workers.

triage.headline_ja: 6月28日：ポリオ予防接種の集中キャンプ
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はポリオ症例の報告ではなく、公衆衛生対策としてのワクチン接種キャンプの告知であり、IHR基準およびスクリーニング基準に該当しない。異常事象、重症度、国際的拡大リスクなし。
triage.notes: 本記事はポリオ症例や患者報告を含まず、定期的な公衆衛生ワクチン接種キャンプの告知に過ぎない。シグナルトリアージ対象のイベント（疾患クラスター、異常症例報告、有病率上昇など）には該当しない。ルーチン免疫化活動として見送り。

article.articleHeadline: Ituri : tous les soins de santé désormais gratuits pendant la période de l'épidémie d'Ebola (Roger Kamba)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ituri: all health care is now free during the Ebola outbreak period (Roger Kamba).
article.articleSummary: Free health care is now available across all health facilities in Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, for the duration of the Ebola outbreak period. Health Minister Roger Kamba announced the measure on June 19, 2026, during a press briefing. The exceptional policy covers all health services and diseases, not only Ebola, aiming to remove financial barriers and encourage rapid access to care in the outbreak response context. Authorities expect universal access will facilitate timely use of facilities and strengthen treatment for patients. The initiative reflects a public health strategy to support communities during the Ebola outbreak in Ituri, ensuring people can seek care without financial constraint while health authorities continue the containment and response activities.

triage.headline_ja: イトゥリ：エボラ流行期間中、すべての医療が無料に（ロジェ・カンバ）
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の流行がDRC・イトゥリ州で発生しており、IHR基準（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）に複数該当。WPRO基準でも重症度・流行しやすさ・管理可能性が該当するため、フルRRA実施対象。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は最高リスク感染症。DRC・イトゥリ州での現在進行形の流行であり、政府による医療無料化措置という公式対応が確認される。国際的なWHO通知と支援の対象となる可能性が高い。記事日付が2026年6月となっており将来日付であることに注意だが、イベント情報として処理する。

article.articleHeadline: חשד לאבולה בישראל: אדם הועבר לבידוד ברמב"ם
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Suspected Ebola in Israel: A person was placed in isolation at Rambam.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-19, Israel reports a suspected Ebola case. A man who returned three days ago from the Democratic Republic of Congo developed fever and headache and is now isolated and hospitalized at Rambam Medical Center, the designated center for suspected Ebola cases. Lab tests are expected within 24 hours to confirm or rule out infection. An epidemiological investigation is underway to identify contacts since his return. The suspicion follows ongoing Ebola outbreaks in the DRC and Uganda. The Health Ministry has issued hospital preparedness measures, protective equipment, and rapid isolation protocols. Guidelines include immediate isolation of suspects, prohibition of self-transport to emergency departments, and EMS transport only, with admission to one of five highly prepared hospitals: Rambam, Hadassah Ein Kerem, Sheba, Ichilov, and Soroka. Preparedness materials have been shared with hospitals and MDA.

triage.headline_ja: イスラエルでエボラ疑い: 患者がラムバム病院に隔離される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上に該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。DRCでの継続的アウトブレイクとの関連、複数国への拡大の可能性、および検査確定待機中の高リスク病原体（エボラ）のため、フルRRA対象
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの主題はイスラエルにおける疑い症例ですが、イスラエルは対象国リストに含まれていません。DRCとウガンダでの継続中のエボラアウトブレイクが言及されており、症例の感染源地がDRCです。DRCは対象国であるため verified_locations に含めています。イスラエルでの検査結果（24時間以内）が重要。

article.articleHeadline: 全班停课10天"！深圳不少娃中招！广东5月新增27849例，近期高发千万留意_手机网易网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "Whole class suspended for 10 days"! Many Shenzhen kids infected! Guangdong reports 27,849 new cases in May; recent surge—stay vigilant.
article.articleSummary: Guangdong recorded 231,664 statutory infectious disease cases in May, including 27,849 HFMD. In Shenzhen, a class was suspended for 10 days (to June 29) with all classmates staying home, per local CDC guidance; return requires symptom resolution and medical clearance; new HFMD cases trigger isolation until recovery. HFMD is caused by enteroviruses, mainly EV71 and Coxsackie A16; incubation 2–10 days (avg 3–5); 90% of cases occur in children under 5, with 3-year-olds at highest risk. Most infections are mild, but severe cases can cause myocarditis, pulmonary edema, or aseptic meningitis; rare fatalities. Shenzhen experiences two seasonal peaks: April–July (spring-summer) and September–November (autumn). Transmission is via close contact, contaminated objects, droplets, food/water. Prevention includes handwashing, disinfection, boiled water, avoiding crowds, and EV71 vaccination (two doses, voluntary, self-paid). Vaccination appointment via Shenzhen CDC public account.

triage.headline_ja: 「全クラス10日間休校」！深圳の多くの子どもが感染！広東5月に27,849例が新規報告、最近の流行に要注意
triage.triage_reason: 手足口病（HFMD）の大規模流行シグナル。広東省で5月に27,849例の新規報告があり、深圳では学級閉鎖措置が取られている。EV71を含む異常な季節的流行であり、IHR基準の「異常性」および「公衆衛生への影響」に該当。WPROスクリーニング基準では「異常性」「流行しやすさ」「社会的関心（学級閉鎖）」が明確に該当するためフルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事は中国・深圳（広東省）でのEV71を含む手足口病（HFMD）の季節的流行を報告。5月の新規報告27,849例は同地域の季節ピーク（4-7月）と一致。学級閉鎖措置は政府による対応実施を示唆。ただし記事に死亡例の報告はなく、重症度は一般的（まれに重症化の可能性）。地理的には対象国はChina（1814991）のみ該当。

article.articleHeadline: DRC Ebola Outbreak Declared Global Emergency, Cases Near 900
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak nears 900 confirmed cases in five weeks, with 896 confirmed and 232 deaths reported by WHO; 21 new infections in a day. More than 90% of cases are in Ituri Province’s northeast, centered on Bunia, as armed conflict hampers containment, with the virus spreading to North Kivu (67 confirmed across 10 health zones) and to South Kivu. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain complicates response, as existing vaccines/treatments target Zaire ebolavirus and may offer limited benefit; past Bundibugyo outbreaks had fatality rates of 25-50%. The May 5 Mongbwalu alert, May 15 lab confirmation, and May 17 WHO PHEIC designation marked the surge. Response capacity expanded to >500 treatment beds; surveillance now handles ~400 alerts and >2,000 tests daily. Contact tracing covers ~75% of known contacts (95% needed). Uganda reports 19 cases, 2 deaths, 10 recoveries; no new Ugandan cases in 12 days. National risk very high; regional risk high.

triage.headline_ja: DRC エボラ爆発が世界的緊急事態と宣言、症例数900近くに達する
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、公衆衛生への深刻な影響（900近い確認症例、232死亡）、異常性（Bundibugyo株による複雑な対応）、国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダへの越境、複数州での伝播）、国際的な渡航・貿易制限のリスクが認識される。WHOがPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）として既に指定。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRC内での爆発を主題としており、ウガンダへの越境事例も記載されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には DRC のみを列挙。既にWHOによるPHEIC指定（2026年5月17日）が確認されており、高い国家リスク・地域リスク評価がなされている。Bundibugyo株による治療・ワクチンの限定的有効性が重大な懸念。

article.articleHeadline: Mato Grosso do Sul registra 23ª morte por Chikungunya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mato Grosso do Sul records 23rd death from Chikungunya.
article.articleSummary: Mato Grosso do Sul recorded its 23rd chikungunya death in 2026. The latest victim is a 19-year-old Indigenous resident of the Dourados Indigenous Reserve, who developed symptoms March 14 and died May 29 after hospitalization at HU-UFGD; the case was confirmed June 19 by the COE. Dourados now accounts for 15 chikungunya deaths, 11 Indigenous in Bororó and Jaguapiru. The SES bulletin lists 22 MS deaths with two under investigation. Three additional suspected deaths—74-year-old woman with CKD and hypertension, 71-year-old man with diabetes, and 43-year-old man with no comorbidities—are under analysis in urban Dourados. The municipality reports 9,772 notifications (5,242 probable, 4,745 lab-confirmed; 497 under investigation); Indigenous Reserve: 3,151 notifications, 2,184 confirmed, 159 under analysis. Hospitalizations down to 20; peak week 12 had 1,207 notifications, week 23 had 194. Public health measures focus on eliminating standing water to curb Aedes aegypti.

triage.headline_ja: マット・グロッソ・ド・スル州がチクングニア熱による第23死亡例を記録
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでのチクングニア熱による継続的な死亡報告であり、重症度と流行の長期化を示唆する情報がある一方、国内での散発的な事例であり国際的拡大の明確な兆候は記事から不明確であるため。
triage.notes: ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれていないため、本来的には評価範囲外である。ただし提供されたイベント情報として処理した場合、チクングニア熱による継続的な死亡とともに、特に先住民コミュニティでの高い致命率（15死亡中11例が先住民）、および長期にわたる局所的流行を示唆する多数の確認例と通知が認められる。蚊媒介感染症としての流行しやすさと、公衆衛生対応の継続的必要性が確認される。ただしブラジル国内の状況であり、即座のPICKUPの判断根拠としては不十分である。

article.articleHeadline: बुखार में डेंगू-मलेरिया जैसे लक्षण, रिपोर्ट आ रही निगेटिव
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fever with dengue- and malaria-like symptoms, reports are coming back negative.
article.articleSummary: As of June 19, 2026, a district reports a rapid rise in fever cases amid rising temperatures. Many patients present with dengue-, malaria-, and typhoid-like symptoms, yet diagnostic tests repeatedly come back negative. Clinicians note high fever, sore throat, cold, cough, body pains, severe headache, and falling platelet counts. Antibiotics and analgesics show limited or no effect in many cases. Outpatient departments at the medical college and district hospital are seeing a steady influx of fever patients. Because the illness is not being confirmed promptly, treatment is largely symptomatic and relief is achieved for some; however, delays in precise diagnosis are impacting the treatment process. Experts emphasize seeking prompt medical consultation rather than self-diagnosis.

triage.headline_ja: 熱病患者でデング熱・マラリア類似症状が見られるも、検査結果は陰性
triage.triage_reason: 複数の蚊媒介感染症の臨床症状を呈する未確認の熱性疾患の集団発生。診断が確定していないため、病因の特定と規模把握が不明であり、情報確保が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、インドのある地区で複数の蚊媒介感染症の臨床症状を呈する発熱患者が急増している状況が確認される。ただし、デング熱・マラリア・腸チフスの診断検査が陰性であり、原因不明の発熱症候群（Undifferentiated Fever Syndrome）の可能性が高い。患者数規模、入院数、死亡者の有無が記事に記載されていないため、深刻度は「不明」と評価。継続的な情報収集が必要。

article.articleHeadline: الاشتباه بإصابة رجل بفيروس إيبولا في إسرائيل ونقله للعزل في مستشفى رمبام
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Suspected Ebola infection in a man in Israel and his transfer to isolation at Rambam Hospital.
article.articleSummary: Suspected Ebola virus disease in Israel: A man who arrived from the Democratic Republic of the Congo three days ago is being treated after developing fever and headache. Health authorities say this is currently only a suspicion, with laboratory testing underway and results expected within the next 24 hours. The patient is in isolation under professional protocols and has been transferred to Rambam Medical Center, designated for suspected Ebola cases. An epidemiological investigation to trace contacts is ongoing. No laboratory confirmation yet of infection. Authorities emphasize routine precautions and the readiness of the isolation facility. The report underscores rapid assessment and containment steps following the cross-border return from the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: イスラエルで男性のエボラウイルス感染を疑い、ラムバム病院に隔離転送
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス疾患の疑い例が国際的な感染地域（DRC）からの渡航者で報告され、IHR基準3項目に該当。未確認だが重大な公衆衛生上の懸念があり、迅速な確認と国際的な監視が必要。
triage.notes: イスラエルは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。患者の渡航元であるDRCのみを記載。検査結果は24時間以内に判明予定であり、継続監視必須。エボラウイルス疾患の疑い例は国際的な重大懸念として扱われるべき。

article.articleHeadline: Criação ilegal de javalis acende alerta para riscos sanitários e prejuízos à pecuária em Pernambuco
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Illegal Breeding of Wild Boars Raises Alarm Over Sanitary Risks and Losses to the Livestock Sector in Pernambuco.
article.articleSummary: Illegal breeding of wild boars in Pernambuco, Brazil, raises sanitary and economic concerns. Wild boars are an exotic invasive species; their breeding is prohibited by environmental law, and unauthorized holdings threaten ecosystems, rural production, and herd health. Escaped or released boars reproduce rapidly, invade farmland, damage vegetation, crops, fences, and water sources, and compete with native species. They pose a heightened risk to livestock health by acting as hosts and potential spreaders of diseases affecting cattle and pigs, jeopardizing Brazil's sanitary status and increasing control and surveillance costs. In swine production, there is particular worry about the potential entry and spread of African swine fever if the virus reaches the country, challenging farm biosafety programs. Pernambuco's case underscores enforcement needs; experts urge integrated actions among environmental agencies, animal health authorities, security forces, and producers to contain spread and mitigate economic and environmental impacts.

triage.headline_ja: ペルナンブーコ州での違法なイノシシ飼育、衛生リスクと畜産被害に警告を発する
triage.triage_reason: アフリカ豚熱（ASF）の侵入リスクが潜在的に言及されているが、現在の実際の発生報告ではなく、違法飼育による予防的警告。ブラジルの現在の疾病状況が不明確。
triage.notes: 本記事はアフリカ豚熱（ASF）の潜在的リスクについて言及しているが、現在の実際の感染発生報告ではなく、違法なイノシシ飼育が行われていることへの予防的警告である。ブラジルでのASF現状不明。野生イノシシの生息により農場バイオセキュリティが脅かされるという長期的曝露リスク、およびウイルス流行の可能性が識別された。政府機関の対応と専門家の提言が記事に反映されている。

article.articleHeadline: Mourners bury a 6-month-old Ebola victim, marking third orphanage death as Congo outbreak spreads
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Congo worsens as mourners bury a 6-month-old girl in Bunia who died earlier this week, the third child to die at an orphanage amid the latest outbreak. Health workers in masks and gloves lowered the coffin as a Catholic priest prayed, underscoring the human toll. Authorities have struggled to contain the outbreak, with ongoing deaths at orphanages in the region. The burial took place on Friday, 2026-06-19. The report does not provide laboratory confirmation details or full case counts. No information on infection source or imported/exported cases is provided. The scene underscores the toll on families and the fragility of outbreak response in eastern Congo.

triage.headline_ja: モーニャーがコンゴの孤児院での3人目の死亡者となった生後6ヶ月のエボラ犠牲者を埋葬。コンゴの感染症爆発が拡大
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の確認された発生。IHR基準で「異常・予想外」「深刻な公衆衛生への影響」「国際的拡大リスク」の複数該当。WPROスクリーニング基準で「重症度（乳幼児死亡）」「流行しやすさ（ヒト-ヒト感染、孤児院での集団発生）」「管理可能性（当局の抑制困難）」が該当。フルRRAに進むべき。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病は高リスク病原体。東コンゴ地域での継続的な発生が報告されており、孤児院での複数死亡（少なくとも3名）が確認されている。発生地域Bunia（北キブ州）は実質的にDRCに含まれる。記事は死亡例の詳細を述べているが、実験室確認やケース総数、感染源についての詳細情報は不足している。対象国リストにおいてDRC（GeoNames ID: 203312）は含まれており、verified_locationsに正しく列挙されている。

article.articleHeadline: شخص من البلاد عاد من الكونغو الديمقراطية ويشتبه بإصابته بفيروس إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A person from the country who has returned from the Democratic Republic of the Congo is suspected of being infected with the Ebola virus.
article.articleSummary: Israel’s Health Ministry announced a suspected case of Ebola virus disease after a person who recently returned from the Democratic Republic of the Congo sought medical care in Israel. The individual arrived in the country three days ago and developed fever and headache, prompting medical evaluation. Diagnostic laboratory tests are underway, with results expected within 24 hours to confirm or rule out Ebola infection. The report provides no additional details on exposure or contacts at this time.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国から帰国した人物がエボラウイルス感染の疑いで検査中
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの疑い例が報告され、国際的な懸念がある。IHR基準で異常性・予想外性と国際的拡大リスクが該当し、公衆衛生上の深刻性も高い。確定診断待ちの段階であるが、高病原性ウイルスの確認報告のため直ちにフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づくと、イベントの発生地はコンゴ民主共和国であり、イスラエルは患者の移動先（帰国地）です。診断確定待ちの段階ですが、エボラウイルスの疑い例は直ちにシグナルとして取り扱うべき高リスク事象です。追加情報として、患者の接触者情報や曝露経路の詳細が今後重要となります。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo: Efforts ramp up as Ebola outbreak accelerates beyond borders - Media Monitors Network (MMN)
article.articleSummary: DR Congo Ebola outbreak escalates with 896 confirmed cases and 232 deaths reported across 31 health zones as of 17 June; Uganda reports 19 cases and 2 deaths per WHO updates. Cross-border risk rises as eastern DRC borders Uganda, Rwanda, Burundi, Tanzania and South Sudan amid ongoing M23 conflict and mass displacement. UNHCR strengthens surveillance, screening, and water, sanitation and hygiene (WASH) in refugee-hosting areas and along border corridors to prevent cross-border transmission. WHO has deployed over 115 experts and delivered more than 110 tonnes of emergency supplies; IOM reports over one million screenings at borders and key travel routes across affected and at-risk countries. Cross-border movements include 2,250 arrivals from Mbau near Beni to Oicha, North Kivu. UNFPA notes up to 90% mortality among pregnant women and up to 100% perinatal mortality in some settings; 153 midwives are deployed with emergency funding urged.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：エボラ感染流行が国境を越えて加速する中、対応策が強化される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPRO基準も複数該当。DRC及びウガンダでの確認症例と死亡、国境を越えた拡大、国際的支援体制の既発動により、フルRRA実施の必要性が極めて高い。
triage.notes: 記事は DRC と Uganda における Ebola 発生について述べているが、対象国リストに Uganda は含まれていないため verified_locations には DRC のみを記載。記事サマリーに Rwanda、Burundi、Tanzania、South Sudan が記載されているが、これらは国境リスク国として言及されており、実際の発生地は DRC が主であることから、対象国リストの該当確認に基づき DRC のみを verified_locations に列挙した。社会的・政治的関心は極めて高く、WHO や IOM、UNFPA が既に介入しており、国際支援が大規模に展開されている。

article.articleHeadline: 剛果烏干達伊波拉疫情：一週病例激增近40%，死亡人數突破200人
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo-Uganda Ebola outbreak: weekly cases surge nearly 40%, death toll surpasses 200.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak: Ebola caused by Bundibugyo virus in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri Province, with cases also in North Kivu and South Kivu) and cross-border spread to Uganda. As of 2026-06-19, confirmed cases reach 894 and deaths exceed 200; recoveries 74. Suspected contacts may total about 35,000, but only ~4,000 are being tracked (roughly 15%). Uganda reports 19 confirmed cases and 2 deaths. The outbreak, in its first month, is about three times more severe than Uganda’s 2000 outbreak. Ituri accounts for more than 90% of cases; other provinces have cases; cross-border transmission to Uganda confirmed. Bundibugyo virus has no approved vaccine or treatment; Zaire virus vaccines exist but not for Bundibugyo; experimental therapies are in development. Pledged outbreak funding (>$900 million) is largely not yet disbursed (~$90 million). Resource gaps and displacement, along with mobile miners and poor infrastructure, hinder contact tracing.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ・ウガンダのエボラ流行：週間新規症例が40%近く急増、死亡者数が200人を超える
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WPRO基準も5項目全て該当。社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 2026年のシナリオケースと判断。DRCのIturi、North Kivu、South Kivu州で Bundibugyo ウイルスによるエボラ流行が発生し、既に894例、死亡者200人超。ウガンダへの越境感染も確認（19例、死亡2人）。Bundibugyo ウイルスには承認されたワクチンがなく、治療薬も限定的。接触者追跡体制の不備（35,000人の接触者中、追跡中は約4,000人のみ）、資金不足（$900百万の誓約に対し実際の支出は約$90百万）、難民・変位人口の存在など、管理上の重大な課題がある。1ヶ月で2000年のウガンダ流行の3倍の重症度に達している。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola spreading 'fast' in DR Congo, warns WHO
article.articleSummary: Fatal Ebola deaths have been buried at Nyamurongo cemetery in Bunia as the Democratic Republic of Congo’s outbreak, caused by the Bundibugyo strain with no vaccine or specific treatment, spreads rapidly from Ituri’s epicenter toward North Kivu and South Kivu. Since the May 15 declaration, 896 confirmed cases and 232 deaths have been recorded, with 21 new cases in the last 24 hours. More than 90% of known cases are in conflict‑stricken Ituri. The outbreak has stretched response capacity—from zero beds to over 500, and from limited surveillance to nearly 400 alerts and more than 2,000 tests per day. Contacts traced reach 75%, still short of the 95% target. So far, 78 patients recovered; 75 health workers infected, 17 dead. A Chinese medical team will head to Bunia. Uganda reports 19 cases, 2 deaths, 10 recoveries, no new cases in 12 days, while border health screenings exceed one million.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがコンゴ民主共和国で「急速に」拡大、WHOが警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。Bundibugyo株による致命的なエボラ出血熱で、既に896確定患者232死亡を記録し、国境を越えてウガンダにも拡大。国際的に深刻な公衆衛生影響と国際感染拡大のリスクが明白。
triage.notes: 発生地域にUgandaが列挙されているが、記事サマリーではUgandaは既に確認された19症例を報告する二次的位置付け。原発感染地はDRCのIturi州およびSouth Kivu州。DRCが対象国リストに含まれるため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとする。ウガンダは非対象国のため除外。高致命率（25.8%）、ワクチン未提供のBundibugyo株、紛争地での対応困難性、越境感染の既発生という要因から即刻のフルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Outbreak Death Toll Tops 200
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola in Congo (central Africa) continues; as of June 18, Congo reports 232 confirmed Ebola deaths and 78 recoveries; Uganda has two deaths. The death toll represents about a quarter of confirmed infections in Congo, with mid-May detection. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus—linked to 2007 Uganda and 2012 Congo outbreaks—posed diagnostic hurdles, as early tests failed to detect it. About 6,000 people were identified as exposed, but contact follow-up is only 71%, well below the 90-95% targets set by Africa CDC. Conflict in affected areas hampers case investigation. U.S. and partner funding will expand testing and tracing. WHO notes health workers are among the deceased: 75 medics contracted, 17 died. No domestic cases in the United States as of now. Congo's health minister Dr. Samuel Kamba leads investigations; CDC's Dr. Satish Pillai and Africa CDC's Dr. Wessam Mankoula commented; Bunia briefing cited.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の死者数が200人を超える
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。コンゴでのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク（232人の確認死亡、78人の回復）は深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダへの波及、米国の関心）、および渡航・貿易制限のリスクを示す。WPROスクリーニング基準も全て該当し、社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus亜種により診断が複雑化。接触者追跡フォローアップが71%にとどまり、ウガンダでも2死亡が報告されているが、DRCが主たる発生地域。紛争地域での疫学調査が困難であるため、管理可能性が制限される。米国およびアフリカCDCパートナーによる資金・技術支援が開始。医療従事者への感染も著しい（75人感染、17人死亡）。

article.articleHeadline: 'Joint efforts key to defeating TB' | Lucknow News
article.articleSummary: Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh: Deputy Chief Minister and health minister Brajesh Pathak says tuberculosis can be eradicated only through coordinated efforts and active public participation, outlining progress under the Pradhan Mantri TB Mukt Bharat Abhiyan and reproductive and child health (RCH) programmes. During a virtual review meeting chaired by Union health minister JP Nadda from the Vidhan Sabha complex, Pathak highlighted large-scale implementation and strengthened healthcare delivery in UP. He stressed intensified TB detection, timely treatment, and enhanced patient support as keys to elimination, noting expanded outreach and improved monitoring under the national TB elimination campaign. The discussion also covered maternal and child healthcare, immunisation coverage, and reproductive health services, with a continued focus on accessibility and quality of care across regions. Additional Chief Secretary Amit Kumar Ghosh attended the meeting.

triage.headline_ja: 結核の撲滅には共同努力が鍵 | ラッキナウ ニュース
triage.triage_reason: インドにおける結核対策の進捗報告と政策レビュー会議に関する記事。新規の感染症クラスター、異常な発生、または緊急的な公衆衛生上の脅威を示す具体的な情報がなく、IHR基準およびWPROスクリーニング基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事は既知の風土病（結核）の国家的対策プログラム（Pradhan Mantri TB Mukt Bharat Abhiyan）の進捗状況に関する政策声明であり、新規アウトブレイク、患者数の異常な増加、死亡率の上昇といった具体的なシグナル情報を含んでいない。標準的な公衆衛生活動の報道であり、フルRRA対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Health Ministry says suspected Ebola patient being treated at Haifa hospital after recent return from DRC
article.articleSummary: On 2026-06-19, Israel's Health Ministry announced a suspected Ebola case following a return from the Democratic Republic of the Congo. The patient has been transferred to Rambam Medical Center in Haifa, which has been designated as the Ebola treatment hospital. The ministry stressed that the Ebola diagnosis has not yet been confirmed and that investigations and laboratory testing are ongoing to determine infection status. The case is imported, linked to travel in the DRC, rather than locally acquired. No additional clinical details or exposure information were disclosed. Authorities will continue monitoring the patient and tracing contacts as part of standard public health measures while awaiting confirmation.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省が発表：DRCからの帰国者がハイファの病院でエボラ疑い患者として治療を受けている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラは極めて高リスク疾患であり、複数国間の渡航関連輸入症例は国際公衆衛生上の懸念事項である。確定前の段階でも迅速なフルRRA評価が必要。
triage.notes: エボラ疑い患者がイスラエル（対象国外）で報告されたが、感染源・疫学的関連はDRCであり、DRCは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含めた。患者はDRC滞在歴がある輸入症例。診断確定前だが、エボラの高リスク特性により高優先度。接触者追跡状況は記事では不明。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue: Campinas tem 32 bairros com alto risco de transmissão da doença
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue: Campinas has 32 neighborhoods at high risk of disease transmission.
article.articleSummary: Dengue and other Aedes aegypti–borne diseases are highlighted by Campinas Health Department's 25th Arboviroses Alert of 2026, issued June 18. The document flags 32 bairros at high transmission risk across six city regions—East, Northwest, North, Southwest, South, and Southeast—with neighborhoods named in each area. The alert aims to guide residents to destroy breeding sites and intensify prevention, and applies citywide including areas surrounding the listed zones. From January 1 to June 18, 2026, Campinas reported 3,115 dengue cases. Authorities conducted 749,399 property inspections for breeding-site control and 49,909 fogging actions. Prevention depends on resident participation; about 80% of mosquito breeding sites are inside homes.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱：カンピーナスで32の地区が疾病感染の高リスク地域と指定
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルはCEPRの対象国に含まれていないため、シグナルトリアージの対象外です。また、記事は地域的な予防警報であり、IHRやWPRO基準を満たしていません。
triage.notes: 発生地域としてブラジル（GeoNames ID 3469034）が含まれていますが、CEPR対象国（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）リストでは、ブラジル（1269750）ではなく3469034が指定されています。実際のブラジル対象国GeoNames IDは3469034であるため、地理的には該当します。ただし、本イベントは局所的なデング熱警報であり、国家緊急レベルまで達していません。記事言語がポルトガル語で、情報源はブラジル地方メディアです。

article.articleHeadline: Минздрав: вирус Эбола, возможно, уже в Израиле
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health: the Ebola virus may already be in Israel.
article.articleSummary: Israel's Ministry of Health reports an epidemiological investigation into a probable Ebola case in a patient who returned three days ago from the Democratic Republic of Congo. Diagnosis is not yet lab-confirmed; the patient, with high fever and headaches, is in isolation in Rambam Hospital's Ebola-ready unit as epidemiologists trace contacts since the return. Authorities highlight an ongoing Ebola outbreak in the region, centered in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda. A month earlier, the ministry warned Israelis against travel to Equatorial Africa and urged returnees to self-isolate and seek medical help by phone if fever or any infection symptoms appear within three weeks of returning. The investigation aims to determine the infection source and assess exposure risk.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省：エボラウイルスはおそらくすでにイスラエルにある
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの疑い例がイスラエルで報告され、DRCでの流行継続中。IHR基準3つ（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）該当し、確定診断待機中の状況で迅速な対応が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づきDRCでのエボラ流流行が主要な背景であり、イスラエルは輸入症例の疑い地として記載。Bluedot APIの発生地域リストには対象国外（イスラエル、ウガンダ）も含まれるが、verified_locationsは対象国リスト内のDRCのみを記載。DRCでの確認されたエボラ流行に加え、イスラエルへの輸入症例の可能性が高リスク要因。確定診断待機中であるが、疑い症例の段階でも迅速な対応が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Actualité | Ebola en RDC : neuf centres de traitement opérationnels avec 500 lits disponibles (OMS) | mediacongo.net
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: News | Ebola in the DRC: nine operational treatment centers with 500 beds available (WHO) | mediacongo.net.
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of Congo, nine Ebola treatment centers are now operational with a 500-bed capacity to treat Ebola virus disease (EVD), WHO representative Marie-Rose Bélicard announced in Bunia on June 19, 2026. The setup enables holistic care, including psychosocial and nutritional support, with help from WFP and UNICEF. Diagnostics have scaled from 20 tests per day to over 2,000 daily, and community deaths are detected, indicating ongoing transmission. The outbreak has expanded from three initial health zones to 33 zones: 21 in Ituri, 11 in North Kivu, and one in South Kivu. Authorities oppose confining Bunia, saying it would hinder response. Ituri province remains the epicenter with more than 800 cases; officials say the peak has not yet been reached.

triage.headline_ja: RDCのエボラ：WHOが発表した500床の9つの運用中の治療センター
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病の確認された流行で、複数の健康地域への拡大、高い重症度、国際的な対応能力の課題があり、WHOによる公式発表も確認される。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病の活動中の流行。33の保健地域に拡大（イトゥリ21、北キブ11、南キブ1）。イトゥリ州が流行の中心で800症例以上。診断能力の大幅な増強（20→2000検査/日）が進行中。WHOおよび複数のUN機関の対応が進行中。ピークに達していないとの当局報告。

article.articleHeadline: חולה שהגיע מקונגו חשוד כנדבק בנגיף אבולה - מוחזק בבידוד
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A patient who arrived from Congo is suspected of being infected with the Ebola virus — held in isolation.
article.articleSummary: An individual who arrived from the Democratic Republic of the Congo is suspected of Ebola and is in complete isolation at Rambam Health Care Campus in Haifa. The Health Ministry launched an extensive epidemiological investigation to rapidly identify all contacts since landing in Israel. Lab tests to identify the Ebola virus are underway, with official results expected within the next hours from Russia and the Central Laboratory. Israel’s health system has prepared for potential outbreaks, issuing strict hospital guidelines, stockpiling protective equipment, and implementing early airport surveillance for travelers returning from risk areas. The ministry also prohibits non-essential travel to risk zones. Travelers returning from Congo and Uganda who develop symptoms within 21 days should remain in full home isolation and immediately contact the Kol HaBriut health hotline. For now, only a suspected case; further public and medical updates will follow.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴから到着した患者がエボラウイルス感染の疑いで隔離中
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの疑い症例が国際移動によってもたらされ、IHR基準2つ以上（異常性・国際的拡大リスク）を満たし、公開性の高い事案のため。
triage.notes: エボラウイルスはIHR基準で即時報告対象疾患。記事サマリーは疫学調査が進行中であり、確定診断は検査中である。発生地域にはイスラエルと露国が含まれているが、実際のイベント（患者からの曝露）はコンゴからの輸入症例であるため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。対象国リストではDRC(203312)に該当。

article.articleHeadline: ¿Por qué esta crisis del ébola es más preocupante?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Why is this Ebola crisis more concerning?
article.articleSummary: 232 deaths and 896 laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases have been reported in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, signaling a potentially grave outbreak. The crisis centers on the Bundibugyo strain, for which there are no approved vaccines, no rapid tests, and no ad hoc treatments, unlike the Zaire strain where medicines exist. The WHO has placed the outbreak at the second-highest global alert level, but ring vaccination is not feasible. The epicenter lies in a war-torn DR Congo region controlled by the M23 rebels; healthcare access is severely limited and mass displacement complicates surveillance. Health infrastructure is strained amid budget cuts to USAID and the US CDC, with critics arguing that post-COVID fatigue, budgetary pressures, and geopolitical tensions have dampened international response and media coverage. This combination raises concern about Ebola’s potential spread.

triage.headline_ja: なぜこのエボラ危機はより懸念されるのか？
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目全て該当する。死亡232例、確認症例896例の深刻なアウトブレイクであり、ワクチンや治療法のない株による国際的拡大リスクが高い。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCにおけるエボラアウトブレイクが主題。米国はBluedot APIの発生地域に含まれているが、記事サマリー上でエボラウイルスの実発生地ではなく、国際対応の文脈での言及に留まるため verified_locations から除外。Bundibugyo株でのワクチン・治療法の欠如、紛争地域での医療アクセス限定、国際的な支援体制の低迷が懸念要因として強調されている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en Ituri : des avancées significatives enregistrées dans la détection des cas - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Ituri: Significant Advances Recorded in Case Detection - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola in Ituri, Democratic Republic of the Congo, shows significant advances in case detection as of June 19, 2026. In the north-eastern Ituri region, health authorities report 933 confirmed Ebola cases with 245 deaths (case fatality rate 26%), 416 patients hospitalized, and 80 recoveries. Hospital capacity has expanded to 516 beds, with ongoing center extensions to manage patient influx and isolate confirmed cases quickly from the community. Active field investigations are identifying more cases, and voluntary admissions to treatment centers are increasing, improving management of the crisis. Suspected cases are being received and triaged while awaiting laboratory confirmation, reflecting strengthened surveillance and response. Ituri is among historically hard-hit Ebola zones in the DRC due to forest ecosystems and continual population movement, underscoring persistent outbreak risk and the need for robust containment measures.

triage.headline_ja: イトゥリ州のエボラ：患者検出における顕著な進展が記録される - ACP
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5つすべてに該当。エボラは確認されたアウトブレイクで933例の確定患者と245人の死亡が記録されており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、および国際支援の必要性が明らかである。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病は確認されたアウトブレイクで、933例の確定患者、245例の死亡（致死率26%）、416人入院、80人回復が報告されている。イトゥリ地域は過去のエボラ流行の高リスク地域。保健当局による症例検出の強化と対応能力の拡大が進行中。DRCは対象国リストに含まれる。

article.articleHeadline: Israel checks suspected first Ebola case at Rambam hospital
article.articleSummary: Israel reported a suspected first Ebola case after a man returning from the Democratic Republic of Congo developed fever and headache and was isolated at Rambam Medical Center in Haifa. The patient is in a negative-pressure isolation room; Rambam has been designated as the national center for suspected cases, with an epidemiological investigation underway to identify contacts and laboratory testing ongoing, results expected within 24 hours. The May 2026 outbreak in DRC's Ituri region involves Bundibugyo strain, a rarer variant with no approved vaccine or specific treatment, with historical fatality rates of 30%–50%. WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17. Congo has 837 confirmed cases and 196 deaths; Uganda has reported cases. WHO risk levels: national very high, regional high, global low. Israel’s Health Ministry has maintained preparedness, issuing guidelines, stocking PPE, enabling traveler screening, and establishing diagnostic capacity.

triage.headline_ja: イスラエル、ラムバム病院で疑わしいエボラ患者の初例を検査
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WHO PHEIC宣言済みの進行中の大規模エボラ流行に関連する国際的な懸念事例。イスラエルでの疑い事例は異常・予想外であり、DRCとウガンダでの既知の流行に加えて国際的な拡大リスクを示唆する。
triage.notes: イスラエルのハイファでの疑い事例は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。DRCが主要な発生地であり、WHO PHEIC宣言（2026年5月17日）済み、Bundibugyo株（30-50%の致死率）、DRC837確認例196死亡、ウガンダでも症例報告あり。イスラエルでの検査結果は24時間以内に判明予定。

article.articleHeadline: コンゴでエボラ熱拡大懸念、避難民キャンプで30人死亡
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Concerns grow over the spread of Ebola in Congo as 30 die in refugee camps.
article.articleSummary: Bunia, in Ituri Province, northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, Ebola virus disease continues to surge after at least 30 deaths in refugee camps since early May, marking an unusually high mortality rate and potential rapid spread based on presenting symptoms. Overall, about 900 Ebola infections have been confirmed in the DRC, with more than 90% occurring in Ituri. The country hosts hundreds of refugee camps for those displaced by conflict, including sites housing around 100,000 people. WHO officials report that since the outbreak began, 75 health workers have been infected and 17 have died. The Ebola strain's persistence is juxtaposed with one of the world's lowest healthcare worker densities, roughly 11 professionals per 10,000 people, signaling severe vulnerability and ongoing transmission risk.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ熱拡大懸念、避難民キャンプで30人死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、高い死亡率、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）かつWPRO基準も全て該当。確認症例900件超、複数の難民キャンプでの集団発生、医療体制の脆弱性など重大な懸念が複数存在。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはIturi州Bunia市におけるエボラウイルス病の発生を明確に述べており、DRCが対象国リストに含まれる。確認症例数は約900件で、Ituri州に90%以上が集中。避難民キャンプという集団環境での高い死亡率（5月初旬以来30人死亡）、医療従事者感染75人（死亡17人）、極めて低い医療従事者密度（人口1万人あたり11人）など、複数の重大な懸念が存在。国際的な支援必要性が明確。

article.articleHeadline: Congo camp deaths raise fears of Ebola spread - Pakistan Today
article.articleSummary: As of June 19, 2026, at least 30 deaths have occurred since early May at Kigonze camp in Bunia, Ituri province, DRC, where over 15,000 displaced residents live, raising fears Ebola is spreading undetected. Victims reportedly exhibited headache, fever and vomiting; testing has been resisted, delaying laboratory confirmation. The outbreak was officially declared May 15, with five samples collected and awaiting results. Ituri accounts for more than 90% of the country’s nearly 900 confirmed Ebola cases. The surge in deaths follows worsening sanitation and funding cuts in camps, heightening transmission risk as bodies are inspected reluctantly. UN data show WASH funding declined to about $38 million in 2025, and this year's $80 million Ebola appeal is only 21% funded. US-backed WASH programs have been reduced, limiting access to toilets and taps for tens of thousands of displaced people; cholera is noted as a potential confounder but Ebola remains the primary concern.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのキゴンゼキャンプでの死亡例の急増、エボラ感染拡大の懸念を引き起こす
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病という重大公衆衛生上の脅威、避難民キャンプでの急速な拡大、国際的な支援不足と感染拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限の可能性。
triage.notes: 5月15日に正式宣言されたエボラ outbreak。5月初旬以降キゴンゼキャンプで少なくとも30人の死亡。15,000人以上の避難民が居住する密集したキャンプでの感染拡大リスクが極めて高い。検査抵抗により検査確認が遅延。イトゥリ州はDRC全体のエボラ確定症例の90%以上を占める。WASH資金不足（2025年$38百万から2026年への$80百万アピールのうち21%未充足）により衛生条件が悪化し、伝播リスクが増加。コレラが混在する可能性も指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: Africa CDC chief says the continent needs to invest its own funds in Ebola response, vaccine
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola in Congo and Uganda, with 894 confirmed cases since May 15 and more than 200 deaths, and up to 35,000 contacts to trace. The epicenter is Congo’s Ituri Province, where routine burials— including infants— occur amid stressed health workers, attacks by residents, and widespread skepticism. The outbreak is driven by Bundibugyo virus, for which there is no approved vaccine, while the Zaire virus— linked to Congo’s past outbreaks— has a vaccine. Africa CDC Director-General Dr. Jean Kaseya urges Africa to fund its own response and vaccine development to reduce reliance on foreign partners; the peak is expected later due to slow contact tracing and unidentified patient zero. An Africa Epidemic Fund has $80 million in pledges; a donor conference raised $910 million. Ramaphosa will visit Ituri and Uganda to mobilize funds. Africa’s vaccine manufacturing and access remain critical as the continent nears 2.5 billion people by 2050.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカCDC事務局長、エボラ対応とワクチン開発への自己資金投資が必要と述べる
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準において深刻な公衆衛生影響（894確認事例、200人以上の死亡）、異常な流行、国際的拡大リスク（複数国での発生）が該当。WPROスクリーニングでも重症度、流行容易性、管理可能性の複数基準を満たし、社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダは発生地域に含まれているが、記事サマリー上ではコンゴが主要な発生地であり、ウガンダについては接触追跡と資金動員の訪問対象として言及されているのみで、確認事例の詳細な記載がない。DRCのイトゥリ州が感染源地（epicenter）である。Bundibugyo virus（ワクチン未承認）による流行であることが重要なリスク要因。

article.articleHeadline: Epidémia eboly sa v Konžskej demokratickej republike šíri ďalej | TNLIVE.sk
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola epidemic spreads further in the Democratic Republic of the Congo | TNLIVE.sk
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) continues to spread rapidly. Since the outbreak was declared on May 15, 896 cases and 232 deaths have been confirmed in DRC, with 21 new cases in the last 24 hours. The majority of cases (about 90%) are in Ituri province, with the epidemic spreading to South Kivu and North Kivu. The outbreak has crossed into Uganda, which reports 19 cases and 2 deaths, 10 recoveries; Ugandan authorities note no new cases in 12 days. WHO warns the outbreak remains serious, but response capacity is increasing: beds for Ebola patients have risen from 0 to over 500; daily testing exceeds 2,000, with about 400 reports currently under review. Contact tracing covers 75% of known contacts; 95% tracing is needed to control transmission. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo variant, for which there is no approved vaccine or treatment.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱がコンゴ民主共和国でさらに拡大 | TNLIVE.sk
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。公衆衛生への深刻な影響（896症例、232死亡）、国際拡大（ウガンダへの越境）、異常性、渡航・貿易制限リスク。Bundibugyo型で治療法・ワクチンなし。
triage.notes: ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めず。記事はDRCでの発生が主題。Bundibugyo型エボラは稀な変異株であり、治療法・ワクチン不在は重大な懸念。接触追跡カバー率75%は目標95%に未達であり、管理可能性に課題あり。

article.articleHeadline: Rondonópolis adota novo método para monitorar e combater o mosquito da dengue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rondonópolis adopts a new method to monitor and combat the dengue-carrying mosquito.
article.articleSummary: Rondonópolis, Brazil, is deploying ovitraps via the Municipal Health Secretariat's Epidemiological Surveillance to monitor and control Aedes aegypti, the dengue, Zika, and chikungunya vector. Part of a Ministry of Health program, the effort covers about 20,000 properties in the Monte Líbano and Carlos Bezerra areas, selected for high infestation in recent years. The traps imitate breeding sites and lure females to lay eggs; after five days, materials are collected for laboratory analysis to gauge infestation levels and direct control actions. Vânia Scapini, head of Epidemiological Surveillance, says the tool enhances mosquito control and enables more efficient strategies. Even outside the rainy season, the method has identified locations needing attention. The public is urged to remove stagnant water from containers and maintain precautions year-round.

triage.headline_ja: ロンドノーポリス、デング媒介蚊の監視・駆除に新手法を採用
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルにおけるデング・ジカ・チクングニア媒介蚊（ネッタイシマカ）の監視・駆除の強化は、公衆衛生上の関心事項である。しかし記事は新しい監視技術の導入という制御可能な公衆衛生的対応が中心であり、まだ重大な流行や異常な拡大の報告はなく、現段階ではフルRRA前の情報収集が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事はロンドノーポリス（ブラジル・マット・グロッソ州）における媒介蚊監視体制の強化を報じており、デング・ジカ・チクングニアの潜在リスク地域に該当する。WPROスクリーニング基準では「長期曝露」（住民の継続的な蚊への曝露）と「流行しやすさ」（ネッタイシマカはヒト-ヒト感染ではなく媒介蚊によるため）に該当するが、現在の重篤な流行報告やIHR基準2つ以上の該当はなく、むしろ予防的な対応段階の記事。社会的関心度は不明だが、政府部門（Ministry of Health、Municipal Health Secretariat）が関与していることから政府関心は確認。続報を注視する価値がある。

article.articleHeadline: Suspected Ebola case isolated in Israel following return from DR Congo
article.articleSummary: Israel's Ministry of Health reports a suspected Ebola case isolated after returning from the Democratic Republic of the Congo. The traveler developed fever and headache three days after arrival and is under isolation at Rambam Hospital in Haifa, designated for suspected Ebola cases; this is Israel’s only suspected case. An epidemiological investigation is tracing contacts. Israel has prepared guidelines, PPE, early detection for travelers from regions, and a lab verification system. Officials urge avoiding non-essential travel to areas of transmission, notably the DRC and Uganda, and advise travelers to seek travel advice at clinics. Returning travelers from the DRC or Uganda who develop fever or other symptoms within 21 days should stay home, avoid contact, and call the Ministry of Health hotline at *5400, noting exposure. Monitoring Bundibugyo strain outbreaks in the DRC continues per WHO. Ebola transmits via contact with symptomatic individuals or contaminated fluids and has high fatality.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国からの帰国者がイスラエルで疑わしいエボラウイルス病患者として隔離
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク）に該当し、高い重症度と致死率を持つエボラ出血熱の国際移動症例であるため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはIsrael、DRC、Ugandaが含まれるが、記事の主題は『DRCから帰国した渡航者がイスラエルで疑い症例として隔立』という事象であり、実際の病原体発生地はDRCである。WPROスクリーニング基準の対象国はDRCのみに該当。患者の症状発症（発熱・頭痛）は潜伏期内（21日以内）であり、確定診断は未確定だが、サマリーに『Rambam Hospital in Haifa, designated for suspected Ebola cases』と記載され、高度なスクリーニングと隔離体制が機能している。

article.articleHeadline: Nashe.Orbita.co.il: Подозрение на первый случай Эболы в Израиле: пациент изолирован
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nashe.Orbita.co.il: Suspected first Ebola case in Israel: patient isolated.
article.articleSummary: As of 19 June 2026, Israel reports a suspected first Ebola case. A man who returned three days ago from the Democratic Republic of Congo is hospitalized with high fever and headache, isolated in a negative-pressure room at Rambam Medical Center, Haifa. Lab results are expected within 24 hours; diagnosis remains unconfirmed. An epidemiological contact-tracing investigation has begun. Ebola is transmitted via body fluids; symptoms include fever, weakness, muscle pains, GI symptoms, and, in severe cases, bleeding; no fully proven specific treatment. The northeast DRC outbreak began in May 2026, with 837 confirmed cases and 196 deaths; Uganda has reported cases as well; WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Israel has reinforced readiness, including hospital instructions, risk-zone passenger screening, and expanded diagnostic capacity. Citizens are urged to avoid nonessential travel to Congo and Uganda; returnees with illness within 21 days should seek care and report travel.

triage.headline_ja: イスラエルのエボラ疑い例：患者を隔離
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラウイルス病は極めて高い致死率を持つ一類感染症で、イスラエルでの初疑い例報告は著しく異常。DRC・ウガンダでの流行と国際的拡大リスク、WHOによるPHEIC宣言済み。
triage.notes: イスラエルはWPRO対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCでの地域流行（837確認例、196死亡）と国際的波及（ウガンダへの拡大、イスラエルへの輸入例疑い）が確認されており、既にWHOによるPHEIC宣言済み。診断未確定だが、疫学的関連性（DRC渡航歴3日前、症状発現）と臨床特徴から高リスク。

article.articleHeadline: Голод страшнее вируса: у Конго больные Эболой массово убегают с больниц
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hunger is scarier than the virus: Ebola patients in the Congo are fleeing hospitals en masse.
article.articleSummary: By late May 2026, the eastern provinces of the Democratic Republic of Congo faced a severe Ebola outbreak accompanied by famine. More than 150 patients fled treatment centers near Mongbvala, 40 km from the epicenter, abandoning quarantine amid a lack of adequate food. The outbreak has infected nearly 900 people with more than 25% fatality. Health authorities are tracing about 6,400 potential contacts, while quarantined families lose access to work and markets due to hunger. Olivier Nkakudulu, head of WFP field operations, warns that without food support, patients and their households will abandon isolation. He notes this province accounts for 90% of confirmed cases. The World Food Programme seeks $175 million, including $32 million for hospital food provisioning; budgets for aid in DRC have fallen by about a third over three years. WHO has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern; there is no vaccine for this Ebola strain.

triage.headline_ja: 飢餓はウイルスより怖い：コンゴのエボラ患者が大量に病院から逃げている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、異常・予想外な事態、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHO既に国際的懸念事項として宣言。WPRO基準も全て該当。
triage.notes: WHOが既に国際的懸念事項（PHEIC）を宣言済み。患者の隔離離脱による感染制御崩壊リスク、飢餓による社会的混乱が特徴。ワクチンなし。6,400人の接触者追跡中。既に900人近くが感染、致死率25%以上。東部州で確認例の90%が集中。国際的支援（WFP 175百万ドル要求）の必要性が差し迫っている。

article.articleHeadline: A Tribuna MT - Saúde: Rondonópolis adota novo método para monitorar e combater o Aedes aegypti
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A Tribuna MT - Health: Rondonópolis adopts a new method to monitor and combat Aedes aegypti.
article.articleSummary: Rondonópolis, Mato Grosso, Brazil, adopts ovitraps to monitor and control Aedes aegypti, vector for dengue, Zika, and chikungunya. The Municipal Health Secretariat (SMS), via Epidemiological Surveillance, joined a Ministry of Health program implementing ovitraps alongside existing vector-control actions. The traps simulate breeding sites to attract female mosquitoes to lay eggs, enabling monitoring of presence and population density.
