The initial deployment area covers about 20,000 properties from Monte Líbano to the Carlos Bezerra region, chosen for higher infestation indices over the past five years. After installation, an agent from Epidemiological Surveillance returns five days later to collect eggs; laboratories count eggs to assess regional risk. Even outside the rainy season, the method has identified points needing attention, and control measures are being reinforced.

triage.headline_ja: トリビューナ・マット - 衛生：ロンドノーポリスがネッタイシマカ監視・防除の新手法を導入
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルにおけるデング・ジカ・チクングニヤウイルスの媒介蚊（ネッタイシマカ）の監視・防除の新しい公衆衛生対策についての報道。予防的な取り組みであり、現在の発生状況の重大性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスクは直接的には述べられていない。情報不足のため、WATCH段階での経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事は媒介蚊の監視・防除プログラムの導入についての情報であり、現在進行中の発生状況やアウトブレイクの詳細は記載されていない。ブラジル保健省のプログラムに参加する地方政策の報道。過去5年間での高い感染指数が言及されているため、流行しやすい環境が存在することが示唆される。

article.articleHeadline: LIRAa de maio orienta ações de prevenção às arboviroses em Mato Grosso do Sul - Perfil News
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: May LIRAa survey guides prevention actions against arboviral diseases in Mato Grosso do Sul - Perfil News
article.articleSummary: May 2026 LIRAa rapid survey for Aedes aegypti in Mato Grosso do Sul identifies infestation levels across 76 municipalities, guiding dengue, Zika, and chikungunya prevention. The second cycle of the year shows high-risk indices (>4.0) in Eldorado (9.8), Santa Rita do Pardo (7.5), Ribas do Rio Pardo (6.6), Rio Negro (5.9), Bela Vista (5.9), Maracaju (5.6), Ponta Porã (5.3), Anastácio (5.2) and Terenos (4.7); near-threshold: Água Clara (4.1) and Camapuã (4.0). Medium risk (1.0–3.9) includes Bataguassu (3.8), Porto Murtinho (3.2), Coronel Sapucaia (3.0), Corumbá (2.8), Itaquiraí (2.7) among others. Zero indices were recorded in Ladário, Nioaque, Juti, Japorã, Dois Irmãos do Buriti and Deodápolis. Alcinópolis, Campo Grande and Dourados did not conduct the survey. Results aid prioritization for vector-control actions, house-to-house visits, and breeding-site elimination, emphasizing continuous community participation and integration with ovitrap and epidemiological data for comprehensive surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: 5月LIRAa調査がマット・グロッソ・ド・スル州のアルボウイルス病予防対策を指導
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルのマット・グロッソ・ド・スル州においてZika、Chikungunya、Dengueの蚊媒介感染症について、Aedes aegypti幼虫指数調査結果が報告されている。複数自治体で高リスク指数が記録されており、防蚊対策の必要性が示唆されているが、現時点では感染症の発生件数や死亡例についての具体的情報が記事に含まれていない。
triage.notes: 記事はAedes aegypti幼虫指数（LIRAa）調査の結果報告であり、蚊媒介感染症の予防対策を指導する公衆衛生措置の記事である。複数自治体で高リスク指数が報告されており、継続的な住民曝露リスク（prolonged_exposure）と流行可能性（epidemic_prone）が認識されている。ただし、実際の感染症患者数や重症度に関する情報は記事には含まれていないため、WATCH段階に留める。継続的な監視と続報の確認が推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: Seventy Five Healthcare Workers in DRC Contract Ebola, 17 Die - WHO
article.articleSummary: On 19 June 2026, the World Health Organization said that 75 healthcare workers involved in combating an Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo have contracted Ebola, with 17 of them dying. The statement notes that at the start of an outbreak, healthcare workers are among the first to be infected. The report underscores the ongoing risk to frontline responders in the DRC as the Ebola outbreak continues. Figures reflect infections and deaths among healthcare workers during their response. The information comes from the WHO and was reported by RIA Novosti on 19 June 2026. This underscores the need for enhanced protective measures for healthcare workers in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ対応に従事する医療従事者75人が感染、17人が死亡 - WHO
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラウイルス病は国際保健上の重大な脅威であり、医療従事者の集団感染と死亡は深刻な公衆衛生影響を示唆。国際的な拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスクも存在。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病は国際保健上の最重要脅威。医療従事者の高い感染率と死亡率は対応体制の脆弱性を示唆し、ただちにフルRRA（Rapid Risk Assessment）を実施すべき案件。DRCは対象国リストに含まれる。

article.articleHeadline: Surge of Suspected Ebola Deaths Hits Crowded Camp
article.articleSummary: At least 30 deaths since early May in the crowded Kigonze camp outside Bunia in eastern Congo have authorities worried Ebola is moving faster than surveillance can track. Many of the deceased displayed symptoms consistent with Ebola, camp leaders and aid workers told Reuters. Families have largely refused post-mortem testing, leaving the exact cause of the deaths unconfirmed. As of June 19, 2026, the spike far exceeds the usual 1–3 deaths per month in the camp, signaling a potential outbreak beyond routine monitoring. The lack of laboratory confirmation complicates understanding transmission dynamics and hampers efforts to establish a confirmed outbreak status in eastern Congo.

triage.headline_ja: 混雑したキャンプでエボラ疑い死亡が急増
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当、かつWPRO基準5項目全て該当。エボラウイルス病の疑い事例が東部コンゴの難民キャンプで急速に増加しており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、および管理可能性の課題が複合的に存在する。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから以下の重要な指標を確認：(1)5月初旬以来少なくとも30人の死亡が記録されており、通常の月1-3人を大幅に超過。(2)エボラウイルス病の症状と一致する疾患の急速な増加。(3)検査確認がなく監視システムでの追跡が困難な状況。(4)混雑した難民キャンプという高いヒト-ヒト感染リスク環境。(5)遺族による検査拒否により確定診断困難。Bunia はDRCの東部に位置し、DRC以外の地域への言及がないため verified_locations は DRC のみとした。

article.articleHeadline: Голод страшніший за вірус: у Конго хворі на Еболу масово тікають з лікарень
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hunger is scarier than the virus: Ebola patients in Congo flee hospitals en masse.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo has infected about 900 people and killed more than 25% by late May 2026. Amid a severe hunger crisis, more than 150 patients escaped from treatment centers, including 11 suspected cases who fled a hospital about 40 km from the outbreak epicenter near Mongbvalu. Health authorities are tracing roughly 6,400 potential contacts, while quarantined families lose livelihoods as markets close. Olivier Njakudulu of the World Food Programme warns that feeding those in isolation is essential; the agency seeks $175 million, including $32 million for hospital food. The outbreak accounts for over 90% of confirmed cases in the province. A poignant example: Jacques, a 52-year-old father of 14, lost his 5-year-old daughter to Ebola; his wife remains in strict isolation. WHO has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern; no vaccine exists for this strain.

triage.headline_ja: 飢餓はウイルスより恐ろしい：コンゴのエボラ患者が病院から大量に逃げ出している
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラアウトブレイク（約900人感染、致死率25%以上）、患者150人以上が治療施設から逃亡、WHO が国際懸念事項の公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）宣言済み、多数の接触者追跡困難。スクリーニング基準も全項目該当で、国際的な関心が極めて高い。
triage.notes: WHO PHEIC宣言済み。患者逃亡により感染拡大のリスク急増。飢餓危機との複合危機。約6,400人の接触者追跡中。ワクチン未開発。高い国際的懸念事項。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Cases Up Nearly 40% in Congo This Week, More than 200 Dead
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-19, Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda, caused by the Bundibugyo strain, have 894 laboratory-confirmed cases and over 200 deaths, with a 38% weekly rise concentrated in eastern DRC. The outbreak is worse than Uganda’s 2000 episode but not yet at the scale of the 2014/2018 DRC crises. Contract tracing remains weak: 17,000–35,000 contacts are estimated for 894 cases, but only about 4,000 (roughly 15%) have been traced. Africa CDC warns funding and staffing gaps hinder response; only 84 of the needed ~540 staff are deployed, and international funds released are ~10%. Safe burials and rapid contact management are critical to interrupt transmission. IFRC, MSF, and UNHCR report mistrust, hostility toward responders, and large internally displaced populations (>2 million IDPs; ~320,000 in unsanitary camps) heightening spread risk. A June 7 displacement from Mbau to Oicha illustrates ongoing transmission and a potentially protracted peak, possibly lasting up to a year.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのエボラ患者数が今週ほぼ40%増加、200人以上が死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当、かつWPRO基準5項目全て該当。エボラウイルス病の大規模アウトブレイク（894確定患者、200人以上死亡、週間38%増加）で、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダへの波及確認）、高い重症度・死亡率、コンタクトトレーシング不十分による感染拡大リスク、国際支援の緊急的必要性が全て認識される。
triage.notes: 発生地域に「Republic of Uganda」も含まれるが、サマリーではウガンダは「2000年のエピソードとの比較参照」及び「ウガンダでの感染確認」の記載は限定的である。ただしサマリー冒頭で「Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda」と記載されており、ウガンダでの確定患者数が明確でないため、DRC（北キブ州オイチャ地区を含む）を主たる検証地として設定。資金・人員不足（必要540名中84名のみ配置）、IDPの大規模存在（200万人以上）、安全な埋葬困難、住民の不信感など、対応困難要因が複数識別される。週間患者数増加率38%は急速な伝播を示唆。最大1年間の感染継続可能性言及。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : le gouvernement mise sur les centres spécialisés pour contrôler la maladie - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: The government relies on specialized centers to control the disease - ACP
article.articleSummary: Bunia, 19 June 2026 — In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Health Minister Dr. Roger Kamba urged Ebola patients be treated in dedicated treatment centers to ensure isolation, surveillance and disease-specific care, noting private facilities often lack resources for holistic management. He called for rapid referral of any suspected case to approved centers to avoid confinement in unsuitable settings. Referencing the 2019–2020 outbreak, the government plans to make all health care free during the Ebola period in Ituri, to prevent disruption of malaria and other diseases, as malaria kills over 20,000 annually. Free care will apply to facilities listed by health zones; identified providers will receive support and must report suspected cases systematically. Authorities stressed vigilance, as Ebola can lack specific signs; tests should be pursued and patients kept isolated pending results. The briefing followed a joint urgent assessment mission, the third in a month.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：政府は疾病制御のための専門センターに依存 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。WPRO基準も複数該当し、DRCでのエボラ発生は即時のフルRRA対象。
triage.notes: DRCのIturi地域でエボラ発生。2019-2020年の流行参照により過去の大規模感染が示唆される。政府による緊急対応（治療センター集約化、無償化）が進行中。マラリアとの同時流行管理も課題。3回目の緊急評価ミッション実施済みで政府関心は高い。WHOへの直接通知の可能性あり。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : le ministre de la Santé recommande aux communautés l'appropriation de la riposte - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Health Minister urges communities to take ownership of the response - ACP
article.articleSummary: On 19 June 2026 in Bunia, Ituri Province, northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo, the Health Minister urged communities to own the Ebola response. In a media briefing after meetings with civil society, customary chiefs, religious leaders, and local community figures, officials stressed stronger community involvement in Ebola containment. More than 1,200 community relays have been trained, about 1,000 deployed on the ground, with a target of 1,300 this week, to support health zones and deployed nurses in sensitization and population surveillance. The deployment aligns with the revised National Health Development Plan (PNDS) to establish a permanent, community-based epidemiological surveillance framework, enabling early detection of Ebola and other epidemic-prone diseases at the base level. The emphasis is on sustaining health-system strengthening beyond the current outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ: 保健大臣がエボラ対策への地域社会の関与を呼びかけ - ACP
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の確認事例であり、IHR基準で深刻な公衆衛生影響（Yes）と国際的拡大リスク（Yes）を満たす。DRC での確認は既知だが、能動的な対応強化と地域参加拡大の発表は重要シグナル。
triage.notes: 2026年6月19日時点でDRCのイトゥリ州ブニアでエボラ対応が進行中。記事は新規事例ではなく、政府による地域社会参加強化の発表。1,200名以上の地域リレーが訓練済み、1,000名以上が配置済み。対象国リストに該当するのはDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: Riposte contre Ebola : Le Ministre de la Santé visite l'hôpital de Bunia et célèbre la guérison de plusieurs patients - LePotentiel
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Response: The Minister of Health Visits Bunia Hospital and Celebrates the Recovery of Several Patients.
article.articleSummary: During a June 19, 2026 visit to Bunia General Reference Hospital in Ituri, Democratic Republic of the Congo, the Minister of Public Health, Hygiene and Social Welfare, with the Communications Minister, assessed the Ebola response and saluted frontline teams. The tour of triage, the molecular diagnostics lab, and the treatment center for confirmed cases reviewed epidemiological surveillance, sampling procedures, and result timelines, with officials endorsing current protocols as satisfactory. The minister stressed that rapid detection saves lives and reduces transmission, noting that earlier case identification improves outcomes. He presided over the discharge of several recovered patients, praising their resilience. He also honored health workers including doctors, nurses, lab technicians, hygiene agents, and logisticians, and pledged continued government support, transparency, and real-time information. Additional logistics and personnel will be strengthened to end the outbreak and protect Congolese citizens.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ対応：保健大臣がブニア病院を訪問し、複数の患者の回復を祝う
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の発生は深刻な公衆衛生上の懸念であり、IHR基準を満たす可能性があるが、記事は政府対応の肯定的な進展と患者の回復に焦点を当てており、新たな危機的悪化の証拠は不明である。継続的な監視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年6月19日のブニア病院への保健大臣訪問を報道しており、患者の回復と政府対応の強化について述べている。エボラウイルス病は既知の流行であり、本記事は継続中の対応を示す。ただし、新規感染者数、現在の発生状況の詳細、国際的な拡大リスクに関する情報は記事サマリーに含まれていない。DRCは対象国リストに含まれる。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : L'Union africaine et le G7 mettent la main à la poche dans la lutte contre Ebola -- La Libre Afrique
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: The African Union and the G7 open their wallets in the fight against Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo continues in the northeast, marking the 17th outbreak there in 50 years (first identified in 1976). The epicenter is Ituri, with substantial spread in Nord-Kivu and Sud-Kivu; transmission is accelerating across 33 health zones in three provinces, and Uganda is affected to a lesser extent. From Bunia in Nord-Kivu, WHO Africa director Marie Roseline Belizaire says the situation is evolving rapidly but response is strengthening. The WHO has deployed over 115 experts and delivered more than 110 tons of emergency supplies, expanding capacity to 516 beds and more than 2,000 tests per day. International funding: at the G7 Evian summit, a joint communiqué pledged mobilization against Ebola; the African Union announced 910 million dollars after a virtual leaders’ meeting. Rebels in parts of Nord- and Sud-Kivu claim Ebola-free status, noting the last patient exited a 21-day quarantine.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：エボラ対策においてアフリカ連合とG7が資金を拠出
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の継続的な流行であり、IHR基準では重篤な影響（死亡を伴う感染症）、異常性、国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダへの波及）、渡航制限リスクが全て該当。WPRO基準でも重症度、流行可能性が高く、国際支援（G7・AU）が既に動員されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで詳述されているのはコンゴ民主共和国（Ituri、Nord-Kivu、Sud-Kivu）での流行が主要。ウガンダへの「軽微な影響」言及があるが、記事の主題はコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ対策であり、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。WHO専門家115名以上の展開、国際資金動員（G7、アフリカ連合9億1000万ドル）など強い政治的関与を示唆。

article.articleHeadline: اخبارك نت | الصحة العالمية: ارتفاع إصابات إيبولا لـ 896 حالة مؤكدة و232 وفاة فى الكونغو - صوت الأمة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: Ebola infections rise to 896 confirmed cases and 232 deaths in Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-19, the World Health Organization reports 896 laboratory-confirmed Ebola infections and 232 deaths in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, linked to an outbreak driven by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, one of the Ebola species, in Central Africa. Uganda has not recorded any new infections since June 5, indicating limited effectiveness of containment measures to date. The DRC outbreak remains under close monitoring due to the rapid spread of the virus and rising fatalities. The report provides these figures for the affected region; it does not detail transmission chains or imported/exported cases. The report's figures reflect ongoing risk in the affected region.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関：エボラ感染者数が896例の確認感染者および232人の死者にコンゴで上昇
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の確認感染者896例・死者232例という深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的な懸念（ウガンダへの波及リスク）、高い死亡率という異常な状況が複合的に該当し、IHR基準3つ以上を満たすシグナルイベント。
triage.notes: ウガンダは発生地域として記載されているが、サマリーでは「6月5日以降新規感染なし」と述べられており、現在の活動的な発生地はコンゴ民主共和国のみ。Bundibugyo ebolavirus による大規模流行で高い死亡率（25.9%）を示しており、迅速なフルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Panvel Municipal Corporation Observes June As Malaria Prevention Month To Eliminate Vector-Borne Diseases By 2030
article.articleSummary: Panvel Municipal Corporation (PMC) observes June as Malaria Prevention Month under the National Vector Borne Disease Control Programme’s Malaria Elimination Strategy 2030, aiming to eliminate vector-borne diseases by 2030 within its jurisdiction. The campaign highlights malaria and other vector-borne diseases—dengue, chikungunya, Zika, Chandipura virus infection, and filariasis. Led by the PMC Medical and Health Department and Dr. Anand Gosavi, Chief Health Officer, activities run through Urban Primary Health Centres, Urban Health and Wellness Sub-Centres and Aapla Davakhana, with medical officers, nurses and ASHA workers conducting information sessions. Information materials—pamphlets, banners, calendars, stickers—are distributed alongside a detailed action plan. Mosquito-control emphasizes guppy fish for biological control, cleanliness, personal protection, nets, and eliminating stagnant water. ASHA volunteers receive training; community activities like rangoli, drawing and essay competitions boost participation. Citizens are urged to maintain cleanliness and remove standing water to prevent spread.

triage.headline_ja: パンベル市公団が2030年までにベクター媒介性疾病を排除するため、6月をマラリア予防月間と宣言
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はインドの公衆衛生機関による予防啓発キャンペーンの実施報告であり、新規の感染症アウトブレイクの発生やシグナルを示さない。IHR基準は非該当、社会的・政治的関心も低い。
triage.notes: 記事は感染症の流行報告ではなく、インドのパンベル市公団による年間予防キャンペーン（Malaria Elimination Strategy 2030）の実施状況を述べたもの。患者数、死亡数、異常な増加、国際的拡大の兆候などは記載されていない。ルーチンの公衆衛生活動として分類される。

article.articleHeadline: رصد حالة يشتبه بإصابتها بفيروس "إيبولا" في "إسرائيل" قادمة من الكونغو
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A suspected Ebola virus case in Israel arriving from Congo.
article.articleSummary: Suspected Ebola virus case in Israel, arriving from Congo. As of 2026-06-19, the patient is under strict isolation and receiving care under professional protocols and risk assessment. The individual has been transferred to Rambam Medical Center, a hospital designated as a specialist center for such rare cases. A parallel epidemiological investigation is underway to trace the patient’s movements since arrival and identify all people who had contact, allowing preventive measures to be taken to avert a potential outbreak. The response focuses on containment, rapid isolation, and thorough contact tracing, pending final diagnostic confirmation. This incident underscores ongoing vigilance for imported infectious diseases.

triage.headline_ja: イスラエルでコンゴから到着したエボラウイルスの疑い患者が報告される
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの疑い患者が報告され、IHR基準3項目に該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。コンゴからイスラエルへの輸入症例であり、厳格な隔離対応と疫学調査が進行中。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで実際の感染症発生地はコンゴであり、イスラエルは輸入症例の到着地。対象国リストに従い、DRCのみを verified_locations に含める。Bluedot APIが両国を発生地域として表示していますが、疫学的には出発地のコンゴが重要。イスラエルは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: 7 Ciri DBD pada Anak yang Tak Boleh Diabaikan Orang Tua
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 7 Signs of Dengue Fever in Children That Parents Should Not Ignore.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever (DHF) in children is outlined with seven key signs that require early medical evaluation, particularly during the rainy season when cases rise in Thailand. Sudden high fever of 39–40°C lasting longer than three days (often five to seven) is common and may be stubborn to break at home. Headache and pain behind the eyes, plus muscle, joint, and abdominal aches, frequently accompany fever. Reduced appetite, nausea, and vomiting occur, with persistent vomiting risking dehydration. A red rash or small under-skin petechiae signals possible thrombocytopenia. Nosebleeds or gum bleeding indicate bleeding risk. Restlessness, extreme lethargy, or difficulty waking suggests progression toward dengue hemorrhagic fever or dengue shock syndrome, requiring urgent hospital care. There is no specific cure; treatment focuses on adequate fluids, monitoring, and preventing complications. Information cited includes Bangkok Hospital (Thailand) and Altrus Health Care.

triage.headline_ja: 親が見逃してはいけない小児デング熱の7つの兆候
triage.triage_reason: タイでのデング熱流行期における小児患者の臨床症状に関する啓発記事。医学的には重要だが、新規アウトブレイク報告ではなく、既知の疾患の教育的コンテンツであるため、情報が不足しており要経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事はタイの雨季におけるデング熱患者増加に触れているが、具体的な現在のアウトブレイク規模、死亡数、確認患者数などの定量的データが記載されていない。啓発記事の性質上、既知の季節的流行への対応ガイダンスと考えられる。フルRRA段階では最新の疫学データ確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Во ДР Конго и Уганда со ебола се заразени 75 здравствени работници, 17 починале
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In DR Congo and Uganda, 75 healthcare workers infected with Ebola, 17 have died.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in DR Congo and Uganda remains severe. 75 healthcare workers have been infected, 17 of them have died. WHO spokesperson Marie-Roseline Belizer, in Bunia (Ituri Province, DR Congo), notes uncertainty whether infections occurred at work or in private life and emphasizes protection gaps in clinics. Of 177 surveyed clinics, only four had capacity and equipment to adequately safeguard staff. About 10% of infected individuals display bleeding-related Ebola symptoms, hindering rapid recognition. As a consequence, many patients delay seeking care at specialized centers, increasing transmission within households and small clinics. Laboratory-confirmed totals show 896 cases and 232 deaths to date. One month after outbreak declaration, the situation remains dire. WHO is deploying protective equipment (gloves, protective clothing) and staff training to even small clinics to curb further spread across the affected region.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国とウガンダでエボラに感染した医療従事者75人、17人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の展開、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。また医療従事者の高い感染率と死亡率、複数国への拡大、WHO対応の必要性からWPRO基準も複数該当。フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダは発生地域フィールドに含まれるが、記事サマリーの主題はコンゴ民主共和国のイツリ州ブニアでの感染者・死亡者統計であり、ウガンダについては見出しで言及されているも詳細情報がない。対象国リストにはDRCのみが含まれるため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。医療従事者の高い感染率（75人中17人死亡）と感染経路の不確実性は感染制御面での重大な懸念を示唆している。

article.articleHeadline: La epidemia de ébola se propaga rápidamente en la RDC, advierte la OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak is spreading rapidly in the DRC, WHO warns.
article.articleSummary: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is spreading rapidly, the World Health Organization warns. Health teams in the northeast are racing against the clock as the situation deteriorates in Ituri Province, centered on Bunia. The outbreak was declared on May 15, with transmission of the rare Bundibugyo Ebola strain having gone undetected for a period. WHO emergency head for Africa, Marie-Roseline Belizaire, says the situation remains grave and is evolving quickly, even as response measures strengthen daily. The briefing highlights ongoing containment challenges in a conflict-affected region, underscoring the need for intensified surveillance, contact tracing, and laboratory confirmation to curb spread. No case counts are provided in the report.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行がコンゴ民主共和国で急速に拡大、WHOが警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラ出血熱は高い致死性と国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスクを有し、紛争地域での急速な蔓延は深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは2026年6月19日配信であり、5月15日にIturi州Buniaを中心として宣言されたエボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo株）の流行報告。紛争地域での複雑な状況、接触者追跡の困難さ、早期未検出の期間があったことが記載されている。WHOのアフリカ緊急対応責任者による声明があり、国際的な関心が極めて高い。DRC対象国に該当。

article.articleHeadline: Congo says 933 Ebola cases confirmed, including 245 deaths
article.articleSummary: As of 19 June 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo reports 933 confirmed Ebola cases and 245 deaths in the ongoing outbreak, with 80 recovered patients discharged from Ebola treatment centres. Health Minister Samuel Roger Kamba told reporters in Ituri province, where the first cases of the outbreak were reported, that the latest tally indicates sustained transmission within the country. The update highlights the scale of Ebola activity in the DRC and the ongoing burden on treatment facilities, underscoring the need for continued public health response in Ituri and across affected districts.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴが933件のエボラ確定症例を報告、うち245人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。確定症例933件、死亡245件という深刻な公衆衛生影響、エボラウイルス病の異常な発生、国際的な拡大リスク、および渡航・貿易制限のリスクが明白である。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は極めて高い致死率を持つVHF（ウイルス性出血熱）。933確定症例、245死亡（CFR約26%）は重大な公衆衛生上の脅威。Ituri州での持続的感染伝播が報告され、国内複数地域での発生が確認されている。治療施設への負担が大きく、国際的な支援体制の構築が急務。DRCは対象国リストに含まれ（GeoNames ID 203312）、verified_locationsに列挙した。

article.articleHeadline: Congo tem 933 casos de Ebola confirmados, incluindo 245 mortes
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo has 933 confirmed Ebola cases, including 245 deaths.
article.articleSummary: As of 19 June 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 933 confirmed Ebola cases and 245 deaths in the ongoing outbreak, with 80 recoveries discharged from treatment centers. Health Minister Samuel Roger Kamba disclosed the figures in Ituri province, where the first cases of the current outbreak were registered. The update confirms continued transmission and active management of patients in Ebola treatment centers. Ituri remains the initial focal point of the outbreak. The brief does not provide additional details on infection sources or laboratory confirmation. The numbers reflect the latest official update and emphasize the ongoing risk in the region.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴで933件のエボラ確認症例、245件の死亡を含む
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）かつWPRO基準4項目該当（異常性、重症度、長期曝露、流行性）。高い死亡率と継続的な感染伝播を示す。
triage.notes: DRCはEBOLA対象国ではないため、当機構の限定スコープ外ですが、IHR基準に基づきPICKUP推奨。933確認症例、245死亡（粗症例致命率26.2%）、80名治癒という高い疾病負荷を示す。Ituri州を中心とした継続的伝播が確認。国境地帯のリスクと国際的懸念が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Antallet af ebola-smittede i DR Congo nærmer sig 1000
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of people infected with Ebola in DR Congo is approaching 1,000.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) nears 1,000 cases, with 933 laboratory-confirmed infections and 245 deaths reported as of 2026-06-19, while 80 patients have recovered. The outbreak is driven by the rare Bundibugyo ebolavirus variant, for which there is no approved treatment or vaccine. Transmission occurs via direct contact with bodily fluids from symptomatic individuals. The World Health Organization estimates a fatality rate around 30–50% for this outbreak. The epicenter is eastern Ituri province, with North Kivu and South Kivu also heavily affected. All three provinces have long endured conflict, hampering public health responses. No evidence of imported/exported cases is noted; the focus remains on containment, patient care, and surveillance within the affected region.

triage.headline_ja: DR コンゴのエボラ感染者数が 1,000 人に近づいている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準において、深刻な公衆衛生への影響（933確定症例、245死亡）、異常・予想外の病原体（Bundibugyo ebolavirus）、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスクの4基準すべてに該当。WPRO基準でも重症度・長期曝露・管理可能性で複数該当。フルRRA（Rapid Risk Assessment）に進むべき。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus は希少な変種で有効なワクチン・治療法がないため公衆衛生上の重大リスク。紛争地帯での発生により対応困難。現時点では国際的な輸出例なしと報告されているが、流行規模の急速な増加（933症例、30-50%致死率）により国境周辺国への波及リスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: ارتفاع حالات الإصابة بـ"إيبولا" في الكونغو إلى 933 منها 245 وفاة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rise in Ebola cases in the Congo to 933, of which 245 have died.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 933 confirmed cases and 245 deaths, according to Health Minister Samuel Roger Kampa. Speaking in Ituri Province, the region where the current outbreak was first reported, Kampa said 80 patients have recovered and left Ebola treatment centers. Reported on 2026-06-19, the figures reflect confirmed cases as of the latest update, with no further details on infection sources, laboratory confirmation methods, or imported/exported cases provided in the report. The update underscores the ongoing persistence of the outbreak in the DRC and the continuing response in Ituri, to protect affected communities.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ患者数が933人に増加、うち245人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準において深刻な公衆衛生影響（933確定症例、245死亡）と異常性が明確であり、国際的拡大リスク・渡航制限リスクも高い。WPRO基準でも重症度（多数の死亡）・流行のしやすさ・管理可能性の課題が認められる。フルRRAへ進むべきシグナル。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病はIHR附属書2の重篤感染症であり、933確定症例・245死亡は極めて深刻な公衆衛生事象。イトゥリ州での継続的な流行、死亡率26%超、地域内での感染持続が記述されている。国際的な懸念と支援必要性は高い。

article.articleHeadline: اشتباه بإصابة شخص بفيروس إيبولا في إسرائيل بعد عودته من الكونغو
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Suspected Ebola virus infection in a person in Israel after returning from the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: On 19 June 2026, Israel reported a suspected Ebola virus infection in a person who had returned from the Democratic Republic of the Congo. The individual sought care after fever and headache; laboratory confirmation is expected within 24 hours to confirm or rule out Ebola. The patient is isolated under infectious-disease protocols and has been moved to Rambam Health Care Campus in Haifa, designated for suspected cases of infectious diseases such as Ebola. Health authorities launched an epidemiological investigation to identify contacts since arrival and to implement preventive measures. Israel has maintained Ebola preparedness, including staff guidance, expanded PPE stocks, traveler screening from outbreak regions, and a dedicated diagnostic laboratory network. The ministry urged avoiding non-essential travel to active areas in the DRC and Uganda and advised returnees to stay home for 21 days and call the Kol HaBryiot Center at 5400 if symptoms appear.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国からの帰国者がイスラエルでエボラウイルスに感染した疑い
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの国際的移動ケース。IHR基準3項目該当（異常・予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPRO基準4項目該当。社会的・政治的関心が高い。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域にはイスラエル、ウガンダ、DRCが含まれているが、記事の主題は『DRCからイスラエルへの帰国者』である。DRCが感染源地域（アウトブレイク地域）として言及されており、対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。イスラエル、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。検査確認待ちの段階だが、エボラの国際移動ケースは高リスク。

article.articleHeadline: 非疾控中心：剛果民主共和國伊波拉疫情擴散速度超過當前應對能力
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Non-CDC Center: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is spreading faster than current response capacity.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, centered at a displaced persons camp, with cumulative cases reaching 896 and 232 deaths. About 380 patients remain in isolation or hospitalized, and 78 have recovered. Laboratory-confirmed infections are reported, reflecting ongoing transmission. Improved Ebola testing capacity since the outbreak’s start contrasts with notable gaps in contact tracing, a major bottleneck that could sustain spread and exceed current response capacity. The WHO Africa Regional Office notes the situation remains severe and evolving. In response, WHO has deployed more than 115 experts to affected areas and transported over 110 metric tons of emergency supplies to support frontline operations. No details on infection sources or imported/exported cases are provided; the emphasis is on rapid containment challenges in eastern DRC.

triage.headline_ja: 非疾控中心：剛果民主共和國伊波拉疫情擴散速度超過當前應對能力（WHO：コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱の感染拡大速度が現在の対応能力を超えている）
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な感染拡大速度、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。累計896症例・232死亡、接触者追跡の大きなギャップにより対応能力超過との評価。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病は高致死率ウイルス感染症。東部DRCの避難民キャンプを中心とした集団感染で、896症例・232死亡（致死率25.9%）の深刻な状況。接触者追跡が大きなボトルネックとなり対応能力を超過している点が特に懸念される。WHO115名以上の専門家派遣、110トン以上の緊急物資輸送により国際支援が既に実施されている。

article.articleHeadline: Nova Lima inicia nova edição do Bota-Fora do Aedes para reforçar combate à dengue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nova Lima begins a new edition of the Aedes Bota-Fora campaign to bolster the fight against dengue.
article.articleSummary: Nova Lima, Brazil, launches a new edition of the Aedes Bota-Fora campaign to eliminate potential Aedes aegypti breeding sites, the vector of dengue, chikungunya, Zika, and urban yellow fever. Starting Monday, June 22, 2026, at 9:00 local time, the citywide operation covers all districts according to a region-specific schedule. Part of ongoing arbovirus surveillance and control, the effort focuses on removing containers that collect rainwater—used tires, plastic and glass bottles, plant pots, buckets, and other receptacles—deemed likely to harbor mosquito larvae. Residents are urged to prepare by identifying items and placing them on their doorstep before collection begins. Teams of Endemic Disease Control Agents and municipal trucks will collect eligible materials. The campaign underscores public participation as essential to reducing Aedes populations.

triage.headline_ja: ノバ・リマがデング熱対策を強化するためAedes蚊駆除キャンペーンの新版を開始
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は病害防除キャンペーン（蚊の繁殖地除去）の実施告知であり、実際の感染症アウトブレイクの報告ではない。公衆衛生上の深刻な影響、異常な発症数の増加、国際的拡大リスクはいずれも示唆されていない。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル・ノバ・リマ市がデング熱対策として Aedes aegypti 蚊の繁殖地除去キャンペーンを実施するという公式な予防措置の告知である。既存のアルボウイルス監視・管理活動の一環であり、新しいアウトブレイクや異常な疾患発生を報告していない。そのため感染症シグナルスクリーニングの対象外と判定される。

article.articleHeadline: مشتبه بإصابته بفيروس إيبولا في إسرائيل
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Suspected Ebola virus infection in Israel.
article.articleSummary: Israel's Ministry of Health reported a suspected case of Ebola Virus Disease in a patient who returned to Israel from the Democratic Republic of the Congo three days earlier. The patient presented with fever and headache and is in isolation at Rambam Medical Center, the designated facility for suspected Ebola cases. Laboratory testing is underway, with results expected within 24 hours. An epidemiological investigation is under way to identify the patient's contacts. The case remains unconfirmed at this stage; authorities are monitoring and implementing standard infection-control measures. As of 19 June 2026, authorities emphasize ongoing monitoring and contact tracing.

triage.headline_ja: イスラエルでエボラウイルスの疑い症例を報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。エボラ出血熱の疑い症例であり、確定診断待ちの段階だが、高リスク病原体のため即時対応が必要。
triage.notes: イスラエルはWHO EMRO地域であり対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。感染源がDRCであり、DRCは対象国リストに含まれるため DRC のみを記載。疑い症例であり確定診断は未了だが、エボラ出血熱は PHEIC 適合性が高く、即時確認報告が必要。接触者追跡が既に開始されており、隔離措置も実施されている。

article.articleHeadline: Congo tem 933 casos de Ebola confirmados, incluindo 245 mortes
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo has 933 confirmed Ebola cases, including 245 deaths.
article.articleSummary: As of June 19, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has 933 confirmed cases and 245 deaths, according to Health Minister Samuel Roger Kamba. The Ituri province, where the first cases were registered, remains the epicenter of the outbreak, with 80 patients having recovered and been discharged from Ebola treatment centers. The briefing underscores the ongoing transmission and the continued burden on the country’s healthcare system, though it provides no details on infection sources or transmission chains. The numbers reflect the current toll and sustained activity of the outbreak in the DRC, particularly in Ituri.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴで933例のエボラ確定患者、245人の死亡を含む
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な疾患、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラウイルス病の継続的な流行は国際的関心事項。
triage.notes: 2026年6月19日現在、DRCのエボラ流行は933例の確定患者と245人の死亡を報告。Ituri州が流行の中心地。保健大臣による公式発表に基づく。エボラは国際保健規則(IHR)の重大な関心事項であり、全ての評価基準で懸念が確認された。

article.articleHeadline: Регистриран прв случај на Зика вирусот во Македонија - пациентот се заразил на Малдиви, каде бил каснат од комарец
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: First case of the Zika virus registered in Macedonia - the patient contracted it in the Maldives, where he was bitten by a mosquito.
article.articleSummary: First Zika virus infection registered in North Macedonia, an imported case contracted in the Maldives after a mosquito bite. On 17 June 2026, the Institute of Public Health’s Virology Department confirmed a positive Zika result; the patient was contacted by an epidemiologist and given preventive measures. Epidemiological data show illness from 20–28 May 2026 during a Maldives stay, with a reported mosquito bite. Initial dengue suspicion prompted testing for dengue, Zika, and chikungunya; serology and molecular testing confirmed Zika. The patient was not hospitalized and is recovering at home in good condition. Although imported, Zika circulation persists in tropical regions (Maldives, Thailand, Indonesia, Brazil, Caribbean), keeping national risk low but allowing potential new imports with travel. Transmission is primarily via Aedes mosquitoes; Aedes albopictus is widely distributed in Europe as a potential vector; pregnancy can cause fetal microcephaly and congenital abnormalities; lab confirmation is required.

triage.headline_ja: マケドニアでジカ熱ウイルスの最初の症例が登録される - 患者はモルディブで蚊に刺されて感染
triage.triage_reason: 海外渡航による輸入症例であり、国内での広がりリスクは限定的。ただし、Aedes mosquitoの欧州分布とジカ熱の重篤性（先天異常）が示唆され、続報監視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はマケドニアでの初輸入症例だが、対象国リスト外のため verified_locations には含めない。記事で言及されている流行地域のうち、対象国はタイ、インドネシア、ブラジルの3カ国。患者は軽症で入院せず自宅療養中。Aedes albopictusの欧州分布と妊娠時の胎児奇形リスクが記載されており、将来の動向注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Reuters сообщило об увеличении подтвержденных случаев заражения Эболой в ДРК до 933
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Reuters reports that confirmed Ebola cases in the DRC have risen to 933.
article.articleSummary: On 19 June 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo reports 933 confirmed Ebola cases and 245 deaths, with 80 recoveries discharged from treatment centers. The World Health Organization had on 9 June recorded 550 cases and 101 deaths, with Ituri province as the epicenter, accounting for 487 cases (94%). By 17 June, the European Union announced €493 million to support outbreak response in Central Africa, the Great Lakes region, and Uganda. The Congolese health minister said on 19 June that Ebola deaths reached 232, with about 6,000 contacts under surveillance; 78 people had recovered after two negative tests. No information is provided on the infection source or on imported or exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: ロイターが報道：DRCのエボラウイルス確認患者数が933件に増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラウイルスの確認患者933件、死亡245件という深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の急速な増加、国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダへの拡大報告、EU支援発表）、渡航・貿易制限の可能性が認められ、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが付与した発生地域にはオーストラリア（New South Wales）が含まれているが、記事サマリーではDRC、ウガンダ、中部アフリカでの発生のみ報告されており、オーストラリアでの発生は記載なし。したがってverified_locationsからは除外。本イベントは既知のDRC Ebola流行の進展報告であり、患者数・死亡数の急速な増加と地理的拡大（ウガンダでの報告）が確認される。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola accelera nella RDC: guerra e profughi alimentano il focolaio
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola accelerates in the DRC: war and refugees fuel the outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ebola accelerates in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, with spillover to Uganda. By June 17, WHO confirms 896 cases and 232 deaths across 31 health zones in the DRC; Uganda has 19 infections and 2 deaths linked to the outbreak. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a rarer variant with no approved vaccine, drives the outbreak declared May 15 and centered in Ituri, with spread to Nord Kivu and Sud Kivu. War and displacement hinder response: eastern DRC hosts over 2 million IDPs and over 320,000 refugees; cross-border movement includes Uganda, Rwanda, Burundi, Tanzania, South Sudan. UN agencies urge a ceasefire to allow lifesaving aid. Response features 115 experts deployed and 110+ tonnes of supplies; beds rose from 0 to over 500, and labs can run over 2,000 tests per day. Contact tracing target 95% but about 75% achieved; pregnant-women mortality can reach 90% without care; 153 midwives deployed. Funding: UNFPA $17.1M, UNHCR $14M, Uganda response $15.8M.

triage.headline_ja: エボラが DRC で加速：戦争と難民がアウトブレイクを助長
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つすべてに該当。Bundibugyo ebolavirusによるアウトブレイク、複数国での確認、高い死亡率（25.8%）、難民・IDPの移動による地域拡大リスク、および複数国への越境拡大が確認されている。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirusは承認ワクチンなしのより希少な変種。妊娠女性の致死率は治療なしで90%に達する可能性あり。戦争・難民移動により感染制御が大幅に困難化。越境リスク高し。記事はウガンダでの19感染確認を述べているが、現地ソース確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: OMS Alerta Para Doenças Transmitidas Por Alimentos Que Afetam 600 Milhões De Pessoas Por Ano
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Alerts About Foodborne Diseases That Affect 600 Million People Each Year
article.articleSummary: 600 million people worldwide contract Foodborne Diseases (FBDs) annually, causing about 420,000 deaths, according to the World Health Organization. In Brazil, warm conditions heighten microbial growth, underscoring hygiene and storage from purchase to cooking. Nutritionist Jussara Pessoa of UNINASSAU Recife recommends separating raw meats from fruits, vegetables, fish, and poultry to prevent cross-contamination, and ensuring meats reach at least 74°C during cooking. Kitchen surfaces should be cleaned with sodium hypochlorite. Perishables require refrigeration with separate, covered containers; peeled items should not be stored with unpeeled ones, and eggs, milk, cheese, and yogurt belong away from the fridge door. Do not store raw and cooked foods for prolonged periods. For produce, wash under running water, scrub with a brush, rinse, soak in a hypochlorite solution (1 tablespoon per liter) for 15 minutes, then rinse again before consumption. Inadequate practices raise risks of salmonellosis, leptospirosis, and helminth infections.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、年間6億人に影響する食品由来疾患について警告
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は食品衛生に関する一般的な啓発記事であり、特定の感染症アウトブレイクの報告ではない。レプトスピラ症は言及されるが、実際の発生事例ではなく潜在的リスク要因としての記載である。
triage.notes: Bluedotが抽出したBrazilはサマリーに地理的背景として記載されているが、アウトブレイク事例の報告ではなく、WHOによる食品衛生教育キャンペーンの記事である。対象国リストにBrazilが含まれていても、実際の感染症イベント（アウトブレイク、クラスタ、患者増加など）の報告がないため検証対象外とした。

article.articleHeadline: الكونغو الديمقراطية: ارتفاع إصابات إيبولا إلى 933 حالة و245 وفاة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo: Ebola cases rise to 933, with 245 deaths.
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Ebola confirmed cases have risen to 933 with 245 deaths; 80 patients have recovered. The outbreak began in Ituri, where first cases were reported. Modelling from U.S. health experts estimates total cases could reach roughly 10,000 to over 20,000, depending on detection, isolation, and intervention effectiveness. Public health leaders warn that without strengthened surveillance and response, the outbreak could spread widely, echoing West Africa’s 2014–2016 epidemic of more than 28,000 cases and 11,000 deaths. In response, the WHO and Africa CDC launched a joint $518 million plan to prepare for and respond to Ebola caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, from June to November 2026, aiming to bolster surveillance, testing, medical supplies, health worker protection, and community engagement in the DRC and Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：エボラ患者数が933人に増加、死亡者245人
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当する。エボラウイルス病の大規模流行であり、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダでの警戒体制）、および渡航・貿易制限の可能性が明らかである。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCのイトゥリ州が主要な発生地域として特定されている。ウガンダについても言及されているが、記事の主題はDRCでの発生流行に焦点が当たっており、ウガンダは準備・警戒体制の文脈での記載であるため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを列挙。死亡数245、推定最大2万例以上の規模、WHO/Africa CDCによる518百万ドルの対応計画、2014-2016年西アフリカ流行との比較言及により、国際的関心が極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: ارتفاع حالات الإصابة المؤكدة بـإيبولا في الكونغو إلى 933.. منها 245 وفاة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rise in confirmed Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo to 933, with 245 deaths.
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Health Minister Samuel Roger Kampa said on Friday that confirmed Ebola virus disease (EVD) cases have risen to 933, with 245 deaths. Speaking to reporters in Ituri Province, where the outbreak’s first cases were reported, Kampa noted that 80 patients have recovered and been discharged from Ebola treatment centers. The figures indicate ongoing transmission and a continuing response in eastern DRC. The report provides case and death counts but does not detail laboratory confirmation methods, infection sources, or any imported/exported cases. The update underscores the persistent burden of the Ebola outbreak in Ituri and surrounding areas.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ確認感染者数が933人に増加、うち245人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラは重症度が高く（死亡率26%）、DRCでの継続的な流行であり、国際的な感染拡大リスク（歴史的先例あり）および渡航・貿易制限の対象となりやすい病原体である。
triage.notes: 記事では933例の確認症例と245例の死亡が報告されており、回復退院者は80例。Ituri Province での継続的な伝播を示唆。ただし、ラボ確認方法や感染源、国際的な流入/流出例の詳細は記載されていない。エボラウイルス病は対象国リスト外のDRCで発生しているが、「対象国」制限の目的（地域的な監視ネットワーク）を考慮し、このシグナルは確実にピックアップされるべきである。

article.articleHeadline: الكونغو.. ارتفاع الإصابات بفيروس إيبولا إلى 933 منها 245 وفاة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo: Ebola infections rise to 933, with 245 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo have risen to 933 confirmed cases with 245 deaths. In Ituri, where the current outbreak was first reported, health authorities confirmed the rise and said about 80 patients have recovered and were discharged from Ebola treatment centers. The World Health Organization reported that 75 health workers have been infected, with 17 fatalities since the outbreak began. The outbreak is caused by the rare Bundibugyo strain and is unfolding in a conflict-affected region, complicating efforts to trace contacts, isolate cases, and maintain public trust. The virus has now spread to three provinces. On May 17, WHO declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, underscoring its international relevance amid security challenges, population displacement, and response constraints.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：エボラ感染者が933人に増加、死亡者245人
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WHOがPHEICを宣言。複数州への拡大、高い死亡率、国際的懸念が確認されたため。
triage.notes: WHOがPHEIC宣言済み。Bundibugyo株による稀なアウトブレイク。紛争地域での発生により接触者追跡・隔離が困難。保健労働者75人感染、17人死亡。3州に拡大。国際的レスポンスが必要とされている。

article.articleHeadline: Ca nhiễm Ebola tăng nhanh, hơn 230 người chết ở CHDC Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola cases rise rapidly, more than 230 people dead in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has surged to 896 infections and 232 deaths, with at least 74 recoveries, according to Reuters updates on June 19, 2026. The epicenter is Ituri province in eastern DRC, accounting for more than 90% of cases, with a 38% week-over-week rise reported by CDC Africa on June 18. Authorities warn up to about 35,000 contacts may exist, but tracing has reached only around 4,000. Field operations are strained by political tensions, funding gaps, and staffing shortages (CDC Africa estimates 540 healthcare workers needed vs. 84 on the ground; commitments exceed $900 million, yet about $90 million disbursed). The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain; no vaccine or approved treatment exists. Researchers are pursuing experimental monoclonal antibodies, with WHO estimating 7–9 months before a vaccine could enter human trials.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ感染者が急速に増加、コンゴ民主共和国で230人以上が死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、重大な公衆衛生上の脅威を示す。WPRO基準も5つすべて該当。未制御のエボラ流行の急速な拡大は国際的な懸念事項。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは2026年6月19日時点でコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）のイトゥリ州を中心とした896人の感染者と232人の死亡を報告。ワクチン及び承認された治療法の不存在、医療人材の深刻な不足（必要540名に対し84名）、接触者追跡の遅れ（4000人/35000人予想）など、管理可能性が極めて低い。Bundibugyo Ebola virus株による流行であり、国際的な支援と介入が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Число умерших от Эболы в ДР Конго достигло 245 человек
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola death toll in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 245.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: 933 confirmed cases and 245 deaths in the current outbreak, with 80 patients discharged after recovery, as reported by Health Minister Samuel Roger Kamba in Ituri province, where the outbreak’s initial cases were detected. The update confirms ongoing transmission in DRC and identifies Ituri as the outbreak’s origin. Separately, infectious disease specialist Dr. Darya Namazova said the risk of spread to Russia and other developed countries remains low. All figures are laboratory-confirmed and reflect the ministry’s status updates as of 20 June 2026.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ死者数が245人に達した
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目以上該当。エボラウイルス病は公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスクを満たし、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 発生地域にロシア連邦が含まれているが、サマリーでは『ロシア及び先進国への拡大リスクは低い』と述べられており、実際の発生地はDRCのイトゥリ州のみ。エボラ病例933件、死者245人の大規模な継続的流行であり、国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念事項。

article.articleHeadline: ارتفاع جديد في إصابات ووفيات "إيبولا" في الكونغو والفيروس يصل إلى إسرائيل
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A new surge in Ebola infections and deaths in the Congo, and the virus has reached Israel.
article.articleSummary: As of 19 June 2026, the Congo reports 933 confirmed Ebola cases and 245 deaths, with 80 recoveries in Ituri where the outbreak began. Israel has a suspected Ebola case: a traveler returned from the DRC three days ago, in isolation at Rambam Medical Center; tests are underway with results within 24 hours and contact tracing is ongoing. A Nature Microbiology study shows Ebola can persist in immune-privileged sites—testes and the CNS—after recovery, demonstrated in human brain organoids, with infection of multiple neural cell types for up to 120 days and spread by cell-to-cell transmission or budding. The study notes potential viral mutations and urges more work on less-understood strains like Bundibugyo driving Africa's current outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ感染者と死亡者が新たに増加、ウイルスがイスラエルに到達
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの多国間拡大（DRC→イスラエル）、高い死亡率（245/933）、免疫特性部位での長期感染による再発リスク証拠があり、IHR基準3項目以上該当。国際的な公衆衛生上の重大リスク。
triage.notes: イスラエルは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。DRCでの933例・245死亡という高い症例数と、脳・精巣などの免疫特性部位での最大120日間の持続感染が確認されており、再発・二次感染リスクが極めて高い。イスラエルでの疑い例報告は国際的な関心を大きく高めている。

article.articleHeadline: Более 240 человек погибли в Конго от лихорадки Эбола: подтверждено уже не менее 933 случаев заражения
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 240 people have died in the Democratic Republic of the Congo from Ebola virus disease: at least 933 cases of infection have already been confirmed.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo reports at least 933 confirmed Ebola virus disease cases and 245 deaths as of June 19, 2026, yielding a 26% case fatality rate. Health Minister Samuel Roger Kamba said 416 people are hospitalized, with 80 recovered and discharged, signaling progress in outbreak response. The outbreak is ongoing, with substantial activity and continued control efforts. In Russia, the risk of Ebola remains low; infection is possible only through travel to Africa or contact with an infected person, as natural reservoirs of the virus exist in African countries.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴで240人以上がエボラ熱で死亡：933件以上の感染が確認済み
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。933確認症例、245死亡、26%致死率により公衆衛生への深刻な影響が明白。エボラウイルスは異常・予想外の高致死性イベント。国際的拡大リスク（記事にロシアへの言及あり）および渡航制限のリスク有り。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの主題はDRCでのエボラ発生。ロシアは言及されているが、イベント発生地ではなくリスク評価の参考情報として記載されているため除外。DRCはシグナルの対象国リストに含まれる。オンゴーイングアウトブレイク、416人が入院中、80人が回復・退院。進行中の制御対応あり。

article.articleHeadline: إسرائيل: اشتباه بإصابة شخص بإيبولا بعد عودته من الكونغو الديمقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Israel: Suspected Ebola infection in a person after returning from the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Israel reports a suspected Ebola case in a patient who recently returned from the Democratic Republic of the Congo three days earlier. The patient developed fever and headache, is hospitalized at Rambam Medical Center in isolation, with confirmatory tests due within 24 hours; an epidemiological investigation and contact tracing are underway. In the DRC, Ebola has 933 confirmed cases and 245 deaths, with about 80 recoveries; initial cases were in Ituri. US-led modeling projects possible outbreaks ranging from roughly 10,000 to over 20,000 infections, depending on case finding and isolation effectiveness, echoing fears of a West Africa-scale resurgence (2014–2016: >28,000 cases, ~11,000 deaths). International response includes a joint plan by WHO and Africa CDC worth $518 million (June–November 2026) to bolster surveillance, testing, medical supplies, health-worker protection, and community engagement in the DRC and Uganda to contain Bundibugyo virus.

triage.headline_ja: イスラエル：民主共和国コンゴから帰国した者がエボラに感染した疑い
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当。エボラウイルスの国際的拡大（DRCから他国への輸入症例）、重症度の高さ、DRCでの大規模流行（933確認例、245死亡）、および国際的な対応体制の構築により、フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: イスラエルでの疑似症例は輸入症例であり、主要な発生地はDRC（Ituri地域）。記事はDRCでの933確認例と国際的流行への懸念を強調しており、WHO・Africa CDCによる5億1,800万ドル規模の緊急対応計画が進行中。確定診断待機中であるが、DRCにおける持続的な曝露と国際的拡大リスクは極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Более 930 зараженных и 245 смертей: лихорадка Эбола в Конго набирает обороты
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 930 infected and 245 deaths: Ebola fever in Congo is gaining momentum.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo confirms 933 Ebola virus disease cases and 245 deaths, as of June 20, 2026, a 26% case fatality with 416 hospitalized and 80 recovered. Health Minister Samuel Roger Kamba stated at a Bunia briefing that progress results from active contact tracing and rising public trust, with hospital capacity for Ebola patients expanded to 516 beds and additional treatment centers being scaled up. The outbreak is centered in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with spillover cases and deaths reported in neighboring Uganda. Russia donated 7,000 Ebola diagnostic tests to Congo, the DPRK, and Turkmenistan, while scientists from the Central Research Institute of Epidemiology (Rospotrebnadzor) developed a novel test system in four days, showing effectiveness in field conditions within ten days.

triage.headline_ja: 930人以上が感染、245人が死亡：コンゴのエボラ熱が勢いを増している
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病の大規模流行により、深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的な拡大リスク（ウガンダへの波及、複数国への支援供与）、渡航・貿易制限のリスクが明らかである。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは、エボラウイルス病の発生地がDRC（Bunia）を中心とし、ウガンダへの波及を報告している。Bluedot APIが付与したロシア連邦・トルクメニスタン・朝鮮民主主義人民共和国は、診断キット寄付やワクチン開発支援の文脈であり、実際の発生地ではないため除外した。DRCのみが対象国リストに含まれるため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。

article.articleHeadline: Jump Into the DNI COVID File Release: Our Group's Bat-CoV Clues - Film Daily
article.articleSummary: Declassified DNI COVID-01 release presents a bat coronavirus study in China (2008–2015). The group collected 817 RdRp sequences—491 Alpha-CoV and 326 Beta-CoV—from multiple Chinese sites. A host–virus phylogeography analysis was applied to the RdRp dataset to infer probable source regions of origin or diversity within China, providing a geographic prior for emergence modeling. The release emphasizes that sequences are fragmentary RdRp data, not full genomes, and the final inferred areas are not disclosed in the text. The release ends before the first recognized human cases linked to SARS-CoV-2, keeping it temporally distinct from outbreak investigations. No coordinates are provided; future releases or tables may supply them. The owner group is named, enabling cross-checks with publications and grants. This evidence can inform comparisons of lab-origin versus natural-spillover hypotheses without claiming a specific site.

triage.headline_ja: DNI COVID ファイル公開にジャンプ：グループのコウモリ-CoV 手がかり
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は2008-2015年の過去の自然界コウモリコロナウイルス調査に関する機密解除文書の学術的レビューであり、現在進行中の感染症イベント、患者発生、流行、または公衆衛生上の緊急事態ではない。また、動物に限定された過去のデータ分析報告であり、IHRスクリーニング基準を満たさない。
triage.notes: 本記事は過去の学術的なコウモリウイルス研究データの文書公開についての報道であり、現在の感染症発生イベントではない。動物由来ウイルスの历史的系統発生解析であり、人間への感染拡大や公衆衛生上の直接的な脅威を示す内容ではない。対象国として特定された国がないため verified_locations は空配列となる。

article.articleHeadline: El Nino dan Cuaca Ekstrem Diwaspadai Picu Kasus DBD pada 2027, Kenaikan Suhu Jadi Penyebab
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: El Niño and Extreme Weather to Be Monitored as Triggers for Dengue Fever Cases in 2027, Temperature Rise as the Cause.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever (DBD) cases in Jakarta, Indonesia, are expected to rise from late 2026 with a potential spike in early 2027 due to dry-season conditions and El Niño, according to the DKI Jakarta Health Department. The 10-year calendar shows Jakarta’s DBD peak in 2024, with declines in 2025–2026; signs of uptick appear by late 2026, with January–February 2027 forecast higher. Both dry and wet seasons pose risk as Aedes aegypti breeds in small water. Global warming further drives dengue globally; more countries, including Indonesia, Southeast Asia, South Asia, and Latin America, report cases. Takeda’s Andreas Gutknecht cites a 2026 dengue burden in Indonesia of Rp 9 trillion. Prevention remains crucial for everyone in Indonesia.

triage.headline_ja: エルニーニョと極端な気象がデング熱の2027年の流行を引き起こす懸念、気温上昇が原因
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の今後の流行予測に関する記事だが、現在進行中の具体的な流行・アウトブレイクではなく、専門家による2027年の予測報道である。社会的関心はあるが、現在の緊急的なシグナルではなく継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は現在のアウトブレイクではなく、2027年の流行予測に関する予防啓発記事である。インドネシアの保健当局が気候変動要因（エルニーニョ）によるデング熱流行リスクを警告している。現時点では症例報告や具体的な流行兆候ではなく、環境因子による将来予測であるため、フルRRA対象には至らず継続監視（WATCH）とした。

article.articleHeadline: Количество смертельных случаев от вируса Эбола в ДР Конго возросло до 245 - Новости на Вести.ru

The Financial Times views the Congo outbreak as more than a local emergency, describing it as a potential 'general rehearsal' for a future worldwide pandemic.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラウイルスによる死亡数が245人に増加

article.articleHeadline: ارتفاع عدد الوفيات بفيروس "إيبولا" بالكونغو الى 245 حالة

article.articleHeadline: Casos graves de tuberculose mais que dobram no HC-UFTM em dois anos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Severe tuberculosis cases more than double at HC-UFTM in two years.
article.articleSummary: Tuberculosis (TB) at HC-UFTM, the reference center for severe TB in 27 municipalities of the Triângulo Sul, rose from 23 cases in 2023 to 47 in 2024 (a 104.3% increase); 2021–2025 shows a 135% accumulated rise. By April 2026, 19 new notifications had been recorded. The hospital notes many patients present with advanced disease, though most TB could be diagnosed and treated in primary care; hospital admission is for severe forms or complex investigations. TB can affect organs beyond the lungs, including pleural, lymphatic, bone, abdominal, genitourinary, pericardial, meningoencephalic, and miliary forms. Brazil reports over 84,000 new TB cases and about 6,000 deaths annually. BCG vaccination via SUS remains key to preventing severe manifestations in children, though it does not fully prevent pulmonary TB. Multidrug-resistant TB requires longer, specialized care and adherence support.

article.articleHeadline: Увеличилось число умерших от Эболы в ДР Конго

article.articleHeadline: تفشي مرعب للفيروس.. الكونغو تُعلن 933 إصابة مؤكدة بإيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Terrifying outbreak of the virus... Congo announces 933 confirmed Ebola infections.
article.articleSummary: As of 19 June 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo reports 933 confirmed Ebola virus infections, signaling a severe and expanding outbreak. The transmission continues in remote areas, where difficult access, weak health infrastructure, and community fears hinder containment, vaccination, and outreach. Health authorities maintain 24/7 surveillance to trace transmission chains, isolate suspected cases, and accelerate diagnosis. Public health efforts emphasize expanding preventive vaccination in the most affected zones, reinforcing frontline health centers with essential medical supplies, and deploying rapid response teams. Ebola, a filovirus transmitted through contact with infected body fluids, typically presents with fever, extreme fatigue, and muscle pains; progression can include internal and external bleeding. Congolese authorities, with international partners, are intensifying community awareness and vaccination campaigns to curb spread and prevent geographic expansion.

triage.headline_ja: 恐ろしいウイルスの流行...コンゴが933件のエボラ確認感染を発表

article.articleHeadline: В ДР Конго число смертей от лихорадки Эбола возросло до 245
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the DR Congo, the death toll from Ebola fever has risen to 245.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-19, Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, centered in Bunia, Ituri Province, has 933 confirmed cases and 245 deaths (case fatality 26%). Four hundred sixteen patients are hospitalized and 80 have recovered. Public health authorities report progress, noting improved diagnostic capacity, increasing trust in medical facilities, and systematic contact tracing that identifies more cases, with more residents seeking care at specialized centers. Ebola-care bed capacity has expanded to 516 beds, and ongoing expansion of treatment centers is planned. No details on infection source or imported/exported cases are provided. Health authorities emphasize continued monitoring and capacity-building in Bunia and Ituri Province.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ熱による死亡者数が245人に増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPRO基準も5項目すべて該当。エボラ出血熱は確認されたアウトブレイク（933症例、245死亡、致命率26%）であり、深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスクを有し、シグナルとしてフルRRAに進める必要がある。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱の確認されたアウトブレイク。ブニア（イトゥリ州）を中心に933確認症例、245死亡を報告。公衆衛生当局は診断能力の向上、医療施設への信頼向上、接触追跡の進展を報告。治療床容量516床に拡大。感染源や輸入・輸出症例の詳細は不明。DRCは対象国に含まれていないため、アフリカ地域の重大シグナルとして優先度付けが必要。

article.articleHeadline: Báo động số nhân viên y tế tử vong do dịch Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Alarm over the number of healthcare workers who died from Ebola.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-20, Ebola Bundibugyo outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda has infected more than 60 healthcare workers, with 34 deaths. This underlines the severe risks faced by medical staff during patient care and outbreak containment. African leaders announced a $910 million funding package to strengthen response, including $80 million from AU member states, to accelerate emergency operations, enhance surveillance, and improve early case detection and preparedness in affected and high-risk countries. The African Union aims to bolster cross-border coordination and rapid public health actions. WHO notes Ebola can have up to a 50% case fatality rate; the Bundibugyo strain, first identified in Uganda in 2007, currently lacks a widely licensed vaccine, making early detection, contact tracing, and infection control essential. AU emphasizes resilient health systems to ensure no member country is left behind in this regional outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱で死亡した医療従事者の数に関する警報
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、また死亡事例・複数国での拡大・医療対応の困難性が確認されるため、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCとウガンダの両国が言及されているが、ウガンダ（GeoNames ID 226074）は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。60人以上の医療従事者感染、34人の死亡、ケースファタリティレート最大50%、ワクチン未承認のブンディブギョエボラ株という極めて高リスク要因により、PICKUP判定。

article.articleHeadline: 非疾控中心：剛果民主共和國伊波拉疫情擴散速度超過當前應對能力
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Non-CDC Center: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is spreading faster than the current response capacity.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo reports an Ebola outbreak with 896 cumulative cases and 232 deaths as of June 20, 2026. About 380 patients remain in isolation or hospitalized, with 78 recoveries. Africa Centers for Disease Control notes that while Ebola testing capacity has improved since the outbreak’s start, contact tracing remains the principal bottleneck, potentially allowing continued transmission and outpacing current response capacity. The WHO Africa Regional Office emergency lead says the situation remains severe and evolving. WHO has deployed more than 115 experts to affected areas and transported over 110 tons of emergency supplies to support frontline actions. The report highlights the critical need for rapid contact tracing and effective isolation to curb transmission in this ongoing outbreak. Keywords: Ebola, Democratic Republic of the Congo, outbreak, public health response, contact tracing.

triage.headline_ja: 非疾控中心：コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ疫情の拡散速度が現在の対応能力を超えている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目すべてに該当。大規模なエボラアウトブレイク（累計896例、死亡232例）で、接触者追跡が主な課題となり対応能力を超えている。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病の大規模アウトブレイク。WHO、アフリカCDCが対応に当たっているが、接触者追跡の不十分さが対応能力を上回っており、更なる国際支援が必要。記事サマリーから対象国リストに含まれる発生地がDRCのみ確認されたため、verified_locationsはDRCのみを記載。

article.articleHeadline: Число умерших от Эболы в ДР Конго выросло до 245
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola death toll in DR Congo has risen to 245.
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak: 933 confirmed cases and 245 deaths (26% case fatality), as reported by Health Minister Samuel Roger Kamba at a briefing. Inpatient load stands at 416, with 80 recoveries discharged from treatment centers. The figures refer to laboratory-confirmed Ebola infections in the Democratic Republic of Congo; no infection source details are provided. The Ministry notes an ongoing outbreak response with continued hospitalizations and patient management. International support continues; Russia's Rospotrebnadzor has supplied more than 7,000 Ebola test systems and is assisting response efforts in Uganda and the DRC. No information is given on imported or exported cases. Data reflect the situation as of 2026-06-20.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラによる死者数が245人に増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、国際的対応の証拠）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度と長期曝露が顕著。国際支援が既に展開中であり、シグナルとして確実に識別される。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ集団発生を主題としており、933件の確認症例と245人の死亡（26%の症例致命率）を報告。ウガンダへの言及はロシアによる国際的な支援活動の文脈であり、ウガンダでの独立した発生は記載されていないため、verified_locationsに含めない。Bluedot APIが Russian Federation を発生地域に含めているのは誤りと判定（記事はロシアの支援活動のみ言及）。

article.articleHeadline: アフリカ・コンゴ民主共和国で「エボラ出血熱」の感染が拡大→その理由がこの世の終わりだった・・・ : オレ的ゲーム速報＠刃
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Africa's Democratic Republic of the Congo, Ebola hemorrhagic fever infections are spreading — the reason was that it was the end of the world...: Ore-teki Game Sokuhō @ Yaiba
article.articleSummary: Ebola hemorrhagic fever continues to spread in the Democratic Republic of the Congo as of 2026-06-20, with containment jeopardized by misinformation. Doctors Without Borders’ tent isolation facility was set on fire by an unidentified individual, and 18 patients escaped, leaving the facility deserted. Police used firearms and tear gas to counter crowds attempting to seize the coffin of a deceased Ebola patient. A local health worker, 28-year-old Etomu, reports that some residents deny Ebola’s existence, and post-COVID vaccine distrust on social media is fueling rumors that Ebola is not real. The report highlights how misinformation and security challenges undermine outbreak response and containment efforts at isolation sites amid the ongoing Ebola outbreak in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ・コンゴ民主共和国で「エボラ出血熱」の感染が拡大→その理由がこの世の終わりだった・・・
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラ出血熱は深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスクを有し、DRCでの感染拡大と隔離施設の機能障害は異常・予想外。WPRO基準も複数該当し、国際支援が必要と判断される。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに偽情報（conspiracy theory的な見出しの「この世の終わり」）が含まれるが、本体の実質内容はDRCにおけるエボラ出血熱の実際の拡大、隔離施設の放火による18患者逃亡、警察と群衆の衝突、ワクチン不信に基づく否定主義が蔓延する状況を報告している。これらは極めて深刻な公衆衛生上の危機。患者脱出と隔離機能の瓦解により、さらなるヒト-ヒト感染拡大と国際的波及の高いリスクが存在する。

article.articleHeadline: WHO beri amaran Ebola 'pantas' merebak di DR Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO warns that Ebola could spread rapidly in DR Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), centered in Ituri with spread to North Kivu and South Kivu. As of 20 June 2026, 896 laboratory-confirmed cases and 232 confirmed deaths, with 21 new cases in the last 24 hours. Caused by the Bundibugyo ebolavirus (rare), there is no vaccine or specific treatment. Declared 15 May; transmission believed to have begun earlier. Ituri accounts for over 90% of known cases. Health facilities expanded from zero beds to over 500. Surveillance handles ~400 alerts and >2,000 daily tests. Contact tracing reaches ~75% of contacts (WHO target 95%). Delays in care entry noted, with patients first seeking traditional healers. 78 recovered; 75 health workers infected, 17 dead. A Chinese medical team has arrived in Kinshasa en route to Bunia. Uganda reports 19 cases, 2 deaths, 10 recoveries; no new cases in 12 days. The UN migration agency cites >1 million health screenings at borders/corridors to detect potential cases.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱の急速な拡散を警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も全項目で該当。エボラ出血熱は公衆衛生への重大な影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスクを有する。既に複数地域での流行と隣国ウガンダへの拡大が確認されている。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo ebolavirus）による重大な流行。2026年6月19日現在、確認症例896例、死亡232例。Ituri州が全症例の90%以上。ウガンダへの越境例（19例、死亡2例）が確認されており国際的拡大が進行中。中国医療チームの派遣、UN国際移住機関による100万件以上の国境スクリーニング実施など、国際的対応が進行中。ワクチン・特異的治療法がない状況での急速拡大が懸念される。
